import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getVerifiedQuoteByCode } from "../../../../lib/server-quote-store";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ code: string }> }
) {
  const { code } = await context.params;
  const record = getVerifiedQuoteByCode(code);
  if (!record) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "Teklif kaydı bulunamadı veya imza doğrulaması başarısız." },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    quote: record,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  parseAndMigrateProject,
  migrateV3ProjectToV4,
  evaluateProjectCompatibility,
  type DesignProject,
} from "@birim/core";
import { generateBOMForProject } from "@birim/manufacturing";
import { calculateProjectPrice } from "@birim/pricing";
import { generateQrCodeSvg } from "../../../lib/qr-svg";
import { encodeSharePayloadBase64Url } from "../../../lib/quote-codec";
import { generateShortQuoteCode, saveVerifiedQuote } from "../../../lib/server-quote-store";

const MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 1_500_000;
const MAX_ALLOWED_DISCOUNT_PCT = 25;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const rawBody = await req.text();
    if (rawBody.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Proje verisi izin verilen maksimum boyutu (1.5 MB) aşıyor." },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    const body = JSON.parse(rawBody) as {
      project?: unknown;
      requestedDiscountPercent?: number;
      requestedInstallments?: number;
      clientReportedTotalEur?: number;
    };

    if (!body || !body.project) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Doğrulanacak proje verisi eksik." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const parsed = parseAndMigrateProject(body.project);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: `Şema doğrulama hatası: ${parsed.error}` },
        { status: 422 }
      );
    }

    const cleanProject = migrateV3ProjectToV4({
      ...parsed.data,
      status: "draft",
    } as DesignProject);

    // Server-side authoritative BOM, Compatibility, and Pricing recomputation (client price is NEVER trusted)
    const serverBom = generateBOMForProject(cleanProject);
    const serverPricing = calculateProjectPrice(serverBom);
    const compat = evaluateProjectCompatibility(cleanProject);

    const safeDiscountPct = Math.max(
      0,
      Math.min(
        MAX_ALLOWED_DISCOUNT_PCT,
        Number.isFinite(body.requestedDiscountPercent)
          ? Number(body.requestedDiscountPercent)
          : 0
      )
    );
    const safeInstallments = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.min(
        18,
        Number.isFinite(body.requestedInstallments)
          ? Math.round(Number(body.requestedInstallments))
          : 1
      )
    );

    const discountedTotalEur = Number(
      (serverPricing.totalWithVatEur * (1 - safeDiscountPct / 100)).toFixed(2)
    );
    const clientMismatch =
      typeof body.clientReportedTotalEur === "number" &&
      Math.abs(body.clientReportedTotalEur - serverPricing.totalWithVatEur) > 1.0;

    const code = generateShortQuoteCode();
    const now = new Date();
    const expires = new Date(now.getTime() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const totalSheetsCount = (serverBom.nestingResults || []).reduce(
      (sum, nr) => sum + (nr.totalSheetsCount || 0),
      0
    );

    const saved = saveVerifiedQuote({
      code,
      projectId: cleanProject.id,
      projectTitle: cleanProject.title,
      version: cleanProject.version,
      createdAt: now.toISOString(),
      expiresAt: expires.toISOString(),
      discountPercent: safeDiscountPct,
      installments: safeInstallments,
      serverVerifiedSubtotalEur: serverPricing.subtotalEur,
      serverVerifiedTotalWithVatEur: serverPricing.totalWithVatEur,
      serverVerifiedDiscountedTotalEur: discountedTotalEur,
      serverVerifiedTotalWithVatTry: serverPricing.totalWithVatTry,
      cutPiecesCount: serverBom.cutList.length,
      totalSheetsCount,
      canApproveProduction: compat.canApproveProduction,
      projectSnapshot: cleanProject,
    });

    const origin = req.nextUrl.origin || "https://konfigurator.birim.com";
    const shortShareUrl = `${origin}/p/${saved.code}`;
    const statelessShareToken = encodeSharePayloadBase64Url({
      code: saved.code,
      verifiedTotalEur: saved.serverVerifiedDiscountedTotalEur,
      sig: saved.hmacSignature.slice(0, 16),
      project: cleanProject,
    });
    const qrSvg = generateQrCodeSvg(shortShareUrl, {
      sizePx: 192,
      darkHex: "#141413",
      lightHex: "#FFFFFF",
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      priceTamperingDetected: clientMismatch,
      quote: saved,
      sharePath: `/p/${saved.code}`,
      shareUrl: shortShareUrl,
      statelessRecoveryUrl: `${shortShareUrl}?d=${statelessShareToken}`,
      qrSvg,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Sunucu teklif doğrulama hatası",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useConfiguratorStore } from "../../../store/useConfiguratorStore";
import { V3UnifiedWorkspace } from "../../../v3/components/V3UnifiedWorkspace";
import { V3BrandBadge } from "../../../v3/design-system";
import { decodeSharePayloadBase64Url, type VerifiedQuoteRecord } from "../../../lib/quote-codec";
import { ShieldCheck, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

export default function SharedProjectQuotePage() {
  const params = useParams<{ code: string }>();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const importProjectJSON = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.importProjectJSON);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"loading" | "ready" | "error">("loading");
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState<string>("");
  const [verifiedBadge, setVerifiedBadge] = useState<{
    code: string;
    totalEur: number;
    hmacShort: string;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const code = String(params?.code || "").toUpperCase();
    const fallbackToken = searchParams?.get("d");

    async function loadSharedQuote() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/quotes/${encodeURIComponent(code)}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; quote?: VerifiedQuoteRecord };
          if (!cancelled && data.ok && data.quote?.projectSnapshot) {
            const imported = importProjectJSON(JSON.stringify(data.quote.projectSnapshot));
            if (imported.success) {
              setVerifiedBadge({
                code: data.quote.code,
                totalEur: data.quote.serverVerifiedDiscountedTotalEur,
                hmacShort: data.quote.hmacSignature.slice(0, 10),
              });
              setStatus("ready");
              return;
            }
          }
        }

        if (fallbackToken) {
          const decoded = decodeSharePayloadBase64Url<{
            code: string;
            verifiedTotalEur: number;
            sig: string;
            project: unknown;
          }>(fallbackToken);
          if (!cancelled && decoded?.project) {
            const imported = importProjectJSON(JSON.stringify(decoded.project));
            if (imported.success) {
              setVerifiedBadge({
                code: decoded.code || code,
                totalEur: decoded.verifiedTotalEur || 0,
                hmacShort: decoded.sig || "stateless",
              });
              setStatus("ready");
              return;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setErrorText("Paylaşılan Birim proje bağlantısı bulunamadı veya süresi dolmuş.");
          setStatus("error");
        }
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setErrorText("Proje yüklenirken bağlantı hatası oluştu.");
          setStatus("error");
        }
      }
    }

    void loadSharedQuote();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [params, searchParams, importProjectJSON]);

  if (status === "loading") {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-screen w-screen bg-[#F5F3EE] text-[#141413] gap-3">
        <V3BrandBadge subtitle="PAYLAŞIM" />
        <p className="text-xs text-[#57534E]">Paylaşılan 3D tasarım ve doğrulanmış teklif yükleniyor...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (status === "error") {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-screen w-screen bg-[#F5F3EE] text-[#141413] p-6">
        <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white border border-[#E4DFD5] rounded-2xl p-6 text-center space-y-3">
          <AlertCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-[#9E2A2B] mx-auto" />
          <div className="text-sm font-bold">{errorText}</div>
          <a
            href="/"
            className="inline-block px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-[#141413] text-white text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            Yeni Tasarım Başlat
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
      {verifiedBadge && (
        <div className="h-8 bg-[#141413] text-white px-4 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] shrink-0 z-40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>
              Doğrulanmış Birim Teklif Kodu: <strong className="font-mono">{verifiedBadge.code}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono text-stone-300">
            Net Teklif: <strong className="text-white">€{verifiedBadge.totalEur.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</strong> • İmza: #{verifiedBadge.hmacShort}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 relative">
        <V3UnifiedWorkspace initialMode="showroom" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400 block">
              Seçili Modül ({activeModuleIndex + 1}/{project.modules.length})
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-stone-900 text-sm">{activeModule.name}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-xl border border-stone-200">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => moveActiveModule(-snapMm || -50)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white text-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
              title="Sola Kaydır"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            <span className="px-2 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-stone-700">
              X: {activeModule.position.x} mm
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => moveActiveModule(snapMm || 50)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white text-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
              title="Sağa Kaydır"
            >
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={duplicateActiveModule}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
            title="Modülü Çoğalt"
          >
            <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          {project.modules.length > 1 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={removeActiveModule}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 cursor-pointer"
              title="Modülü Sil"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Direct Precision Dimension Inputs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-stone-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-200">
            <span className="text-stone-500 font-semibold">Genişlik (W):</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              data-testid="plan-width-input"
              min={300}
              max={3600}
              step={50}
              value={width}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setDimensions(
                  Math.min(3600, Math.max(300, Number(e.target.value) || 300)),
                  height,
                  depth
                )
              }
              className="w-20 px-2 py-1 bg-white border border-stone-300 rounded-lg font-mono font-bold text-center text-stone-900"
            />
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              {[600, 800, 1200, 1800, 2000].map((pw) => (
                <button
                  key={pw}
                  type="button"
                  data-testid={`plan-width-preset-${pw}`}
                  onClick={() => setDimensions(pw, height, depth)}
                  className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold cursor-pointer ${
                    width === pw
                      ? "bg-amber-700 text-white"
                      : "bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {pw}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Shelf & Bay Action */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="plan-add-shelf-btn"
              onClick={() => addShelf(activeBayIndex)}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 border border-stone-200 text-stone-800 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
              <span>+ Raf ({activeBay?.shelves.length || 0})</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="plan-add-drawer-btn"
              onClick={() => addDrawer(activeBayIndex)}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 border border-stone-200 text-stone-800 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
              <span>+ Çekmece ({activeBay?.drawers.length || 0})</span>
            </button>
            <select
              aria-label="Bölme Sayısı"
              value={activeModule.bays.length}
              onChange={(e) => setBayCount(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200 font-semibold text-stone-800 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => (
                <option key={n} value={n}>
                  {n} Bölme
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Material Dots */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-stone-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-200">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500 mr-1">Yüzey:</span>
            {DEFAULT_MATERIALS.slice(0, 5).map((mat) => (
              <button
                key={mat.id}
                type="button"
                data-testid={`plan-mat-${mat.id}`}
                onClick={() => setMaterials(undefined, mat.id)}
                title={mat.name}
                className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full border transition cursor-pointer ${
                  activeModule.carcass.doorMaterialId === mat.id
                    ? "ring-2 ring-amber-700 border-white scale-110"
                    : "border-stone-300 opacity-85 hover:opacity-100"
                }`}
                style={{ backgroundColor: mat.colorHex }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Total Price */}
        <div className="text-right ml-auto">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400 font-bold block">
            Proje Toplamı
          </span>
          <span
            data-testid="plan-total-price"
            className="text-base font-black font-mono text-stone-900"
          >
            €{pricing.totalWithVatEur.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </span>
        </div>
      </footer>

      <V3ProjectModal
        isOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsProjectModalOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

);

export default function V3ShowroomPage() {

  return (

              className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer ${

                    loadLinearKitchen();

                  }}

                >
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-900">
                    Levent Loft Doğrusal Mutfak
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-0.5">
                    3200mm tam donanımlı mutfak yerleşimi
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500">
                  Hızlı Ölçü & İç Donatı Özelleştirme ({activeModule.name})
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveDrawer("none")}
                  className="text-xs text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-900 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Kapat ✕
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Module pills if multi-module */}
              {project.modules.length > 1 && (
                <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
                  {project.modules.map((m, idx) => (
                    <button
                      key={m.id}
                      type="button"
                      data-testid={`showroom-mod-select-${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => setActiveModuleIndex(idx)}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer ${
                        activeModuleIndex === idx
                          ? "bg-stone-900 text-white"
                          : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {m.name}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
                {/* Width presets */}
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-stone-600">Genişlik</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-stone-900">{width} mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
                    {[1200, 1600, 1800, 2000, 2400].map((pw) => (
                      <button
                        key={pw}
                        type="button"
                        data-testid={`showroom-width-preset-${pw}`}
                        onClick={() => setDimensions(pw, height, depth)}
                        className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-mono text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer ${
                          width === pw
                            ? "bg-amber-700 text-white"
                            : "bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-700"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {pw}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Height presets */}
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-stone-600">Yükseklik</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-stone-900">{height} mm</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
                    {[2000, 2200, 2400, 2600].map((ph) => (
                      <button
                        key={ph}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDimensions(width, ph, depth)}
                        className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-mono text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer ${
                          height === ph
                            ? "bg-amber-700 text-white"
                            : "bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-700"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {ph}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Shelf Add */}
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-stone-600">
                    İç Raflar ({activeBay?.shelves.length || 0} Adet)
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-testid="showroom-add-shelf-btn"
                    onClick={() => addShelf(activeBayIndex)}
                    className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                    <span>+ Yeni Raf Ekle</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5. FLOATING BOTTOM MATERIAL CAROUSEL & PRICE CARD */}
      {!zenMode && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-5 left-6 right-6 z-20 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 pointer-events-none">
          {/* Left: Quick Drawer Triggers */}
          <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md p-2 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 shadow-lg">
            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="showroom-open-templates"
              onClick={() =>
                setActiveDrawer(activeDrawer === "templates" ? "none" : "templates")
              }
              className={`px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer ${
                activeDrawer === "templates"
                  ? "bg-stone-900 text-white"
                  : "hover:bg-stone-100 text-stone-800"
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
              <span>Koleksiyonlar</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="showroom-open-customize"
              onClick={() =>
                setActiveDrawer(activeDrawer === "customize" ? "none" : "customize")
              }
              className={`px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer ${
                activeDrawer === "customize"
                  ? "bg-stone-900 text-white"
                  : "hover:bg-stone-100 text-stone-800"
              }`}
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
              <span>Ölçü & Raf ({width}mm)</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Center: Interactive Material Swatch Bar */}
          <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 shadow-lg overflow-x-auto max-w-full">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pr-2 border-r border-stone-200 text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 shrink-0">
              <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
              <span>Kapak Yüzeyi:</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((mat) => {
                const isSelected = activeModule.carcass.doorMaterialId === mat.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={mat.id}
                    type="button"
                    data-testid={`showroom-mat-${mat.id}`}
                    onClick={() => setMaterials(undefined, mat.id)}
                    className={`group flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-amber-50 border-amber-700 text-stone-900 font-bold shadow-2xs"
                        : "bg-white hover:bg-stone-50 border-stone-200 text-stone-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border border-stone-300 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: mat.colorHex }}
                    >
                      {isSelected && (
                        <Check
                          className={`w-3 h-3 ${
                            mat.colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#f3f4f6" ||
                            mat.colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#ede8d0"
                              ? "text-stone-900"
                              : "text-white"
                          }`}
                        />
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <span className="hidden xl:inline">{mat.name.split(" (")[0]}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: Customer Presentation Price Card */}
          <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-4 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200/90 shadow-lg">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400 block">
                Anahtar Teslim Fiyat
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span
                  data-testid="showroom-total-price"
                  className="text-lg font-black font-mono text-stone-900"
                >
                  €{pricing.totalWithVatEur.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-stone-500">
                  ({pricing.totalWithVatTry.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} TL)
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <V3ProjectModal
        isOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsProjectModalOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

        <aside

          className="w-88 border-l border-stone-200/90 bg-white flex flex-col z-20 shrink-0"
          style={{ width: "348px" }}
        >
          <div className="h-11 border-b border-stone-200/80 px-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-stone-50/70">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-700" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-800">
                {activeModule.name} Özellikleri
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-stone-500">
              {width}×{height}×{depth}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3.5 space-y-3.5">
            {/* Smart Span Warning if > 1200mm with single bay */}
            {width > 1200 && activeModule.bays.length < 2 && (
              <V3AlertBanner
                type="warning"
                title="Geniş Açıklık Sehim Uyarısı"
                message={`${width} mm genişlikte tek bölme raflarda esneme yapabilir. Otomatik bölme önerilir.`}
                actionLabel="Optimum Bölmeye Ayır"

              />
            )}

            {/* 1. Parametric Dimensions */}
            <V3CollapsibleSection

                max={3600}

                onChange={(w) => setDimensions(w, height, depth)}
              />
              <V3DimensionControl
                label="Yükseklik"
                code="H"
                testIdPrefix="studio-height"
                value={height}
                min={400}
                max={2800}
                step={50}
                presets={[2000, 2200, 2400, 2600]}
                onChange={(h) => setDimensions(width, h, depth)}
              />
              <V3DimensionControl
                label="Derinlik"
                code="D"
                testIdPrefix="studio-depth"
                value={depth}
                min={250}
                max={900}
                step={50}

              />

            <V3CollapsibleSection

                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-600 block">
                  Kabin İçi Bölme Sayısı
                </span>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1.5">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((cnt) => (
                    <button
                      key={cnt}
                      type="button"
                      data-testid={`studio-bay-count-${cnt}`}
                      onClick={() => setBayCount(cnt)}
                      className={`h-10 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                        activeModule.bays.length === cnt
                          ? "bg-stone-900 text-white shadow-xs"
                          : "bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {cnt}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {activeModule.bays.length > 1 && (
                <div className="flex gap-1 pt-1 overflow-x-auto">
                  {activeModule.bays.map((b, idx) => (
                    <button
                      key={b.index}
                      type="button"
                      data-testid={`studio-select-bay-${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => setActiveBayIndex(idx)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                        activeBayIndex === idx
                          ? "bg-amber-700 text-white"
                          : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200"
                      }`}
                    >
                      Bölme {idx + 1}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {activeBay && (
                <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-stone-200/80">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-testid="studio-add-shelf-btn"
                      onClick={() => addShelf(activeBayIndex)}
                      className="min-h-[42px] px-2 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 border border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-700/50 text-stone-800 text-xs font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
                      <span>+ Raf ({activeBay.shelves.length})</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-testid="studio-add-drawer-btn"
                      onClick={() => addDrawer(activeBayIndex)}
                      className="min-h-[42px] px-2 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 border border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-700/50 text-stone-800 text-xs font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
                      <span>+ Çekmece ({activeBay.drawers.length})</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-testid="studio-add-rail-btn"
                      onClick={() => addHangingRail(activeBayIndex)}
                      className="min-h-[42px] px-2 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-amber-50 border border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-700/50 text-stone-800 text-xs font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Shirt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
                      <span>+ Askı ({activeBay.hangingRails.length})</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Door Type Quick Selector */}
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-600">
                      Bölme {activeBayIndex + 1} Kapak Tipi
                    </span>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                      {[
                        { id: "single_left", label: "Sol Kapak" },
                        { id: "double", label: "Çift Kapak" },
                        { id: "open", label: "Açık Modül" },
                      ].map((dt) => (
                        <button
                          key={dt.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            setBayDoorType(
                              activeBayIndex,
                              dt.id as "single_left" | "double" | "open"
                            )
                          }
                          className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                            activeBay.door.type === dt.id
                              ? "bg-stone-900 text-white"
                              : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {dt.label}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Active Fittings List */}
                  {(activeBay.shelves.length > 0 || activeBay.drawers.length > 0) && (
                    <div className="space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto pt-1">
                      {activeBay.shelves.map((s, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={s.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200/80 text-[11px]"
                        >
                          <span className="text-stone-700 font-medium">
                            Raf #{i + 1} ({s.elevationY} mm)
                          </span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => removeShelf(activeBayIndex, s.id)}
                            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-red-600 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {activeBay.drawers.map((d, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={d.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200/80 text-[11px]"
                        >
                          <span className="text-stone-700 font-medium">
                            Çekmece #{i + 1} ({d.height} mm)
                          </span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => removeDrawer(activeBayIndex, d.id)}
                            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-red-600 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {activeBay.hangingRails.map((r, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={r.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200/80 text-[11px]"
                        >
                          <span className="text-stone-700 font-medium">
                            Askı Borusu #{i + 1}
                          </span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => removeHangingRail(activeBayIndex, r.id)}
                            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-red-600 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </V3CollapsibleSection>

            {/* 3. Quick Surface Material Selector in Right Panel */}
            <V3CollapsibleSection title="3. Kapak Yüzey Seçimi" defaultOpen={false}>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5">
                {DEFAULT_MATERIALS.slice(0, 5).map((mat) => (
                  <V3MaterialSwatch
                    key={mat.id}
                    id={mat.id}
                    compact
                    testId={`studio-inspector-mat-${mat.id}`}
                    name={mat.name}
                    colorHex={mat.colorHex}
                    costPerM2={mat.costPerM2}
                    category={mat.category}
                    selected={activeModule.carcass.doorMaterialId === mat.id}
                    onSelect={() => setMaterials(undefined, mat.id)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </V3CollapsibleSection>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>

      {/* 3. CLEAN BOTTOM STATUS & PRICE BAR */}
      <footer className="h-14 bg-white border-t border-stone-200/90 flex items-center justify-between px-5 shrink-0 z-30">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs text-stone-600">
          <div>
            <span className="text-stone-400 mr-1.5">Modül Ölçüsü:</span>
            <span
              data-testid="studio-footer-dimensions"
              className="font-mono font-bold text-stone-900"
            >
              {width} × {height} × {depth} mm
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-stone-300">•</span>
          <div>
            <span className="text-stone-400 mr-1.5">Toplam Modül:</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-stone-800">{project.modules.length} Adet</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400 font-bold block">
              KDV Dahil Toplam
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span
                data-testid="studio-total-price"
                className="text-base font-black font-mono text-stone-900"
              >
                €{pricing.totalWithVatEur.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-stone-500">
                ({pricing.totalWithVatTry.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} TL)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <V3Button
            variant="outline"
            size="md"
            onClick={() => setIsBomModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" />
            <span>Kesim & BOM</span>
          </V3Button>

          <V3Button
            variant="primary"
            size="md"
            data-testid="studio-approve-btn"
            onClick={handleApprove}
          >
            <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Üretime Onayla</span>
          </V3Button>
        </div>
      </footer>

      <V3ProjectModal
        isOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsProjectModalOpen(false)}
      />
      <BomModal isOpen={isBomModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsBomModalOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
}

interface BomModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialTab?: "cutlist" | "hardware" | "nesting" | "validation" | "assembly" | "selco" | "cnc_mpr_cix" | "quote" | "blum_bxf";
}

function escapeHtml(raw: unknown): string {
  return String(raw ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

export default function BomModal({ isOpen, onClose, initialTab = "cutlist" }: BomModalProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<
    "cutlist" | "hardware" | "nesting" | "validation" | "assembly" | "selco" | "cnc_mpr_cix" | "quote" | "blum_bxf"
  >(initialTab);
  const [exportStatusBanner, setExportStatusBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [erpAlgorithm, setErpAlgorithm] = useState<"Auto" | "Guillotine" | "MaxRects">("Auto");
  const [erpSheetHeight, setErpSheetHeight] = useState<2100 | 2070>(2100);
  const [erpKerf, setErpKerf] = useState<number>(4);
  const [erpMargin, setErpMargin] = useState<number>(15);
  const [erpUseNetCut, setErpUseNetCut] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [erpCommonCut, setErpCommonCut] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showCutSequences, setShowCutSequences] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showErpContractPreview, setShowErpContractPreview] = useState<boolean>(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && initialTab) {
      setActiveTab(initialTab);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialTab]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const bom = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.bom);
  const project = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.project);
  const pricing = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.pricing);

  const erpNestingBundle = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return null;
    const matMap = new Map(DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    return buildBirimErpNestingBundle(project, bom, matMap, {
      organizationId: project.branchId || "org_birim_fabrika",
      orderRef: `${project.id}_v${project.version}`,
      sheetWidthMm: 2800,
      sheetHeightMm: erpSheetHeight,
      kerfMm: erpKerf,
      edgeMarginMm: erpMargin,
      algorithm: erpAlgorithm,
      useCommonCut: erpCommonCut,
      useNetCutDimensions: erpUseNetCut,
    });
  }, [
    isOpen,
    project,
    bom,
    erpSheetHeight,
    erpKerf,
    erpMargin,
    erpAlgorithm,
    erpCommonCut,
    erpUseNetCut,
  ]);

  const blumBxfXml = React.useMemo(
    () => (isOpen && activeTab === "blum_bxf" ? generateBlumBxfXml(project, bom) : ""),
    [isOpen, activeTab, project, bom]
  );
  const blumCabinetSummaries = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      isOpen && activeTab === "blum_bxf"
        ? project.modules
            .filter((m) => m.category !== "complementary")
            .map((m) => calculateBlumEngineeringSummary(m))
        : [],
    [isOpen, activeTab, project.modules]
  );

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const downloadCustomerQuoteHtml = () => {
    const safeTitle = escapeHtml(project.title);
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<title>Birim Mobilya - Müşteri Teklif ve Teknik Sunum Föyü (${safeTitle})</title>
<style>
  body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; color: #1c1917; margin: 32px; background: #fafaf9; }
  .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 3px solid #b45309; padding-bottom: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; background: #fff; }
  th, td { border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }
  th { background: #f5f5f4; font-weight: 700; }
  .total-box { background: #1c1917; color: #fff; padding: 18px 24px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: right; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <h1 style="margin:0;font-size:22px;">BİRİM MOBİLYA — MÜŞTERİ TEKLİF & TEKNİK SUNUM FÖYÜ</h1>
      <p style="margin:4px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:#57534e;">Proje: ${safeTitle} • Versiyon: v${escapeHtml(project.version)} • Tarih: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString("tr-TR")}</p>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:right;font-size:13px;">
      <strong>Toplam Modül:</strong> ${project.modules.length} Adet<br/>
      <strong>Toplam Panel Alanı:</strong> ${bom.summary.totalPanelAreaM2} m²
    </div>
  </div>
  <h3>1. Modül ve Malzeme Özeti</h3>
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Modül Adı</th><th>Ölçüler (G×Y×D)</th><th>Gövde Malzemesi</th><th>Kapak Malzemesi</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      ${project.modules.map((m, i) => `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.name)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.dimensions.width)}×${escapeHtml(m.dimensions.height)}×${escapeHtml(m.dimensions.depth)} mm</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.carcass.bodyMaterialId)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.carcass.doorMaterialId)}</td></tr>`).join("")}
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <h3>2. Dünya Markaları Donanım, Aksesuar ve LED Aydınlatma Listesi</h3>
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>Katalog Kodu (SKU)</th><th>Donanım / Aksesuar Açıklaması</th><th>Miktar</th><th>Birim Fiyat (€)</th><th>Toplam (€)</th></tr></thead>

  </div>
</body>
</html>`;

      if (a.parentNode) a.parentNode.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }, 1500);
  };

            <div className="space-y-5 text-xs">
              {/* ERP Settings & 1-Click Machine/API Exports Toolbar */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950 border border-indigo-500/40 rounded-xl space-y-3.5">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span>Birim Portal ERP — CNC Panel Nesting & Kesim Motoru</span>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-400/30 text-indigo-300 font-mono text-[10px]">
                        {erpNestingBundle.schema_version}
                      </span>
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                      ERP <code>nesting_projects</code>, <code>nesting_sheets</code>, <code>nesting_parts</code> (U1/U2/K1/K2 PVC + Arkalık Kanalı JSON) ve <code>nesting_placements</code> ile birebir aynı algoritma ve şema
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={downloadErpNestingJson}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ERP (.json)
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={downloadErpSelcoCsv}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      🪚 ERP Selco WNT 600 (.csv)
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={downloadErpCncGCode}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <FileCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ⚙️ ERP CNC G-Code (.nc)
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Interactive ERP Optimization Parameters */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80">
                  <label className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Algoritma</span>
                    <select
                      value={erpAlgorithm}
                      onChange={(e) => setErpAlgorithm(e.target.value as "Auto" | "Guillotine" | "MaxRects")}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 font-medium"
                    >
                      <option value="Auto">Auto (ERP Varsayılan)</option>
                      <option value="Guillotine">Guillotine (Ebatlama)</option>
                      <option value="MaxRects">MaxRects (CNC Router)</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Plaka Ebadı</span>
                    <select
                      value={erpSheetHeight}
                      onChange={(e) => setErpSheetHeight(Number(e.target.value) as 2100 | 2070)}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 font-mono"
                    >
                      <option value={2100}>2800 × 2100 mm (ERP)</option>
                      <option value={2070}>2800 × 2070 mm</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Bıçak Payı (Kerf)</span>
                    <select
                      value={erpKerf}
                      onChange={(e) => setErpKerf(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 font-mono"
                    >
                      <option value={4}>4.0 mm (ERP)</option>
                      <option value={4.4}>4.4 mm (Selco)</option>
                      <option value={3.5}>3.5 mm</option>
                      <option value={6}>6.0 mm (Freze)</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Kenar Tıraş (Margin)</span>
                    <select
                      value={erpMargin}
                      onChange={(e) => setErpMargin(Number(e.target.value))}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 font-mono"
                    >
                      <option value={15}>15 mm</option>
                      <option value={10}>10 mm (ERP)</option>
                      <option value={20}>20 mm</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <label className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold block">Parça Ölçü Bazı</span>
                    <select
                      value={erpUseNetCut ? "net" : "nominal"}
                      onChange={(e) => setErpUseNetCut(e.target.value === "net")}
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-100 font-medium"
                    >
                      <option value="net">Net Kesim (Bant Düşülmüş)</option>
                      <option value="nominal">Bitmiş Anma Ölçüsü</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>

                  <div className="flex flex-col justify-end gap-1.5">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={erpCommonCut}
                        onChange={(e) => setErpCommonCut(e.target.checked)}
                        className="rounded border-slate-600"
                      />
                      <span>Ortak Kesim (Kerf=0)</span>
                    </label>
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300 cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={showCutSequences}
                        onChange={(e) => setShowCutSequences(e.target.checked)}
                        className="rounded border-slate-600"
                      />
                      <span>Kesim Sırası Çizgileri</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Live ERP Summary KPIs + Color Legend */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-[11px]">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      İş Emri Grubu: <strong className="text-white">{erpNestingBundle.summary.board_groups_count}</strong>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      Toplam Plaka: <strong className="text-amber-400">{erpNestingBundle.summary.total_sheets_used} adet</strong>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      Yerleşen Parça: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{erpNestingBundle.summary.total_parts_placed}/{erpNestingBundle.summary.total_parts_requested}</strong>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      Genel Verim: <strong className="text-indigo-400">%{erpNestingBundle.summary.overall_utilization_percent}</strong>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-300">
                      Artık Plaka (≥400×400): <strong className="text-cyan-400">{erpNestingBundle.summary.reclaimable_remnants_count} adet ({erpNestingBundle.summary.reclaimable_remnants_area_m2} m²)</strong>
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px]">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-rose-300">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-1 bg-rose-500 inline-block rounded" /> 2.0mm PVC
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-300">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-1 bg-amber-400 inline-block rounded" /> 1.0mm PVC
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-cyan-300">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-1 bg-cyan-400 inline-block rounded" /> 0.4mm PVC
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sky-300">
                      <span className="w-3 border-b-2 border-dashed border-cyan-300 inline-block" /> Arkalık Kanalı
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowErpContractPreview((v) => !v)}
                      className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-300 border border-slate-700 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {showErpContractPreview ? "JSON Sözleşmeyi Gizle" : "ERP API / DB Önizleme"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {showErpContractPreview && (
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-indigo-500/30 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-bold text-indigo-300">
                      Canlı Birim ERP API &amp; Supabase <code>nesting_parts</code> / <code>nesting_projects</code> JSON Sözleşmesi
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                      POST /api/nesting/sheets → POST /api/nesting → POST /api/nesting/:id/parts → POST /api/nesting/:id/optimize
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <pre className="max-h-60 overflow-auto p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-[10.5px] font-mono text-slate-300">
                    {JSON.stringify(
                      erpNestingBundle.jobs.map((j) => ({
                        project_no: j.project_record.project_no,
                        source_type: j.project_record.source_type,
                        source_ref: j.project_record.source_ref,
                        sheet_input: j.sheet_input,
                        parts_count: j.part_inputs.length,
                        sample_parts: j.part_inputs.slice(0, 4),
                        sheets_used: j.optimization_result.sheets.length,
                        algorithm_selected: j.optimization_result.algorithm,
                        utilization_percent: j.optimization_result.overall_utilization,
                      })),
                      null,
                      2
                    )}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Render Each Material/Thickness ERP Nesting Job */}
              {erpNestingBundle.jobs.map((job) => {
                const sheetW = job.sheet_record.width_mm;
                const sheetH = job.sheet_record.height_mm;
                const margin = job.sheet_record.edge_margin_mm;
                const getBandColor = (tape?: string) => {
                  if (!tape) return null;
                  const cl = tape.toLowerCase();
                  if (cl.includes("2")) return "#F43F5E";
                  if (cl.includes("1")) return "#F59E0B";
                  if (cl.includes("0.4")) return "#06B6D4";
                  return "#10B981";
                };

                return (
                  <div key={job.group_key} className="space-y-3.5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-600/20 border border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-300 font-mono font-bold text-[11px]">
                          {job.project_record.project_no}
                        </span>
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-100 text-sm">
                          {job.material_name} ({job.thickness_mm}mm)
                        </h3>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-mono text-[10px]">
                          {job.sheet_input.material_type}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-xs font-mono">
                        <span>
                          Algoritma: <strong className="text-indigo-400">{job.optimization_result.algorithm}</strong>
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Plaka: <strong className="text-amber-400">{job.optimization_result.sheets.length} adet</strong>
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Parça: <strong className="text-slate-200">{job.optimization_result.total_parts_placed}/{job.optimization_result.total_parts_requested}</strong>
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Doluluk: <strong className="text-emerald-400">%{job.optimization_result.overall_utilization}</strong>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                      {job.optimization_result.sheets.map((sheet) => {
                        const sheetRemnants = job.reclaimable_remnants.filter(
                          (rm) => rm.sheet_index === sheet.sheet_index
                        );
                        const globalSvgIdx = sheet.sheet_index + 1;
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={sheet.sheet_index}
                            className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2.5"
                          >
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200">
                                Plaka #{sheet.sheet_index + 1} ({sheetW}×{sheetH} mm)
                              </span>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
                                {sheetRemnants.length > 0 && (
                                  <span className="text-cyan-400">
                                    Artık: {sheetRemnants.length} adet
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                <span className="text-emerald-400">
                                  Verim: %{sheet.utilization_percent}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="relative w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden p-1.5">
                              <svg
                                data-testid={`bom-nesting-svg-sheet-${globalSvgIdx}`}
                                viewBox={`-110 -85 ${sheetW + 200} ${sheetH + 160}`}
                                className="w-full h-auto block select-none"
                              >
                                <defs>
                                  <pattern
                                    id={`waste_hatch_${job.job_index}_${sheet.sheet_index}`}
                                    width="40"
                                    height="40"
                                    patternTransform="rotate(45 0 0)"
                                    patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
                                  >
                                    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="40" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="6" />
                                  </pattern>
                                </defs>

                                {/* Ham Plaka Sınırı */}
                                <rect
                                  x={0}
                                  y={0}
                                  width={sheetW}
                                  height={sheetH}
                                  fill={`url(#waste_hatch_${job.job_index}_${sheet.sheet_index})`}
                                  stroke="#64748B"
                                  strokeWidth="8"
                                />
                                {/* Kenar Tıraş Payı (Margin) */}
                                <rect
                                  x={margin}
                                  y={margin}
                                  width={sheetW - 2 * margin}
                                  height={sheetH - 2 * margin}
                                  fill="#0F172A"
                                  stroke="#475569"
                                  strokeWidth="4"
                                  strokeDasharray="24 14"
                                />

                                {/* Üst Cetvel */}
                                <line x1={0} y1={-32} x2={sheetW} y2={-32} stroke="#94A3B8" strokeWidth="4" />
                                {[0, 700, 1400, 2100, sheetW].map((tx) => (
                                  <g key={`rx_${tx}`}>
                                    <line x1={tx} y1={-48} x2={tx} y2={-16} stroke="#94A3B8" strokeWidth="4" />
                                    <text x={tx} y={-54} textAnchor="middle" fill="#CBD5E1" fontSize="40" fontWeight="800" fontFamily="monospace">
                                      {tx}
                                    </text>
                                  </g>
                                ))}

                                {/* Sol Cetvel */}
                                <line x1={-32} y1={0} x2={-32} y2={sheetH} stroke="#94A3B8" strokeWidth="4" />
                                {[0, 500, 1000, 1500, sheetH].map((ty) => (
                                  <g key={`ry_${ty}`}>
                                    <line x1={-48} y1={ty} x2={-16} y2={ty} stroke="#94A3B8" strokeWidth="4" />
                                    <text x={-56} y={ty + 14} textAnchor="end" fill="#CBD5E1" fontSize="38" fontWeight="800" fontFamily="monospace">
                                      {ty}
                                    </text>
                                  </g>
                                ))}

                                {/* Geri Kazanılabilir Artık Plakalar (>=400x400mm) */}
                                {sheetRemnants.map((rm) => (
                                  <g key={`rem_${rm.remnant_index}`}>
                                    <rect
                                      x={margin + rm.x_mm}
                                      y={margin + rm.y_mm}
                                      width={rm.width_mm}
                                      height={rm.height_mm}
                                      fill="rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.14)"
                                      stroke="#10B981"
                                      strokeWidth="5"
                                      strokeDasharray="18 10"
                                    />
                                    {rm.width_mm >= 400 && rm.height_mm >= 350 && (
                                      <text
                                        x={margin + rm.x_mm + rm.width_mm / 2}
                                        y={margin + rm.y_mm + rm.height_mm / 2}
                                        textAnchor="middle"
                                        fill="#6EE7B7"
                                        fontSize="36"
                                        fontWeight="800"
                                        fontFamily="monospace"
                                      >
                                        {`ARTIK ${Math.round(rm.width_mm)}×${Math.round(rm.height_mm)}`}
                                      </text>
                                    )}
                                  </g>
                                ))}

                                {/* Yerleşen Parçalar + U1/U2/K1/K2 Kenar Bantları + Arkalık Kanalı */}
                                {sheet.placements.map((pl) => {
                                  const pw = Math.max(40, pl.width);
                                  const ph = Math.max(40, pl.height);
                                  const cx = pl.x + pw / 2;
                                  const cy = pl.y + ph / 2;
                                  const rot = (pl.rotation || (pl.rotated ? 90 : 0)) % 360;
                                  const cU1 = getBandColor(pl.edgeL1);
                                  const cU2 = getBandColor(pl.edgeL2);
                                  const cK1 = getBandColor(pl.edgeW1);
                                  const cK2 = getBandColor(pl.edgeW2);
                                  const visEdges =
                                    rot === 90
                                      ? { top: cK1, bottom: cK2, left: cU2, right: cU1 }
                                      : rot === 180
                                      ? { top: cU2, bottom: cU1, left: cK2, right: cK1 }
                                      : rot === 270
                                      ? { top: cK2, bottom: cK1, left: cU1, right: cU2 }
                                      : { top: cU1, bottom: cU2, left: cK1, right: cK2 };

                                  const adjGrooveSide = pl.hasGroove
                                    ? adjustErpGrooveSideForRotation(pl.grooveSide || "Alt", rot)
                                    : "";
                                  const gOff = pl.grooveOffset ?? 20;
                                  const fontTitle = Math.max(
                                    24,
                                    Math.min(44, Math.floor(pw / Math.max(6, pl.part_label.length * 0.58)))
                                  );
                                  const fontDim = Math.max(22, Math.min(38, Math.floor(pw / 8.5)));

                                  return (
                                    <g key={pl.part_id}>
                                      <rect
                                        x={pl.x}
                                        y={pl.y}
                                        width={pw}
                                        height={ph}
                                        rx={4}
                                        fill={pl.color || "#3B82F6"}
                                        fillOpacity={0.82}
                                        stroke="#0F172A"
                                        strokeWidth="4"
                                      />
                                      {/* U1/U2/K1/K2 PVC Kenar Bant Çizgileri */}
                                      {visEdges.top && (
                                        <line
                                          x1={pl.x + 3}
                                          y1={pl.y + 5}
                                          x2={pl.x + pw - 3}
                                          y2={pl.y + 5}
                                          stroke={visEdges.top}
                                          strokeWidth="10"
                                        />
                                      )}
                                      {visEdges.bottom && (
                                        <line
                                          x1={pl.x + 3}
                                          y1={pl.y + ph - 5}
                                          x2={pl.x + pw - 3}
                                          y2={pl.y + ph - 5}
                                          stroke={visEdges.bottom}
                                          strokeWidth="10"
                                        />
                                      )}
                                      {visEdges.left && (
                                        <line
                                          x1={pl.x + 5}
                                          y1={pl.y + 3}
                                          x2={pl.x + 5}
                                          y2={pl.y + ph - 3}
                                          stroke={visEdges.left}
                                          strokeWidth="10"
                                        />
                                      )}
                                      {visEdges.right && (
                                        <line
                                          x1={pl.x + pw - 5}
                                          y1={pl.y + 3}
                                          x2={pl.x + pw - 5}
                                          y2={pl.y + ph - 3}
                                          stroke={visEdges.right}
                                          strokeWidth="10"
                                        />
                                      )}

                                      {/* Arkalık Kanalı (Groove) */}
                                      {pl.hasGroove && (
                                        <line
                                          x1={
                                            adjGrooveSide === "Sol"
                                              ? pl.x + gOff
                                              : adjGrooveSide === "Sağ"
                                              ? pl.x + pw - gOff
                                              : pl.x + 8
                                          }
                                          y1={
                                            adjGrooveSide === "Üst"
                                              ? pl.y + gOff
                                              : adjGrooveSide === "Alt"
                                              ? pl.y + ph - gOff
                                              : pl.y + 8
                                          }
                                          x2={
                                            adjGrooveSide === "Sol"
                                              ? pl.x + gOff
                                              : adjGrooveSide === "Sağ"
                                              ? pl.x + pw - gOff
                                              : pl.x + pw - 8
                                          }
                                          y2={
                                            adjGrooveSide === "Üst"
                                              ? pl.y + gOff
                                              : adjGrooveSide === "Alt"
                                              ? pl.y + ph - gOff
                                              : pl.y + ph - 8
                                          }
                                          stroke="#67E8F9"
                                          strokeWidth="6"
                                          strokeDasharray="16 10"
                                        />
                                      )}

                                      {pw >= 120 && ph >= 80 && (
                                        <>
                                          <text
                                            x={cx}
                                            y={cy - 4}
                                            textAnchor="middle"
                                            fill="#FFFFFF"
                                            fontSize={fontTitle}
                                            fontWeight="900"
                                            fontFamily="sans-serif"
                                          >
                                            {pl.part_label.slice(0, 22)}
                                          </text>
                                          <text
                                            x={cx}
                                            y={cy + fontDim + 6}
                                            textAnchor="middle"
                                            fill="#FEF08A"
                                            fontSize={fontDim}
                                            fontWeight="800"
                                            fontFamily="monospace"
                                          >
                                            {`${Math.round(pl.width)}×${Math.round(pl.height)}${pl.rotated ? " ↻" : ""}`}
                                          </text>
                                        </>
                                      )}
                                    </g>
                                  );
                                })}

                                {/* Kesim Sırası Çizgileri (Guillotine Rip/Cross veya CNC Traversal) */}
                                {showCutSequences &&
                                  (sheet.sequences || []).map((seq, sqIdx) => (
                                    <line
                                      key={`seq_${sqIdx}`}
                                      x1={seq.x1}
                                      y1={seq.y1}
                                      x2={seq.x2}
                                      y2={seq.y2}
                                      stroke={seq.isTraversal ? "#38BDF8" : "#F43F5E"}
                                      strokeWidth={seq.isTraversal ? "4" : "5.5"}
                                      strokeDasharray={seq.isTraversal ? "14 10" : "22 10"}
                                      opacity={0.85}
                                    />
                                  ))}
                              </svg>
                            </div>

                            {/* Guillotine Operatör Kesim Reçetesi */}
                            {sheet.cuttingInstructions && sheet.cuttingInstructions.length > 0 && (
                              <details className="rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 p-2.5">
                                <summary className="cursor-pointer font-semibold text-amber-300 text-[11px]">
                                  🪚 Ebatlama Operatör Kesim Reçetesi ({sheet.placements.length} Parça Kesim Adımı)
                                </summary>
                                <pre className="mt-2 max-h-40 overflow-auto text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                                  {sheet.cuttingInstructions.join("\n")}
                                </pre>
                              </details>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 4: FACTORY VALIDATION GATE & SHELF DEFLECTION */}
          {activeTab === "validation" && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-200 text-sm">
                  6 Aşamalı Deterministik Üretim Doğrulama Kapısı (Fail-Closed Gate)
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
