"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { createComponentMesh, publishSceneDiagnostics, createModuleGroup } from "./componentMesh";
import { OrbitControls } from "three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js";
import { useConfiguratorStore } from "../store/useConfiguratorStore";
import { generateModuleGeometry } from "@birim/geometry";
import { DEFAULT_MATERIALS, MaterialDefinition } from "@birim/core";
import {
  attachWebGLContextRecovery,
  disposeObject3DTree,
  markSharedGeometry,
  markSharedMaterial,
} from "../v3/materials/webglResourceGuard";

// 1. Shared Unit Geometries (Never recreated, GPU buffer persists across life of app)
const UNIT_BOX_GEO = markSharedGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1));
const UNIT_EDGES_GEO = markSharedGeometry(new THREE.EdgesGeometry(UNIT_BOX_GEO));

// 2. Shared Material Caches (Avoids shader compilation and GPU memory leaks)
const materialCache = new Map<string, THREE.MeshStandardMaterial>();
const edgeMaterialCache = new Map<string, THREE.LineBasicMaterial>();

function getPanelMaterial(matDef: MaterialDefinition, isSelected: boolean, isRail: boolean): THREE.MeshStandardMaterial {
  const key = `${matDef.id}_${isSelected ? 1 : 0}_${isRail ? 1 : 0}`;
  let m = materialCache.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    let matColor = matDef.colorHex;
    let metalness = matDef.metalness;
    let roughness = matDef.roughness;

    if (isRail) {
      matColor = "#cccccc";
      metalness = 0.95;
      roughness = 0.15;
    }

    m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(matColor),
      metalness,
      roughness,
      emissive: isSelected ? new THREE.Color(0x2563eb) : new THREE.Color(0x000000),
      emissiveIntensity: isSelected ? 0.35 : 0.0,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(m);
    materialCache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

function getEdgeMaterial(isSelected: boolean): THREE.LineBasicMaterial {
  const key = isSelected ? "sel" : "norm";
  let m = edgeMaterialCache.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: isSelected ? 0x60a5fa : 0x000000,
      linewidth: 1,
      opacity: isSelected ? 0.9 : 0.2,
      transparent: true,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(m);
    edgeMaterialCache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

export default function ThreeCanvas() {
  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const project = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.project);
  const activeModIndex = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.activeModuleIndex);
  const doorAngle = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.doorOpenAngleDeg);
  const drawerOpenMm = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.drawerOpenMm);
  const explodedFactor = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.explodedFactor);
  const isOrthographic = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.isOrthographic);
  const cameraPreset = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.cameraPreset);
  const selectedComponentId = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.selectedComponentId);
  const setSelectedComponentId = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.setSelectedComponentId);

  const sceneRef = useRef<THREE.Scene | null>(null);
  const perspCameraRef = useRef<THREE.PerspectiveCamera | null>(null);
  const orthoCameraRef = useRef<THREE.OrthographicCamera | null>(null);
  const rendererRef = useRef<THREE.WebGLRenderer | null>(null);
  const controlsRef = useRef<OrbitControls | null>(null);
  const meshGroupRef = useRef<THREE.Group | null>(null);
  const needsRenderRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const [contextLost, setContextLost] = useState(false);

  const requestRender = useCallback(() => {
    needsRenderRef.current = true;
  }, []);

  // Initialize Scene & On-Demand Render Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const width = container.clientWidth;
    const height = container.clientHeight;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0f1d);
    sceneRef.current = scene;

    const perspCamera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42, width / height, 10, 25000);
    perspCamera.position.set(2400, 2200, 3400);
    perspCameraRef.current = perspCamera;

    const aspect = width / height;
    const orthoD = 1800;
    const orthoCamera = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(
      -orthoD * aspect,
      orthoD * aspect,
      orthoD,
      -orthoD,
      -50000,
      50000
    );
    orthoCamera.position.set(2400, 2200, 3400);
    orthoCameraRef.current = orthoCamera;

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false, powerPreference: "high-performance" });
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    rendererRef.current = renderer;
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const activeCamera = isOrthographic ? orthoCamera : perspCamera;
    const controls = new OrbitControls(activeCamera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = true;
    controls.dampingFactor = 0.08;
    controls.maxDistance = 15000;
    controls.minDistance = 200;
    controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI / 2 - 0.02;
    controls.target.set(1000, 1100, 300);
    controls.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if (controls.target.y < 0) controls.target.y = 0;
      needsRenderRef.current = true;
    });
    controlsRef.current = controls;

    // Lighting setup
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.85);
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    const mainLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff8ee, 1.3);
    mainLight.position.set(3000, 4500, 3500);
    mainLight.castShadow = true;
    mainLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
    mainLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
    mainLight.shadow.bias = -0.0005;
    scene.add(mainLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xddeeff, 0.6);
    fillLight.position.set(-2500, 2500, -1800);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // Floor Grid
    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(8000, 80, 0x334155, 0x1e293b);
    grid.position.y = -2;
    scene.add(grid);

    const shadowPlaneGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8000, 8000);
    const shadowPlaneMat = new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ opacity: 0.28 });
    const shadowPlane = new THREE.Mesh(shadowPlaneGeo, shadowPlaneMat);
    shadowPlane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    shadowPlane.position.y = -1;
    shadowPlane.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(shadowPlane);

    const meshGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(meshGroup);
    meshGroupRef.current = meshGroup;

    // Raycaster for click selection
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

    let pointerDownPos: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
    const handlePointerDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      pointerDownPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    };

    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (pointerDownPos) {
        const moveDist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - pointerDownPos.x, e.clientY - pointerDownPos.y);
        if (moveDist > 5) return;
      }
      const activeRenderer = rendererRef.current;
      const currentMeshGroup = meshGroupRef.current;
      if (!activeRenderer || !currentMeshGroup) return;

      const rect = activeRenderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      mouse.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      mouse.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

      const currentCam = (controlsRef.current?.object as THREE.Camera) || perspCameraRef.current;
      if (!currentCam) return;

      raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, currentCam);
      const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(currentMeshGroup.children, true);
      if (intersects.length > 0) {
        const topObject = intersects[0].object;
        if (topObject.userData && topObject.userData.componentId) {
          setSelectedComponentId(topObject.userData.componentId);
        }
      } else {
        setSelectedComponentId(null);
      }
    };

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("click", handleClick);
    const detachContextRecovery = attachWebGLContextRecovery(renderer.domElement, {
      onContextLost: () => setContextLost(true),
      onContextRestored: () => {
        setContextLost(false);
        needsRenderRef.current = true;
      },
    });

    // On-demand rendering loop: Only renders when camera moves or scene is flagged dirty
    let animId: number;
    const animate = () => {
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      const currentControls = controlsRef.current;
      const currentRenderer = rendererRef.current;
      const currentScene = sceneRef.current;
      if (!currentControls || !currentRenderer || !currentScene) return;

      const controlsUpdated = currentControls.update();
      if (needsRenderRef.current || controlsUpdated) {
        const curCam = (currentControls.object as THREE.Camera) || perspCameraRef.current;
        if (curCam) currentRenderer.render(currentScene, curCam);
        needsRenderRef.current = false;
      }
    };
    animate();

    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentRenderer = rendererRef.current;
      if (!container || !currentRenderer) return;
      const w = container.clientWidth;
      const h = container.clientHeight;
      if (w === 0 || h === 0) return;

      if (perspCameraRef.current) {
        perspCameraRef.current.aspect = w / h;
        perspCameraRef.current.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }
      if (orthoCameraRef.current) {
        const asp = w / h;
        const d = 1800;
        orthoCameraRef.current.left = -d * asp;
        orthoCameraRef.current.right = d * asp;
        orthoCameraRef.current.top = d;
        orthoCameraRef.current.bottom = -d;
        orthoCameraRef.current.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }
      currentRenderer.setSize(w, h);
      needsRenderRef.current = true;
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
      detachContextRecovery();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener("click", handleClick);
      controls.dispose();
      disposeObject3DTree(scene);
      renderer.dispose();
      if (container.contains(renderer.domElement)) {
        container.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      }
    };
  }, [setSelectedComponentId]);

  // Seamless Camera Projection Switching (Perspective <-> Orthographic) without destroying scene
  useEffect(() => {
    const controls = controlsRef.current;
    const perspCam = perspCameraRef.current;
    const orthoCam = orthoCameraRef.current;
    if (!controls || !perspCam || !orthoCam) return;

    if (isOrthographic) {
      // Perspective -> Orthographic
      const offset = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(perspCam.position, controls.target);
      const dist = offset.length();
      const fovRad = (perspCam.fov * Math.PI) / 180;
      const visibleHeight = 2 * dist * Math.tan(fovRad / 2);
      if (visibleHeight > 0) {
        orthoCam.zoom = 3600 / visibleHeight;
      }
      orthoCam.position.copy(perspCam.position);
      orthoCam.quaternion.copy(perspCam.quaternion);
      orthoCam.updateProjectionMatrix();

      controls.object = orthoCam;
    } else {
      // Orthographic -> Perspective
      const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(orthoCam.position, controls.target).normalize();
      if (dir.lengthSq() < 0.001) dir.set(0, 0, 1);
      const fovRad = (perspCam.fov * Math.PI) / 180;
      const visibleHeight = 3600 / Math.max(0.01, orthoCam.zoom);
      const dist = visibleHeight / (2 * Math.tan(fovRad / 2));

      perspCam.position.copy(controls.target).addScaledVector(dir, dist);
      perspCam.quaternion.copy(orthoCam.quaternion);
      perspCam.updateProjectionMatrix();

      controls.object = perspCam;
    }

    controls.update();
    requestRender();
  }, [isOrthographic, requestRender]);

  // Handle camera presets
  useEffect(() => {
    const controls = controlsRef.current;
    const perspCam = perspCameraRef.current;
    const orthoCam = orthoCameraRef.current;
    const activeMod = project.modules[activeModIndex] || project.modules[0];
    if (!controls || !perspCam || !orthoCam || !activeMod) return;

    const { width, height, depth } = activeMod.dimensions;
    const centerX = activeMod.position.x + width / 2;
    const centerY = activeMod.position.y + height / 2;
    const centerZ = activeMod.position.z + depth / 2;
    controls.target.set(centerX, centerY, centerZ);

    const maxDim = Math.max(width, height, depth);
    const fitDist = maxDim * 2.2;

    const targetPos = new THREE.Vector3();
    if (cameraPreset === "front") {
      targetPos.set(centerX, centerY, centerZ + fitDist);
    } else if (cameraPreset === "side") {
      targetPos.set(centerX - fitDist, centerY, centerZ);
    } else if (cameraPreset === "top") {
      targetPos.set(centerX, centerY + fitDist, centerZ + 1);
    } else {
      targetPos.set(centerX + width * 1.2, centerY + height * 1.1, centerZ + Math.max(width, height) * 1.3);
    }

    perspCam.position.copy(targetPos);
    perspCam.lookAt(centerX, centerY, centerZ);
    perspCam.updateProjectionMatrix();

    orthoCam.position.copy(targetPos);
    orthoCam.lookAt(centerX, centerY, centerZ);
    const fovRad = (perspCam.fov * Math.PI) / 180;
    const visibleHeight = 2 * targetPos.distanceTo(controls.target) * Math.tan(fovRad / 2);
    if (visibleHeight > 0) {
      orthoCam.zoom = 3600 / visibleHeight;
    }
    orthoCam.updateProjectionMatrix();

    controls.update();
    requestRender();
  }, [cameraPreset, project, activeModIndex, requestRender]);

  // Fast selection highlight without rebuilding scene geometry
  useEffect(() => {
    const meshGroup = meshGroupRef.current;
    if (!meshGroup) return;

    meshGroup.traverse((child) => {
      if (child instanceof THREE.Mesh && child.userData && child.userData.componentId) {
        const isSelected = child.userData.componentId === selectedComponentId;
        const isRail = child.userData.role === "hanging_rail" || child.userData.role?.includes("fit");
        const matDef = child.userData.matDef || DEFAULT_MATERIALS[0];
        child.material = getPanelMaterial(matDef, isSelected, isRail);

        // Update wireframe child
        if (child.children.length > 0 && child.children[0] instanceof THREE.LineSegments) {
          child.children[0].material = getEdgeMaterial(isSelected);
        }
      }
    });
    requestRender();
  }, [selectedComponentId, requestRender]);

  // Update Geometry & Meshes (Shared Unit Geometry + Scaled Meshes)
  useEffect(() => {
    const meshGroup = meshGroupRef.current;
    if (!meshGroup) return;

    // Dispose transient geometries/materials while preserving shared cached resources
    disposeObject3DTree(meshGroup);

    const matMap = new Map(DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((m) => [m.id, m]));

    project.modules.forEach((mod) => {
      const breakdown = generateModuleGeometry(mod, {
        doorOpenAngleDeg: doorAngle,
        drawerOpenMm,
        explodedFactor,
      });

      const moduleGroup = createModuleGroup(mod);
      meshGroup.add(moduleGroup);

      breakdown.components.forEach((comp) => {
        const matDef = matMap.get(comp.materialId) || DEFAULT_MATERIALS[0];
        const isSelected = comp.id === selectedComponentId;
        const isRail = comp.role === "door_handle" || comp.role === "drawer_handle" || comp.role === "gola_profile" || comp.role === "hanging_rail" || comp.role === "door_hinge" || comp.role.includes("fit");

        const material = getPanelMaterial(matDef, isSelected, isRail);
        const wireMat = getEdgeMaterial(isSelected);

        const compW = Math.max(1, comp.dimensions.width);
        const compH = Math.max(1, comp.dimensions.height);
        const compD = Math.max(1, comp.dimensions.depth);

        const componentGroup = createComponentMesh(comp, material, wireMat, { componentId: comp.id, role: comp.role, matDef });
        moduleGroup.add(componentGroup);
      });
    });

    if (rendererRef.current) publishSceneDiagnostics(rendererRef.current.domElement, meshGroup);
    requestRender();
  }, [project, activeModIndex, doorAngle, drawerOpenMm, explodedFactor, requestRender, selectedComponentId]);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-full">
      <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" />
      {contextLost && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-center bg-stone-950/75 text-stone-100 text-xs font-semibold">
          3D grafik bağlamı yeniden başlatılıyor...
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3D Viewport Top HUD Controls */}
      <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex gap-2 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700/60 text-xs">
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setCameraPreset("iso")}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${cameraPreset === "iso" ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          İzo (3D)
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setCameraPreset("front")}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${cameraPreset === "front" ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Ön (Görünüş)
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setCameraPreset("side")}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${cameraPreset === "side" ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Yan (Profil)
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setCameraPreset("top")}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${cameraPreset === "top" ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Üst (Plan)
        </button>
        <div className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-700 my-auto" />
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setOrthographic(false)}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${!isOrthographic ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Perspektif
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setOrthographic(true)}
          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${isOrthographic ? "bg-amber-600 font-semibold text-white" : "text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"}`}
        >
          Ortografik
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 3D Animation & Exploded View Sliders Bottom HUD */}
      <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-md p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-700/60 text-xs flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
        {/* Door Angle Slider */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-slate-400">Kapak:</span>
          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={90}
            value={doorAngle}
            onChange={(e) => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setDoorOpenAngleDeg(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-20 accent-amber-500 cursor-pointer"
          />
          <span className="font-mono text-amber-400 w-8">{doorAngle}°</span>
        </div>

        {/* Drawer Pull-out Slider */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-slate-400">Çekmece:</span>
          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={350}
            step={10}
            value={drawerOpenMm}
            onChange={(e) => useConfiguratorStore.getState().setDrawerOpenMm(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="w-20 accent-blue-500 cursor-pointer"
          />
          <span className="font-mono text-blue-400 w-12">{drawerOpenMm}mm</span>
        </div>

        {/* Exploded View Slider */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

          <input

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useConfiguratorStore } from "../store/useConfiguratorStore";
import { generateModuleGeometry, generateTopPlan2D } from "@birim/geometry";

export default function TopPlan2D() {
  const project = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.project);
  const activeModIndex = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.activeModuleIndex);
  const selectedComponentId = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.selectedComponentId);
  const setSelectedComponentId = useConfiguratorStore((s) => s.setSelectedComponentId);

  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [pan, setPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [isPanning, setIsPanning] = useState(false);
  const [startPan, setStartPan] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  const activeMod = project.modules[activeModIndex] || project.modules[0];
  if (!activeMod) return null;

  const breakdown = generateModuleGeometry(activeMod, { doorOpenAngleDeg: 0 });
  const planData = generateTopPlan2D(breakdown, selectedComponentId || undefined);

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    setIsPanning(true);
    setStartPan({ x: e.clientX - pan.x, y: e.clientY - pan.y });
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!isPanning) return;
    setPan({ x: e.clientX - startPan.x, y: e.clientY - startPan.y });
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    setIsPanning(false);
  };

  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newZoom = Math.min(Math.max(0.4, zoom - e.deltaY * 0.001), 3);
    setZoom(newZoom);
  };

  const vb = planData.viewBox;

  return (
    <div
      className="relative w-full h-full bg-slate-900 overflow-hidden cursor-crosshair"
      onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
      onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
      onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
      onWheel={handleWheel}
    >
      <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 flex gap-2 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 text-xs">
        <span className="text-amber-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider self-center">Üstten Plan (2D Top Plan)</span>
        <button
          onClick={() => { setZoom(1); setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 }); }}
          className="ml-4 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700"
        >
          Sıfırla
        </button>
        <span className="text-slate-400 self-center">Zoom: {Math.round(zoom * 100)}%</span>
      </div>

      <svg
        viewBox={`${vb.x} ${vb.y} ${vb.width} ${vb.height}`}
        className="w-full h-full"
        style={{
          transform: `scale(${zoom}) translate(${pan.x}px, ${pan.y}px)`,
          transformOrigin: "center center",
          transition: isPanning ? "none" : "transform 0.08s ease-out",
        }}
      >
        <defs>
          <pattern id="plan_grid" width="100" height="100" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <path d="M 100 0 L 0 0 0 100" fill="none" stroke="#1e293b" strokeWidth="1" />
          </pattern>
        </defs>

        <rect x={vb.x} y={vb.y} width={vb.width} height={vb.height} fill="url(#plan_grid)" />

        {/* Back Wall Representation */}
        <line
          x1={-50}
          y1={-5}
          x2={activeMod.dimensions.width + 50}
          y2={-5}
          stroke="#475569"
          strokeWidth="6"
        />

        {/* Components */}
        {planData.elements.map((el) => {
          const isSelected = el.isSelected;
          return (
            <rect
              key={el.id}
              x={el.x}
              y={el.y}
              width={Math.max(1, el.width)}
              height={Math.max(1, el.height)}
              fill={isSelected ? "#1d4ed8" : "#334155"}
              stroke={isSelected ? "#60a5fa" : "#64748b"}
              strokeWidth={isSelected ? 3 : 1.5}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setSelectedComponentId(el.id);
              }}
              className="cursor-pointer hover:brightness-125"
            />
          );
        })}

        {/* Dimension Lines */}
        {planData.dimensionLines.map((dim) => {
          const isH = dim.orientation === "horizontal";
          const midX = (dim.x1 + dim.x2) / 2;
          const midY = (dim.y1 + dim.y2) / 2;
          const pillW = Math.max(170, dim.label.length * 17 + 32);
          const pillH = 46;

          return (
            <g key={dim.id} className="select-none pointer-events-none">
              <line x1={dim.x1} y1={dim.y1} x2={dim.x2} y2={dim.y2} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="3" />
              {isH ? (
                <>
                  <line x1={dim.x1} y1={dim.y1 - 15} x2={dim.x1} y2={dim.y1 + 15} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="3" />
                  <line x1={dim.x2} y1={dim.y2 - 15} x2={dim.x2} y2={dim.y2 + 15} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="3" />
                  <rect
                    x={midX - pillW / 2}
                    y={dim.y1 - pillH - 8}
                    width={pillW}
                    height={pillH}
                    rx={10}
                    fill="#0f172a"
                    stroke="#f59e0b"
                    strokeWidth="2.5"
                  />
                  <text
                    x={midX}
                    y={dim.y1 - 18}
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    fill="#fbbf24"
                    fontSize="26"
                    fontWeight="700"
                    fontFamily="monospace"
                  >
                    {dim.label}
                  </text>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <line x1={dim.x1 - 15} y1={dim.y1} x2={dim.x1 + 15} y2={dim.y1} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="3" />
                  <line x1={dim.x2 - 15} y1={dim.y2} x2={dim.x2 + 15} y2={dim.y2} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="3" />
                  <g transform={`translate(${dim.x1 - 38}, ${midY}) rotate(-90)`}>
                    <rect
                      x={-pillW / 2}
                      y={-pillH / 2}
                      width={pillW}
                      height={pillH}
                      rx={10}
                      fill="#0f172a"
                      stroke="#f59e0b"
                      strokeWidth="2.5"
                    />
                    <text
                      x={0}
                      y={9}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      fill="#fbbf24"
                      fontSize="26"
                      fontWeight="700"
                      fontFamily="monospace"
                    >
                      {dim.label}
                    </text>
                  </g>
                </>
              )}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Pure, dependency-free ISO/IEC 18004 QR Code SVG Generator (Versions 1..8, Byte Mode, EC Level L).
 * Runs 100% offline in both browser and Node.js with zero external CDN or network requests.
 */

interface QrVersionSpec {
  version: number;
  size: number;
  totalDataCodewords: number;
  ecCodewordsPerBlock: number;
  numBlocks: number;
  alignmentCenters: number[];
}

const QR_VERSION_TABLE_L: QrVersionSpec[] = [
  { version: 1, size: 21, totalDataCodewords: 19, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 7, numBlocks: 1, alignmentCenters: [] },
  { version: 2, size: 25, totalDataCodewords: 34, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 10, numBlocks: 1, alignmentCenters: [6, 18] },
  { version: 3, size: 29, totalDataCodewords: 55, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 15, numBlocks: 1, alignmentCenters: [6, 22] },
  { version: 4, size: 33, totalDataCodewords: 80, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 20, numBlocks: 1, alignmentCenters: [6, 26] },
  { version: 5, size: 37, totalDataCodewords: 108, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 26, numBlocks: 1, alignmentCenters: [6, 30] },
  { version: 6, size: 41, totalDataCodewords: 136, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 18, numBlocks: 2, alignmentCenters: [6, 34] },
  { version: 7, size: 45, totalDataCodewords: 156, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 20, numBlocks: 2, alignmentCenters: [6, 22, 38] },
  { version: 8, size: 49, totalDataCodewords: 194, ecCodewordsPerBlock: 24, numBlocks: 2, alignmentCenters: [6, 24, 42] },
];

const GF_EXP = new Uint8Array(512);
const GF_LOG = new Uint8Array(256);
(() => {
  let x = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = x;
    GF_LOG[x] = i;
    x <<= 1;
    if (x & 0x100) x ^= 0x11d;
  }
  for (let i = 255; i < 512; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = GF_EXP[i - 255];
  }
})();

function gfMul(a: number, b: number): number {
  if (a === 0 || b === 0) return 0;
  return GF_EXP[GF_LOG[a] + GF_LOG[b]];
}

function buildGeneratorPoly(degree: number): Uint8Array {
  let poly = new Uint8Array([1]);
  for (let i = 0; i < degree; i++) {
    const next = new Uint8Array(poly.length + 1);
    const root = GF_EXP[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < poly.length; j++) {
      next[j] ^= poly[j];
      next[j + 1] ^= gfMul(poly[j], root);
    }
    poly = next;
  }
  return poly;
}

function computeReedSolomonRemainder(data: Uint8Array, ecLen: number): Uint8Array {
  const gen = buildGeneratorPoly(ecLen);
  const rem = new Uint8Array(ecLen);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const factor = data[i] ^ rem[0];
    rem.copyWithin(0, 1);
    rem[ecLen - 1] = 0;
    if (factor !== 0) {
      for (let j = 0; j < ecLen; j++) {
        rem[j] ^= gfMul(gen[j + 1], factor);
      }
    }
  }
  return rem;
}

function computeFormatBits(ecLevelBits: number, maskPattern: number): number {
  const data = (ecLevelBits << 3) | maskPattern;
  let rem = data << 10;
  for (let i = 4; i >= 0; i--) {
    if ((rem >> (i + 10)) & 1) {
      rem ^= 0x537 << i;
    }
  }
  return ((data << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412;
}

function computeVersionBits(version: number): number {
  let rem = version << 12;
  for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
    if ((rem >> (i + 12)) & 1) {
      rem ^= 0x1f25 << i;
    }
  }
  return (version << 12) | rem;
}

export function encodeQrMatrix(text: string): boolean[][] {
  const utf8 = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
  const spec = QR_VERSION_TABLE_L.find((s) => utf8.length + 3 <= s.totalDataCodewords);
  if (!spec) {
    throw new Error(`QR payload exceeds supported Version 8 capacity (${utf8.length} bytes)`);
  }

  const bits: number[] = [];
  const pushBits = (val: number, len: number) => {
    for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      bits.push((val >>> i) & 1);
    }
  };
  pushBits(0b0100, 4);
  pushBits(utf8.length, 8);
  for (const b of utf8) pushBits(b, 8);

  const maxBits = spec.totalDataCodewords * 8;
  const termLen = Math.min(4, maxBits - bits.length);
  pushBits(0, termLen);
  while (bits.length % 8 !== 0) bits.push(0);

  const dataBytes = new Uint8Array(spec.totalDataCodewords);
  for (let i = 0; i < bits.length / 8; i++) {
    let byte = 0;
    for (let b = 0; b < 8; b++) byte = (byte << 1) | bits[i * 8 + b];
    dataBytes[i] = byte;
  }
  let padToggle = true;
  for (let i = bits.length / 8; i < spec.totalDataCodewords; i++) {
    dataBytes[i] = padToggle ? 0xec : 0x11;
    padToggle = !padToggle;
  }

  const blockDataLen = Math.floor(spec.totalDataCodewords / spec.numBlocks);
  const dataBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const ecBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  for (let b = 0; b < spec.numBlocks; b++) {
    const slice = dataBytes.slice(offset, offset + blockDataLen);
    offset += blockDataLen;
    dataBlocks.push(slice);
    ecBlocks.push(computeReedSolomonRemainder(slice, spec.ecCodewordsPerBlock));
  }

  const finalCodewords: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < blockDataLen; i++) {
    for (let b = 0; b < spec.numBlocks; b++) finalCodewords.push(dataBlocks[b][i]);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < spec.ecCodewordsPerBlock; i++) {
    for (let b = 0; b < spec.numBlocks; b++) finalCodewords.push(ecBlocks[b][i]);
  }

  const finalBits: number[] = [];
  for (const cw of finalCodewords) {
    for (let bit = 7; bit >= 0; bit--) finalBits.push((cw >>> bit) & 1);
  }

  const N = spec.size;
  const modules: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: N }, () => Array(N).fill(false));
  const isFunction: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: N }, () => Array(N).fill(false));

  const setFunc = (r: number, c: number, dark: boolean) => {
    if (r < 0 || r >= N || c < 0 || c >= N) return;
    modules[r][c] = dark;
    isFunction[r][c] = true;
  };

  const drawFinder = (topR: number, leftC: number) => {
    for (let dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) {
      for (let dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
        const r = topR + dr;
        const c = leftC + dc;
        if (r < 0 || r >= N || c < 0 || c >= N) continue;
        const inOuter = dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && dc >= 0 && dc <= 6;
        const onBorder = dr === 0 || dr === 6 || dc === 0 || dc === 6;
        const inCore = dr >= 2 && dr <= 4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4;
        setFunc(r, c, inOuter && (onBorder || inCore));
      }
    }
  };

  drawFinder(0, 0);
  drawFinder(0, N - 7);
  drawFinder(N - 7, 0);

  for (let i = 8; i < N - 8; i++) {
    setFunc(6, i, i % 2 === 0);
    setFunc(i, 6, i % 2 === 0);
  }

  const centers = spec.alignmentCenters;
  for (let i = 0; i < centers.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < centers.length; j++) {
      if (
        (i === 0 && j === 0) ||
        (i === 0 && j === centers.length - 1) ||
        (i === centers.length - 1 && j === 0)
      ) {
        continue;
      }
      const cr = centers[i];
      const cc = centers[j];
      for (let dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
        for (let dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
          const dist = Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc));
          setFunc(cr + dr, cc + dc, dist !== 1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  setFunc(4 * spec.version + 9, 8, true);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    if (!isFunction[8][i]) setFunc(8, i, false);
    if (!isFunction[i][8]) setFunc(i, 8, false);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    if (!isFunction[8][N - 1 - i]) setFunc(8, N - 1 - i, false);
    if (!isFunction[N - 1 - i][8]) setFunc(N - 1 - i, 8, false);
  }
  if (spec.version >= 7) {
    const vBits = computeVersionBits(spec.version);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const bit = ((vBits >>> i) & 1) === 1;
      const a = N - 11 + (i % 3);
      const b = Math.floor(i / 3);
      setFunc(b, a, bit);
      setFunc(a, b, bit);
    }
  }

  let bitIdx = 0;
  let upward = true;
  for (let right = N - 1; right >= 1; right -= 2) {
    if (right === 6) right = 5;
    for (let vert = 0; vert < N; vert++) {
      const r = upward ? N - 1 - vert : vert;
      for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
        const c = right - j;
        if (!isFunction[r][c]) {
          const dark = bitIdx < finalBits.length ? finalBits[bitIdx] === 1 : false;
          modules[r][c] = dark;
          bitIdx++;
        }
      }
    }
    upward = !upward;
  }

  const maskPattern = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) {
      if (!isFunction[r][c] && (r + c) % 2 === 0) {
        modules[r][c] = !modules[r][c];
      }
    }
  }

  const fmt = computeFormatBits(0b01, maskPattern);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) modules[8][i] = ((fmt >>> i) & 1) === 1;
  modules[8][7] = ((fmt >>> 6) & 1) === 1;
  modules[8][8] = ((fmt >>> 7) & 1) === 1;
  modules[7][8] = ((fmt >>> 8) & 1) === 1;
  for (let i = 9; i < 15; i++) modules[14 - i][8] = ((fmt >>> i) & 1) === 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) modules[N - 1 - i][8] = ((fmt >>> i) & 1) === 1;
  for (let i = 8; i < 15; i++) modules[8][N - 15 + i] = ((fmt >>> i) & 1) === 1;

  return modules;
}

export function generateQrCodeSvg(
  text: string,
  options?: {
    sizePx?: number;
    darkHex?: string;
    lightHex?: string;
    marginModules?: number;
  }
): string {
  const matrix = encodeQrMatrix(text);
  const N = matrix.length;
  const margin = options?.marginModules ?? 3;
  const total = N + margin * 2;
  const sizePx = options?.sizePx ?? 180;
  const darkHex = options?.darkHex ?? "#141413";
  const lightHex = options?.lightHex ?? "#FFFFFF";

  const pathParts: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) {
      if (matrix[r][c]) {
        pathParts.push(`M${c + margin},${r + margin}h1v1h-1z`);
      }
    }
  }

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${total} ${total}" width="${sizePx}" height="${sizePx}" shape-rendering="crispEdges" role="img" aria-label="QR Kod"><rect width="${total}" height="${total}" fill="${lightHex}" rx="2"/><path d="${pathParts.join("")}" fill="${darkHex}"/></svg>`;
}

import type { DesignProject } from "@birim/core";

export interface VerifiedQuoteRecord {
  code: string;
  projectId: string;
  projectTitle: string;
  version: number;
  createdAt: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  discountPercent: number;
  installments: number;
  serverVerifiedSubtotalEur: number;
  serverVerifiedTotalWithVatEur: number;
  serverVerifiedDiscountedTotalEur: number;
  serverVerifiedTotalWithVatTry: number;
  cutPiecesCount: number;
  totalSheetsCount: number;
  canApproveProduction: boolean;
  hmacSignature: string;
  projectSnapshot: DesignProject;
}

export function encodeSharePayloadBase64Url(payload: unknown): string {
  const json = JSON.stringify(payload);
  if (typeof Buffer !== "undefined") {
    return Buffer.from(json, "utf8")
      .toString("base64")
      .replace(/\+/g, "-")
      .replace(/\//g, "_")
      .replace(/=+$/g, "");
  }
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
  let binary = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/g, "");
}

export function decodeSharePayloadBase64Url<T = unknown>(token: string): T | null {
  try {
    const padded = token.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/") + "===".slice((token.length + 3) % 4);
    if (typeof Buffer !== "undefined") {
      return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(padded, "base64").toString("utf8")) as T;
    }
    const binary = atob(padded);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

import crypto from "crypto";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import type { VerifiedQuoteRecord } from "./quote-codec";

const MEMORY_QUOTES = new Map<string, VerifiedQuoteRecord>();

function getStoreFilePath(): string {
  const customDir = process.env.BIRIM_QUOTES_DATA_DIR || process.cwd();
  return path.join(customDir, ".birim-quotes-store.json");
}

function getSigningSecret(): string {
  return (
    process.env.BIRIM_QUOTE_SIGNING_SECRET ||
    "birim-dev-hmac-secret-change-in-production-v46"
  );
}

function loadDiskQuotesOnce(): void {
  if (MEMORY_QUOTES.size > 0) return;
  try {
    const file = getStoreFilePath();
    if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")) as VerifiedQuoteRecord[];
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      for (const rec of parsed) {
        if (rec && typeof rec.code === "string") {
          MEMORY_QUOTES.set(rec.code.toUpperCase(), rec);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal in read-only serverless containers; MEMORY_QUOTES remains active
  }
}

function persistDiskQuotes(): void {
  try {
    const file = getStoreFilePath();
    const list = Array.from(MEMORY_QUOTES.values()).slice(-500);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(list, null, 2), "utf8");
  } catch {
    // Ignore EROFS in read-only edge/serverless deployments
  }
}

export function generateShortQuoteCode(): string {
  const alphabet = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ";
  const bytes = crypto.randomBytes(6);
  let token = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    token += alphabet[bytes[i] % alphabet.length];
  }
  return `BRM-${token}`;
}

export function computeQuoteHmac(payload: Omit<VerifiedQuoteRecord, "hmacSignature">): string {
  const canonical = [
    payload.code,
    payload.projectId,
    payload.version,
    payload.createdAt,
    payload.expiresAt,
    payload.discountPercent.toFixed(2),
    payload.serverVerifiedSubtotalEur.toFixed(2),
    payload.serverVerifiedTotalWithVatEur.toFixed(2),
    payload.serverVerifiedDiscountedTotalEur.toFixed(2),
    payload.cutPiecesCount,
  ].join("|");
  return crypto.createHmac("sha256", getSigningSecret()).update(canonical, "utf8").digest("hex");
}

export function verifyQuoteHmac(record: VerifiedQuoteRecord): boolean {
  const { hmacSignature, ...rest } = record;
  const expected = computeQuoteHmac(rest);
  try {
    return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
      Buffer.from(hmacSignature, "hex"),
      Buffer.from(expected, "hex")
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function saveVerifiedQuote(
  unsignedRecord: Omit<VerifiedQuoteRecord, "hmacSignature">
): VerifiedQuoteRecord {
  loadDiskQuotesOnce();
  const hmacSignature = computeQuoteHmac(unsignedRecord);
  const signed: VerifiedQuoteRecord = {
    ...unsignedRecord,
    hmacSignature,
  };
  MEMORY_QUOTES.set(signed.code.toUpperCase(), signed);
  persistDiskQuotes();
  return signed;
}

export function getVerifiedQuoteByCode(code: string): VerifiedQuoteRecord | null {
  loadDiskQuotesOnce();
  const rec = MEMORY_QUOTES.get(String(code || "").trim().toUpperCase());
  if (!rec) return null;
  if (!verifyQuoteHmac(rec)) return null;
  return rec;
}

function cloneProject(project: DesignProject): DesignProject {
  const nextVersion = (project.version || 1) + 1;
  return {
    ...project,
    status: "draft",
    version: nextVersion,
    schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    catalogVersion: project.catalogVersion || project.libraryVersionId || "lib_v4_0_0",
    revisionId: `rev_v${nextVersion}`,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    space: {
      ...project.space,
      walls: project.space.walls.map((w) => ({
        ...w,
        position: { ...w.position },
        elements: w.elements ? w.elements.map((el) => ({ ...el, position: { ...el.position }, dimensions: { ...el.dimensions } })) : [],
      })),
      elements: project.space.elements
        ? project.space.elements.map((el) => ({
            ...el,
            position: { ...el.position },
            dimensions: { ...el.dimensions },
          }))
        : [],
      floorPlanUnderlay: project.space.floorPlanUnderlay
        ? structuredClone(project.space.floorPlanUnderlay)
        : undefined,
    },
    modules: project.modules.map((m) => ({
      ...m,
      dimensions: { ...m.dimensions },
      position: { ...m.position },
      rotation: m.rotation ? { ...m.rotation } : { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
      componentMaterialOverrides: m.componentMaterialOverrides
        ? { ...m.componentMaterialOverrides }
        : undefined,
      componentGrainOverrides: m.componentGrainOverrides
        ? { ...m.componentGrainOverrides }
        : undefined,
      carcass: {
        ...m.carcass,
        customCadPolygon: m.carcass.customCadPolygon
          ? m.carcass.customCadPolygon.map((pt) => ({ ...pt }))
          : undefined,
      },
      bays: m.bays.map((b) => ({
        ...b,
        door: {
          ...b.door,
          customCadPolygon: b.door.customCadPolygon
            ? b.door.customCadPolygon.map((pt) => ({ ...pt }))
            : undefined,
        },
        shelves: b.shelves.map((s) => ({ ...s })),
        drawers: b.drawers.map((d) => ({ ...d })),
        hangingRails: b.hangingRails.map((r) => ({ ...r })),
        specialFittings: b.specialFittings ? b.specialFittings.map((f) => ({ ...f })) : [],
        subDividers: b.subDividers ? b.subDividers.map((sd) => ({ ...sd })) : [],
      })),
    })),
  };
}

let storeNestingDebounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

function scheduleBackgroundStoreNesting(project: DesignProject, bom: ManufacturingBOM) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || bom.cutList.length === 0) return;
  if (storeNestingDebounceTimer) clearTimeout(storeNestingDebounceTimer);
  const targetProjectId = project.id;
  const targetVersion = project.version;
  const targetRev = project.revisionId;
  storeNestingDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    storeNestingDebounceTimer = null;
    void computeNestingAsync(bom.cutList, targetVersion, undefined, {
      projectId: targetProjectId,
      revisionId: targetRev,
    }).then((workerSheets) => {
      if (!workerSheets) return;
      const latest = useConfiguratorStore.getState();
      if (latest.project.id === targetProjectId && latest.project.version === targetVersion) {
        const refreshedBom = { ...latest.bom, nestingResults: workerSheets };
        useConfiguratorStore.setState({
          bom: refreshedBom,
          pricing: calculateProjectPrice(refreshedBom),
        });
      }
    });
  }, 180);
}

function recompute(project: DesignProject, options?: { syncInitial?: boolean }) {
  const validationIssues = validateProject(project);
  const compat = evaluateProjectCompatibility(project);
  project.verificationSnapshot = {
    overallStatus: compat.overallStatus,
    canApproveProduction: compat.canApproveProduction,
    unverifiedCount: compat.evidenceMatrix.unverifiedPartOrOpCount,
    evaluatedAt: compat.evidenceMatrix.evaluatedAt,
  };
  // SSR Hydration Determinism: initial store boot runs synchronous nesting on BOTH server & client
  // so initial HTML and hydrated client DOM match byte-for-byte (e.g. € 2.589,62 === € 2.589,62).
  // Subsequent interactive mutations in the browser offload nesting to the background Web Worker.
  const skipNesting = Boolean(!options?.syncInitial && typeof window !== "undefined");
  const bom = generateBOMForProject(project, undefined, { skipSyncNesting: skipNesting });
  const pricing = calculateProjectPrice(bom);
  const activeMod = project.modules[0] || createDefaultWardrobeModule();
  const smartAdvice = analyzeAndAdviseSpan(activeMod.dimensions.width, activeMod.dimensions.height);
  if (skipNesting) {
    scheduleBackgroundStoreNesting(project, bom);
  }
  return { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice };
}

function nextHistory(history: DesignProject[], current: DesignProject, batchStartProject: DesignProject | null): DesignProject[] {
  if (batchStartProject) return history;
  return [...history.slice(-15), current];
}

const initialProj = createInitialProject();
const { validationIssues: initIssues, bom: initBom, pricing: initPricing, smartAdvice: initAdvice } = recompute(initialProj, { syncInitial: true });

export const useConfiguratorStore = create<ConfiguratorState>((set, get) => ({
  project: initialProj,
  activeModuleIndex: 0,
  viewMode: "3d",
  selectedComponentId: null,
  doorOpenAngleDeg: 0,
  drawerOpenMm: 0,
  explodedFactor: 0,
  isOrthographic: false,
  cameraPreset: "iso",
  uiMode: "simple",
  userExperienceTier: "simple",
  activeBayIndex: 0,
  autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
  validationIssues: initIssues,
  bom: initBom,
  pricing: initPricing,
  smartAdvice: initAdvice,
  history: [],
  future: [],
  revisions: [],
  batchStartProject: null,
  selectedModuleIds: initialProj.modules[0] ? [initialProj.modules[0].id] : [],

  setUiMode: (uiMode) =>
    set({
      uiMode,
      userExperienceTier: uiMode === "technical" ? "architect" : "simple",
    }),
  setUserExperienceTier: (userExperienceTier) =>
    set({
      userExperienceTier,
      uiMode: userExperienceTier === "simple" ? "simple" : "technical",
    }),
  setActiveBayIndex: (activeBayIndex) => set({ activeBayIndex }),
  setAutoSaveStatus: (autoSaveStatus) => set({ autoSaveStatus }),
  setViewMode: (viewMode) => set({ viewMode }),
  setCameraPreset: (cameraPreset) => set({ cameraPreset }),
  setSelectedComponentId: (selectedComponentId) => set({ selectedComponentId }),
  setActiveModuleIndex: (activeModuleIndex) => {
    const curState = get();
    const mods = curState.project.modules;
    const clampedIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(mods.length - 1, activeModuleIndex));
    const targetMod = mods[clampedIdx];
    if (clampedIdx === curState.activeModuleIndex) {
      set({
        selectedModuleIds: targetMod ? [targetMod.id] : [],
      });
      return;
    }
    set({
      activeModuleIndex: clampedIdx,
      activeBayIndex: 0,
      selectedComponentId: null,
      selectedModuleIds: targetMod ? [targetMod.id] : [],
    });
  },
  setDoorOpenAngleDeg: (doorOpenAngleDeg) => set({ doorOpenAngleDeg }),
  setDrawerOpenMm: (drawerOpenMm) => set({ drawerOpenMm }),
  setExplodedFactor: (explodedFactor) => set({ explodedFactor }),
  toggleOrthographic: () => set((s) => ({ isOrthographic: !s.isOrthographic })),
  setOrthographic: (isOrthographic) => set({ isOrthographic }),
  toggleDoorOpen: () => {
    const cur = get().doorOpenAngleDeg;
    set({ doorOpenAngleDeg: cur > 0 ? 0 : 75 });
  },

  beginHistoryTransaction: () => {
    const { project } = get();
    set({ batchStartProject: structuredClone(project) });
  },

  commitHistoryTransaction: () => {
    const { batchStartProject, project, history } = get();
    if (!batchStartProject) return;
    const hasChanged =
      batchStartProject.version !== project.version ||
      batchStartProject.modules !== project.modules ||
      batchStartProject.space !== project.space;
    if (!hasChanged) {
      set({ batchStartProject: null });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(project);
    set({
      history: [...history.slice(-15), batchStartProject],
      future: [],
      batchStartProject: null,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  createRevisionSnapshot: (label) => {
    const { project, pricing, bom, revisions } = get();
    const revisionId = `rev_${project.version}_${revisions.length + 1}`;
    const snap: ProjectRevisionSnapshot = {
      revisionId,
      label: label || `Revizyon v${project.version}`,
      version: project.version,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      priceEur: pricing.totalWithVatEur,
      cutPiecesCount: bom.cutList.length,
      moduleCount: project.modules.length,
      project: structuredClone({ ...project, revisionId }),
    };
    set({ revisions: [...revisions, snap] });
    return revisionId;
  },

  restoreRevisionSnapshot: (revisionId) => {
    const { revisions, project, history } = get();
    const target = revisions.find((r) => r.revisionId === revisionId);
    if (!target) return false;
    const restored = structuredClone(target.project);
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(restored);
    set({
      history: [...history.slice(-15), project],
      future: [],
      project: restored,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: 0,
      activeBayIndex: 0,
      selectedComponentId: null,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
    return true;
  },

  diffRevisions: (fromRevisionId, toRevisionId) => {
    const { revisions } = get();
    const fromSnap = revisions.find((r) => r.revisionId === fromRevisionId);
    const toSnap = revisions.find((r) => r.revisionId === toRevisionId);
    if (!fromSnap || !toSnap) return null;

    const fromMap = new Map(fromSnap.project.modules.map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    const toMap = new Map(toSnap.project.modules.map((m) => [m.id, m]));

    const addedModuleIds = toSnap.project.modules.filter((m) => !fromMap.has(m.id)).map((m) => m.id);
    const removedModuleIds = fromSnap.project.modules.filter((m) => !toMap.has(m.id)).map((m) => m.id);
    const modifiedModuleIds = toSnap.project.modules
      .filter((m) => {
        const prev = fromMap.get(m.id);
        return prev && JSON.stringify(prev) !== JSON.stringify(m);
      })
      .map((m) => m.id);

    return {
      fromRevisionId,
      toRevisionId,
      versionDelta: toSnap.version - fromSnap.version,
      moduleCountDelta: toSnap.moduleCount - fromSnap.moduleCount,
      cutPiecesDelta: toSnap.cutPiecesCount - fromSnap.cutPiecesCount,
      priceDeltaEur: Number((toSnap.priceEur - fromSnap.priceEur).toFixed(2)),
      addedModuleIds,
      removedModuleIds,
      modifiedModuleIds,
    };
  },

  updateProjectTitle: (title) => {
    const current = get().project;
    const updated: DesignProject = { ...current, title, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    set({ project: updated, autoSaveStatus: "unsaved" });
  },

  setDimensions: (width, height, depth) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod) return;

    if (![width, height, depth].every(Number.isFinite)) return;
    const template = mod.templateId ? getV4TemplateById(mod.templateId) : undefined;
    const limits = template?.dimensionLimits;
    const clamp = (n: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, n));
    const next = {
      width: roundIntMm(mod.isFixedWidth ? mod.dimensions.width : clamp(width, limits?.minW ?? 200, limits?.maxW ?? 3600)),
      height: roundIntMm(clamp(height, limits?.minH ?? 300, limits?.maxH ?? 2800)),
      depth: roundIntMm(clamp(depth, limits?.minD ?? 200, limits?.maxD ?? 950)),
    };
    const maxSafeBays = getMaxSafeBayCount(next.width, mod.carcass.panelThickness);
    if (mod.bays.length > maxSafeBays) {
      mod.bays = mod.bays.slice(0, maxSafeBays).map((b, idx) => ({ ...b, index: idx }));
    }
    const oldInner = Math.max(1, mod.dimensions.height - mod.carcass.plinthHeight - 2 * mod.carcass.panelThickness);
    const newInner = Math.max(1, next.height - mod.carcass.plinthHeight - 2 * mod.carcass.panelThickness);
    if (next.height !== mod.dimensions.height) mod.bays.forEach((b) => {
      b.shelves.forEach((s) => {
        s.elevationY = roundIntMm(clamp((s.elevationY * newInner) / oldInner, 0, Math.max(0, newInner - (s.thickness ?? mod.carcass.panelThickness))));
      });
      b.drawers.forEach((d) => {
        d.elevationY = roundIntMm(clamp((d.elevationY * newInner) / oldInner, 0, Math.max(0, newInner - d.height)));
      });
      b.hangingRails.forEach((r) => {
        r.elevationY = roundIntMm(clamp((r.elevationY * newInner) / oldInner, 0, Math.max(0, newInner - 25)));
      });
    });
    mod.dimensions = next;
    updated.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);

    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  setMaterials: (bodyMatId, doorMatId) => {

  setBayCount: (count) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    if (count < 1 || count > 8) return;
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod) return;

    const currentBays = mod.bays;
    if (count > currentBays.length) {
      for (let i = currentBays.length; i < count; i++) {
        currentBays.push({
          index: i,
          door: { id: `door_${i}`, bayIndex: i, type: "single_left", softClose: true },
          shelves: [{ id: `shelf_${i}_mid`, bayIndex: i, elevationY: 900, isAdjustable: true }],
          hangingRails: [{ id: `rail_${i}_1`, bayIndex: i, elevationY: 1700 }],
          drawers: [],
          specialFittings: [],
        });
      }
    } else if (count < currentBays.length) {
      mod.bays = currentBays.slice(0, count);
    }
    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  setBayDoorType: (bayIdx, type) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod || !mod.bays[bayIdx]) return;

    if (type === "sliding") {
      // Real wardrobe rule: sliding tracks span across the module; ensure at least 2 bays if >=1000mm
      mod.bays.forEach((b, idx) => {
        const curMount = b.door.slidingMountingType || "top_hung_pelmet";
        b.door.type = "sliding";
        b.door.doorSystemId =
          curMount === "inset_inside"
            ? "sliding_bottom_rolling"
            : curMount === "coplanar_flush"
            ? "sliding_coplanar"
            : "sliding_top_hung";
        b.door.slidingMountingType = curMount;
        b.door.overlayType = curMount === "inset_inside" ? "inset" : "full_overlay";
        // Rear sliding leaves use flush recessed grips so front & rear doors never collide
        if (idx % 2 === 0 && mod.bays.length > 1) {
          b.door.handleCategory = "recessed_grip";
        }
      });
      mod.isOpenFront = false;
    } else {
      // If switching away from module-wide sliding back to hinged/open, convert any sibling sliding bays cleanly too
      const wasModuleSliding = mod.bays.some((b) => b.door.type === "sliding");
      if (wasModuleSliding && mod.bays.length > 1) {
        mod.bays.forEach((b, idx) => {
          const fallbackType =
            idx === bayIdx
              ? type
              : type === "open"
              ? "open"
              : idx === 0
              ? "single_left"
              : "single_right";
          b.door.type = fallbackType;
          b.door.doorSystemId = inferDoorSystemIdFromType(fallbackType);
          b.door.overlayType = "full_overlay";
          if (b.door.handleCategory === "recessed_grip") {
            b.door.handleCategory = "bar_handle";
          }
        });
      } else {
        mod.bays[bayIdx].door.type = type;
        mod.bays[bayIdx].door.doorSystemId = inferDoorSystemIdFromType(type);
        mod.bays[bayIdx].door.overlayType = "full_overlay";
      }
      mod.isOpenFront = false;
    }
    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  addShelf: (bayIdx) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod || !mod.bays[bayIdx]) return;

    const bay = mod.bays[bayIdx];
    const T = mod.carcass.panelThickness || 18;
    const plinthH = mod.carcass.plinthHeight ?? 100;
    const netH = Math.max(200, mod.dimensions.height - plinthH - 2 * T);
    const drawerTopY =
      bay.drawers.length > 0
        ? Math.max(...bay.drawers.map((d) => d.elevationY + d.height))
        : 0;
    const minY = Math.min(netH - 80, drawerTopY + 64);
    const maxY = Math.max(minY + 32, netH - 64);

    bay.shelves.push({
      id: `shelf_${bayIdx}_${Date.now()}`,
      bayIndex: bayIdx,
      elevationY: Math.round((minY + maxY) / 2),
      isAdjustable: true,
    });

    // Intelligently distribute all shelves in this bay evenly inside the usable cavity [drawerTopY .. netH]
    const totalShelves = bay.shelves.length;
    const usableSpan = Math.max(120, netH - drawerTopY);
    bay.shelves.forEach((sh, idx) => {
      const idealY = drawerTopY + ((idx + 1) * usableSpan) / (totalShelves + 1);
      const snappedY = Math.round(idealY / 32) * 32;
      sh.elevationY = Math.max(48, Math.min(netH - 48, snappedY));
    });

    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  removeShelf: (bayIdx, shelfId) => {

  addHangingRail: (bayIdx) => {

    const existingRails = mod.bays[bayIdx].hangingRails.length;
    const targetRailY =
      existingRails === 0
        ? Math.max(120, netH_r - 88)
        : Math.max(96, Math.round((netH_r * 0.48) / 32) * 32);
    mod.bays[bayIdx].hangingRails.push({
      id: `rail_${bayIdx}_${Date.now()}`,
      bayIndex: bayIdx,
      elevationY: Math.min(netH_r - 48, targetRailY),

    if (batchStartProject) {

  addDrawer: (bayIdx) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod || !mod.bays[bayIdx]) return;

    const bay = mod.bays[bayIdx];
    const T_d = mod.carcass.panelThickness || 18;
    const plinth_d = mod.carcass.plinthHeight ?? 100;
    const netH_d = Math.max(220, mod.dimensions.height - plinth_d - 2 * T_d);
    const prevTop =
      bay.drawers.length > 0
        ? Math.max(...bay.drawers.map((d) => d.elevationY + d.height))
        : 0;
    const drwH = Math.min(180, Math.max(110, Math.floor(netH_d / Math.max(2, bay.drawers.length + 1))));
    const clampedElev = Math.max(0, Math.min(netH_d - drwH, prevTop));
    bay.drawers.push({
      id: `drw_${bayIdx}_${Date.now()}`,
      bayIndex: bayIdx,
      elevationY: clampedElev,
      height: drwH,
      slideType: "soft_close",
    });

    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;

    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);

      smartAdvice,

  addSpecialFitting: (bayIdx, type) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod || !mod.bays[bayIdx]) return;

    const bay = mod.bays[bayIdx];
    if (!bay.specialFittings) bay.specialFittings = [];
    const defaultHeights: Record<string, number> = {
      trouser_rack: 85,
      shoe_rack: 140,
      wire_basket: 160,
      wardrobe_lift: 840,
      jewelry_tray: 70,
      corner_lemans: 520,
      pantry_pullout: 1700,
      waste_bin: 420,
      spice_pullout: 520,
      cutlery_tray: 65,
      tie_rack: 75,
      led_profile: 20,
    };
    const defaultElevs: Record<string, number> = {
      wardrobe_lift: 1100,
      pantry_pullout: 100,
      corner_lemans: 120,
      waste_bin: 80,
      spice_pullout: 80,
      shoe_rack: 180,
      trouser_rack: 680,
      wire_basket: 420,
      jewelry_tray: 820,
      cutlery_tray: 480,
    };
    const existingCount = bay.specialFittings.length;
    const T_f = mod.carcass.panelThickness || 18;
    const plinth_f = mod.carcass.plinthHeight ?? 100;
    const netH_f = Math.max(200, mod.dimensions.height - plinth_f - 2 * T_f);
    const fitH = Math.min(netH_f - 40, defaultHeights[type] ?? 120);
    const rawFitY = defaultElevs[type] ?? (160 + existingCount * 180);
    const clampedFitY = Math.max(32, Math.min(Math.max(48, netH_f - fitH - 16), rawFitY));
    bay.specialFittings.push({
      id: `fit_${bayIdx}_${Date.now()}_${existingCount}`,
      bayIndex: bayIdx,
      elevationY: clampedFitY,
      type,
      height: fitH,
    });

    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  addAdjacentModule: () => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const targetMod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    const maxRightX = updated.modules.reduce(
      (maxX, m, idx) => Math.max(maxX, (m.position?.x ?? idx * 1000) + m.dimensions.width),
      0
    );

    if (targetMod) {
      const clonedMod: ModuleInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(targetMod));
      const uid = `${Date.now()}_${updated.modules.length + 1}`;
      clonedMod.id = `mod_${uid}`;
      const baseName = targetMod.name.replace(/\s*\(Kopya\)|\s*#\d+$/g, "").trim();
      clonedMod.name = `${baseName} #${updated.modules.length + 1}`;
      clonedMod.position = {
        x: maxRightX,
        y: targetMod.position?.y ?? 0,
        z: targetMod.position?.z ?? 0,
      };
      clonedMod.bays.forEach((b, i) => {
        b.door.id = `${clonedMod.id}_door_${i}`;
        b.shelves.forEach((s, j) => {
          s.id = `${clonedMod.id}_shelf_${i}_${j}`;
        });
        b.drawers.forEach((d, j) => {
          d.id = `${clonedMod.id}_drw_${i}_${j}`;
        });
        b.hangingRails.forEach((r, j) => {
          r.id = `${clonedMod.id}_rail_${i}_${j}`;
        });
        (b.specialFittings ?? []).forEach((f, j) => {
          f.id = `${clonedMod.id}_fit_${i}_${j}`;
        });
        (b.subDividers ?? []).forEach((sd, j) => {
          sd.id = `${clonedMod.id}_subdiv_${i}_${j}`;
        });
      });
      updated.modules.push(clonedMod);
    }

    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: updated.modules.length - 1,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  duplicateActiveModule: () => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const targetMod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex] || updated.modules[0];
    if (!targetMod) return;

    const lastMod = updated.modules[updated.modules.length - 1];
    const newX = lastMod ? lastMod.position.x + lastMod.dimensions.width : 0;

    const clonedMod: ModuleInstance = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(targetMod));
    clonedMod.id = `mod_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    clonedMod.bays.forEach((b, i) => {
      b.door.id = `${clonedMod.id}_door_${i}`;
      for (const items of [b.shelves, b.drawers, b.hangingRails, b.specialFittings ?? [], b.subDividers ?? []]) items.forEach((item, j) => { item.id = `${clonedMod.id}_${i}_${item.id}_${j}`; });
    });
    clonedMod.name = `${targetMod.name} (Kopya)`;
    clonedMod.position.x = newX;

    updated.modules.push(clonedMod);
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: updated.modules.length - 1,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  removeActiveModule: () => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    if (project.modules.length === 0) return;
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    updated.modules.splice(activeModuleIndex, 1);
    const nextIdx = Math.min(activeModuleIndex, Math.max(0, updated.modules.length - 1));

    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: nextIdx,
      selectedComponentId: null,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  moveActiveModule: (deltaX: number) => {
    const { project, history, activeModuleIndex, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[activeModuleIndex];
    if (!mod) return;

    mod.position.x = Math.max(0, mod.position.x + deltaX);
    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  saveToStorage: (name?: string) => {
    const { project, pricing } = get();
    const saveId = `saved_${project.id}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    const title = name || project.title;
    const saveEntry = {
      id: saveId,
      title,
      date: new Date().toISOString(),
      priceEur: pricing.totalWithVatEur,
      project: {
        ...project,
        title,
        schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        catalogVersion: project.catalogVersion || project.libraryVersionId || "lib_v4_0_0",
        revisionId: project.revisionId || `rev_v${project.version || 1}`,
      },
    };

    try {
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("birim_saved_projects") || "[]");
      if (!Array.isArray(existing)) throw new Error("Kayıt listesi bozuk; JSON dışa aktarımını kullanın.");
      existing.unshift(saveEntry);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("birim_saved_projects", JSON.stringify(existing.slice(0, 30)));
      } catch {
        // QuotaExceededError fallback: cache oversized base64 underlay in session memory and compact history
        const compactProject = structuredClone(saveEntry.project);
        if (compactProject.space?.floorPlanUnderlay?.dataUrl && compactProject.space.floorPlanUnderlay.dataUrl.length > 150_000) {
          sessionUnderlayDataCache.set(saveId, compactProject.space.floorPlanUnderlay.dataUrl);
          compactProject.space.floorPlanUnderlay.dataUrl = undefined;
        }
        existing[0] = { ...saveEntry, project: compactProject };
        localStorage.setItem("birim_saved_projects", JSON.stringify(existing.slice(0, 12)));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      set({ autoSaveStatus: "unsaved" });
      throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? `Kayıt başarısız: ${error.message}` : "Kayıt başarısız.");
    }
    set({ autoSaveStatus: "saved" });
    return saveId;
  },

  loadFromStorage: (id: string) => {
    try {
      const list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("birim_saved_projects") || "[]");
      const found = list.find((item: { id: string; project: DesignProject }) => item.id === id);
      if (found && found.project) {
        const parsedRes = parseAndMigrateProject(found.project);
        if (!parsedRes.success) return false;
        const migrated = migrateV3ProjectToV4({ ...parsedRes.data, status: "draft" } as DesignProject);
        const cachedDataUrl = sessionUnderlayDataCache.get(id);
        if (cachedDataUrl && migrated.space?.floorPlanUnderlay && !migrated.space.floorPlanUnderlay.dataUrl) {
          migrated.space.floorPlanUnderlay.dataUrl = cachedDataUrl;
        }
        const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(migrated);
        set({
          project: migrated,
          autoSaveStatus: "saved",
          activeModuleIndex: 0,
          history: [],
          future: [],
          batchStartProject: null,
          validationIssues,
          bom,
          pricing,
          smartAdvice,
        });
        return true;
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
    return false;
  },

  getSavedProjects: () => {
    try {
      const list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("birim_saved_projects") || "[]");
      return list.map((item: { id: string; title: string; date: string; priceEur: number }) => ({
        id: item.id,
        title: item.title,
        date: item.date,
        priceEur: item.priceEur,
      }));
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  },

  exportProjectJSON: () => {
    const { project } = get();
    return JSON.stringify(
      {
        ...project,
        schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        catalogVersion: project.catalogVersion || project.libraryVersionId || "lib_v4_0_0",
        revisionId: project.revisionId || `rev_v${project.version || 1}`,
      },
      null,
      2
    );
  },

  importProjectJSON: (jsonStr: string) => {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
      const parsedRes = parseAndMigrateProject(parsed);
      if (!parsedRes.success) {
        return { success: false, error: parsedRes.error };
      }
      const validProject = migrateV3ProjectToV4({ ...parsedRes.data, status: "draft" } as DesignProject);
      const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(validProject);
      set({
        project: validProject,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
        activeModuleIndex: 0,
        history: [],
        future: [],
        batchStartProject: null,
        validationIssues,
        bom,
        pricing,
        smartAdvice,
      });
      return { success: true };
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      return { success: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "JSON ayrıştırma hatası" };
    }
  },

  approveProduction: () => {
    const { project, validationIssues } = get();
    const blockingErrors = validationIssues.filter((i) => i.blockingProduction || i.severity === "error");
    if (blockingErrors.length > 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Üretim onayı verilemez: ${blockingErrors.length} adet kritik mühendislik hatası mevcut.`,
      };
    }

    const v4Compat = evaluateProjectCompatibility(project);
    if (!v4Compat.canApproveProduction) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Üretim kontrolü tamamlanmadı (${v4Compat.overallStatus === "UNVERIFIED" ? "Saha/Fabrika Onayı Bekliyor" : v4Compat.overallStatus}): Doğrulanmamış kuralları ve üretime etkisini görmek için Üretim Kontrolü panelini açın.`,
      };
    }

    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    updated.status = "production_approved";
    updated.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const { validationIssues: newIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);

    set({
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues: newIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Tasarım versiyonu v${updated.version} başarıyla onaylandı ve üretim snapshot kilitlendi.`,
    };
  },

  applySmartSpan: (spanWidth) => {
    const { project, history, batchStartProject } = get();
    const updated = cloneProject(project);
    const mod = updated.modules[0];
    if (!mod) return;

    mod.dimensions.width = spanWidth;
    const optimalBays = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.round(spanWidth / 800)));
    mod.bays = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < optimalBays; i++) {
      mod.bays.push({
        index: i,
        door: { id: `door_${i}`, bayIndex: i, type: optimalBays === 1 ? "double" : "single_left", softClose: true },
        shelves: [{ id: `shelf_${i}_top`, bayIndex: i, elevationY: 1800, isAdjustable: false }],
        hangingRails: [{ id: `rail_${i}_1`, bayIndex: i, elevationY: 1730 }],
        drawers: i === 0 ? [{ id: `drw_${i}_1`, bayIndex: i, elevationY: 0, height: 180, slideType: "soft_close" }] : [],
        specialFittings: [],
      });
    }

    if (batchStartProject) {
      set({
        project: updated,
        autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      });
      return;
    }
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);
    set({
      history: nextHistory(history, project, batchStartProject),
      future: [],
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  undo: () => {
    const { history, project, future } = get();
    if (history.length === 0) return;
    const previous = history[history.length - 1];
    const newHistory = history.slice(0, -1);
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(previous);

    set({
      project: previous,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: Math.min(get().activeModuleIndex, previous.modules.length - 1),
      activeBayIndex: 0,
      selectedComponentId: null,
      history: newHistory,
      future: [project, ...future],
      batchStartProject: null,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  redo: () => {
    const { future, project, history } = get();
    if (future.length === 0) return;
    const next = future[0];
    const newFuture = future.slice(1);
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(next);

    set({
      project: next,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: Math.min(get().activeModuleIndex, next.modules.length - 1),
      activeBayIndex: 0,
      selectedComponentId: null,
      history: [...history, project],
      future: newFuture,
      batchStartProject: null,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
    });
  },

  applyTemplate: (templateId) => {
    const tpl = WARDROBE_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.templateId === templateId);
    if (!tpl) return;

    const nextVersion = project.version + 1;
    const updated: DesignProject = {
      ...project,
      modules: [newMod],
      version: nextVersion,
      schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      revisionId: `rev_v${nextVersion}`,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(updated);

    set({
      history: [...history.slice(-15), project],
      future: [],
      batchStartProject: null,
      project: updated,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: 0,
      validationIssues,
      bom,
      pricing,
      smartAdvice,
      selectedComponentId: null,
    });
  },

  resetToDefault: () => {
    const def = createInitialProject();
    const { validationIssues, bom, pricing, smartAdvice } = recompute(def);
    set({
      project: def,
      autoSaveStatus: "unsaved",
      activeModuleIndex: 0,
      activeBayIndex: 0,
      history: [],

      revisions: [],
      batchStartProject: null,
      selectedModuleIds: def.modules[0] ? [def.modules[0].id] : [],
      validationIssues,
      bom,

      selectedComponentId: null,

      drawerOpenMm: 0,
