                  strokeWidth="8"
                />
                <text
                  x={wallLeftSvgX + 20}
                  y={ceilingSvgY - 22}
                  fill="#44403C"
                  fontSize="28"
                  fontWeight="800"
                  fontFamily="monospace"
                >
                  {`🏠 DUVAR CEPHESİ: ${mainWallLen}mm × Tavan ${ceilingH}mm (Zemin Y: 0mm)`}
                </text>

                {/* Architectural Obstacles in Elevation (Window, Plumbing, Door, Column, Beam) */}
                {spaceObstacles.map((obs) => {
                  const ox = wallLeftSvgX + obs.position.x;
                  const ow = obs.dimensions.width;
                  const oh = obs.dimensions.height;
                  const oyBottom = obs.position.y;
                  const oySvg = floorSvgY - (oyBottom + oh);

                  const isSelElevObs =
                    selectedPlanObject?.kind === "obstacle" && selectedPlanObject.id === obs.id;
                  const onElevObsMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setSelectedPlanObject({ kind: "obstacle", id: obs.id });
                    const svgEl = (e.currentTarget as Element).closest("svg") as SVGSVGElement | null;
                    const scale = svgEl ? getElevScaleMmPerPx(svgEl) : { x: 4, y: 4 };
                    beginHistoryTransaction();
                    setElevDraggingObs({
                      id: obs.id,
                      startClientX: e.clientX,
                      startClientY: e.clientY,
                      startX: obs.position.x,
                      startY: obs.position.y,
                      mmPerPxX: scale.x,
                      mmPerPxY: scale.y,
                    });
                  };

                  if (obs.type === "window") {
                    const frameW = 48;
                    const sashW = Math.max(40, ow / 2 - frameW - 18);
                    const sashH = Math.max(60, oh - frameW * 2);
                    return (
                      <g
                        key={obs.id}
                        data-testid={`elev-obs-${obs.id}`}
                        onMouseDown={onElevObsMouseDown}
                        className="cursor-move"
                      >
                        {/* 4-Sided Dark Anthracite Outer Window Casing Frame (Doğrama Kasa Çerçevesi) */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox - 12}
                          y={oySvg - 12}
                          width={ow + 24}
                          height={oh + 24}
                          rx={4}
                          fill="#27272A"
                          stroke="#18181B"
                          strokeWidth="6"
                        />
                        {/* Inner White Sash Frame */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + frameW * 0.6}
                          y={oySvg + frameW * 0.6}
                          width={Math.max(60, ow - frameW * 1.2)}
                          height={Math.max(60, oh - frameW * 1.2)}
                          fill="#F8FAFC"
                          stroke="#475569"
                          strokeWidth="4"
                        />
                        {/* Left & Right Double-Glazed Glass Panes */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + frameW}
                          y={oySvg + frameW}
                          width={sashW}
                          height={sashH}
                          fill="#BAE6FD"
                          fillOpacity={0.82}
                          stroke="#0284C7"
                          strokeWidth="4"
                        />
                        <rect
                          x={ox + ow / 2 + 18}
                          y={oySvg + frameW}
                          width={sashW}
                          height={sashH}
                          fill="#BAE6FD"
                          fillOpacity={0.82}
                          stroke="#0284C7"
                          strokeWidth="4"
                        />
                        {/* Opening Direction Dashed V-Lines on Both Sashes */}
                        <polyline
                          points={`${ox + frameW},${oySvg + frameW} ${ox + frameW + sashW},${oySvg + oh / 2} ${ox + frameW},${oySvg + frameW + sashH}`}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="#0369A1"
                          strokeWidth="3"
                          strokeDasharray="12 8"
                        />
                        <polyline
                          points={`${ox + ow - frameW},${oySvg + frameW} ${ox + ow / 2 + 18},${oySvg + oh / 2} ${ox + ow - frameW},${oySvg + frameW + sashH}`}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="#0369A1"
                          strokeWidth="3"
                          strokeDasharray="12 8"
                        />
                        {/* Center Vertical Mullion & Metallic Window Handle (Pencere Kolu) */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + ow / 2 - 16}
                          y={oySvg + frameW * 0.6}
                          width={32}
                          height={Math.max(60, oh - frameW * 1.2)}
                          fill="#27272A"
                        />
                        <rect
                          x={ox + ow / 2 + 4}
                          y={oySvg + oh / 2 - 28}
                          width={16}
                          height={68}
                          rx={5}
                          fill="#FBBF24"
                          stroke="#78350F"
                          strokeWidth="2.5"
                        />
                        {/* Protruding Marble Window Sill (Denizlik) */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox - 34}
                          y={oySvg + oh + 8}
                          width={ow + 68}
                          height={28}
                          rx={4}
                          fill="#D6D3D1"
                          stroke="#292524"
                          strokeWidth="4"
                        />
                        {/* Sill Height Guide & Label */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + ow / 2 - 230}
                          y={oySvg + oh / 2 - 26}
                          width={460}
                          height={52}
                          rx={10}
                          fill="#0369A1"
                          opacity={0.92}
                        />
                        <text
                          x={ox + ow / 2}
                          y={oySvg + oh / 2 + 8}
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill="#FFFFFF"
                          fontSize="24"
                          fontWeight="800"
                          fontFamily="monospace"
                        >
                          {`🪟 ${obs.name} (Denizlik Y:${oyBottom}mm)`}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  }

                  if (obs.type === "plumbing") {
                    const cx = ox + ow / 2;
                    const cy = oySvg + oh / 2;
                    return (
                      <g key={obs.id} data-testid={`elev-obs-${obs.id}`} onMouseDown={onElevObsMouseDown} className="cursor-move">
                        {/* Vertical Plumbing Axis Line from Floor to Ceiling */}
                        <line
                          x1={cx}
                          y1={ceilingSvgY}
                          x2={cx}
                          y2={floorSvgY}
                          stroke="#0284C7"
                          strokeWidth="4"
                          strokeDasharray="14 8"
                        />
                        {/* Plumbing Box */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox}
                          y={oySvg}
                          width={ow}
                          height={oh}
                          rx={16}
                          fill="#E0F2FE"
                          stroke="#0284C7"
                          strokeWidth="5"
                        />
                        {/* Hot Water (Red), Cold Water (Blue), Waste Drain (Dark) */}
                        <circle cx={cx - 45} cy={cy - 15} r={18} fill="#DC2626" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="3" />
                        <circle cx={cx + 45} cy={cy - 15} r={18} fill="#2563EB" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="3" />
                        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy + 35} r={26} fill="#334155" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="4" />
                        <rect
                          x={cx - 235}
                          y={oySvg - 58}
                          width={470}
                          height={46}
                          rx={10}
                          fill="#0F172A"
                        />
                        <text
                          x={cx}
                          y={oySvg - 28}
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill="#38BDF8"
                          fontSize="23"
                          fontWeight="800"
                          fontFamily="monospace"
                        >
                          {`🚰 TESİSAT AKSI X:${Math.round(obs.position.x + ow / 2)}mm • Y:${oyBottom}mm`}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  }

                  if (obs.type === "electrical" || obs.type === "ventilation") {
                    const cx = ox + ow / 2;
                    const cy = oySvg + oh / 2;
                    return (
                      <g key={obs.id} data-testid={`elev-obs-${obs.id}`} onMouseDown={onElevObsMouseDown} className="cursor-move">
                        <rect
                          x={ox}
                          y={oySvg}
                          width={ow}
                          height={oh}
                          rx={14}
                          fill="#FEF3C7"
                          stroke="#D97706"
                          strokeWidth="5"
                        />
                        <circle cx={cx - 22} cy={cy} r={10} fill="#B45309" />
                        <circle cx={cx + 22} cy={cy} r={10} fill="#B45309" />
                        <rect
                          x={cx - 210}
                          y={oySvg - 48}
                          width={420}
                          height={40}
                          rx={8}
                          fill="#78350F"
                        />
                        <text
                          x={cx}
                          y={oySvg - 22}
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill="#FDE68A"
                          fontSize="21"
                          fontWeight="800"
                          fontFamily="monospace"
                        >
                          {`⚡ ${obs.name} (X:${obs.position.x} • Kot Y:${oyBottom}mm)`}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  }

                  if (obs.type === "door") {
                    const jambW = 64;
                    const isRightSwing = obs.doorSwing === "right";
                    const hingeX = isRightSwing ? ox + ow - jambW : ox + jambW;
                    const handleX = isRightSwing ? ox + jambW + 58 : ox + ow - jambW - 58;
                    const handleY = oySvg + oh - Math.min(oh - 200, 1020);
                    return (
                      <g key={obs.id} data-testid={`elev-obs-${obs.id}`} onMouseDown={onElevObsMouseDown} className="cursor-move">
                        {/* 3-Sided Dark Architrave Door Casing Frame (Kapı Kasası & Pervaz Çerçevesi) */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox - 12}
                          y={oySvg - 12}
                          width={ow + 24}
                          height={oh + 12}
                          fill="#292524"
                          stroke="#1C1917"
                          strokeWidth="5"
                        />
                        {/* Wood Door Leaf Inside Casing */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + jambW}
                          y={oySvg + jambW}
                          width={Math.max(120, ow - jambW * 2)}
                          height={Math.max(200, oh - jambW)}
                          fill="#D97706"
                          fillOpacity={0.85}
                          stroke="#78350F"
                          strokeWidth="5"
                        />
                        {/* Decorative Upper & Lower Recessed Door Panels */}
                        <rect
                          x={ox + jambW + 65}
                          y={oySvg + jambW + 70}
                          width={Math.max(60, ow - jambW * 2 - 130)}
                          height={Math.max(80, (oh - jambW) * 0.36)}
                          fill="#B45309"
                          fillOpacity={0.55}
                          stroke="#78350F"
                          strokeWidth="3"
                        />
                        <rect
                          x={ox + jambW + 65}
                          y={oySvg + jambW + (oh - jambW) * 0.54}
                          width={Math.max(60, ow - jambW * 2 - 130)}
                          height={Math.max(80, (oh - jambW) * 0.32)}
                          fill="#B45309"
                          fillOpacity={0.55}
                          stroke="#78350F"
                          strokeWidth="3"
                        />
                        {/* Architectural Opening-Direction Dashed V-Lines (Hinge -> Handle) */}
                        <polyline
                          points={`${hingeX},${oySvg + jambW + 20} ${handleX},${handleY} ${hingeX},${oySvg + oh - 20}`}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="#FEF08A"
                          strokeWidth="5"
                          strokeDasharray="18 10"
                        />
                        {/* 3 Hinge Barrels on Hinge Jamb */}
                        {[0.18, 0.5, 0.82].map((hr, hIdx) => (
                          <rect
                            key={hIdx}
                            x={hingeX - 8}
                            y={oySvg + jambW + (oh - jambW) * hr - 28}
                            width={16}
                            height={56}
                            rx={4}
                            fill="#FBBF24"
                            stroke="#78350F"
                            strokeWidth="2.5"
                          />
                        ))}
                        {/* Prominent Lever Door Handle & Escutcheon Plate (Kapı Kolu) */}
                        <rect
                          x={handleX - 18}
                          y={handleY - 68}
                          width={36}
                          height={136}
                          rx={8}
                          fill="#FBBF24"
                          stroke="#451A03"
                          strokeWidth="3.5"
                        />
                        <rect
                          x={isRightSwing ? handleX - 6 : handleX - 115}
                          y={handleY - 12}
                          width={120}
                          height={24}
                          rx={8}
                          fill="#FEF08A"
                          stroke="#451A03"
                          strokeWidth="3.5"
                        />
                        <rect
                          x={ox + ow / 2 - 220}
                          y={oySvg + oh * 0.46 - 26}
                          width={440}
                          height={52}
                          rx={10}
                          fill="#451A03"
                          opacity={0.92}
                        />
                        <text
                          x={ox + ow / 2}
                          y={oySvg + oh * 0.46 + 8}
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill="#FEF08A"
                          fontSize="22"
                          fontWeight="800"
                          fontFamily="monospace"
                        >
                          {`🚪 ${obs.name} (${isRightSwing ? "SAĞ MENTEŞE" : "SOL MENTEŞE"} • ${ow}×${oh})`}
                        </text>
                      </g>
                    );
                  }

                  // Column or Beam
                  return (
                    <g key={obs.id} data-testid={`elev-obs-${obs.id}`} onMouseDown={onElevObsMouseDown} className="cursor-move">
                      <rect
                        x={ox}
                        y={oySvg}
                        width={ow}
                        height={oh}
                        fill="#D6D3D1"
                        fillOpacity={0.85}
                        stroke="#44403C"
                        strokeWidth="5"
                        strokeDasharray={obs.type === "beam" ? "12 6" : undefined}
                      />
                      <text
                        x={ox + ow / 2}
                        y={oySvg + oh / 2}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        fill="#1C1917"
                        fontSize="24"
                        fontWeight="800"
                        fontFamily="monospace"
                      >
                        {`🏛️ ${obs.name} (X:${obs.position.x})`}
                      </text>
                    </g>
                  );
                })}

                {/* Empty Wall Prompt when all modules are deleted */}
                {!hasSceneModules && (
                  <g data-testid="elev-empty-scene-notice" className="pointer-events-none">
                    <rect
                      x={mainWallLen / 2 - 420}
                      y={floorSvgY - ceilingH / 2 - 44}
                      width={840}
                      height={88}
                      rx={16}
                      fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)"
                      stroke="#94A3B8"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      strokeDasharray="10 6"
                    />
                    <text
                      x={mainWallLen / 2}
                      y={floorSvgY - ceilingH / 2 + 8}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      fill="#334155"
                      fontSize="26"
                      fontWeight="800"
                      fontFamily="sans-serif"
                    >
                      📦 Sahnede dolap yok — Sol panelden veya '+ Modül Ekle' ile dolap ekleyebilirsiniz
                    </text>
                  </g>
                )}

                {/* Active Module Selection Banner in 2D Elevation */}
                {hasSceneModules && (
                <g data-testid="elev-active-mod-selection-halo">
                  <g
                    onMouseDown={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      const svgEl = (e.currentTarget as Element).closest("svg") as SVGSVGElement | null;
                      const scale = svgEl ? getElevScaleMmPerPx(svgEl) : { x: 4, y: 4 };
                      beginHistoryTransaction();
                      setElevDraggingMod({
                        modIdx: activeModuleIndex,
                        startClientX: e.clientX,
                        startClientY: e.clientY,
                        startModX: activeModule.position.x,
                        startModY: activeModule.position.y,
                        mmPerPxX: scale.x,
                        mmPerPxY: scale.y,
                      });
                    }}
                    className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
                  >
                    <rect
                      x={breakdown.overall.width / 2 - 240}
                      y={-125}
                      width={480}
                      height={46}
                      rx={12}
                      fill="#B45309"
                      stroke="#FFFFFF"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                    />
                    <text
                      x={breakdown.overall.width / 2}
                      y={-95}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      fill="#FFFFFF"
                      fontSize="22"
                      fontWeight="900"
                      fontFamily="monospace"
                    >
                      {`★ SEÇİLİ #${activeModuleIndex + 1}: ${activeModule.name} (✋ Taşı: X & Kot Y)`}
                    </text>
                  </g>
                </g>
                )}

                {/* ALL Modules Simultaneous Interior Elevation (Every cabinet stays open & directly interactive!) */}
                {project.modules.map((m, mIdx) => {
                  if (mIdx === activeModuleIndex) return null;
                  const mx = wallLeftSvgX + m.position.x;
                  const my = floorSvgY - (m.position.y + m.dimensions.height);
                  const mw = m.dimensions.width;
                  const mh = m.dimensions.height;
                  const dimY = -38;

                  const nBreakdown = generateModuleGeometry(m, { doorOpenAngleDeg: 0 });
                  const nElevData = generateElevation2D(nBreakdown, selectedComponentId || undefined);
                  const nRails = nBreakdown.components.filter((c) => c.role === "hanging_rail");
                  const nElements = nElevData.elements.filter((el) => {
                    if (!showDoorsIn2D && el.role.startsWith("door") && el.role !== "door_hinge") {
                      return false;
                    }
                    if (
                      el.role.startsWith("drawer_") &&
                      el.role !== "drawer_front" &&
                      el.role !== "drawer_handle"
                    ) {
                      return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                  });

                  const startNeighborModMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<SVGGElement>) => {
                    if (elevPanMode || e.button !== 0 || e.altKey) return;
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    setActiveModuleIndex(mIdx);
                    const svgEl = (e.currentTarget as Element).closest("svg") as SVGSVGElement | null;
                    const scale = svgEl ? getElevScaleMmPerPx(svgEl) : { x: 4, y: 4 };
                    beginHistoryTransaction();
                    setElevDraggingMod({
                      modIdx: mIdx,
                      startClientX: e.clientX,
                      startClientY: e.clientY,
                      startModX: m.position.x,
                      startModY: m.position.y,
                      mmPerPxX: scale.x,
                      mmPerPxY: scale.y,
                    });
                  };

                  return (
                    <g
                      key={m.id}
                      data-testid={`elev-neighbor-mod-${mIdx}`}
                      transform={`translate(${mx}, ${my})`}
                    >
                      {/* Clean Interior Cavity Background (Never opaque gray — always open!) */}
                      <rect
                        x={0}
                        y={0}
                        width={mw}
                        height={mh}
                        fill="#FAF9F6"
                        stroke="#292524"
                        strokeWidth="3"
                        onMouseDown={startNeighborModMove}
                        className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
                      />

                      {/* Neighbor Module Carcass, Dividers, Shelves, Drawers & Special Fittings */}
                      {nElements.map((el) => {
                        const isHinge = el.role === "door_hinge";
                        const isSpecialFitting = el.role === "special_fitting";
                        const isDoor = el.role.startsWith("door") && !isHinge;
                        const isDrawer = el.role.startsWith("drawer");
                        const isShelf = el.role === "shelf";
                        const isDivider = el.role === "carcass_divider";
                        const isSubDivider = el.role === "carcass_sub_divider";
                        const isDrawerHandle = el.role === "drawer_handle";
                        const dragMeta = findDraggableInteriorComponent(
                          m,
                          el.id,
                          nBreakdown.bayWidths
                        );

                        const isPlinth = el.role === "plinth";
                        const isPlinthSeal = el.role === "plinth_seal" || el.id.includes("_plinth_seal_");
                        const isHiddenLeg = el.role === "plinth_leg_hidden";
                        let fill = "#FFFFFF";
                        let stroke = "#1C1917";
                        if (isDoor) {
                          fill = "#F5F5F4";
                          stroke = "#57534E";
                        } else if (isPlinthSeal) {
                          fill = "#27272A";
                          stroke = "#18181B";
                        } else if (isPlinth) {
                          fill = "#E7E5E4";
                          stroke = "#1C1917";
                        } else if (isHiddenLeg) {
                          fill = "none";
                          stroke = "#64748B";
                        } else if (isDrawerHandle) {
                          fill = "#44403C";
                          stroke = "#1C1917";
                        } else if (isDrawer) {
                          fill = "#FEF3C7";
                          stroke = "#9A3412";
                        } else if (isShelf) {
                          fill = "#FDE68A";
                          stroke = "#B45309";
                        } else if (isDivider) {
                          fill = "#E7E5E4";
                          stroke = "#1C1917";
                        } else if (isSubDivider) {
                          fill = "#FDBA74";
                          stroke = "#9A3412";
                        } else if (isHinge) {
                          fill = "#0284C7";
                          stroke = "#0F172A";
                        } else if (isSpecialFitting) {
                          fill = "#A7F3D0";
                          stroke = "#047857";
                        }

                        const elevMm =
                          dragMeta && (dragMeta.kind === "shelf" || dragMeta.kind === "drawer")
                            ? dragMeta.startVal
                            : null;

                        return (
                          <g
                            key={el.id}
                            data-testid={`cad-el-${el.id}`}
                            onMouseDown={(e) => {
                              if (elevPanMode || e.button !== 0 || e.altKey) return;
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              setActiveModuleIndex(mIdx);
                              setSelectedComponentId(el.id);
                              if (dragMeta) {
                                beginHistoryTransaction();
                                setActiveBayIndex(dragMeta.bayIdx);
                                setInteriorDrag({
                                  kind: dragMeta.kind,
                                  bayIdx: dragMeta.bayIdx,
                                  targetId: dragMeta.targetId,
                                  startClientX: e.clientX,

                              } else {

                          <rect

                            fontWeight="800"

          {/* Render 2D Elements (Carcass, Dividers, Shelves, Drawers) */}

"use client";

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { ModuleInstance, DEFAULT_MATERIALS, calculateBayWidths } from "@birim/core";
import { V4ModuleTemplateDefinition } from "@birim/catalog";

export interface V3IsometricModuleIconProps {
  module?: ModuleInstance;
  template?: V4ModuleTemplateDefinition;
  presetLayout?: "linear_kitchen" | "l_kitchen";
  bayCount?: number;
  widthMm?: number;
  heightMm?: number;
  depthMm?: number;
  hasDrawers?: boolean;
  isOpenFront?: boolean;
  doorColorHex?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl";
  testId?: string;
}

/**
 * High-resolution (viewBox 160x128) architectural 3D isometric CAD illustration for furniture modules.
 * Uses clean thin technical linework, 3D depth shading, bay-by-bay cutaway (open left bay showing
 * interior shelves/rails/drawers, closed right bay showing door leaf & handle — zero overlapping lines),
 * and dedicated multi-cabinet scenes for Linear Kitchen and L-Kitchen presets.
 */
export const V3IsometricModuleIcon: React.FC<V3IsometricModuleIconProps> = React.memo(
  ({
    module: propModule,
    template,
    presetLayout,
    bayCount: propBayCount,
    widthMm: propW,
    heightMm: propH,
    depthMm: propD,
    hasDrawers: propDrawers,
    isOpenFront: propOpen,
    doorColorHex: propColor,
    size = "md",
    testId,
  }) => {
    const resolvedModule = useMemo<ModuleInstance | undefined>(() => {
      if (propModule) return propModule;
      if (template) {
        return template.createInstance(`preview_${template.templateId}`);
      }
      return undefined;
    }, [propModule, template]);

    const dimClass =
      size === "sm"
        ? "w-11 h-9"
        : size === "md"
        ? "w-16 h-14"
        : size === "lg"
        ? "w-28 h-22"
        : size === "xl"
        ? "w-36 h-28"
        : "w-48 h-36";

    // 1. DEDICATED MULTI-MODULE ILLUSTRATION FOR LINEAR KITCHEN (3.2m)
    if (presetLayout === "linear_kitchen") {
      return (

          <rect x="18" y="24" width="22" height="82" fill="#9caf88" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />

          <line x1="104" y1="66" x2="104" y2="102" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          {/* Sink Base Double Doors */}
          <line x1="56" y1="66" x2="56" y2="102" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1" />
          {/* Middle 3-Drawer Stack */}
          <line x1="72" y1="76" x2="104" y2="76" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1" />

          <line x1="84" y1="71" x2="92" y2="71" stroke="#1c1917" strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1="84" y1="82" x2="92" y2="82" stroke="#1c1917" strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <line x1="84" y1="95" x2="92" y2="95" stroke="#1c1917" strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" />

          {/* Continuous Quartz Countertop + Backsplash */}
          <polygon points="40,66 50,58 146,58 136,66" fill="#fafaf9" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="48,58 48,40 144,40 144,58" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#a8a29e" strokeWidth="0.9" />

          <polygon points="46,64 51,60 66,60 61,64" fill="#94a3b8" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1" />
          <path d="M58,60 C58,51 53,51 53,56" fill="none" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          {/* Hob Burners */}
          <ellipse cx="116" cy="62" rx="4.5" ry="2" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ef4444" strokeWidth="0.9" />
          <ellipse cx="127" cy="62" rx="4.5" ry="2" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ef4444" strokeWidth="0.9" />

          {/* Upper Wall Cabinets (3 Modules) */}
          <polygon points="44,24 52,18 142,18 134,24" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <rect x="44" y="24" width="90" height="22" fill="#e7e5e4" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="134,24 142,18 142,40 134,46" fill="#d6d3d1" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="74" y1="24" x2="74" y2="46" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          <line x1="104" y1="24" x2="104" y2="46" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          {/* Warm Under-Cabinet LED Glow */}
          <line x1="46" y1="47" x2="132" y2="47" stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // 2. DEDICATED MULTI-MODULE ILLUSTRATION FOR L-SHAPED CORNER KITCHEN (90°)
    if (presetLayout === "l_kitchen") {
      return (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 160 128"
          data-testid={testId}
          className={`${dimClass} shrink-0 overflow-visible`}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <polygon points="18,112 146,104 146,72 56,72 18,98" fill="#1c1917" opacity="0.1" />
          {/* Back Main Wall Base Run */}
          <polygon points="48,58 58,50 144,50 134,58" fill="#fafaf9" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <rect x="48" y="58" width="86" height="38" fill="#9caf88" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="134,58 144,50 144,88 134,96" fill="#7a8c68" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="78" y1="58" x2="78" y2="96" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          <line x1="106" y1="58" x2="106" y2="96" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          <line x1="78" y1="70" x2="106" y2="70" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1" />
          <line x1="78" y1="82" x2="106" y2="82" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1" />

          {/* 90-Degree Left Return Wing (Isometric Forward Return) */}
          <polygon points="20,78 48,58 66,58 38,78" fill="#fafaf9" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="20,78 38,78 38,114 20,114" fill="#849673" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="38,78 66,58 66,94 38,114" fill="#9caf88" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <line x1="52" y1="68" x2="52" y2="104" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          {/* Sink on Back Run + Cooktop on Return Wing */}
          <polygon points="84,56 88,52 102,52 98,56" fill="#94a3b8" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1" />
          <path d="M94,52 C94,44 89,44 89,49" fill="none" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeLinecap="round" />
          <ellipse cx="42" cy="68" rx="4.5" ry="2.2" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ef4444" strokeWidth="0.9" />

          {/* Back Wall Upper Cabinets */}
          <polygon points="52,20 60,14 142,14 134,20" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <rect x="52" y="20" width="82" height="20" fill="#e7e5e4" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.3" />
          <polygon points="134,20 142,14 142,34 134,40" fill="#d6d3d1" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.2" />
          <line x1="80" y1="20" x2="80" y2="40" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
          <line x1="108" y1="20" x2="108" y2="40" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.1" />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    const tplId = (
      resolvedModule?.templateId ||
      template?.templateId ||
      ""
    ).toLowerCase();
    const familyId = resolvedModule?.moduleFamilyId || template?.familyId;
    const compRole =
      resolvedModule?.complementaryRole || template?.complementaryRole;
    const isCorner = Boolean(resolvedModule?.isCorner || template?.isCorner);

    const wMm = resolvedModule
      ? resolvedModule.dimensions.width
      : propW || 1200;
    const hMm = resolvedModule
      ? resolvedModule.dimensions.height
      : propH || 2200;
    const dMm = resolvedModule
      ? resolvedModule.dimensions.depth
      : propD || 600;
    const bays = resolvedModule
      ? resolvedModule.bays.length
      : propBayCount || 2;

    const firstDoor = resolvedModule?.bays[0]?.door;
    const doorSystemId =
      firstDoor?.doorSystemId || template?.defaultDoorSystemId || "hinged_double";

    const isOpen = resolvedModule
      ? Boolean(
          resolvedModule.isOpenFront ||
            resolvedModule.bays.every((b) => b.door.type === "open" || b.door.doorSystemId === "open")
        )
      : Boolean(propOpen);

    const matDef = resolvedModule
      ? DEFAULT_MATERIALS.find(
          (m) => m.id === resolvedModule.carcass.doorMaterialId
        )
      : undefined;
    const isGlassDoor =
      resolvedModule?.carcass.doorMaterialId === "mat_smoked_glass" ||
      tplId.includes("glass");
    const frontColor =
      propColor ||
      (isGlassDoor ? "#334155" : matDef?.colorHex) ||
      (familyId?.startsWith("fam_kitchen") ? "#9caf88" : "#c5a075");

    // 3. COMPLEMENTARY PARTS (Countertop, Plinth, Filler, LED, Feet)
    if (familyId === "fam_complementary" || compRole) {
      return (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 160 128"
          data-testid={testId}
          className={`${dimClass} shrink-0 overflow-visible`}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {compRole === "leveling_feet" ? (
            <g>
              {[38, 66, 94, 122].map((lx, idx) => (
                <g key={idx}>
                  <rect x={lx - 5} y={38} width={10} height={42} rx={2} fill="#374151" stroke="#111827" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                  <ellipse cx={lx} cy={84} rx={12} ry={5} fill="#1f2937" stroke="#111827" strokeWidth="1.5" />
                </g>
              ))}
            </g>
          ) : compRole === "led_channel" ? (
            <g>
              <polygon points="24,78 124,42 134,52 34,88" fill="#fef08a" stroke="#ca8a04" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <line x1="28" y1="82" x2="128" y2="46" stroke="#f59e0b" strokeWidth="4" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </g>
          ) : (
            <g>
              <polygon points="22,64 44,44 138,44 116,64" fill="#f5f5f4" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <rect x="22" y="64" width="94" height="16" fill={frontColor} stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <polygon points="116,64 138,44 138,60 116,80" fill="#d6d3d1" stroke="#292524" strokeWidth="1.5" />
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // 3B. DEDICATED 3D ISOMETRIC CORNER CABINET ILLUSTRATION (90° L-Corner & Blind Corner)
    const nameLower = (resolvedModule?.name || template?.name || "").toLowerCase();
    if (isCorner || familyId === "fam_special_corner" || tplId.includes("corner") || nameLower.includes("köşe")) {
      const isBlind = tplId.includes("blind") || nameLower.includes("kör");
      const isUpperCorner =
        resolvedModule?.category === "kitchen_wall" ||
        tplId.includes("wall") ||
        nameLower.includes("üst");
      const topY = isUpperCorner ? 22 : 14;
      const botY = isUpperCorner ? 76 : 104;
      const hSpan = botY - topY;

      if (isBlind) {
        // Blind Corner (Kör Köşe): Left fixed blind panel + kidney LeMans tray preview + Right hinged access door
        return (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 160 128"
            data-testid={testId}
            className={`${dimClass} shrink-0 overflow-visible`}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <polygon points="22,108 142,108 150,96 32,96" fill="#0f172a" opacity="0.07" />
            {/* Top Countertop / Roof Slab */}
            <polygon
              points="24,28 38,16 138,16 124,28"
              fill="#f8fafc"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.4"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
            {/* Right Side 3D Face */}
            <polygon
              points="124,28 138,16 138,92 124,104"
              fill="#cbd5e1"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.4"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
            {/* Left Fixed Blind Panel (Shaded with dashed inner corner & LeMans kidney curve) */}
            <rect
              x="24"
              y="28"
              width="48"
              height="70"
              fill="#e2e8f0"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.4"
            />
            <line
              x1="28"
              y1="32"
              x2="68"
              y2="94"
              stroke="#64748b"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
              strokeDasharray="3 2"
            />
            <path
              d="M 34 54 C 46 46, 64 48, 66 58 C 68 66, 50 68, 36 62 Z"
              fill="#EEF3F8"
              stroke="#475569"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
            <path
              d="M 34 76 C 46 68, 64 70, 66 80 C 68 88, 50 90, 36 84 Z"
              fill="#EEF3F8"
              stroke="#475569"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
            {/* Center Corner Filler Stile (Kör Köşe Dönüş Çıtası) */}
            <rect
              x="72"
              y="28"
              width="6"
              height="70"
              fill={frontColor}
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.2"
            />
            {/* Right Hinged Access Door */}
            <rect
              x="78"
              y="28"
              width="46"
              height="70"
              fill={frontColor}
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.4"
            />
            {/* Handle on Left Edge of Right Access Door */}
            <line
              x1="84"
              y1="54"
              x2="84"
              y2="70"
              stroke="#111827"
              strokeWidth="2.2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            {/* Plinth */}
            <rect
              x="26"
              y="98"
              width="96"
              height="6"
              fill="#64748b"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
          </svg>
        );
      }

      // True 90° L-Corner Cabinet (L-Köşe Dolabı): Unmistakable 3D L-Shaped Top + Left Forward Return Wing + Right Main Wing + Inner 90° Bi-Fold Doors
      return (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 160 128"
          data-testid={testId}
          className={`${dimClass} shrink-0 overflow-visible`}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {/* L-Shaped Floor Shadow */}
          <polygon
            points={`22,${botY + 12} 68,${botY + 12} 68,${botY + 2} 134,${botY + 2} 144,${botY - 8} 44,${botY - 8}`}
            fill="#0f172a"
            opacity="0.08"
          />

          {/* Right Main Wing Front Door (Back-Right Arm of the L) */}
          <rect
            x="72"
            y={topY + 14}
            width="54"
            height={hSpan - 12}
            fill={frontColor}
            stroke="#334155"
            strokeWidth="1.4"
          />
          {/* Right Wing 3D Side Face */}
          <polygon
            points={`126,${topY + 14} 140,${topY + 2} 140,${botY - 10} 126,${botY + 2}`}
            fill="#cbd5e1"
            stroke="#334155"
            strokeWidth="1.35"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          {/* Right Wing Plinth */}
          {!isUpperCorner && (
            <rect
              x="72"
              y={botY - 4}
              width="54"
              height="6"
              fill="#64748b"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
          )}

          {/* Left Forward 90° Return Wing — Inner Z-Return Door Face (Angled toward inner corner) */}
          <polygon
            points={`54,${topY + 30} 72,${topY + 14} 72,${botY + 2} 54,${botY + 16}`}
            fill={frontColor}
            stroke="#334155"
            strokeWidth="1.4"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <polygon
            points={`54,${topY + 30} 72,${topY + 14} 72,${botY + 2} 54,${botY + 16}`}
            fill="#0f172a"
            opacity="0.1"
          />

          {/* Left Forward 90° Return Wing — Front End Panel (Gable Face at Z-max) */}
          <rect
            x="24"
            y={topY + 30}
            width="30"
            height={hSpan - 12}
            fill="#e2e8f0"
            stroke="#334155"
            strokeWidth="1.4"
          />
          {!isUpperCorner && (
            <rect
              x="24"
              y={botY + 10}
              width="30"
              height="6"
              fill="#64748b"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
          )}

          {/* Unmistakable 3D L-Shaped Top Roof / Countertop Polygon */}
          <polygon
            points={`24,${topY + 30} 54,${topY + 2} 140,${topY + 2} 126,${topY + 14} 72,${topY + 14} 54,${topY + 30}`}
            fill="#f8fafc"
            stroke="#334155"
            strokeWidth="1.5"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />

          {/* 90° Inner-Corner Bi-Fold Meeting Seam & Dual Handles */}
          <line
            x1="72"
            y1={topY + 14}
            x2="72"
            y2={botY - 4}
            stroke="#111827"
            strokeWidth="1.8"
          />
          <line
            x1="78"
            y1={topY + Math.round(hSpan * 0.44)}
            x2="78"
            y2={topY + Math.round(hSpan * 0.64)}
            stroke="#111827"
            strokeWidth="2.1"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
          <line
            x1="66"
            y1={topY + Math.round(hSpan * 0.48)}
            x2="66"
            y2={topY + Math.round(hSpan * 0.68)}
            stroke="#111827"
            strokeWidth="2.1"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        </svg>
      );
    }

    // 4. STANDARD & SPECIAL CABINET GEOMETRY IN 160x128 VIEWBOX
    const isWallCab = familyId === "fam_kitchen_wall";
    const isBaseCab =
      familyId === "fam_kitchen_base" || tplId.includes("island");

    const normW = Math.max(
      52,
      Math.min(112, Math.round(48 + (wMm / 2400) * 64))
    );
    const normH = isWallCab
      ? Math.max(42, Math.min(62, Math.round((hMm / 900) * 54)))
      : isBaseCab
      ? 68
      : Math.max(76, Math.min(96, Math.round((hMm / 2400) * 92)));
    const isoDx = Math.max(14, Math.min(24, Math.round((dMm / 650) * 20)));
    const isoDy = Math.round(isoDx * 0.55);

    const x0 = Math.round((160 - (normW + isoDx)) / 2);
    const y0 = isWallCab
      ? 26
      : Math.round((122 - (normH + isoDy)) / 2) + isoDy;

    const topPoints = `${x0},${y0} ${x0 + isoDx},${y0 - isoDy} ${
      x0 + normW + isoDx
    },${y0 - isoDy} ${x0 + normW},${y0}`;

    const sidePoints = `${x0 + normW},${y0} ${x0 + normW + isoDx},${
      y0 - isoDy
    } ${x0 + normW + isoDx},${y0 + normH - isoDy} ${x0 + normW},${y0 + normH}`;

    const isSink = tplId.includes("sink");
    const isCooktop = tplId.includes("cooktop");
    const isOvenBase = tplId.includes("kb_09_oven");
    const isOvenTower =
      tplId.includes("oven_tower") || tplId.includes("oven_microwave");
    const isMicrowaveWall = tplId.includes("microwave_wall");
    const isHood = tplId.includes("hood");
    const isFridge = tplId.includes("fridge");
    const isSliding =
      doorSystemId.startsWith("sliding") || tplId.includes("sliding");
    const isLift = doorSystemId.startsWith("lift_");

    const plinthPx = isWallCab ? 0 : 6;
    const usableH = normH - plinthPx;
    const bayWidthsMm = resolvedModule
      ? calculateBayWidths(resolvedModule)
      : Array.from({ length: bays }, () => wMm / bays);
    const totalBayW = Math.max(1, bayWidthsMm.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0));

    return (
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 160 128"
        data-testid={testId}
        className={`${dimClass} shrink-0 overflow-visible`}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="iso_top_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ffffff" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ebe7df" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="iso_side_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#dfd9ce" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#b8b0a2" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="iso_cavity_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ede4d3" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#fcf9f2" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        {/* Soft Multi-Layer Studio Floor Shadow */}
        <polygon
          points={`${x0 + 2},${y0 + normH + 6} ${x0 + normW + isoDx + 8},${
            y0 + normH - isoDy + 6
          } ${x0 + normW + 4},${y0 + normH + 12} ${x0 - 6},${y0 + normH + 12}`}
          fill="#0c0a09"
          opacity={isWallCab ? 0.04 : 0.08}
        />
        <polygon
          points={`${x0 + 4},${y0 + normH + 4} ${x0 + normW + isoDx + 4},${
            y0 + normH - isoDy + 4
          } ${x0 + normW + 2},${y0 + normH + 8} ${x0 - 2},${y0 + normH + 8}`}
          fill="#1c1917"
          opacity={isWallCab ? 0.07 : 0.14}
        />

        {/* Top 3D Face with Studio Gradient */}
        <polygon
          points={topPoints}
          fill="url(#iso_top_grad)"
          stroke="#292524"
          strokeWidth="1.45"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        />

        {/* Right Side 3D Face with Depth Gradient */}
        <polygon
          points={sidePoints}
          fill="url(#iso_side_grad)"
          stroke="#292524"
          strokeWidth="1.45"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        />

        {/* L-Corner 90-Degree Forward Return Wing */}
        {isCorner && (
          <g>
            <polygon
              points={`${x0 - 16},${y0 + 12} ${x0},${y0} ${x0 + 22},${y0} ${x0 + 6},${y0 + 12}`}
              fill="#fafaf9"
              stroke="#292524"
              strokeWidth="1.3"
            />
            <polygon
              points={`${x0 - 16},${y0 + 12} ${x0 + 6},${y0 + 12} ${x0 + 6},${y0 + normH + 10} ${x0 - 16},${y0 + normH + 10}`}
              fill={frontColor}
              stroke="#292524"
              strokeWidth="1.3"
            />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* Outer Carcass Frame Background with Interior Studio Gradient */}
        <rect
          x={x0}
          y={y0}
          width={normW}
          height={usableH}
          fill="url(#iso_cavity_grad)"
          stroke="#292524"
          strokeWidth="1.55"
        />

        {/* Plinth / Baza */}
        {!isWallCab && (
          <rect
            x={x0 + 2}
            y={y0 + usableH}
            width={normW - 4}
            height={plinthPx}
            fill="#44403c"
            stroke="#292524"
            strokeWidth="1.2"
          />
        )}

        {/* Kitchen Countertop Lip */}
        {isBaseCab && (
          <line
            x1={x0 - 1}
            y1={y0}
            x2={x0 + normW + 1}
            y2={y0}
            stroke="#44403c"
            strokeWidth="2.8"
          />
        )}

        {/* Sink Basin & Swan-Neck Faucet on Top Face */}
        {isSink && (
          <g>
            <polygon
              points={`${x0 + 10},${y0 - 2} ${x0 + 16},${y0 - isoDy + 3} ${
                x0 + normW - 8
              },${y0 - isoDy + 3} ${x0 + normW - 14},${y0 - 2}`}
              fill="#94a3b8"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="1.2"
            />
            <path
              d={`M ${x0 + normW * 0.55} ${y0 - isoDy + 3} C ${
                x0 + normW * 0.55
              } ${y0 - isoDy - 12}, ${x0 + normW * 0.42} ${
                y0 - isoDy - 12
              }, ${x0 + normW * 0.42} ${y0 - isoDy - 3}`}
              fill="none"
              stroke="#334155"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* Cooktop Burners on Top Face */}
        {(isCooktop || isOvenBase) && (
          <g>
            <ellipse
              cx={x0 + normW * 0.36}
              cy={y0 - isoDy * 0.48}
              rx={6}
              ry={2.8}
              fill="#0f172a"
              stroke="#ef4444"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
            <ellipse
              cx={x0 + normW * 0.68}
              cy={y0 - isoDy * 0.48}
              rx={6}
              ry={2.8}
              fill="#0f172a"
              stroke="#ef4444"
              strokeWidth="1.1"
            />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* Per-Bay Clean Architectural Rendering:
            - If module is open OR bayIdx === 0 on a multi-bay module (Cutaway Preview Bay!),
              render the 3D interior cavity (shelves, hanging rail + clothes hangers, internal drawers) with ZERO door clutter on top!
            - On closed bays (or right half of single-bay), render the clean door leaf, hinge markers, and handle! */}
        {(() => {
          let curX = x0;
          return bayWidthsMm.map((bwMm, bIdx) => {
            const bw = (bwMm / totalBayW) * normW;
            const bx0 = curX;
            curX += bw;

            const bayObj = resolvedModule?.bays[bIdx];
            const bayDoorSys = bayObj?.door.doorSystemId || doorSystemId;
            const bayDoorType =
              bayObj?.door.type ||
              (bayDoorSys === "hinged_double" ? "double" : "single_left");

            const bayShelves = bayObj ? bayObj.shelves.length : 2;
            const bayRails = bayObj ? bayObj.hangingRails.length : 0;
            const bayExtDrawers = bayObj
              ? bayObj.drawers.filter((d) => !d.isInternal)
              : propDrawers && bIdx === bays - 1
              ? [
                  { id: "d0", elevationY: 0, height: 180 },
                  { id: "d1", elevationY: 185, height: 180 },
                ]
              : [];
            const bayIntDrawers = bayObj
              ? bayObj.drawers.filter((d) => d.isInternal)
              : [];

            const dCount = Math.min(4, bayExtDrawers.length);
            const hasDoorInBay =
              !isOpen &&
              bayDoorType !== "open" &&
              bayDoorSys !== "open" &&
              !isOvenBase;

            // Never stretch bottom drawers over the full wardrobe height when bay is open!
            const isDrawerOnlyModule =
              dCount > 0 && bayShelves === 0 && bayRails === 0 && isBaseCab;
            const drawerZoneH =
              dCount === 0
                ? 0
                : isDrawerOnlyModule
                ? usableH - 2
                : Math.min(usableH * 0.36, Math.max(12, dCount * 10.5));

            const upperTopY = y0 + 1.5;
            const upperBottomY = y0 + usableH - drawerZoneH;
            const upperH = Math.max(8, upperBottomY - upperTopY);

            // Only show open interior when the bay is genuinely open or glass-doored (matches 3D product 1-to-1!)
            const showInteriorInUpperBay = !hasDoorInBay || isGlassDoor;

            return (
              <g key={`bay_${bIdx}`}>
                {/* Vertical Carcass Divider between Bays */}
                {bIdx < bayWidthsMm.length - 1 && (
                  <line
                    x1={bx0 + bw}
                    y1={y0}
                    x2={bx0 + bw}
                    y2={y0 + usableH}
                    stroke="#292524"
                    strokeWidth="1.6"
                  />
                )}

                {/* A. UPPER BAY ZONE: EITHER CLEAN 3D INTERIOR CAVITY OR CLEAN CLOSED DOOR LEAF */}
                {isOvenBase ? (
                  <g>
                    <rect
                      x={bx0 + 4}
                      y={y0 + 6}
                      width={bw - 8}
                      height={usableH - 14}
                      rx={2}
                      fill="#0f172a"
                      stroke="#475569"
                      strokeWidth="1.2"
                    />
                    <line
                      x1={bx0 + 8}
                      y1={y0 + 11}
                      x2={bx0 + bw - 8}
                      y2={y0 + 11}
                      stroke="#f59e0b"
                      strokeWidth="1.5"
                    />
                  </g>
                ) : isOvenTower ? (
                  <g>
                    <rect
                      x={bx0 + 1.5}
                      y={y0 + 1.5}
                      width={bw - 3}
                      height={usableH * 0.25}
                      fill={frontColor}
                      stroke="#292524"
                      strokeWidth="1.1"
                    />
                    <rect
                      x={bx0 + 3}
                      y={y0 + usableH * 0.28}
                      width={bw - 6}
                      height={usableH * 0.16}
                      rx={1.5}
                      fill="#0f172a"
                      stroke="#475569"
                      strokeWidth="1.1"
                    />
                    <rect
                      x={bx0 + 3}
                      y={y0 + usableH * 0.46}
                      width={bw - 6}
                      height={usableH * 0.22}
                      rx={1.5}
                      fill="#0f172a"
                      stroke="#475569"
                      strokeWidth="1.1"
                    />
                    <line
                      x1={bx0 + 7}
                      y1={y0 + usableH * 0.5}
                      x2={bx0 + bw - 7}
                      y2={y0 + usableH * 0.5}
                      stroke="#f59e0b"
                      strokeWidth="1.4"
                    />
                  </g>
                ) : showInteriorInUpperBay ? (
                  <g>
                    {/* 3D Inner Depth Wall Shading */}
                    <polygon
                      points={`${bx0 + 1.5},${upperTopY} ${bx0 + Math.min(7, bw * 0.22)},${upperTopY + 4} ${bx0 + Math.min(7, bw * 0.22)},${upperBottomY - 2} ${bx0 + 1.5},${upperBottomY}`}
                      fill="#e2d9c8"
                    />
                    {/* Clothes Hanging Rail + Garment Hangers */}
                    {bayRails > 0 && (
                      <g>
                        <line
                          x1={bx0 + 2}
                          y1={upperTopY + 12}
                          x2={bx0 + bw - 2}
                          y2={upperTopY + 12}
                          stroke="#64748b"
                          strokeWidth="2"
                        />
                        {[0.34, 0.64].map((rx, hIdx) => (
                          <g key={hIdx}>
                            <path
                              d={`M ${bx0 + bw * rx} ${upperTopY + 12} L ${bx0 + bw * rx - 5} ${upperTopY + 19} L ${bx0 + bw * rx + 5} ${upperTopY + 19} Z`}
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="#475569"
                              strokeWidth="1.2"
                            />
                            <rect
                              x={bx0 + bw * rx - 4.5}
                              y={upperTopY + 19}
                              width={9}
                              height={Math.min(18, upperH * 0.32)}
                              rx={1.5}
                              fill={hIdx === 0 ? "#cbd5e1" : "#d6d3d1"}
                              stroke="#64748b"
                              strokeWidth="0.9"
                            />
                          </g>
                        ))}
                      </g>
                    )}

                    {/* Crisp 3D Oak Shelves */}
                    {Array.from({ length: Math.min(4, bayShelves) }).map((_, sIdx) => {
                      const startOffset = bayRails > 0 ? upperH * 0.46 : 4;
                      const span = Math.max(10, upperH - startOffset - 4);
                      const sy =
                        upperTopY +
                        startOffset +
                        ((sIdx + 1) * span) / (Math.min(4, bayShelves) + 1);
                      return (
                        <g key={sIdx}>
                          <polygon
                            points={`${bx0 + 1.5},${sy} ${bx0 + 5},${sy - 2.5} ${bx0 + bw - 1.5},${sy - 2.5} ${bx0 + bw - 1.5},${sy}`}
                            fill="#e7d8c1"
                          />
                          <rect
                            x={bx0 + 1.5}
                            y={sy}
                            width={Math.max(4, bw - 3)}
                            height={2.6}
                            fill="#b45309"
                          />
                        </g>
                      );
                    })}
                  </g>
                ) : (
                  /* CLEAN CLOSED DOOR LEAF(S) IN THIS BAY */
                  <g>
                    <rect
                      x={bx0 + 1.2}
                      y={upperTopY}
                      width={Math.max(4, bw - 2.4)}
                      height={upperH}
                      fill={frontColor}
                      stroke="#292524"
                      strokeWidth="1.25"
                      rx="1"

                      x={bx0 + 2.8}
                      y={upperTopY + 1.6}
                      width={Math.max(2, bw - 5.6)}
                      height={Math.max(2, upperH - 3.2)}
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="#ffffff"
                      strokeOpacity="0.32"
                      strokeWidth="0.9"
                      rx="0.5"
                    />
                    {/* Double Door Center Split (also when bay width > 600mm on hinged) */}
                    {(bayDoorType === "double" ||
                      bayDoorSys === "hinged_double" ||
                      (!isLift && !isSliding && bwMm > 600)) && (
                      <line
                        x1={bx0 + bw / 2}
                        y1={upperTopY}
                        x2={bx0 + bw / 2}
                        y2={upperBottomY}

                        strokeWidth="1.2"

                    {/* Clean Metallic Handles matching 3D hinge sides (Left-hinged door -> handle on right; Double door -> 2 center handles) */}

                      bayDoorType === "double" ||
                      bayDoorSys === "hinged_double" ||

                          <line
                            x1={bx0 + bw / 2 - 2.4}

                            strokeWidth="1.7"
                            strokeLinecap="round"

                          <line
                            x1={bx0 + bw / 2 + 2.4}
                            y1={upperTopY + upperH * 0.44}
                            x2={bx0 + bw / 2 + 2.4}

                          strokeLinecap="round"
                        />

                  </g>

                  !isOvenBase &&

                    const dh = drawerZoneH / dCount;

"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useV3Adapter } from "../adapter/useV3Adapter";
import { SavedProjectMeta } from "../../store/useConfiguratorStore";
import { FolderOpen, Save, Trash2, Check, X } from "lucide-react";

export const V3ProjectModal: React.FC<{
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { project, saveToStorage, loadFromStorage, getSavedProjects } = useV3Adapter();
  const [saveTitle, setSaveTitle] = useState(project.title);
  const [savedList, setSavedList] = useState<SavedProjectMeta[]>([]);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackIsError, setFeedbackIsError] = useState(false);

  const refresh = () => {
    setSavedList(getSavedProjects());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setSaveTitle(project.title);
      refresh();
      setFeedback(null);
      setFeedbackIsError(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen, project.title]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSave = () => {
    try {
      const id = saveToStorage(saveTitle.trim() || project.title);
      setFeedbackIsError(false);
      setFeedback(`Tasarım kaydedildi (${id.slice(0, 10)})`);
      refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      setFeedbackIsError(true);
      setFeedback(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Kayıt başarısız.");
    }
  };

  const handleLoad = (id: string) => {
    const ok = loadFromStorage(id);
    if (ok) {
      setFeedback("Tasarım başarıyla yüklendi.");
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("birim_saved_projects");
      if (raw) {
        const parsed: SavedProjectMeta[] = JSON.parse(raw);
        localStorage.setItem(
          "birim_saved_projects",
          JSON.stringify(parsed.filter((p) => p.id !== id))
        );
        refresh();
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      data-testid="v3-project-modal"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-stone-950/40 backdrop-blur-xs p-4 select-none"
    >
      <div className="birim-ice-popover rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full overflow-hidden text-stone-900">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-stone-200 flex items-center justify-between bg-stone-50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700" />
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold">Proje Kayıt & Yükleme</h2>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-testid="v3-modal-close"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-200/60 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {feedback && (
          <div
            role={feedbackIsError ? "alert" : "status"}
            data-testid="v3-modal-feedback"
            className={`px-5 py-2.5 border-b text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${feedbackIsError ? "bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-800" : "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800"}`}
          >
            {feedbackIsError ? <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            <span>{feedback}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="p-5 space-y-5">
          {/* Save Section */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 block">
              Aktif Tasarımı Kaydet
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                data-testid="v3-save-input"
                value={saveTitle}
                onChange={(e) => setSaveTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Proje adı..."
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 text-xs font-medium text-stone-900 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-700"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                data-testid="v3-save-confirm-btn"
                onClick={handleSave}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Kaydet
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Saved List */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-700">
              Kayıtlı Tasarımlar ({savedList.length})
            </div>
            {savedList.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-6 text-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-stone-300 text-xs text-stone-500">
                Henüz kaydedilmiş bir proje yok.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {savedList.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    data-testid={`v3-saved-item-${idx}`}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-900">{item.title}</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-amber-800 font-semibold">
                        €{item.priceEur?.toLocaleString("tr-TR", { minimumFractionDigits: 0 })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-testid={`v3-load-btn-${idx}`}
                        onClick={() => handleLoad(item.id)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Aç / Yükle
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-red-600 cursor-pointer"
                        title="Sil"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

let cachedContactAoTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
function getContactAoShadowTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  if (cachedContactAoTex) return cachedContactAoTex;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 256;
  canvas.height = 256;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(128, 128, 18, 128, 128, 126);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.84)");
  grad.addColorStop(0.48, "rgba(15, 14, 12, 0.52)");
  grad.addColorStop(0.78, "rgba(20, 18, 16, 0.22)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(20, 18, 16, 0.0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedContactAoTex = tex;
  return tex;
}

let cachedCreviceAoTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
function getLinearCreviceAoTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  if (cachedCreviceAoTex) return cachedCreviceAoTex;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 64;
  canvas.height = 128;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 128);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.56)");
  grad.addColorStop(0.38, "rgba(12, 11, 10, 0.22)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(12, 11, 10, 0.0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 128);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedCreviceAoTex = tex;
  return tex;
}

const cachedSideCornerAoMap = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
function getHorizontalCornerAoTexture(side: "left" | "right"): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const hit = cachedSideCornerAoMap.get(side);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 128;
  canvas.height = 64;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const grad =
    side === "left"
      ? ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 128, 0)
      : ctx.createLinearGradient(128, 0, 0, 0);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.46)");
  grad.addColorStop(0.36, "rgba(12, 11, 10, 0.16)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(12, 11, 10, 0.0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 64);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedSideCornerAoMap.set(side, tex);
  return tex;
}

const cachedUnderShelfGlowMap = new Map<number, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
function getKelvinUnderShelfWashTexture(kelvin: number): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const kKey = kelvin <= 2800 ? 2700 : kelvin >= 3800 ? 4000 : 3000;
  const hit = cachedUnderShelfGlowMap.get(kKey);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const W = 96;
  const H = 192;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const img = ctx.createImageData(W, H);
  const [rC, gC, bC] =
    kKey === 2700 ? [255, 208, 142] : kKey === 4000 ? [255, 248, 236] : [255, 228, 182];
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    const v = y / (H - 1);
    const vertFade = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - v), 2.35);
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const u = x / (W - 1);
      const horizFade = Math.pow(Math.sin(u * Math.PI), 0.45);
      const a = Math.round(255 * 0.48 * vertFade * horizFade);
      const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
      img.data[idx] = rC;
      img.data[idx + 1] = gC;
      img.data[idx + 2] = bC;
      img.data[idx + 3] = x === 0 || x === W - 1 || y === H - 1 ? 0 : a;
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedUnderShelfGlowMap.set(kKey, tex);
  return tex;
}

const cachedStripBloomMap = new Map<number, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
function getGaussianLedBloomTexture(kelvin: number): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const kKey = kelvin <= 2800 ? 2700 : kelvin >= 3800 ? 4000 : 3000;
  const hit = cachedStripBloomMap.get(kKey);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const W = 128;
  const H = 64;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = W;
  canvas.height = H;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const img = ctx.createImageData(W, H);
  const [rC, gC, bC] =
    kKey === 2700 ? [255, 214, 154] : kKey === 4000 ? [255, 250, 242] : [255, 236, 198];
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    const v = y / (H - 1);
    const endTipFade = y === 0 || y === H - 1 ? 0 : Math.pow(Math.sin(v * Math.PI), 0.25);
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const u = x / (W - 1);
      // Strict Gaussian bell curve across width so outer edges are 100% transparent (ZERO hard yellow band!)
      const d = (u - 0.5) * 6.4;
      const gauss = x === 0 || x === W - 1 ? 0 : Math.exp(-d * d);
      const a = Math.round(255 * gauss * endTipFade);
      const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
      img.data[idx] = rC;
      img.data[idx + 1] = gC;
      img.data[idx + 2] = bC;
      img.data[idx + 3] = a;
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedStripBloomMap.set(kKey, tex);
  return tex;
}

function computeHeroStudioFraming(
  bounds: THREE.Box3,
  fovDeg: number,
  aspect: number,
  angle: "hero" | "front" = "hero"
): { target: THREE.Vector3; position: THREE.Vector3; dist: number } {
  const center = bounds.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const size = bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(
    center.x,
    bounds.min.y + size.y * 0.485,
    center.z
  );
  const halfVertRad = ((fovDeg || 30) * Math.PI) / 360;
  const tanV = Math.max(0.18, Math.tan(halfVertRad));
  const safeAspect = Math.max(0.85, aspect || 1.5);
  const tanH = tanV * safeAspect;
  // Tight showroom vertical & horizontal fill (~84% vertical height, matching reference studio photograph)
  const distForHeight = (size.y * 0.595) / tanV;
  const distForWidth = (size.x * 0.64) / tanH;
  const dist = Math.max(2100, distForHeight, distForWidth);
  const dir =
    angle === "front"
      ? new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.02, 1).normalize()
      : new THREE.Vector3(0.28, 0.048, 1.0).normalize();
  const position = target.clone().addScaledVector(dir, dist);
  return { target, position, dist };
}

let cachedLedWashTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
function getWarmLedWashTexture(): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  if (cachedLedWashTex) return cachedLedWashTex;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 128;
  canvas.height = 128;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return null;
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 128, 0);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255, 202, 108, 0.34)");
  grad.addColorStop(0.38, "rgba(255, 206, 124, 0.12)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255, 210, 140, 0.0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  cachedLedWashTex = tex;
  return tex;
}
