                          value: ds.id,
                          label: ds.name,
                          badge: ds.verifiedForProduction ? "CNC Onaylı" : "Önizleme",
                        }))}
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[13px] font-bold text-stone-700 block mb-1">
                        Kapak Bini / Yerleşim Tipi
                      </label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1">
                        {[
                          { id: "full_overlay", label: "Tam Bini" },
                          { id: "half_overlay", label: "Yarım Bini" },
                          { id: "inset", label: "İçerde (Inset)" },
                        ].map((ov) => (
                          <button
                            key={ov.id}
                            type="button"
                            data-testid={`v4-overlay-${ov.id}`}
                            onClick={() =>
                              setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                overlayType: ov.id as DoorOverlayType,
                              })
                            }
                            className={`py-1 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                              (activeBay.door.overlayType || "full_overlay") === ov.id
                                ? "bg-[#EEF3F8] text-[#1C1917] border border-[#CBD5E1]"
                                : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-200"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {ov.label}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[13px] font-bold text-stone-700 block mb-1.5">
                        2. Kulp & Profil Sistemi (Görsel Seçim)
                      </label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 mb-2">
                        {[
                          { cat: "bar_handle", label: "Çubuk Kulp (Bar)" },
                          { cat: "knob", label: "Düğme Kulp (Knob)" },
                          { cat: "long_profile_handle", label: "Boy Profil (100cm)" },
                          { cat: "gola_profile", label: "Gola Kanal Profil" },
                          { cat: "j_pull", label: "J-Pull (Kendinden)" },
                          { cat: "recessed_grip", label: "Gömme Kulp" },
                          { cat: "edge_profile", label: "Üst Kenar Profil" },
                          { cat: "handleless_plain", label: "Kulpsuz Düz (Bas-Aç)" },
                        ].map((hItem) => {
                          const isSel = (activeBay.door.handleCategory || "bar_handle") === hItem.cat;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={hItem.cat}
                              type="button"
                              data-testid={`v4-handle-visual-btn-${hItem.cat}`}
                              onClick={() =>
                                setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                  handleCategory: hItem.cat as HandleCategory,
                                })
                              }
                              className={`p-2 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-2 text-left transition cursor-pointer ${
                                isSel
                                  ? "bg-[#EEF3F8] border-[#1C1917] text-[#111827] shadow-xs"
                                  : "bg-stone-50 hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] border-stone-200 text-stone-800"
                              }`}
                            >
                              <svg viewBox="0 0 36 28" className="w-8 h-6 shrink-0">
                                <rect
                                  x="2"
                                  y="2"
                                  width="32"
                                  height="24"
                                  rx="2"
                                  fill={isSel ? "#92400E" : "#FFFFFF"}
                                  stroke="currentColor"
                                  strokeWidth="1.6"
                                />
                                {hItem.cat === "knob" ? (
                                  <circle cx="26" cy="14" r="3.5" fill="currentColor" />
                                ) : hItem.cat === "bar_handle" ? (
                                  <rect x="25" y="7" width="3" height="14" rx="1" fill="currentColor" />
                                ) : hItem.cat === "long_profile_handle" ? (
                                  <rect x="26" y="3" width="3" height="22" rx="1" fill="currentColor" />
                                ) : hItem.cat === "gola_profile" || hItem.cat === "j_pull" || hItem.cat === "edge_profile" ? (
                                  <rect x="3" y="3" width="30" height="4" fill="currentColor" />
                                ) : hItem.cat === "recessed_grip" ? (
                                  <rect x="12" y="5" width="12" height="5" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" />
                                ) : null}
                              </svg>
                              <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight">{hItem.label}</span>
                            </button>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[#57534E] mb-1">Geometriler temsilidir. Kulp montajı ve gelişmiş kapak hareketleri teknik doğrulama bekliyor.</p>
                      <V3PremiumDropdown
                        label="Kulp & Profil Kategorisi"
                        testId="v4-handle-select"
                        value={activeBay.door.handleCategory || "bar_handle"}
                        onChange={(val) =>
                          setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                            handleCategory: val as HandleCategory,
                          })
                        }
                        options={handleProfiles.map((hp) => ({
                          value: hp.category,
                          label: hp.name,
                        }))}
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <V3PremiumDropdown
                        label="3. Açılma Konforu & Mekanizma"
                        testId="v4-opening-select"
                        value={activeBay.door.openingTechnology || "soft_close"}
                        onChange={(val) =>
                          setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                            openingTechnology: val as OpeningTechnology,
                          })
                        }
                        options={openingMechanisms.map((om) => ({
                          value: om.id,
                          label: om.name,
                        }))}
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <V3PremiumDropdown
                        label="4. Üretici Donanım Profili (Blum / Hettich / Salice)"
                        testId="v4-hardware-sku-select"
                        value={activeBay.door.hardwareProductId || "hw_blum_71b3550"}
                        onChange={(val) =>
                          setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                            hardwareProductId: val,
                          })
                        }
                        options={hardwareCatalog
                          .filter(
                            (h) =>
                              h.familyId === "fam_hinge_concealed" ||
                              h.familyId === "fam_lift_system" ||
                              h.familyId === "fam_sliding_system" ||
                              h.familyId === "fam_pocket_system"
                          )
                          .map((hw) => ({
                            value: hw.id,
                            label: hw.name,
                            badge: hw.sku,
                          }))}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* 5. KAPAK KESİT PROFİLİ & ÖZEL CAD ÇİZİM (DXF / SVG) SİSTEMİ */}
                    <div
                      data-testid="studio-door-cross-section-picker"
                      className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#CBD5E1] space-y-2.5"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-[13px] font-extrabold text-[#1C1917]">
                          📐 5. Kapak Kesit Profili & Özel CAD Çizim (DXF/SVG)
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#EBE6DC] text-[#2C2A29] font-bold">
                          CNC Kesit
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <V3PremiumDropdown
                        label="Aktif Kapak Kesit Profili"
                        testId="v4-door-cross-section-select"
                        value={doorCrossSectionProfile}
                        onChange={(val) => {
                          const nextProf = val as
                            | "flat_slab"
                            | "shaker_frame"
                            | "fluted_ribbed"
                            | "bevel_45"
                            | "custom_cad_profile";
                          setDoorCrossSectionProfile(nextProf);
                          setModuleDoorCrossSection(nextProf);
                          if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
                            (window as unknown as { __birimDoorCrossSection?: string }).__birimDoorCrossSection = nextProf;
                          }
                          setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                            softClose: activeBay.door.softClose,
                          } as Parameters<typeof setBayV4DoorConfig>[1]);
                        }}
                        options={[
                          {
                            value: "flat_slab",
                            label: "Düz Modern Plaka Kesit (18mm/22mm)",
                            sub: "1mm ABS kenar bantlı standart düz kapak kesiti",
                            badge: "Standart",
                          },
                          {
                            value: "shaker_frame",
                            label: "5 Parçalı Çıtalı / Shaker Çerçeve Kesit",
                            sub: "65mm dış kayıt çerçevesi + 6mm çökertmeli orta göbek",
                            badge: "CNC Çerçeve",
                          },
                          {
                            value: "fluted_ribbed",
                            label: "Dikey Mikro-Çıtalı (Fluted / Derzli) Kesit",
                            sub: "36mm adımlı CNC dikey derz kanallı mimari yüzey",
                            badge: "CNC Derz",
                          },
                          {
                            value: "bevel_45",
                            label: "45° Pahlı / Kademeli Kenar Kesiti",
                            sub: "Çevre kenarları 45° CNC pah bıçağı ile işlenmiş kesit",
                            badge: "45° Pah",
                          },
                          {
                            value: "custom_cad_profile",
                            label: customCadProfileName
                              ? `Özel CAD Kesiti: ${customCadProfileName}`
                              : "Özel DXF / SVG Kapak Kesit Çizimi",
                            sub: "Dışarıdan yüklenen 2D kesit eğrisinin (Extrude/Sweep) uygulanması",
                            badge: "DXF / SVG",
                          },
                        ]}
                      />

                      {/* Live 2D Technical Cross-Section Diagram (X-Z Kesit Önizleme) */}
                      <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <svg viewBox="0 0 120 44" className="w-28 h-11 shrink-0 bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-lg border border-[#E2E8F0] p-1">
                          {doorCrossSectionProfile === "flat_slab" && (
                            <rect x="10" y="12" width="100" height="20" rx="1.5" fill="#D6CFC2" stroke="#2C2A29" strokeWidth="2" />
                          )}
                          {doorCrossSectionProfile === "shaker_frame" && (
                            <path
                              d="M10 10 H32 V18 H88 V10 H110 V32 H10 Z"
                              fill="#D6CFC2"
                              stroke="#2C2A29"
                              strokeWidth="2"
                            />
                          )}
                          {doorCrossSectionProfile === "fluted_ribbed" && (
                            <path
                              d="M10 32 V16 H20 V22 H30 V16 H40 V22 H50 V16 H60 V22 H70 V16 H80 V22 H90 V16 H100 V22 H110 V32 Z"
                              fill="#D6CFC2"
                              stroke="#2C2A29"
                              strokeWidth="1.8"
                            />
                          )}
                          {doorCrossSectionProfile === "bevel_45" && (
                            <path
                              d="M10 32 L22 12 H98 L110 32 Z"
                              fill="#D6CFC2"
                              stroke="#2C2A29"
                              strokeWidth="2"
                            />
                          )}
                          {doorCrossSectionProfile === "custom_cad_profile" && (
                            <path
                              d={customCadSvgPath || "M10 32 V18 L20 12 H35 V18 H85 V12 H100 L110 18 V32 Z"}
                              fill="#D6CFC2"
                              stroke="#2C2A29"
                              strokeWidth="2"
                            />
                          )}
                        </svg>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
                          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-[#1C1917]">
                            2D Kesit Mantığı (Extrude & CNC Göbek)
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-[#57534E] leading-snug">
                            Yüklenen .dxf/.svg 2D kesit poligonu dış çerçevede (Sweep) ve orta göbekte (CNC Pocket) parametrik ölçeklenir.
                          </p>
                          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#EEF3F8] hover:bg-[#E4ECF4] text-[#1C1917] text-[#111827] text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer">
                            <span>📂 .DXF / .SVG Kesit Yükle</span>
                            <input
                              type="file"
                              accept=".dxf,.svg,.json"
                              className="hidden"
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                                if (!file) return;
                                const reader = new FileReader();
                                reader.onload = () => {
                                  const text = typeof reader.result === "string" ? reader.result : "";
                                  const parsed = parseDoorCrossSectionFile(file.name, text);
                                  setCustomCadProfileName(file.name);
                                  setCustomCadSvgPath(parsed.svgPathD);
                                  setDoorCrossSectionProfile("custom_cad_profile");
                                  setModuleDoorCrossSection("custom_cad_profile", file.name, parsed.points);
                                  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
                                    (window as unknown as { __birimDoorCrossSection?: string }).__birimDoorCrossSection = "custom_cad_profile";
                                  }
                                };
                                reader.readAsText(file);
                              }}
                            />
                          </label>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* ADVANCED PRODUCTION & CNC SETTINGS TOGGLE (Separates Basic Design from Factory/CNC Level) */}
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#E2E8F0]">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-testid="studio-toggle-advanced-cnc-btn"
                        onClick={() => setShowAdvancedCncLevel((v) => !v)}
                        className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#EEF3F8] hover:bg-[#E4ECF4] border border-[#CBD5E1] flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#111827] cursor-pointer transition"
                      >
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#475569]" />
                          <span>İleri Üretim & CNC Ayarları (Menteşe Delik & Kesit)</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1]">
                          {showAdvancedCncLevel ? "Daralt ▲" : "Göster ▼"}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* 5. HINGE COUNT & TOP/BOTTOM EDGE SPACING CONTROLS */}
                    {(() => {
                      const leafSpec = fourSpaceDimensions?.doorLeaves[activeBayIndex];
                      const dSys = activeBay.door.doorSystemId || "hinged_single";
                      const isHingedSys =
                        !dSys.startsWith("sliding") &&
                        !dSys.startsWith("lift") &&
                        dSys !== "open" &&
                        dSys !== "tambour_roller";
                      if (!isHingedSys || !leafSpec) return null;
                      const hyList = leafSpec.hingePositionsY || [];
                      const avgPitch =
                        hyList.length >= 2
                          ? Math.round((hyList[hyList.length - 1] - hyList[0]) / (hyList.length - 1))
                          : 0;
                      const curBotOff = activeBay.door.hingeBottomOffsetMm ?? 100;
                      const curTopOff = activeBay.door.hingeTopOffsetMm ?? 100;
                      return (
                        <div
                          data-testid="v4-hinge-spacing-panel"
                          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#E2E8F0] space-y-2"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#111827]">
                              5. Menteşe Sayısı & Kenar Aralıkları (CNC/3D/2D)
                            </span>
                            <span
                              data-testid="v4-hinge-count-badge"
                              className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#EEF3F8] text-[#111827] border border-[#CBD5E1] font-mono text-xs font-bold"
                            >
                              {leafSpec.effectiveHingeCount} Menteşe / Kanat
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/90 border border-[#E2E8F0] text-xs text-stone-700 leading-tight">
                            <span className="font-bold text-[#111827] block">
                              📐 Blum CLIP top / Hettich Sensys / DIN 68856 (System 32) Standardı:
                            </span>
                            <span>
                              ≤1000mm (≤9kg): <b>2 Ad.</b> • 1001–1600mm (≤13kg): <b>3 Ad.</b> • 1601–2200mm (≤18kg): <b>4 Ad.</b> • &gt;2200mm (&gt;18kg): <b>5 Ad.</b> (Eşit aralıklı + raf çakışma korumalı)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600 block">
                              Kanat Başına Menteşe Sayısı (Kapak H:{leafSpec.leafHeightMm}mm • {leafSpec.leafWeightKg}kg):
                            </span>
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1">
                              {[
                                { val: undefined, label: `Oto (${leafSpec.recommendedHingesPerLeaf})` },
                                { val: 2, label: "2 Adet" },
                                { val: 3, label: "3 Adet" },
                                { val: 4, label: "4 Adet" },
                                { val: 5, label: "5 Adet" },
                              ].map((hOpt) => {
                                const isSel = activeBay.door.hingeCount === hOpt.val;
                                return (
                                  <button
                                    key={hOpt.label}
                                    type="button"
                                    data-testid={`v4-hinge-count-btn-${hOpt.val ?? "auto"}`}
                                    onClick={() =>
                                      setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                        hingeCount: hOpt.val,
                                      })
                                    }
                                    className={`py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                      isSel
                                        ? "bg-[#EEF3F8] text-[#111827] border border-[#CBD5E1]"
                                        : "bg-white hover:bg-[#F1F5F9] border border-[#E2E8F0] text-stone-700"
                                    }`}
                                  >
                                    {hOpt.label}
                                  </button>
                                );
                              })}
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                            <div className="bg-white p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#E2E8F0] space-y-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-600">
                                  Alt Kenar Payı:
                                </span>
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  data-testid="v4-hinge-bottom-offset-input"
                                  min={50}
                                  max={350}
                                  step={10}
                                  value={curBotOff}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                      hingeBottomOffsetMm: Number(e.target.value),
                                    })
                                  }
                                  className="w-12 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-stone-900 text-right"
                                />
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex gap-1">
                                {[80, 100, 120, 150].map((presetOff) => (
                                  <button
                                    key={presetOff}
                                    type="button"
                                    data-testid={`v4-hinge-bot-preset-${presetOff}`}
                                    onClick={() =>
                                      setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                        hingeBottomOffsetMm: presetOff,
                                      })
                                    }
                                    className={`flex-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer ${
                                      curBotOff === presetOff
                                        ? "bg-[#2563EB] text-white"
                                        : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-700"
                                    }`}
                                  >
                                    {presetOff}
                                  </button>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="bg-white p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#E2E8F0] space-y-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-600">
                                  Üst Kenar Payı:
                                </span>
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  data-testid="v4-hinge-top-offset-input"
                                  min={50}
                                  max={350}
                                  step={10}
                                  value={curTopOff}
                                  onChange={(e) =>
                                    setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                      hingeTopOffsetMm: Number(e.target.value),
                                    })
                                  }
                                  className="w-12 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-stone-900 text-right"
                                />
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex gap-1">
                                {[80, 100, 120, 150].map((presetOff) => (
                                  <button
                                    key={presetOff}
                                    type="button"
                                    data-testid={`v4-hinge-top-preset-${presetOff}`}
                                    onClick={() =>
                                      setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
                                        hingeTopOffsetMm: presetOff,
                                      })
                                    }
                                    className={`flex-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer ${
                                      curTopOff === presetOff
                                        ? "bg-[#2563EB] text-white"
                                        : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-700"
                                    }`}
                                  >
                                    {presetOff}
                                  </button>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div
                            data-testid="v4-hinge-positions-readout"
                            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] font-mono text-xs text-[#111827] flex items-center justify-between"
                          >
                            <span>🔩 Y: {hyList.join(" • ")} mm</span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-[#111827]">ΔY: {avgPitch} mm</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}
                  </div>
                </V3CollapsibleSection>
              )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </aside>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 3. DESIGN STUDIO BOTTOM STATUS, MODULE STRIP & COMMERCIAL BAR */}
      {mode === "studio" && (() => {
        const mainModules = project.modules.filter((m) => m.category !== "complementary");
        const totalWidthMm = mainModules.reduce((acc, m) => acc + m.dimensions.width, 0);
        const totalVolM3 = mainModules.reduce(
          (acc, m) =>
            acc +
            (m.dimensions.width / 1000) *
              (m.dimensions.height / 1000) *
              (m.dimensions.depth / 1000),
          0
        );
        const estWeightKg =
          bom?.summary?.totalWeightKg ||
          Math.max(18, Math.round(totalVolM3 * 103));
        const unitPriceEur =
          mainModules.length > 0
            ? pricing.totalWithVatEur / mainModules.length
            : pricing.totalWithVatEur;

        return (
          <footer className="h-[52px] birim-ice-bar text-[#141413] border-t flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 shrink-0 z-30 gap-2.5">
            {/* Sol: Buzlu Cam Modül Film Şeridi + İkon "+" Ekleme */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-0.5 rounded-2xl birim-ice-pill">
                {project.modules.map((m, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={m.id}
                    className={`h-8 px-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 transition shrink-0 ${
                      activeModuleIndex === idx
                        ? "birim-ice-btn-active"
                        : "hover:bg-white/70 text-[#141413]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-testid={`studio-mod-pill-${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => setActiveModuleIndex(idx)}
                      title={`#${idx + 1} ${m.name} (${m.dimensions.width}×${m.dimensions.height}mm)`}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <V3IsometricModuleIcon module={m} size="sm" />
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold">
                        {isSimpleBlumMode ? `${m.dimensions.width / 10}` : m.dimensions.width}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                    {project.modules.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-testid={`studio-delete-mod-${idx}`}
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          removeModuleAt(idx);
                        }}
                        title="Bu modülü sahneden sil"
                        className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full hover:bg-red-500/20 opacity-70 hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs leading-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        ×
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}

                <button
                  type="button"

                          {wizSpaceCategory === "kitchen"
                            ? `${estModCount} Alt + ${mainModCount} Üst Modül`
                            : `~${estHanging} Askı • ~${estFolded} Katlı`}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#DED8CC] flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#8C7A6B] uppercase tracking-wider">
                          KDV Dahil Tahmini Toplam
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-[#57534E] mt-0.5">
                          {wizRoomShape === "rectangular"
                            ? "Düz duvar yerleşimi"
                            : wizRoomShape === "l_shape"
                            ? "L köşe dönüşlü yerleşim"
                            : "U tipi 3 duvar yerleşimi"}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-[#141413]">
                        ~€{estTotalEur.toLocaleString("tr-TR")}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Her Adımda Aktif "Hemen Oluştur" Aksiyon Butonları */}
                  <div className="space-y-2 mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-[#DED8CC]">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-testid="wizard-finish-3d-btn"
                      onClick={() => handleFinishStepWizard("studio_3d")}
                      className="w-full h-10 px-4 rounded-lg bg-[#141413] hover:bg-[#292524] text-[#FAF9F6] font-semibold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition active:scale-[0.99] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#D6C7B2]" />
                      <span>Tasarımı Oluştur ve 3D Stüdyoda Aç</span>
                    </button>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-testid="wizard-finish-2d-btn"
                        onClick={() => handleFinishStepWizard("plan_2d")}
                        className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg bg-white hover:bg-[#EFECE5] text-[#141413] border border-[#DED8CC] font-semibold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span>2D Planda Aç</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-testid="wizard-finish-pdf-btn"
                        onClick={() => handleFinishStepWizard("print_pdf")}
                        className="h-9 px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#8C7A6B] hover:bg-[#766557] text-white border border-[#7A695B] font-semibold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span>Sunum PDF&apos;i Al</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Alt İleri / Geri Navigasyon Çubuğu */}
              <div className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#FAF9F6] border-t border-[#DED8CC] flex items-center justify-between">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-testid="wizard-prev-btn"
                  disabled={safeStep === 1}
                  onClick={() => setWizardStep((s) => Math.max(1, s - 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5)}
                  className={`h-9 px-4 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold border transition ${
                    safeStep === 1
                      ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-[#EFECE5] text-[#78716C] border-[#DED8CC]"
                      : "bg-white hover:bg-[#EFECE5] text-[#141413] border-[#DED8CC] cursor-pointer"
                  }`}
                >
                  ‹ Önceki Adım
                </button>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((dot) => (
                    <span
                      key={dot}
                      className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${
                        safeStep === dot ? "w-6 bg-[#141413]" : "w-2 bg-[#D6D0C4]"
                      }`}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>

                {safeStep < 4 ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-testid="wizard-next-btn"
                    onClick={() => setWizardStep((s) => Math.min(4, s + 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5)}
                    className="h-9 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[#141413] hover:bg-[#292524] text-[#FAF9F6] text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Sonraki Adım ›
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleFinishStepWizard("studio_3d")}
                    className="h-9 px-5 rounded-lg bg-[#141413] hover:bg-[#292524] text-[#FAF9F6] text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ✓ Tamamla ve 3D Aç
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      <PresentationQuoteModal
        isOpen={showQuickSellModal}
        onClose={() => setShowQuickSellModal(false)}
        project={project}
        materials={DEFAULT_MATERIALS}
        pricing={pricing}
        stats={liveCustomerAndFactoryStats}
        activeConceptTier={activeConceptTier}
        onApplyConceptTier={handleApplyConceptTier}
        onSmartWallAutoFill={handleSmartWallAutoFill}
        quoteDiscountPct={quoteDiscountPct}
        onChangeDiscountPct={setQuoteDiscountPct}
        quoteInstallments={quoteInstallments}
        onChangeInstallments={setQuoteInstallments}
        ledEnabled={Boolean(activeModule.carcass.ledLightingEnabled)}
        onToggleLedUpsell={() =>
          toggleModuleLedLighting(!activeModule.carcass.ledLightingEnabled, {
            ledType: "led_vertical_strip",
            colorTempK: 3000,
            sensorType: "ir_door",
          })
        }
        onAddTrouserUpsell={() => addSpecialFitting(activeBayIndex, "trouser_pullout")}
        onAddJewelryUpsell={() => addSpecialFitting(activeBayIndex, "jewelry_tray")}
        onApplyGlassDoorUpsell={() => {
          setBayV4DoorConfig(activeBayIndex, {
            doorSubType: "alu_frame_smoked_glass",
          });
          copyDoorConfigToAllBays(activeBayIndex);
        }}
        onFix32mmCollisions={handleFix32mmHingeShelfCollisions}
        compatibilityStatus={v4CompatibilityReport.overallStatus}
        onPrintVisualPdf={(meta) => handlePrintVisualCustomerPresentation(meta)}
        onOpenNestingModal={() => {
          setShowQuickSellModal(false);
          setBomModalInitialTab("nesting");
          setIsBomModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onOpenBomModal={() => {
          setShowQuickSellModal(false);
          setBomModalInitialTab("cutlist");
          setIsBomModalOpen(true);
        }}
      />

            <V3ProjectModal
        isOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsProjectModalOpen(false)}
      />
      <BomModal isOpen={isBomModalOpen} onClose={() => setIsBomModalOpen(false)} initialTab={bomModalInitialTab} />
      <TapToPlaceController
        armedItem={armedTapItem}
        bayCount={activeModule.bays.length}
        bayWidthsMm={activeBreakdown.bayWidths}
        netInnerHeightMm={netInnerHeightMm}
        onCancel={() => setArmedTapItem(null)}
        onAppendModuleTemplate={(tplId) => applyV4Template(tplId, true)}
        onPlaceInBay={(item, bayIdx, zone) => {
          setActiveBayIndex(bayIdx);
          if (item.kind === "carcass_divider") {
            splitBayIntoTwo(bayIdx);
            return;
          }
          if (item.kind === "sub_divider") {
            addSubDivider(bayIdx);
            return;
          }
          const targetElev =
            zone === "low"
              ? Math.round(netInnerHeightMm * 0.16)
              : zone === "high"
              ? Math.round(netInnerHeightMm * 0.8)
              : Math.round(netInnerHeightMm * 0.48);
          addInteriorItemAtElevation(bayIdx, item.id, targetElev);
        }}
      />

      {showArAnd3DModal && (() => {
        const exportParts: ExportBoxPart[] = [];
        project.modules.forEach((m) => {
          const geo = generateModuleGeometry(m, { doorOpenAngleDeg: 0 });
          const rotDeg = ((m.rotation?.y ?? 0) % 360 + 360) % 360;
          const rad = (rotDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
          const cos = Math.cos(rad);
          const sin = Math.sin(rad);
          geo.components.forEach((c) => {
            const lx = c.position.x + c.dimensions.width / 2;
            const ly = c.position.y + c.dimensions.height / 2;
            const lz = c.position.z + c.dimensions.depth / 2;
            exportParts.push({
              id: c.id,
              name: c.label || c.role,
              role: c.role,
              moduleId: m.id,
              moduleName: m.name,
              materialId: c.materialId,
              positionMm: {
                x: m.position.x + lx * cos + lz * sin,
                y: m.position.y + ly,
                z: m.position.z - lx * sin + lz * cos,
              },
              dimensionsMm: { ...c.dimensions },
              rotationYDeg: rotDeg,
            });
          });
        });
        return (
          <ArRoomPreviewModal
            isOpen={showArAnd3DModal}
            onClose={() => setShowArAnd3DModal(false)}
            project={project}
            materials={DEFAULT_MATERIALS}
            parts={exportParts}
            discountPercent={quoteDiscountPct}
            installments={quoteInstallments}
            clientTotalEur={pricing.totalWithVatEur}
          />
        );
      })()}
    </div>
  );
};

export default V3UnifiedWorkspace;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. BUTTONS (Warm Cashmere & Espresso Monochrome Style)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface V3ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "danger";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "touch";
  active?: boolean;
}

export const V3Button: React.FC<V3ButtonProps> = ({
  variant = "secondary",
  size = "md",
  active = false,
  className = "",
  children,
  ...props
}) => {
  const sizeCls =
    size === "touch"
      ? "min-h-[42px] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl"
      : size === "sm"
      ? "min-h-[32px] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg"
      : "min-h-[36px] px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl";

  const variantCls = active
    ? "birim-ice-btn-active"
    : variant === "primary"
    ? "birim-ice-btn-active hover:opacity-95"
    : variant === "outline"
    ? "birim-ice-btn text-[#1C1917]"
    : variant === "danger"
    ? "bg-rose-500/15 hover:bg-rose-500/25 backdrop-blur-md text-[#9E2A2B] border border-rose-300/60"
    : variant === "ghost"
    ? "bg-transparent hover:bg-white/55 text-[#44403C]"
    : "birim-ice-btn text-[#1C1917]";

  return (
    <button
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none cursor-pointer ${sizeCls} ${variantCls} ${className}`}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. DIMENSION INPUT WITH TOUCH STEPPERS & QUICK PRESETS
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface V3DimensionControlProps {
  label: string;
  code: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  presets: number[];
  onChange: (val: number) => void;
  testIdPrefix?: string;
}

export const V3DimensionControl: React.FC<V3DimensionControlProps> = ({
  label,
  code,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step = 50,
  presets,
  onChange,
  testIdPrefix = "dim",
}) => {
  const clamp = (v: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(v)));
  const [draftText, setDraftText] = React.useState<string>(String(value));
  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = React.useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rangeHint, setRangeHint] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isFocused) {
      setDraftText(String(value));
    }
  }, [value, isFocused]);

  const commitDraft = (rawStr: string) => {
    const trimmed = rawStr.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setDraftText(String(value));
      setRangeHint(null);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = Number(trimmed);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
      setDraftText(String(value));
      setRangeHint(null);
      return;
    }
    if (parsed < min || parsed > max) {
      const clamped = clamp(parsed);
      setRangeHint(`Üretim sınırı ${min}–${max} mm (${clamped} mm uygulandı)`);
      setDraftText(String(clamped));
      onChange(clamped);
      return;
    }
    setRangeHint(null);
    const rounded = clamp(parsed);
    setDraftText(String(rounded));
    onChange(rounded);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/58 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/75 shadow-2xs space-y-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-white/72">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-[#F5F3EE] border border-[#DED8CC] text-[#141413] font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            {code}
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#141413] block truncate">{label}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#78716C] block">
              {(value / 10).toFixed(value % 10 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} cm
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-minus`}
            onClick={() => {
              setRangeHint(null);
              onChange(clamp(value - step));
            }}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#FAF9F6] hover:bg-[#EFECE5] border border-[#DED8CC] text-[#141413] font-bold text-sm flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
            title={`-${step} mm`}
          >
            −
          </button>
          <input
            type="number"
            data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-input`}
            min={min}
            max={max}
            step={10}
            value={isFocused ? draftText : value}
            onFocus={() => {
              setIsFocused(true);
              setDraftText(String(value));
            }}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const raw = e.target.value;
              setDraftText(raw);
              const parsed = Number(raw);
              if (raw.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
                if (parsed >= min && parsed <= max) {
                  setRangeHint(null);
                  onChange(Math.round(parsed));
                } else {
                  setRangeHint(`Geçerli aralık: ${min} – ${max} mm`);
                }
              }
            }}
            onBlur={(e) => {
              setIsFocused(false);
              commitDraft(e.target.value);
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                e.currentTarget.blur();
              } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
                setIsFocused(false);
                setDraftText(String(value));
                setRangeHint(null);
              }
            }}
            className={`w-18 h-7 px-1.5 bg-white border rounded-lg text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#141413] focus:outline-none ${
              rangeHint
                ? "border-amber-500 ring-1 ring-amber-400/40"
                : "border-[#DED8CC] focus:border-[#141413]"
            }`}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-plus`}
            onClick={() => {
              setRangeHint(null);
              onChange(clamp(value + step));
            }}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#FAF9F6] hover:bg-[#EFECE5] border border-[#DED8CC] text-[#141413] font-bold text-sm flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
            title={`+${step} mm`}
          >
            +
          </button>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-[#78716C]">mm</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {rangeHint && (
        <div
          role="status"
          className="text-[10px] font-medium text-[#8C5A2B] bg-[#FDF8F2] border border-[#EAD5BE] rounded-lg px-2 py-1"
        >
          {rangeHint}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
        {presets.map((p) => {
          const isSelected = value === p;
          return (
            <button
              key={p}
              type="button"
              data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-preset-${p}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setRangeHint(null);
                onChange(p);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 min-w-[44px] py-1 px-1.5 rounded-lg font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                isSelected
                  ? "bg-[#141413] text-white border border-[#141413]"
                  : "bg-[#FAF9F6] hover:bg-[#EFECE5] text-[#44403C] border border-[#E4DFD5]"
              }`}
            >
              {p}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <input
        type="range"
        data-testid={`${testIdPrefix}-slider`}
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={50}
        value={value}
        onPointerDown={() => {
          useConfiguratorStore.getState().beginHistoryTransaction();
        }}
        onPointerUp={() => {
          useConfiguratorStore.getState().commitHistoryTransaction();
        }}
        onPointerCancel={() => {
          useConfiguratorStore.getState().commitHistoryTransaction();
        }}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setRangeHint(null);
          onChange(Number(e.target.value));
        }}
        className="w-full accent-[#141413] h-1.5 bg-[#E4DFD5] rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. MATERIAL SWATCH CARD
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface V3MaterialSwatchProps {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  colorHex: string;
  costPerM2: number;
  category: string;
  selected: boolean;
  onSelect: () => void;
  compact?: boolean;
  testId?: string;
}

export const V3MaterialSwatch: React.FC<V3MaterialSwatchProps> = ({
  name,
  colorHex,
  costPerM2,
  category,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  compact = false,
  testId,
}) => {
  if (compact) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        data-testid={testId}
        onClick={onSelect}
        className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer ${
          selected
            ? "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-[#2C2A29] text-[#1C1917] ring-1 ring-[#2C2A29]"
            : "bg-white hover:bg-[#FFFFFF] border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#44403C]"
        }`}
      >
        <span
          className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full border border-stone-300 shadow-inner shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center"
          style={{ backgroundColor: colorHex }}
        >
          {selected && (
            <Check
              className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
                colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#f3f4f6" || colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#ede8d0"
                  ? "text-stone-950"
                  : "text-white"
              }`}
            />
          )}
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#111827] truncate">{name}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#78716C]">€{costPerM2}/m²</div>
        </div>
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      data-testid={testId}
      onClick={onSelect}
      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer ${
        selected
          ? "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-[#2C2A29] text-[#1C1917] ring-1 ring-[#2C2A29] shadow-2xs"
          : "bg-white hover:bg-[#FFFFFF] border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#44403C]"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
        <span
          className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg border border-stone-300 shadow-inner shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center"
          style={{ backgroundColor: colorHex }}
        >
          {selected && (
            <Check
              className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${
                colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#f3f4f6" || colorHex.toLowerCase() === "#ede8d0"
                  ? "text-stone-950"
                  : "text-white"
              }`}
            />
          )}
        </span>
        <div className="truncate">
          <div className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#111827] truncate">{name}</div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#475569] truncate">
            {category || "18mm Kalibrasyonlu Plaka"}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#44403C] shrink-0 ml-2">
        €{costPerM2}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
};

export interface V3PremiumDropdownOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  sub?: string;
  subLabel?: string;
  badge?: string;
  colorHex?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

function renderAutoOptionVisual(opt?: V3PremiumDropdownOption) {
  if (!opt) return null;
  if (opt.icon) return <span className="shrink-0 text-[#2563EB]">{opt.icon}</span>;
  const v = (opt.value || "").toLowerCase();
  const lbl = (opt.label || "").toLowerCase();

  // Auto color swatch for materials
  const matColorMap: Record<string, string> = {
    mat_melamine_white: "#F8FAFC",
    mat_melamine_cashmere: "#DFD7CC",
    mat_mdf_anthracite: "#334155",
    mat_wood_natural_oak: "#C8A476",
    mat_wood_smoked_walnut: "#5C4028",
    mat_lacquer_sage: "#849B87",
    mat_lacquer_sand: "#E2D9C8",
    mat_glass_bronze: "#785A46",
    mat_mirror_silver: "#CBD5E1",
    mat_neolith_calacatta_luxe: "#F4F1EA",
  };
  const hex = opt.colorHex || matColorMap[v];
  if (hex || v.startsWith("mat_")) {
    return (
      <span
        className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 shadow-inner shrink-0 inline-block"
        style={{ backgroundColor: hex || "#E2E8F0" }}
      />
    );
  }
  if (v.includes("blum") || lbl.includes("blum")) {
    return (
      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 text-[#FF5500] font-black text-[9px] shrink-0">
        blum
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (v.includes("hafele") || lbl.includes("häfele") || lbl.includes("loox")) {
    return (
      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-[#DC2626] font-extrabold text-[9px] shrink-0">
        HÄF
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 shrink-0">
      <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
        <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3" />
        <path d="M9 12h6" />
      </svg>
    </span>
  );
}

export const V3PremiumDropdown: React.FC<{
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  value: string;
  options: V3PremiumDropdownOption[];

}> = ({ label, placeholder, value, options, onChange, testId }) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const selectedOpt = options.find((o) => o.value === value) || options[0];

  return (
    <div

          data-testid={testId}

          ))}
        </select>
      )}
      <button
        type="button"

        className="w-full min-h-[40px] px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-slate-50/70 hover:from-blue-50/40 hover:to-blue-50/20 text-left transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.99]"
      >

          {renderAutoOptionVisual(selectedOpt)}

            {label && (
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#475569] block leading-tight mb-0.5">

                    isSel

                      : "hover:bg-slate-100/80 text-[#111827] border border-transparent"
                  }`}

                      <div className="text-xs font-bold truncate">{opt.label}</div>
                      {subTxt && (

                          className={`text-[10px] truncate ${
                            isSel ? "text-blue-700" : "text-[#64748B]"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {subTxt}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    {opt.badge && (
                      <span

import { DesignProject, ModuleInstance } from "@birim/core";

export interface ElevationSnapTarget {
  elevationY: number;
  worldY: number;
  label: string;
  sourceModuleIndex: number;
  sourceBayIndex: number;
  kind: "shelf" | "drawer_top" | "drawer_bottom" | "rail" | "mid";
}

export function findDraggableInteriorComponent(
  mod: ModuleInstance,
  compId: string,
  bayWidths: number[]
): {
  kind: "shelf" | "drawer" | "rail" | "special_fitting" | "divider" | "sub_divider";
  bayIdx: number;
  targetId: string;
  startVal: number;
  startElevY?: number;
  itemHeightMm?: number;
} | null {
  for (let bIdx = 0; bIdx < mod.bays.length; bIdx++) {
    const bay = mod.bays[bIdx];
    const shelf = bay.shelves.find(
      (s, sIdx) => s.id === compId || `${mod.id}_bay_${bIdx}_shelf_${sIdx}` === compId
    );
    if (shelf) {
      return {
        kind: "shelf",
        bayIdx: bIdx,
        targetId: shelf.id,
        startVal: shelf.elevationY,
        itemHeightMm: shelf.thickness || mod.carcass.panelThickness,
      };
    }

    const drawer = bay.drawers.find(
      (d) => compId === d.id || compId.startsWith(`${d.id}_`)
    );
    if (drawer) {
      return {
        kind: "drawer",
        bayIdx: bIdx,
        targetId: drawer.id,
        startVal: drawer.elevationY,
        itemHeightMm: drawer.height,
      };
    }

    const rail = bay.hangingRails.find(
      (r, rIdx) => r.id === compId || `${mod.id}_bay_${bIdx}_rail_${rIdx}` === compId
    );
    if (rail) {
      return {
        kind: "rail",
        bayIdx: bIdx,
        targetId: rail.id,
        startVal: rail.elevationY,
        itemHeightMm: 25,
      };
    }

    const fit = bay.specialFittings?.find(
      (f, fIdx) =>
        compId === f.id ||
        compId.startsWith(`${f.id}_`) ||
        compId === `${mod.id}_bay_${bIdx}_fit_${fIdx}` ||
        compId.startsWith(`${mod.id}_bay_${bIdx}_fit_${fIdx}_`)
    );
    if (fit) {
      return {
        kind: "special_fitting",
        bayIdx: bIdx,
        targetId: fit.id,
        startVal: fit.elevationY,
        itemHeightMm: fit.height || 100,
      };
    }

    const subDiv = bay.subDividers?.find(
      (sd, sdIdx) => sd.id === compId || `${mod.id}_bay_${bIdx}_subdiv_${sdIdx}` === compId
    );
    if (subDiv) {
      return {
        kind: "sub_divider",
        bayIdx: bIdx,
        targetId: subDiv.id,
        startVal: subDiv.offsetX,
        startElevY: subDiv.elevationY,
        itemHeightMm: subDiv.height,
      };
    }
  }

  if (compId.includes("_divider_")) {
    const divIdx = Number(compId.split("_divider_")[1]);
    if (!Number.isNaN(divIdx) && bayWidths[divIdx]) {
      return {
        kind: "divider",
        bayIdx: divIdx,
        targetId: compId,
        startVal: bayWidths[divIdx],
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export function computeElevationSnapTargets(
  project: DesignProject,
  activeModuleIndex: number,
  activeBayIndex: number,
  targetId: string,
  draggedItemHeightMm = 0
): ElevationSnapTarget[] {
  const activeMod = project.modules[activeModuleIndex] || project.modules[0];
  if (!activeMod) return [];

  const activeBaseWorldY =
    (activeMod.position?.y ?? 0) +
    activeMod.carcass.plinthHeight +
    activeMod.carcass.panelThickness;
  const activeNetInnerH = Math.max(
    200,
    activeMod.dimensions.height -
      activeMod.carcass.plinthHeight -
      2 * activeMod.carcass.panelThickness
  );

  const targets: ElevationSnapTarget[] = [];

  project.modules.forEach((mod, mIdx) => {
    const modBaseWorldY =
      (mod.position?.y ?? 0) + mod.carcass.plinthHeight + mod.carcass.panelThickness;
    const modPrefix = mIdx === activeModuleIndex ? "" : `${mod.name} • `;

    mod.bays.forEach((bay, bIdx) => {
      const isSameBay = mIdx === activeModuleIndex && bIdx === activeBayIndex;

      // 1. Shelves across all bays & modules
      bay.shelves.forEach((s) => {
        if (isSameBay && s.id === targetId) return;
        const worldY = modBaseWorldY + s.elevationY;
        const localElevY = Math.round(worldY - activeBaseWorldY);
        if (localElevY >= 0 && localElevY <= activeNetInnerH) {
          targets.push({
            elevationY: localElevY,
            worldY,
            label: `${modPrefix}B${bIdx + 1} Raf Hizası (${localElevY} mm)`,
            sourceModuleIndex: mIdx,
            sourceBayIndex: bIdx,
            kind: "shelf",
          });
        }
      });

      // 2. Drawers (Bottom & Top / Fixed Shelf Above Drawer) across all bays & modules
      bay.drawers.forEach((d) => {
        if (isSameBay && d.id === targetId) return;
        const botWorldY = modBaseWorldY + d.elevationY;
        const botLocalY = Math.round(botWorldY - activeBaseWorldY);
        if (botLocalY >= 0 && botLocalY <= activeNetInnerH) {
          targets.push({
            elevationY: botLocalY,
            worldY: botWorldY,
            label: `${modPrefix}B${bIdx + 1} Çekmece Altı (${botLocalY} mm)`,
            sourceModuleIndex: mIdx,
            sourceBayIndex: bIdx,
            kind: "drawer_bottom",
          });
        }

        const topWorldY = modBaseWorldY + d.elevationY + d.height;
        const topLocalY = Math.round(topWorldY - activeBaseWorldY);
        if (topLocalY >= 0 && topLocalY <= activeNetInnerH) {
          targets.push({
            elevationY: topLocalY,
            worldY: topWorldY,
            label: `${modPrefix}B${bIdx + 1} Çekmece Üstü (${topLocalY} mm)`,
            sourceModuleIndex: mIdx,
            sourceBayIndex: bIdx,
            kind: "drawer_top",
          });
        }

        if (draggedItemHeightMm > 30) {
          const alignTopLocalY = topLocalY - draggedItemHeightMm;
          if (alignTopLocalY >= 0 && alignTopLocalY <= activeNetInnerH) {
            targets.push({
              elevationY: alignTopLocalY,
              worldY: topWorldY,
              label: `${modPrefix}B${bIdx + 1} Çekmece Üst Hizası (${topLocalY} mm)`,
              sourceModuleIndex: mIdx,
              sourceBayIndex: bIdx,
              kind: "drawer_top",
            });
          }
        }
      });

      // 3. Hanging Rails across all bays & modules
      bay.hangingRails.forEach((r) => {
        if (isSameBay && r.id === targetId) return;
        const worldY = modBaseWorldY + r.elevationY;
        const localElevY = Math.round(worldY - activeBaseWorldY);
        if (localElevY >= 0 && localElevY <= activeNetInnerH) {
          targets.push({
            elevationY: localElevY,
            worldY,
            label: `${modPrefix}B${bIdx + 1} Askı Hizası (${localElevY} mm)`,
            sourceModuleIndex: mIdx,
            sourceBayIndex: bIdx,
            kind: "rail",
          });
        }
      });
    });
  });

  // 4. Cabinet inner midpoint
  const midElev = Math.round(activeNetInnerH / 2);
  targets.push({
    elevationY: midElev,
    worldY: activeBaseWorldY + midElev,
    label: `Dolap Orta Hizası (${midElev} mm)`,
    sourceModuleIndex: activeModuleIndex,
    sourceBayIndex: activeBayIndex,
    kind: "mid",
  });

  return targets;
}

export function resolveElevationSnap(
  rawElevationY: number,
  targets: ElevationSnapTarget[],
  thresholdMm = 18
): { elevationY: number; snappedTarget: ElevationSnapTarget | null } {
  let best: ElevationSnapTarget | null = null;
  let bestDist = thresholdMm + 0.01;

  for (const t of targets) {
    const dist = Math.abs(rawElevationY - t.elevationY);
    if (dist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = dist;
      best = t;
    }
  }

  if (best) {
    return { elevationY: best.elevationY, snappedTarget: best };
  }

  return {
    elevationY: Math.round(rawElevationY / 5) * 5,
    snappedTarget: null,
  };
}

import React from "react";
import {
  calculateModulePlacement,
  DesignProject,
  ModuleInstance,
  ArchitecturalElement,
  WallDefinition,
  ValidationIssue,
} from "@birim/core";

let activeDraggedTemplateIdState: string | null = null;
let transparentDragCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;

export function setActiveDraggedTemplateId(templateId: string | null): void {
  activeDraggedTemplateIdState = templateId;
}

export function getActiveDraggedTemplateId(): string | null {
  return activeDraggedTemplateIdState;
}

/**
 * Initiates a clean silhouette drag operation:
 * - Suppresses the browser's default rectangular HTML button screenshot via a 1x1 transparent canvas
 * - Stores the active templateId so 3D and 2D viewports can render the real-scale Cabinet Silhouette
 *   and magnetic snap target lines live during `onDragOver`.
 */
export function startModuleSilhouetteDrag(
  e: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>,
  templateId: string
): void {
  setActiveDraggedTemplateId(templateId);
  e.dataTransfer.setData("application/x-birim-template-id", templateId);
  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";

  if (typeof document !== "undefined") {
    if (!transparentDragCanvas) {
      transparentDragCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      transparentDragCanvas.width = 110;
      transparentDragCanvas.height = 96;
      transparentDragCanvas.style.position = "fixed";
      transparentDragCanvas.style.top = "0px";
      transparentDragCanvas.style.left = "0px";
      transparentDragCanvas.style.zIndex = "-9999";
      transparentDragCanvas.style.opacity = "0.01";
      transparentDragCanvas.style.pointerEvents = "none";
      document.body.appendChild(transparentDragCanvas);
    }
    const ctx = transparentDragCanvas.getContext("2d");
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 110, 96);
      const isWall = templateId.includes("_kw_") || templateId.includes("wall");
      const w = 58;
      const h = isWall ? 38 : 58;
      const dx = 14;
      const dy = 8;
      const x0 = 20;
      const y0 = isWall ? 24 : 18;

      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.lineCap = "round";

      // Isometric Top Face Silhouette
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + dx, y0 - dy);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w + dx, y0 - dy);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w, y0);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.34)";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#047857";
      ctx.stroke();

      // Isometric Right Side Face Silhouette
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0 + w, y0);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w + dx, y0 - dy);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w + dx, y0 + h - dy);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w, y0 + h);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.38)";
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();

      // Isometric Front Carcass Silhouette + Internal Shelves/Bays
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.24)";
      ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, w, h);
      ctx.strokeRect(x0, y0, w, h);

      // Center bay & shelf dashed silhouette lines
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0 + w / 2, y0);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w / 2, y0 + h);
      ctx.moveTo(x0 + 4, y0 + h * 0.36);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w - 4, y0 + h * 0.36);
      ctx.moveTo(x0 + 4, y0 + h * 0.68);
      ctx.lineTo(x0 + w - 4, y0 + h * 0.68);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
    e.dataTransfer.setDragImage(transparentDragCanvas, 52, 48);
  }
}


let accessoryDragCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;

/**
 * Sets a clean, button-free 3D isometric silhouette as the cursor drag image when dragging
 * an interior accessory (shelf, drawer, rail, trouser rack, etc.) so the browser never drags the button card.
 */
export function startAccessorySilhouetteDrag(
  e: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>,
  item: { id: string; visual: string; title: string; cat: string; spec: string }
): void {
  e.dataTransfer.setData("application/x-birim-accessory-id", item.id);
  e.dataTransfer.setData("application/x-birim-accessory-kind", item.visual);
  e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", item.title);
  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy";

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    (window as any).__birimActiveDraggedAccessory = item;
  }

  if (typeof document !== "undefined") {
    if (!accessoryDragCanvas) {
      accessoryDragCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      accessoryDragCanvas.width = 96;
      accessoryDragCanvas.height = 72;
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.position = "fixed";
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.top = "0px";
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.left = "0px";
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.zIndex = "-9999";
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.opacity = "0.01";
      accessoryDragCanvas.style.pointerEvents = "none";
      document.body.appendChild(accessoryDragCanvas);
    }
    const ctx = accessoryDragCanvas.getContext("2d");
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 96, 72);
      ctx.lineJoin = "round";
      ctx.lineCap = "round";

      if (item.visual.includes("drawer") || item.visual.includes("basket")) {
        // Draw clean 3D drawer box silhouette
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28)";
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#1D4ED8";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.fillRect(16, 20, 56, 30);
        ctx.strokeRect(16, 20, 56, 30);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(16, 20);
        ctx.lineTo(28, 10);
        ctx.lineTo(84, 10);
        ctx.lineTo(72, 20);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (item.visual === "sub_divider" || item.visual === "carcass_divider" || item.visual.includes("divider")) {
        // Draw clean 3D vertical divider panel silhouette (Raf Arası Dikme / Ara Dikme)
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35)";
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#1D4ED8";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(40, 8);
        ctx.lineTo(56, 4);
        ctx.lineTo(56, 62);
        ctx.lineTo(40, 68);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (item.visual.includes("rail")) {
        // Draw clean 3D chrome hanging rail silhouette
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#2563EB";
        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(12, 32);
        ctx.lineTo(84, 32);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        // Draw clean 3D isometric shelf / accessory board silhouette
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35)";
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#1D4ED8";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(12, 36);
        ctx.lineTo(30, 22);
        ctx.lineTo(84, 26);
        ctx.lineTo(66, 40);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    e.dataTransfer.setDragImage(accessoryDragCanvas, 48, 36);
  }
}

/**
 * Computes the oriented 2D/3D Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) of a module,
 * properly respecting 90-degree L/U corner rotations (`rotation.y`).
 */
export function classifyModuleCornerFootprint(mod: ModuleInstance): {
  isCorner: boolean;
  cornerType: CornerFootprintType;
  wingDepthMm: number;
} {
  const tplLower = (mod.templateId || "").toLowerCase();
  const nameLower = (mod.name || "").toLowerCase();
  const rawW = mod.dimensions.width;
  const rawH = mod.dimensions.height;
  const rawD = mod.dimensions.depth;

  const isWallL =
    mod.category === "kitchen_wall" || mod.moduleFamilyId === "fam_kitchen_wall";
  const isWardrobe =
    !mod.category ||
    mod.category.startsWith("wardrobe") ||
    mod.category === "special_corner" ||
    mod.moduleFamilyId === "fam_wardrobe" ||
    mod.moduleFamilyId === "fam_special_corner" ||
    Boolean(mod.templateId?.startsWith("tpl_wd_")) ||
    Boolean(mod.templateId?.startsWith("tpl_wardrobe")) ||
    Boolean(mod.templateId?.startsWith("tpl_sc_")) ||
    (Boolean(mod.isCorner) && rawH >= 1400);

  const minArm = Math.min(rawW, rawD);
  const wingDepthMm = isWallL
    ? Math.min(350, Math.round(minArm * 0.56))
    : isWardrobe
    ? Math.min(600, Math.round(minArm * 0.58))
    : Math.min(580, Math.round(minArm * 0.64));

  const isBlind =
    tplLower.includes("blind") || nameLower.includes("kör köşe") || nameLower.includes("lemans");
  const isDiagonal =
    tplLower.includes("diagonal") || nameLower.includes("diyagonal") || nameLower.includes("45°");
  const isOuter =
    tplLower.includes("outer_corner") || nameLower.includes("dış köşe");
  const isExplicitL =
    tplLower.includes("l_corner") ||
    tplLower.includes("corner_wall") ||
    tplLower.includes("corner_wardrobe") ||
    tplLower.includes("walkin_l") ||
    tplLower.includes("inner_corner") ||
    nameLower.includes("l köşe") ||
    nameLower.includes("köşe gardırop") ||
    nameLower.includes("köşe üst") ||
    nameLower.includes("iç köşe") ||
    nameLower.includes("l giyinme");

  if (isBlind) {
    return { isCorner: true, cornerType: "blind_corner", wingDepthMm: rawD };
  }
  if (isDiagonal) {
    return { isCorner: true, cornerType: "diagonal_corner", wingDepthMm };
  }
  if (isOuter) {
    return { isCorner: true, cornerType: "outer_corner", wingDepthMm };
  }
  if (isExplicitL || (Boolean(mod.isCorner) && rawW >= 620 && rawD >= 620)) {
    return { isCorner: true, cornerType: "l_corner", wingDepthMm };
  }
  return { isCorner: Boolean(mod.isCorner), cornerType: "none", wingDepthMm: rawD };
}

export function getModuleOrientedFootprint(
  mod: ModuleInstance,
  idx: number
): OrientedFootprint2D {
  const rotY = (((mod.rotation?.y || 0) % 360) + 360) % 360;

  const rawW = mod.dimensions.width;
  const rawH = mod.dimensions.height;
  const rawD = mod.dimensions.depth;

  const placement = calculateModulePlacement(mod);
  const planWidth = placement.width;
  const planDepth = placement.depth;
  const cornerMeta = classifyModuleCornerFootprint(mod);

  return {
    moduleId: mod.id,
    moduleIndex: idx,
    name: mod.name,
    category: mod.category,
    x: mod.position.x,
    z: mod.position.z,
    planWidth,
    planDepth,
    yBottom: mod.position.y,
    yTop: mod.position.y + rawH,
    rotationY: rotY,
    rawWidth: rawW,
    rawHeight: rawH,
    rawDepth: rawD,
    isCorner: cornerMeta.isCorner,
    isOpenFront: Boolean(mod.isOpenFront || mod.bays[0]?.door?.type === "open" || mod.bays[0]?.door?.doorSystemId === "open"),
    cornerType: cornerMeta.cornerType,
    wingDepthMm: cornerMeta.wingDepthMm,
  };
}

/**
 * Returns default architectural obstacles (Window, Column, Plumbing, Electrical)
 * for kitchen spaces if the project's space does not yet have any populated,
 * or returns the existing elements in `project.space.elements`.
 */
export function getEffectiveSpaceObstacles(project: DesignProject): ArchitecturalElement[] {
  if ((project.space as any).wizardCleanRoom) {
    return project.space.elements || [];
  }
  if (project.space.elements && project.space.elements.length > 0) {
    return project.space.elements;
  }

  const maxModRightX = (project.modules || []).reduce(
    (maxX, m) => Math.max(maxX, (m.position?.x || 0) + (m.dimensions?.width || 0)),
    0
  );

  // Provide realistic architectural fixtures for kitchen layouts
  if (project.space.type.startsWith("kitchen")) {
    return [
      {
        id: "arch_plumbing_main",
        type: "plumbing",
        name: "Su & Gider Tesisat Noktası",
        position: { x: 350, y: 450, z: 0 },
        dimensions: { width: 200, height: 250, depth: 80 },
      },
      {
        id: "arch_window_main",
        type: "window",
        name: "Mutfak Penceresi (Denizlik: 1100mm)",
        position: { x: 1850, y: 1100, z: 0 },
        dimensions: { width: 950, height: 1050, depth: 150 },
      },
      {
        id: "arch_column_right",
        type: "column",
        name: "Taşıyıcı Köşe Kolonu",
        position: { x: Math.max(3650, maxModRightX + 40), y: 0, z: 0 },
        dimensions: { width: 250, height: 2600, depth: 300 },
      },
    ];
  }

  // Wardrobe room default architectural element placed safely beyond active module span
  return [
    {
      id: "arch_wardrobe_column",
      type: "column",
      name: "Oda Köşe Kolonu",
      position: { x: Math.max(3350, maxModRightX + 40), y: 0, z: 0 },
      dimensions: { width: 250, height: 2700, depth: 250 },
    },
  ];
}
