/**
 * Runs complete geometric spatial & kitchen engineering validations:
 * 1. Oriented 3D AABB module-to-module overlap (including rotated L/U corner arms)
 * 2. Wall boundary overflow
 * 3. Window collision with wall/tall cabinets
 * 4. Structural column collision
 * 5. Plumbing point alignment with sink module (`Evye`)
 * 6. Tall cabinet appliance ventilation & wall filler tolerances
 */
export function validateSpatialAndKitchenEngineering(
  project: DesignProject
): ValidationIssue[] {
  const issues: ValidationIssue[] = [];
  const footprints = project.modules.map((m, idx) => getModuleOrientedFootprint(m, idx));
  const obstacles = getEffectiveSpaceObstacles(project);
  const mainWallLength = project.space.walls[0]?.length || 3600;

  // Helper: decompose an L-corner footprint into its two actual physical arm rectangles in 2D Plan
  const getFootprintSubRects = (fp: OrientedFootprint2D) => {
    if (fp.cornerType !== "l_corner") {
      return [{ x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth }];
    }
    const wd = Math.min(fp.wingDepthMm, fp.planWidth, fp.planDepth);
    if (fp.rotationY === 90) {
      return [
        { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + wd },
        { x1: fp.x + fp.planWidth - wd, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
      ];
    }
    if (fp.rotationY === 180) {
      return [
        { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z + fp.planDepth - wd, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
        { x1: fp.x + fp.planWidth - wd, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
      ];
    }
    if (fp.rotationY === 270) {
      return [
        { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z + fp.planDepth - wd, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
        { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + wd, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
      ];
    }
    return [
      { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + fp.planWidth, z2: fp.z + wd },
      { x1: fp.x, z1: fp.z, x2: fp.x + wd, z2: fp.z + fp.planDepth },
    ];
  };

  // 1. Oriented Module-to-Module Overlap & Corner Clearance Check
  for (let i = 0; i < footprints.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < footprints.length; j++) {
      const a = footprints[i];
      const b = footprints[j];
      const yOverlap = a.yBottom < b.yTop && a.yTop > b.yBottom;
      if (!yOverlap) continue;

      const rectsA = getFootprintSubRects(a);
      const rectsB = getFootprintSubRects(b);
      let overlapMm = 0;
      for (const ra of rectsA) {
        for (const rb of rectsB) {
          const xo = Math.min(ra.x2, rb.x2) - Math.max(ra.x1, rb.x1);
          const zo = Math.min(ra.z2, rb.z2) - Math.max(ra.z1, rb.z1);
          if (xo > 2 && zo > 2) {
            overlapMm = Math.max(overlapMm, Math.min(xo, zo));
          }
        }
      }

      if (overlapMm > 2) {
        issues.push({
          severity: "error",
          code: "ERR_SPATIAL_MODULE_OVERLAP",
          message: `"${a.name}" ile "${b.name}" planda çakışıyor (${Math.round(overlapMm)}mm girişim).`,
          targetId: a.moduleId,
          blockingProduction: true,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Wall Boundary Overflow & Installation Filler Checks
  footprints.forEach((fp) => {
    if (fp.rotationY === 0 && fp.x + fp.planWidth > mainWallLength) {
      const overflow = fp.x + fp.planWidth - mainWallLength;
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        code: "ERR_WALL_BOUNDARY_OVERFLOW",
        message: `"${fp.name}" ana duvar sınırını (${mainWallLength}mm) ${overflow}mm aşıyor.`,
        targetId: fp.moduleId,
        blockingProduction: true,
      });
    }

    // Tall pantry ventilation & appliance clearance rule
    if (fp.category === "kitchen_tall" && fp.rawDepth < 560) {
      issues.push({
        severity: "warning",
        code: "WARN_APPLIANCE_VENT_CLEARANCE",
        message: `"${fp.name}" ankastre/soğutucu hava sirkülasyonu için min. 560mm derinlik gerektirir (Mevcut: ${fp.rawDepth}mm).`,
        targetId: fp.moduleId,
      });
    }
  });

  // 3. Architectural Obstacles (Window, Column, Plumbing) Geometric Checks
  obstacles.forEach((obs) => {
    const ox1 = obs.position.x;
    const ox2 = obs.position.x + obs.dimensions.width;
    const oy1 = obs.position.y;
    const oy2 = obs.position.y + obs.dimensions.height;
    const oz1 = obs.position.z;
    const oz2 = obs.position.z + obs.dimensions.depth;

    if (obs.type === "column") {
      footprints.forEach((fp) => {
        const xHit = fp.x < ox2 && fp.x + fp.planWidth > ox1;
        const zHit = fp.z < oz2 && fp.z + fp.planDepth > oz1;
        if (xHit && zHit) {
          issues.push({
            severity: "error",
            code: "ERR_COLUMN_COLLISION",
            message: `"${fp.name}" modülü "${obs.name}" (${ox1}–${ox2}mm) ile çakışıyor.`,
            targetId: fp.moduleId,
            blockingProduction: true,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    if (obs.type === "window") {
      footprints.forEach((fp) => {
        const xHit = fp.x < ox2 && fp.x + fp.planWidth > ox1;
        const zHit = fp.z < oz2 + 400; // along back wall
        const yHit = fp.yBottom < oy2 && fp.yTop > oy1;
        if (xHit && zHit && yHit) {
          issues.push({
            severity: "error",
            code: "ERR_WINDOW_COLLISION",
            message: `"${fp.name}" üst kotu (${fp.yTop}mm), "${obs.name}" (${oy1}–${oy2}mm) açıklığını kapatıyor.`,
            targetId: fp.moduleId,
            blockingProduction: true,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    if (obs.type === "plumbing" && project.space.type.startsWith("kitchen")) {
      const plumbingCenterX = ox1 + obs.dimensions.width / 2;
      const sinkMod = footprints.find(
        (fp) =>
          fp.name.toLowerCase().includes("evye") || fp.moduleId.toLowerCase().includes("sink")
      );
      if (sinkMod) {
        const sinkCenterX = sinkMod.x + sinkMod.planWidth / 2;
        const dist = Math.abs(sinkCenterX - plumbingCenterX);
        if (dist > 350) {
          issues.push({
            severity: "warning",
            code: "WARN_PLUMBING_OFFSET",
            message: `Evye dolabı merkezi (${Math.round(
              sinkCenterX
            )}mm), su tesisat aksından (${Math.round(
              plumbingCenterX
            )}mm) ${Math.round(dist)}mm uzakta. Tesisat uzatması gerekir.`,
            targetId: sinkMod.moduleId,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // 4. Wall End Filler (Bitiş Kör Parçası) Recommendation
  const maxRightX = Math.max(
    0,
    ...footprints.filter((f) => f.rotationY === 0).map((f) => f.x + f.planWidth)
  );
  const rightGap = mainWallLength - maxRightX;
  if (rightGap > 0 && rightGap < 45) {
    issues.push({
      severity: "info",
      code: "INFO_WALL_FILLER_REQUIRED",
      message: `Duvar bitişinde ${rightGap}mm boşluk kaldı; kapakların duvara sürtmemesi için min. ${rightGap}mm montaj kör çıtası (paspayı) kullanılmalıdır.`,
    });
  }

  return issues;
}

import * as THREE from "three";
import { MaterialDefinition } from "@birim/core";
import { markSharedMaterial, markSharedTexture } from "./webglResourceGuard";

interface CachedTextureSet {
  colorMap?: THREE.CanvasTexture;
  roughnessMap?: THREE.CanvasTexture;
  normalMap?: THREE.CanvasTexture;
  bumpMap?: THREE.CanvasTexture;
}

const textureCache = new Map<string, CachedTextureSet>();
const rotatedTexCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
const pbrMaterialCache = new Map<string, THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial>();

function fract(x: number): number {
  return x - Math.floor(x);
}

function hash2D(x: number, y: number): number {
  return fract(Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7) * 43758.5453123);
}

/**
 * Periodic seamless value noise so tileable textures wrap across [0..period] with zero seam lines.
 */
function periodicNoise(x: number, y: number, periodX: number, periodY: number): number {
  const px = Math.max(1, Math.round(periodX));
  const py = Math.max(1, Math.round(periodY));
  const ix = Math.floor(x);
  const iy = Math.floor(y);
  const fx = x - ix;
  const fy = y - iy;

  const x0 = ((ix % px) + px) % px;
  const x1 = (x0 + 1) % px;
  const y0 = ((iy % py) + py) % py;
  const y1 = (y0 + 1) % py;

  const u = fx * fx * (3.0 - 2.0 * fx);
  const v = fy * fy * (3.0 - 2.0 * fy);

  const a = hash2D(x0, y0);
  const b = hash2D(x1, y0);
  const c = hash2D(x0, y1);
  const d = hash2D(x1, y1);

  return a * (1 - u) * (1 - v) + b * u * (1 - v) + c * (1 - u) * v + d * u * v;
}

function periodicFbm(
  nx: number,
  ny: number,
  baseFreqX: number,
  baseFreqY: number,
  octaves = 4
): number {
  let val = 0;
  let amp = 0.5;
  let fx = baseFreqX;
  let fy = baseFreqY;
  for (let i = 0; i < octaves; i++) {
    val += amp * periodicNoise(nx * fx, ny * fy, fx, fy);
    fx *= 2;
    fy *= 2;
    amp *= 0.5;
  }
  return val;
}

function hexToRgb(hex: string): [number, number, number] {
  const clean = (hex || "#d6d3cd").replace("#", "");
  const num = parseInt(clean, 16);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return [214, 211, 205];
  return [(num >> 16) & 255, (num >> 8) & 255, num & 255];
}

function clampByte(v: number): number {
  return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : Math.round(v);
}

/**
 * Converts a seamless [0..1] heightfield into a true RGB Tangent-Space Normal Map via 3x3 Sobel gradients.
 */
function buildNormalMapFromHeightField(
  heights: Float32Array,
  W: number,
  H: number,
  strength: number,
  repeatX = 1,
  repeatY = 1
): THREE.CanvasTexture {
  const nCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  nCanvas.width = W;
  nCanvas.height = H;
  const nCtx = nCanvas.getContext("2d")!;
  const nImg = nCtx.createImageData(W, H);

  const sample = (x: number, y: number): number => {
    const wx = ((x % W) + W) % W;
    const wy = ((y % H) + H) % H;
    return heights[wy * W + wx];
  };

  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const tl = sample(x - 1, y - 1);
      const t = sample(x, y - 1);
      const tr = sample(x + 1, y - 1);
      const l = sample(x - 1, y);
      const r = sample(x + 1, y);
      const bl = sample(x - 1, y + 1);
      const b = sample(x, y + 1);
      const br = sample(x + 1, y + 1);

      const dX = tr + 2 * r + br - (tl + 2 * l + bl);
      const dY = bl + 2 * b + br - (tl + 2 * t + tr);

      let nx = -dX * strength;
      let ny = -dY * strength;
      let nz = 1.0;
      const invLen = 1.0 / Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz);
      nx *= invLen;
      ny *= invLen;
      nz *= invLen;

      const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
      nImg.data[idx] = clampByte((nx * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255);
      nImg.data[idx + 1] = clampByte((ny * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255);
      nImg.data[idx + 2] = clampByte((nz * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255);
      nImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;
    }
  }

  nCtx.putImageData(nImg, 0, 0);
  const normalTex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(nCanvas));
  normalTex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  normalTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  normalTex.repeat.set(repeatX, repeatY);
  normalTex.anisotropy = 8;
  normalTex.needsUpdate = true;
  return normalTex;
}

/**
 * Generates high-definition 3-Channel PBR Texture Suites (Albedo + Micro-Roughness + Sobel Tangent Normal Map)
 * cached once per material on GPU.
 */
function getOrCreateProceduralMaps(matDef: MaterialDefinition): CachedTextureSet {
  const cached = textureCache.get(matDef.id);
  if (cached) return cached;

  if (typeof document === "undefined") {
    return {};
  }

  // 1. HIGH-DEFINITION RIFT-CUT / CATHEDRAL ARCHITECTURAL WOOD VENEERS (768x768 3-Map PBR)
  if (matDef.category === "wood" || (matDef.category === "laminate" && matDef.hasGrain)) {
    const W = 768;
    const H = 768;
    const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    colorCanvas.width = W;
    colorCanvas.height = H;
    const cCtx = colorCanvas.getContext("2d")!;

    const roughCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    roughCanvas.width = W;
    roughCanvas.height = H;
    const rCtx = roughCanvas.getContext("2d")!;

    const cImg = cCtx.createImageData(W, H);
    const rImg = rCtx.createImageData(W, H);
    const heightField = new Float32Array(W * H);

    const idLow = matDef.id.toLowerCase();
    const isWalnut = idLow.includes("walnut") || idLow.includes("ceviz");
    const isSmoked = idLow.includes("smoked") || idLow.includes("fume");
    const isNaturalOak = idLow.includes("oak") || idLow.includes("mese");
    // Rich warm golden-honey European Rift-Cut Oak (#c38d52) & deep American Walnut (#5e402d) matching studio showroom reference
    const calibratedWoodHex = isWalnut
      ? "#5e402d"
      : isSmoked
      ? "#46372c"
      : isNaturalOak
      ? "#c38d52"
      : matDef.colorHex || "#c38d52";
    const [hr, hg, hb] = hexToRgb(calibratedWoodHex);

    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
      const ny = y / H;
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        const nx = x / W;

        // Pure longitudinal rift-cut fiber meander (zero horizontal banding)
        const meander = (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 3, 1, 3) - 0.5) * 0.09;
        const ux = fract(nx + meander);
        const uy = ny;

        const broadHeartwood = periodicFbm(ux, uy, 4, 1, 3);
        const mediumFibers = periodicFbm(ux, uy, isWalnut ? 20 : 26, 2, 4);
        const fineGrain = periodicNoise(ux * 84, uy * 8, 84, 8);

        // Open-pore longitudinal wood vessels (characteristic recessed capillaries of European Oak & American Walnut)
        const poreNoise = periodicNoise(ux * 168 + 0.37, uy * 28 + 0.19, 168, 28);
        const poreDepth = poreNoise > 0.77 ? Math.min(1, (poreNoise - 0.77) * 4.4) : 0;

        // Delicate quarter-sawn silver medullary ray shimmer on Oak
        const medullaryRay = !isWalnut
          ? Math.max(0, periodicNoise(ux * 10 + 0.61, uy * 52, 10, 52) - 0.75) * 0.95
          : 0;

        // Organic non-periodic latewood fiber density (zero periodic sine stripes)
        const latewoodBand = periodicFbm(ux + 0.41, uy, isWalnut ? 10 : 14, 1, 3);

        const fiberDelta =
          (broadHeartwood - 0.5) * (isWalnut ? 0.24 : 0.21) +
          (mediumFibers - 0.5) * (isWalnut ? 0.21 : 0.18) +
          (latewoodBand - 0.5) * (isWalnut ? 0.13 : 0.11) +
          (fineGrain - 0.5) * 0.065 +
          medullaryRay * 0.08 -
          poreDepth * (isWalnut ? 0.21 : 0.18);

        const r = hr * (1 + fiberDelta * 1.04);
        const g = hg * (1 + fiberDelta * 0.98);
        const b = hb * (1 + fiberDelta * 0.9);

        const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
        cImg.data[idx] = clampByte(r);
        cImg.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(g);
        cImg.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(b);
        cImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;

        // Physical Roughness Map: open pores are recessed & matte (high roughness); latewood ridges are satin-smooth
        const roughByte = clampByte(
          126 + (mediumFibers - 0.5) * 32 + poreDepth * 82 - (latewoodBand - 0.5) * 20 - medullaryRay * 22
        );
        rImg.data[idx] = roughByte;
        rImg.data[idx + 1] = roughByte;
        rImg.data[idx + 2] = roughByte;
        rImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;

        // Physical Micro-Heightfield for Sobel Tangent Normal Map
        heightField[y * W + x] =
          0.55 +
          (mediumFibers - 0.5) * 0.22 +
          (fineGrain - 0.5) * 0.09 +
          (latewoodBand - 0.5) * 0.1 -
          poreDepth * 0.42;
      }
    }

    cCtx.putImageData(cImg, 0, 0);
    rCtx.putImageData(rImg, 0, 0);

    const colorMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas));
    colorMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    colorMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    colorMap.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    colorMap.anisotropy = 8;
    colorMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const roughnessMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(roughCanvas));
    roughnessMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.anisotropy = 8;
    roughnessMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const normalMap = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, W, H, 1.85, 1, 1);

    const set: CachedTextureSet = {
      colorMap,
      roughnessMap,
      normalMap,
      bumpMap: roughnessMap,
    };
    textureCache.set(matDef.id, set);
    return set;
  }

  // 2. BRUSHED ARCHITECTURAL METALS (Anodized Black, Brushed Brass, Inox, Anthracite)
  if (matDef.category === "metal") {
    const S = 256;
    const roughCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    roughCanvas.width = S;
    roughCanvas.height = S;
    const rCtx = roughCanvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const rImg = rCtx.createImageData(S, S);
    const heightField = new Float32Array(S * S);

    for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
      const ny = y / S;
      for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
        const nx = x / S;
        // Directional fine linear brushing along Y
        const brush = periodicNoise(nx * 128, ny * 6, 128, 6);
        const micro = hash2D(x * 0.8, y * 0.15);
        const idx = (y * S + x) * 4;
        const rv = clampByte(138 + (brush - 0.5) * 38 + (micro - 0.5) * 16);
        rImg.data[idx] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 1] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 2] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = 0.5 + (brush - 0.5) * 0.25 + (micro - 0.5) * 0.1;
      }
    }
    rCtx.putImageData(rImg, 0, 0);

    const roughnessMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(roughCanvas));
    roughnessMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.anisotropy = 8;
    roughnessMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const normalMap = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, S, S, 0.9, 1, 1);
    const set: CachedTextureSet = { roughnessMap, normalMap };
    textureCache.set(matDef.id, set);
    return set;
  }

  // 3. SILK MATTE ITALIAN LACQUER & SUPRAMAT MELAMINE (Micro-velvet roughness + subtle sprayed lacquer skin normal)
  if (matDef.category === "lacquer" || matDef.category === "laminate") {
    const S = 256;
    const roughCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    roughCanvas.width = S;
    roughCanvas.height = S;
    const rCtx = roughCanvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const rImg = rCtx.createImageData(S, S);
    const heightField = new Float32Array(S * S);

    for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
      const ny = y / S;
      for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
        const nx = x / S;
        const softSkin = periodicFbm(nx, ny, 12, 12, 3);
        const fineVelvet = hash2D(x * 0.9, y * 0.9);
        const v = clampByte(192 + (softSkin - 0.5) * 18 + (fineVelvet - 0.5) * 12);
        const idx = (y * S + x) * 4;
        rImg.data[idx] = v;
        rImg.data[idx + 1] = v;
        rImg.data[idx + 2] = v;
        rImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = 0.5 + (softSkin - 0.5) * 0.12 + (fineVelvet - 0.5) * 0.04;
      }
    }
    rCtx.putImageData(rImg, 0, 0);

    const roughnessMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(roughCanvas));
    roughnessMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.repeat.set(2.5, 2.5);
    roughnessMap.anisotropy = 4;
    roughnessMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const normalMap = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, S, S, 0.35, 2.5, 2.5);

    const set: CachedTextureSet = { roughnessMap, normalMap };
    textureCache.set(matDef.id, set);
    return set;
  }

  // 4. NEOLITH SINTERED STONE, DEKTON, BELENCO & HONED MARBLE VEINING (768x768 3-Map PBR)
  if (matDef.category === "stone") {
    const W = 768;
    const H = 768;
    const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    colorCanvas.width = W;
    colorCanvas.height = H;
    const cCtx = colorCanvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const cImg = cCtx.createImageData(W, H);

    const roughCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    roughCanvas.width = W;
    roughCanvas.height = H;
    const rCtx = roughCanvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const rImg = rCtx.createImageData(W, H);
    const heightField = new Float32Array(W * H);

    const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(matDef.colorHex || "#f4f3ef");

    const idLower = matDef.id.toLowerCase();
    const isGoldVeined =
      idLower.includes("luxe") || idLower.includes("abu_dhabi") || idLower.includes("entzo");
    const isDarkStone = idLower.includes("basalt") || idLower.includes("piombo");
    const isEmperador = idLower.includes("emperador");

    const veinRgb: [number, number, number] = isGoldVeined
      ? [182, 148, 98]
      : isDarkStone
      ? [210, 206, 198]
      : isEmperador
      ? [235, 225, 210]
      : [148, 146, 142];

    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
      const ny = y / H;
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        const nx = x / W;
        const warp = periodicFbm(nx, ny, 4, 4, 4);
        const vein1 = Math.pow(
          Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.sin((nx * 2.0 + ny * 2.0 + warp * 1.65) * Math.PI)) * 4.8),
          2.4
        );
        const vein2 =
          Math.pow(
            Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.sin((nx * 4.0 - ny * 4.0 + warp * 2.2) * Math.PI)) * 6.5),
            2.9
          ) * 0.55;
        const vFactor = Math.min(1, vein1 + vein2);
        const strength = isDarkStone ? 0.22 : 0.3;
        const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
        cImg.data[idx] = clampByte(br * (1 - vFactor * strength) + veinRgb[0] * vFactor * strength);
        cImg.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(bg * (1 - vFactor * strength) + veinRgb[1] * vFactor * strength);
        cImg.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(bb * (1 - vFactor * strength) + veinRgb[2] * vFactor * strength);
        cImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;

        const rv = clampByte(72 + warp * 26 + vFactor * 28);
        rImg.data[idx] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 1] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 2] = rv;
        rImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;

        heightField[y * W + x] = 0.5 + (warp - 0.5) * 0.14 - vFactor * 0.08;
      }
    }
    cCtx.putImageData(cImg, 0, 0);
    rCtx.putImageData(rImg, 0, 0);

    const colorMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas));
    colorMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    colorMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    colorMap.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    colorMap.anisotropy = 8;
    colorMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const roughnessMap = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(roughCanvas));
    roughnessMap.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    roughnessMap.anisotropy = 8;
    roughnessMap.needsUpdate = true;

    const normalMap = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, W, H, 0.75, 1, 1);

    const set: CachedTextureSet = { colorMap, roughnessMap, normalMap };
    textureCache.set(matDef.id, set);
    return set;
  }

  return {};
}

const floorTextureCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
const floorNormalCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
const wallTextureCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();
const wallNormalCache = new Map<string, THREE.CanvasTexture>();

export type ArchitecturalWallTone =
  | "brut_concrete"
  | "anthracite_gallery"
  | "warm_taupe"
  | "soft_plaster";

/**
 * Procedural Birim Architectural Fair-Faced Concrete ("Brüt Beton") & Micro-Troweled Gallery Wall Texture
 * with paired Sobel Tangent Normal Map for subtle formwork joints and mineral plaster relief.
 */
export function getArchitecturalWallTexture(
  tone: ArchitecturalWallTone
): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const cached = wallTextureCache.get(tone);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const S = 512;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = S;
  canvas.height = S;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
  const img = ctx.createImageData(S, S);
  const heightField = new Float32Array(S * S);

  const palette: Record<ArchitecturalWallTone, [number, number, number]> = {
    brut_concrete: [132, 127, 120],
    anthracite_gallery: [56, 55, 53],
    warm_taupe: [152, 143, 131],
    soft_plaster: [204, 199, 190],
  };
  const [br, bg, bb] = palette[tone];
  const isConcrete = tone === "brut_concrete" || tone === "anthracite_gallery";

  for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
    const ny = y / S;
    for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
      const nx = x / S;
      const cloud = (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 4, 4, 4) - 0.5) * (isConcrete ? 20 : 11);
      const trowel = (periodicFbm(nx + 0.3, ny + 0.7, 12, 8, 3) - 0.5) * (isConcrete ? 9 : 6);
      const fineMineral = (hash2D(x * 0.7, y * 0.7) - 0.5) * 5;
      const isFormworkJoint = isConcrete && (x % 256 === 0 || y % 256 === 0);

      // Subtle architectural concrete tie-cone dimples at panel centers
      const dxTie = ((x + 128) % 256) - 128;
      const dyTie = ((y + 128) % 256) - 128;
      const distTie = Math.sqrt(dxTie * dxTie + dyTie * dyTie);
      const isTieCone = isConcrete && distTie < 3.6;

      const seamDelta = isFormworkJoint ? -13 : isTieCone ? -18 : 0;

      const idx = (y * S + x) * 4;
      img.data[idx] = clampByte(br + cloud + trowel + fineMineral + seamDelta);
      img.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(bg + cloud + trowel + fineMineral + seamDelta);
      img.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(bb + cloud + trowel + fineMineral + seamDelta);
      img.data[idx + 3] = 255;

      heightField[y * S + x] =
        0.5 +
        cloud * 0.008 +
        trowel * 0.01 -
        (isFormworkJoint ? 0.32 : 0) -
        (isTieCone ? 0.4 : 0);
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  tex.repeat.set(3.2, 2.1);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.anisotropy = 8;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  wallTextureCache.set(tone, tex);

  const nTex = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, S, S, 1.35, 3.2, 2.1);
  wallNormalCache.set(tone, nTex);

  return tex;
}

export function getArchitecturalWallNormalMap(
  tone: ArchitecturalWallTone
): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  if (!wallNormalCache.has(tone)) {
    getArchitecturalWallTexture(tone);
  }
  return wallNormalCache.get(tone) || null;
}

export type ArchitecturalFloorStyle =
  | "oak_parquet"
  | "herringbone_oak"
  | "walnut_parquet"
  | "travertine"
  | "neolith_calacatta"
  | "microcement"
  | "studio";

export function getArchitecturalFloorTexture(
  style: ArchitecturalFloorStyle
): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || style === "studio") return null;
  const cached = floorTextureCache.get(style);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const S = 512;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = S;
  canvas.height = S;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
  const img = ctx.createImageData(S, S);
  const heightField = new Float32Array(S * S);

  for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
    const ny = y / S;
    for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
      const nx = x / S;
      const idx = (y * S + x) * 4;
      if (style === "oak_parquet" || style === "walnut_parquet") {
        const isWalnut = style === "walnut_parquet";
        const plankRow = Math.floor(y / 64);
        const plankX = (x + (plankRow % 2) * 128) % 256;
        const plankY = y % 64;
        const isMicroJoint = plankX === 0 || plankY === 0;
        const plankSeed = hash2D(plankRow, Math.floor((x + (plankRow % 2) * 128) / 256));
        const fiber =
          (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 8, 40, 3) - 0.5) * 14 + (plankSeed - 0.5) * 9;
        const baseR = isWalnut ? 118 : 182;
        const baseG = isWalnut ? 90 : 162;
        const baseB = isWalnut ? 70 : 136;
        const seamDrop = isMicroJoint ? 22 : 0;
        img.data[idx] = clampByte(baseR + fiber - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(baseG + fiber * 0.92 - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(baseB + fiber * 0.82 - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = 0.5 + fiber * 0.008 - (isMicroJoint ? 0.36 : 0);
      } else if (style === "herringbone_oak") {
        const col = Math.floor(x / 64);
        const diag = col % 2 === 0 ? (x + y) % 64 : (x - y + 512) % 64;
        const isSeam = x % 64 === 0 || diag === 0;
        const plankId = Math.floor((col % 2 === 0 ? x + y : x - y + 512) / 64);
        const plankTint = (hash2D(col, plankId) - 0.5) * 9;
        const grain = (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 16, 16, 3) - 0.5) * 14 + plankTint;
        const seamDrop = isSeam ? 28 : 0;
        img.data[idx] = clampByte(178 + grain - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(158 + grain * 0.92 - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(132 + grain * 0.82 - seamDrop);
        img.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = 0.5 + grain * 0.007 - (isSeam ? 0.35 : 0);
      } else if (style === "neolith_calacatta") {
        const tileX = x % 256;
        const tileY = y % 256;
        const isGrout = tileX === 0 || tileY === 0;
        const warp = periodicFbm(nx, ny, 4, 4, 3);
        const vein = Math.pow(
          Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(Math.sin((nx * 2.0 + ny * 2.0 + warp * 1.4) * Math.PI)) * 5.2),
          2.5
        );
        img.data[idx] = isGrout ? 214 : clampByte(240 - vein * 28);
        img.data[idx + 1] = isGrout ? 211 : clampByte(237 - vein * 30);
        img.data[idx + 2] = isGrout ? 205 : clampByte(231 - vein * 34);
        img.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = isGrout ? 0.2 : 0.5 - vein * 0.05;
      } else if (style === "microcement") {
        const n = (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 6, 6, 4) - 0.5) * 12;
        img.data[idx] = clampByte(224 + n);
        img.data[idx + 1] = clampByte(220 + n);
        img.data[idx + 2] = clampByte(213 + n);
        img.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = 0.5 + n * 0.01;
      } else {
        const tileX = x % 256;
        const tileY = y % 256;
        const isGrout = tileX === 0 || tileY === 0;
        const n = (periodicFbm(nx, ny, 8, 4, 3) - 0.5) * 13;
        img.data[idx] = isGrout ? 202 : clampByte(226 + n);
        img.data[idx + 1] = isGrout ? 196 : clampByte(220 + n);
        img.data[idx + 2] = isGrout ? 186 : clampByte(208 + n);
        img.data[idx + 3] = 255;
        heightField[y * S + x] = isGrout ? 0.22 : 0.5 + n * 0.008;
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  const rep = style === "microcement" ? 3 : 4.5;
  const tex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas));
  tex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  tex.repeat.set(rep, rep);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.anisotropy = 8;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  floorTextureCache.set(style, tex);

  const nTex = buildNormalMapFromHeightField(heightField, S, S, 1.1, rep, rep);
  floorNormalCache.set(style, nTex);

  return tex;
}

export function getArchitecturalFloorNormalMap(
  style: ArchitecturalFloorStyle
): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || style === "studio") return null;
  if (!floorNormalCache.has(style)) {
    getArchitecturalFloorTexture(style);
  }
  return floorNormalCache.get(style) || null;
}

let cachedStudioEnvTexture: THREE.DataTexture | null = null;
const pmremTargetByRenderer = new WeakMap<THREE.WebGLRenderer, THREE.WebGLRenderTarget>();

export function disposeRendererPmremEnvironment(
  renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer | null | undefined
): void {
  if (!renderer) return;
  const target = pmremTargetByRenderer.get(renderer);
  if (target) {
    target.dispose();
    pmremTargetByRenderer.delete(renderer);
  }
}

/**
 * High-Contrast Architectural Photography Studio HDRI Rig (PMREM IBL):
 * - Dark gallery negative-fill enclosure ([0.16, 0.15, 0.14]) for luxury Fresnel contrast on glass, mirrors & lacquer
 * - 4-Bay Floor-to-Ceiling North Daylight Window Wall with dark structural mullions (creates crisp architectural window reflections!)
 * - Diffused overhead architectural softbox scrim + warm indirect travertine/oak floor & cove bounce
 */
export function getStudioPmremEnvironment(renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer): THREE.Texture {
  const existingTarget = pmremTargetByRenderer.get(renderer);
  if (existingTarget) return existingTarget.texture;
  try {
    const pmremGenerator = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
    pmremGenerator.compileCubemapShader();

    const envScene = new THREE.Scene();

    // Rich architectural charcoal-stone negative fill enclosure so glass & satin lacquer reflections never wash out
    const roomBox = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(40, 28, 40),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: new THREE.Color(0.22, 0.21, 0.195),
        side: THREE.BackSide,
      })
    );
    envScene.add(roomBox);

    // Warm oak / limestone floor bounce
    const floorBounce = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(36, 36),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: new THREE.Color(0.68, 0.59, 0.48),
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        toneMapped: false,
      })
    );
    floorBounce.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floorBounce.position.set(0, -13.2, 0);
    envScene.add(floorBounce);

    const addLightformer = (
      w: number,
      h: number,
      pos: [number, number, number],
      rot: [number, number, number],
      rgb: [number, number, number]
    ) => {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: new THREE.Color(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]),
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          toneMapped: false,
        })
      );
      m.position.set(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
      m.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);
      envScene.add(m);
    };

    // 1. 4-Bay Floor-to-Ceiling North Daylight Window Bank (Right-Front: creates real mullion reflections on glass & lacquer!)
    const bayZPositions = [-4.5, 1.5, 7.5, 13.5];
    bayZPositions.forEach((bz, idx) => {
      const skyBoost = 1 - idx * 0.05;
      // Upper sky pane
      addLightformer(
        4.9,
        10.5,
        [19.2, 6.2, bz],
        [0, -Math.PI / 2, 0],
        [6.4 * skyBoost, 6.18 * skyBoost, 5.85 * skyBoost]
      );
      // Lower garden/horizon pane
      addLightformer(
        4.9,
        9.5,
        [19.2, -4.4, bz],
        [0, -Math.PI / 2, 0],
        [3.9 * skyBoost, 3.72 * skyBoost, 3.45 * skyBoost]
      );
    });

    // 2. Overhead Architectural Softbox Ceiling Scrim
    addLightformer(18, 14, [1.5, 13.4, 4], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [3.35, 3.28, 3.16]);

    // 3. Warm Opposite Plaster Bounce Wall + Warm 3000K Cove Accent (Left)
    addLightformer(16, 18, [-19.2, 1.5, 4], [0, Math.PI / 2, 0], [1.45, 1.35, 1.22]);
    addLightformer(14, 1.8, [-18.8, 10.5, 5], [0, Math.PI / 2, 0], [3.1, 2.35, 1.55]);

    // 4. Subtle Front Fill Strip for Handle & Bevel Edge Specular Glints
    addLightformer(20, 5.5, [-1.5, 5.8, 19.2], [0, Math.PI, 0], [2.45, 2.4, 2.32]);

    const renderTarget = pmremGenerator.fromScene(envScene, 0.03);
    markSharedTexture(renderTarget.texture);
    pmremTargetByRenderer.set(renderer, renderTarget);

    envScene.traverse((obj) => {
      if (obj instanceof THREE.Mesh) {
        obj.geometry.dispose();
        if (obj.material instanceof THREE.Material) obj.material.dispose();
      }
    });
    envScene.clear();
    pmremGenerator.dispose();
    return renderTarget.texture;
  } catch {
    return getStudioEnvironmentTexture();
  }
}

export function getStudioEnvironmentTexture(): THREE.DataTexture {
  if (cachedStudioEnvTexture) return cachedStudioEnvTexture;

  const width = 256;
  const height = 128;
  const data = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);

  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    const v = y / (height - 1);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const u = x / (width - 1);
      const softboxKey = Math.exp(-Math.pow((u - 0.24) * 5.2, 2) - Math.pow((v - 0.65) * 4.2, 2));
      const softboxFill = Math.exp(-Math.pow((u - 0.78) * 5.0, 2) - Math.pow((v - 0.56) * 5.0, 2));
      const topSkylight = Math.exp(-Math.pow((v - 0.92) * 4.0, 2));

      const skyR = 186 + softboxKey * 66 + softboxFill * 30 + topSkylight * 36;
      const skyG = 182 + softboxKey * 64 + softboxFill * 28 + topSkylight * 35;
      const skyB = 176 + softboxKey * 58 + softboxFill * 26 + topSkylight * 33;

      const groundR = 132;
      const groundG = 124;
      const groundB = 112;

      const blend = Math.pow(v, 0.78);
      const r = clampByte(groundR * (1 - blend) + skyR * blend);
      const g = clampByte(groundG * (1 - blend) + skyG * blend);
      const b = clampByte(groundB * (1 - blend) + skyB * blend);

      const idx = (y * width + x) * 4;
      data[idx] = r;
      data[idx + 1] = g;
      data[idx + 2] = b;
      data[idx + 3] = 255;
    }
  }

  const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(data, width, height, THREE.RGBAFormat);
  tex.mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  markSharedTexture(tex);
  cachedStudioEnvTexture = tex;
  return tex;
}

function getRotatedClone(
  baseTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | undefined,
  cacheKey: string,
  rotRad: number
): THREE.CanvasTexture | null {
  if (!baseTex) return null;
  if (rotRad === 0) return baseTex;
  let rot = rotatedTexCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (!rot) {
    rot = baseTex.clone();
    rot.center.set(0.5, 0.5);
    rot.rotation = rotRad;
    rot.needsUpdate = true;
    markSharedTexture(rot);
    rotatedTexCache.set(cacheKey, rot);
  }
  return rot;
}

/**
 * Returns a calibrated, GPU-cached `THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial` for any Birim material definition.
 */
export function getV3PbrMaterial(
  matDef: MaterialDefinition,
  isSelected: boolean,
  isRailOrMetalFitting: boolean,
  grainDirection: "lengthwise" | "crosswise" | "custom" = "lengthwise",
  surfaceFinishOverride?: "matte" | "satin" | "gloss"
): THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial {
  const key = `pbr_${matDef.id}_sel:${isSelected ? 1 : 0}_metal:${isRailOrMetalFitting ? 1 : 0}_gr:${grainDirection}_fin:${surfaceFinishOverride || "def"}`;
  const existing = pbrMaterialCache.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing;

  const emissive = isSelected ? new THREE.Color(0x1d4ed8) : new THREE.Color(0x000000);
  const emissiveIntensity = isSelected ? 0.18 : 0.0;

  // 0. Multi-Kelvin Architectural Recessed LED Diffuser Materials (2700K / 3000K / 4000K)
  if (matDef.id.startsWith("mat_led_")) {
    const is2700 = matDef.id.includes("2700");
    const is4000 = matDef.id.includes("4000");
    const emissiveHex = is2700 ? "#ffb04a" : is4000 ? "#fff1d8" : "#ffce70";
    const coreHex = is2700 ? "#ffe4b8" : is4000 ? "#ffffff" : "#fff2d6";
    const ledMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(coreHex),
      emissive: new THREE.Color(emissiveHex),
      emissiveIntensity: isSelected ? 4.0 : 3.45,
      roughness: 0.16,
      metalness: 0.0,
      envMapIntensity: 0.12,
      clearcoat: 0.4,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(ledMat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, ledMat);
    return ledMat;
  }

  // 1. Brushed Architectural Hardware (Honors Matte Black K019, Satin Inox K020, Brushed Brass K021, Anthracite K022!)
  if (isRailOrMetalFitting || matDef.category === "metal") {
    const idLow = matDef.id.toLowerCase();
    const isMatteBlack = idLow.includes("black") || idLow.includes("siyah");
    const isBrass = idLow.includes("brass") || idLow.includes("pirinc") || idLow.includes("bronze");
    const isAnthracite = idLow.includes("anthracite") || idLow.includes("antrasit");

    const metalColor = isMatteBlack
      ? "#1d1d1b"
      : isBrass
      ? "#bfa065"
      : isAnthracite
      ? "#3d3e42"
      : matDef.category === "metal" && matDef.colorHex
      ? matDef.colorHex
      : "#d4cfc6";

    const metalMaps = getOrCreateProceduralMaps({
      ...matDef,
      id: `metal_brush_${isMatteBlack ? "blk" : isBrass ? "brs" : isAnthracite ? "ant" : "inx"}`,
      category: "metal",
    });

    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(metalColor),
      metalness: isMatteBlack ? 0.72 : 0.92,
      roughness: isMatteBlack ? 0.38 : isBrass ? 0.24 : 0.2,
      roughnessMap: metalMaps.roughnessMap || null,
      normalMap: metalMaps.normalMap || null,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.16, 0.16),
      clearcoat: isMatteBlack ? 0.12 : 0.4,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.22,
      ior: 1.65,
      reflectivity: 0.95,
      envMapIntensity: isMatteBlack ? 1.15 : 1.45,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // 2. Architectural Bronze / Silver Mirror
  if (matDef.category === "mirror" || matDef.id.includes("mirror") || matDef.id.includes("ayna")) {
    const isBronze = matDef.id.toLowerCase().includes("bronze") || matDef.id.toLowerCase().includes("bronz");
    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(isBronze ? "#cbb69e" : "#e6eaef"),
      metalness: 0.98,
      roughness: 0.025,
      clearcoat: 1.0,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.02,
      ior: 1.55,
      reflectivity: 1.0,
      envMapIntensity: 1.55,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // 3. Architectural Smoked / Fluted Showcase Glass (Rimadesio-grade Fresnel reflections)
  if (matDef.category === "glass" || matDef.id.includes("glass")) {
    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(matDef.colorHex || "#2d3748"),
      metalness: 0.06,
      roughness: 0.04,
      transmission: 0.72,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.84,
      depthWrite: false,
      ior: 1.52,
      reflectivity: 0.98,
      clearcoat: 1.0,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.03,
      envMapIntensity: 1.65,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  const maps = getOrCreateProceduralMaps(matDef);

  // 4. Natural Rift-Cut Wood Veneers (Oak & Walnut) with 3-Map PBR (Albedo + Pore Roughness + Sobel Normal)
  if (matDef.category === "wood" || (matDef.category === "laminate" && matDef.hasGrain)) {
    const rotRad =
      grainDirection === "lengthwise"
        ? 0
        : grainDirection === "crosswise"
        ? Math.PI / 2
        : Math.PI / 4;
    const colorTex = getRotatedClone(maps.colorMap, `${matDef.id}_c_${grainDirection}`, rotRad);
    const roughTex = getRotatedClone(maps.roughnessMap, `${matDef.id}_r_${grainDirection}`, rotRad);
    const normTex = getRotatedClone(maps.normalMap, `${matDef.id}_n_${grainDirection}`, rotRad);

    const roughVal =
      surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss"
        ? 0.16
        : surfaceFinishOverride === "satin"
        ? 0.36
        : surfaceFinishOverride === "matte"
        ? 0.56
        : 0.44;
    const clearcoatVal =
      surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.85 : surfaceFinishOverride === "matte" ? 0.12 : 0.26;

    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#ffffff"),
      map: colorTex,
      roughnessMap: roughTex,
      normalMap: normTex,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.38, 0.38),
      roughness: roughVal,
      metalness: 0.01,
      ior: 1.5,
      specularIntensity: 0.82,
      clearcoat: clearcoatVal,
      clearcoatRoughness: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.08 : 0.32,
      reflectivity: 0.56,
      envMapIntensity: 0.92,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // 5. Honed / Polished Calacatta Marble & Sintered Stone Countertop
  if (matDef.category === "stone" || matDef.id.includes("stone") || matDef.id.includes("calacatta")) {
    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#ffffff"),
      map: maps.colorMap || null,
      roughnessMap: maps.roughnessMap || null,
      normalMap: maps.normalMap || null,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.22, 0.22),
      roughness: 0.18,
      metalness: 0.02,
      ior: 1.54,
      specularIntensity: 0.94,
      clearcoat: 0.82,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.09,
      reflectivity: 0.92,
      envMapIntensity: 1.28,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // 6. Silk Matte Italian Lacquer & Soft-Touch Supramat (with physical 85% diffuse ceiling so whites sculpt in 3D!)
  if (matDef.category === "lacquer") {
    const [rawR, rawG, rawB] = hexToRgb(matDef.colorHex);
    const r = Math.min(226, Math.round(rawR * 0.91));
    const g = Math.min(224, Math.round(rawG * 0.905));
    const b = Math.min(219, Math.round(rawB * 0.895));
    const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(`rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`),
      roughnessMap: maps.roughnessMap || null,
      normalMap: maps.normalMap || null,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.05, 0.05),
      roughness: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.09 : 0.29,
      metalness: 0.01,
      ior: 1.5,
      specularIntensity: 0.85,
      sheen: 0.24,
      sheenRoughness: 0.45,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#fafaf9"),
      clearcoat: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.92 : 0.34,
      clearcoatRoughness: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.05 : 0.26,
      reflectivity: 0.62,
      envMapIntensity: 0.88,
      emissive,
      emissiveIntensity,
    });
    markSharedMaterial(mat);
    pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
    return mat;
  }

  // 7. Calibrated Architectural Melamine / MDF-Lam (physical 85% max albedo prevents flat #FFFFFF blowout!)
  const [mRawR, mRawG, mRawB] = hexToRgb(matDef.colorHex);
  const mR = Math.min(225, Math.round(mRawR * 0.905));
  const mG = Math.min(223, Math.round(mRawG * 0.9));
  const mB = Math.min(218, Math.round(mRawB * 0.89));
  const mat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
    color: new THREE.Color(`rgb(${mR}, ${mG}, ${mB})`),
    roughnessMap: maps.roughnessMap || null,
    normalMap: maps.normalMap || null,
    normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.04, 0.04),
    roughness: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.13 : 0.36,
    metalness: 0.01,
    ior: 1.49,
    specularIntensity: 0.72,
    sheen: 0.12,
    sheenRoughness: 0.52,
    sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#fafaf9"),
    clearcoat: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.8 : 0.22,
    clearcoatRoughness: surfaceFinishOverride === "gloss" ? 0.07 : 0.32,
    reflectivity: 0.54,
    envMapIntensity: 0.82,
    emissive,
    emissiveIntensity,
  });
  markSharedMaterial(mat);
  pbrMaterialCache.set(key, mat);
  return mat;
}

export function getPbrCacheStats(): { texturesCount: number; materialsCount: number } {
  return {
    texturesCount:
      textureCache.size * 3 +
      rotatedTexCache.size +
      floorTextureCache.size +
      floorNormalCache.size +
      wallTextureCache.size +
      wallNormalCache.size,
    materialsCount: pbrMaterialCache.size,
  };
}

export function computePhysicalUvScale(
  widthMm: number,
  heightMm: number,
  grain: "lengthwise" | "crosswise" | "none" = "lengthwise"
): { repeatX: number; repeatY: number; rotationRad: number } {
  const referenceTileMm = 650;
  const repeatX = Math.max(0.1, Number((widthMm / referenceTileMm).toFixed(3)));
  const repeatY = Math.max(0.1, Number((heightMm / referenceTileMm).toFixed(3)));
  const rotationRad = grain === "crosswise" ? Math.PI / 2 : 0;
  return { repeatX, repeatY, rotationRad };
}

import * as THREE from "three";

/**
 * Sculpted, GPU-Cached 3D Wardrobe Lifestyle Props Builder (V5.0 Studio Edition):
 * Replaces primitive cubes with smooth, anatomically contoured, physically shaded 3D assets:
 * 1. Contoured Wooden Coat Hangers + Swan-Neck Chrome/Brass Hooks + Draped Collared Shirts with Sleeves & Pleats
 * 2. U-Folded Rounded Knitwear / Towel Stacks with Curved Front Fold Loops & Recessed Creases

let cachedFabricRoughnessTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;
let cachedFabricNormalTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null = null;

function ensureFabricTextures(): {
  roughTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null;
  normTex: THREE.CanvasTexture | null;
} {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") {
    return { roughTex: null, normTex: null };
  }
  if (cachedFabricRoughnessTex && cachedFabricNormalTex) {
    return { roughTex: cachedFabricRoughnessTex, normTex: cachedFabricNormalTex };
  }

  const S = 128;
  const rCan = document.createElement("canvas");
  rCan.width = S;
  rCan.height = S;
  const rCtx = rCan.getContext("2d")!;
  const rImg = rCtx.createImageData(S, S);

  const nCan = document.createElement("canvas");
  nCan.width = S;
  nCan.height = S;
  const nCtx = nCan.getContext("2d")!;
  const nImg = nCtx.createImageData(S, S);

  for (let y = 0; y < S; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < S; x++) {
      // Fine cross-woven linen/poplin textile micro-relief
      const warp = Math.sin((x / S) * Math.PI * 64);
      const weft = Math.sin((y / S) * Math.PI * 64);
      const weave = warp * 0.5 + weft * 0.5;
      const idx = (y * S + x) * 4;

      const rv = Math.round(212 + weave * 22);
      rImg.data[idx] = rv;
      rImg.data[idx + 1] = rv;
      rImg.data[idx + 2] = rv;
      rImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;

      nImg.data[idx] = Math.round(128 + warp * 18);
      nImg.data[idx + 1] = Math.round(128 + weft * 18);
      nImg.data[idx + 2] = 248;
      nImg.data[idx + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  rCtx.putImageData(rImg, 0, 0);
  nCtx.putImageData(nImg, 0, 0);

  const rTex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(rCan));
  rTex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  rTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  rTex.repeat.set(6, 8);
  rTex.needsUpdate = true;

  const nTex = markSharedTexture(new THREE.CanvasTexture(nCan));
  nTex.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  nTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  nTex.repeat.set(6, 8);
  nTex.needsUpdate = true;

  cachedFabricRoughnessTex = rTex;
  cachedFabricNormalTex = nTex;
  return { roughTex: rTex, normTex: nTex };
}

// Shared Materials (Curated Warm Editorial Wardrobe Palette matching Studio Reference)
const shirtMaterialsCache: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial[] = [];
const knitMaterialsCache: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial[] = [];
let hangerWoodMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let hangerHookMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let boxBodyLinenMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let boxLidLinenMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let boxShadowRimMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;
let boxPullPlateMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let shoeUpperCamelMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let shoeUpperEspressoMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let shoeUpperTaupeMat: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial | null = null;
let shoeSoleCreamMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;
let shoeInnerDarkMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial | null = null;

function ensurePropMaterials() {
  if (shirtMaterialsCache.length > 0) return;
  const { roughTex, normTex } = ensureFabricTextures();

  // 1. Shirt / Overshirt Fabrics (Warm Camel, Soft Cream, Powder Oxford Blue, Oatmeal Taupe, Warm Sand)
  const shirtHexes = ["#C99E72", "#EAE1D3", "#B5C3D3", "#CFC1AE", "#D8B994"];
  shirtHexes.forEach((hex) => {
    const mat = markSharedMaterial(
      new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
        color: new THREE.Color(hex),
        roughness: 0.84,
        roughnessMap: roughTex,
        normalMap: normTex,
        normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.18, 0.18),
        metalness: 0.0,
        sheen: 0.58,
        sheenRoughness: 0.72,
        sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#fffaf2"),
        envMapIntensity: 0.62,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      })
    );
    shirtMaterialsCache.push(mat);
  });

  // 2. Folded Knitwear / Towel Palette (Warm Cream, Sand Cashmere, Soft Biscuit)
  const knitHexes = ["#EFE7DA", "#DCCBB5", "#CEB9A1"];
  knitHexes.forEach((hex) => {
    const mat = markSharedMaterial(
      new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
        color: new THREE.Color(hex),
        roughness: 0.88,
        roughnessMap: roughTex,
        normalMap: normTex,
        normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.24, 0.24),
        metalness: 0.0,
        sheen: 0.68,
        sheenRoughness: 0.65,
        sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#fffdf9"),
        envMapIntensity: 0.55,
      })
    );
    knitMaterialsCache.push(mat);
  });

  hangerWoodMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#BA7938"),
      roughness: 0.34,
      metalness: 0.02,
      clearcoat: 0.45,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.24,
    })
  );

  hangerHookMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#D8D3C8"),
      roughness: 0.18,
      metalness: 0.94,
      envMapIntensity: 1.4,
    })
  );

  boxBodyLinenMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#C6B098"),
      roughness: 0.86,
      roughnessMap: roughTex,
      normalMap: normTex,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.16, 0.16),
      sheen: 0.35,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#faf5ee"),
      envMapIntensity: 0.5,
    })
  );

  boxLidLinenMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#CEBAA3"),
      roughness: 0.84,
      roughnessMap: roughTex,
      normalMap: normTex,
      normalScale: new THREE.Vector2(0.15, 0.15),
      sheen: 0.35,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color("#faf5ee"),
      envMapIntensity: 0.52,
    })
  );

  boxShadowRimMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#1F1B18"),
      roughness: 0.95,
    })
  );

  boxPullPlateMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#8A7256"),
      roughness: 0.42,
      metalness: 0.35,
    })
  );

  shoeUpperCamelMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#9C7654"),
      roughness: 0.62,
      sheen: 0.45,
      sheenRoughness: 0.6,
      clearcoat: 0.12,
    })
  );

  shoeUpperEspressoMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#3D312A"),
      roughness: 0.44,
      clearcoat: 0.28,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.32,
    })
  );

  shoeUpperTaupeMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#B8ACA0"),
      roughness: 0.74,
      sheen: 0.5,
    })
  );

  shoeSoleCreamMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#EAE4DA"),
      roughness: 0.68,
    })
  );

  shoeInnerDarkMat = markSharedMaterial(
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color("#1C1917"),
      roughness: 0.92,
    })
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCULPTED WOODEN HANGER + DRAPED COLLARED SHIRT GEOMETRIES (GPU-Cached)
// ============================================================================
let sharedHookGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
let sharedHangerBarGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
const shirtTorsoCache = new Map<number, THREE.BufferGeometry>();
let sharedCollarGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
let sharedSleeveGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
let sharedPlacketGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;

function getHookAndHangerGeos() {
  if (!sharedHookGeo) {
    // Swan-neck curved coat-hanger hook wrapping around Ø25mm hanging rail at y=0
    const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -42, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -18, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -8, -11),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 8, -13),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 18, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 10, 12),
    ]);
    sharedHookGeo = markSharedGeometry(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 16, 1.9, 8, false));
  }

  if (!sharedHangerBarGeo) {
    // Contoured curved wooden coat-hanger yoke spanning along Z (front-to-back inside wardrobe)
    const armCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -76, -185),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -56, -105),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -42, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -56, 105),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -76, 185),
    ]);
    const g = new THREE.TubeGeometry(armCurve, 18, 8.5, 10, false);
    g.scale(0.68, 1.15, 1.0); // Sculpted flat-oval beechwood hanger cross-section
    sharedHangerBarGeo = markSharedGeometry(g);
  }
  return { hookGeo: sharedHookGeo, hangerBarGeo: sharedHangerBarGeo };
}

/**
 * Builds a normalized unit-scale sculpted shirt torso (height = 1.0 from y=0 down to y=-1.0,
 * depth = 1.0 along Z, thickness = 1.0 along X) with organic vertical drape folds & contoured shoulders.
 */
function getSculptedShirtTorsoGeo(pleatVariant: number): THREE.BufferGeometry {
  const key = pleatVariant % 3;
  const cached = shirtTorsoCache.get(key);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const segU = 28; // Around horizontal perimeter
  const segV = 16; // Top shoulder (v=0) down to bottom hem (v=1)
  const positions: number[] = [];
  const uvs: number[] = [];
  const indices: number[] = [];

  const phase = key * 1.35;

  for (let iv = 0; iv <= segV; iv++) {
    const v = iv / segV;
    // Shoulder dome rounding at top (v < 0.14), natural drape waist & slight bottom flare
    const shoulderTaper = v < 0.14 ? 0.36 + 0.64 * Math.sin((v / 0.14) * (Math.PI / 2)) : 1.0;
    const hemFlare = 1.0 + Math.pow(v, 1.6) * 0.12;
    const y = -v;

    // Slight natural gravity sway along X
    const swayX = Math.sin(v * Math.PI * 0.9 + phase) * 0.04;

    for (let iu = 0; iu <= segU; iu++) {
      const u = iu / segU;
      const theta = u * Math.PI * 2;

      // Soft vertical fabric pleats/drapes that deepen toward the bottom hem
      const pleatAmp = Math.pow(v, 0.85) * 0.13;
      const pleat =
        1.0 +
        pleatAmp * Math.sin(theta * 5 + phase) +
        pleatAmp * 0.55 * Math.cos(theta * 9 - phase * 0.7);

      // Super-elliptical shirt cross-section (slim side profile along X, wide shoulder span along Z)
      const cosT = Math.cos(theta);
      const sinT = Math.sin(theta);
      const rx = 0.5 * hemFlare * pleat * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.abs(sinT));
      const rz = 0.5 * shoulderTaper * (1.0 - v * 0.06) * (1.0 + pleatAmp * 0.22 * Math.sin(theta * 3));

      const px = cosT * rx + swayX;
      const pz = sinT * rz;

      positions.push(px, y, pz);
      uvs.push(u * 2, v * 2);
    }
  }

  const stride = segU + 1;
  for (let iv = 0; iv < segV; iv++) {
    for (let iu = 0; iu < segU; iu++) {
      const a = iv * stride + iu;
      const b = a + 1;
      const c = a + stride + 1;
      const d = a + stride;
      indices.push(a, d, b, b, d, c);
    }
  }

  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute("position", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute("uv", new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const shared = markSharedGeometry(geo);
  shirtTorsoCache.set(key, shared);
  return shared;
}

function getShirtDetailGeos() {
  if (!sharedCollarGeo) {
    // Sculpted turn-down folded shirt collar ring at neck
    const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(28, 36, 36, 18, 1, true);
    g.scale(0.62, 1.0, 1.35);
    sharedCollarGeo = markSharedGeometry(g);
  }
  if (!sharedSleeveGeo) {
    // Tapered draped long shirt sleeve with cuff
    const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(26, 21, 1.0, 14, 4, false);
    g.translate(0, -0.5, 0);
    g.scale(0.74, 1.0, 1.05);
    sharedSleeveGeo = markSharedGeometry(g);
  }
  if (!sharedPlacketGeo) {
    sharedPlacketGeo = markSharedGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4, 1.0, 22));
  }
  return {
    collarGeo: sharedCollarGeo,
    sleeveGeo: sharedSleeveGeo,
    placketGeo: sharedPlacketGeo,
  };
}

export function createSculptedHangingShirtGroup(
  variantIdx: number,
  garmentHeightMm: number,
  garmentDepthMm: number
): THREE.Group {
  ensurePropMaterials();
  const grp = new THREE.Group();

  const { hookGeo, hangerBarGeo } = getHookAndHangerGeos();
  const { collarGeo, sleeveGeo, placketGeo } = getShirtDetailGeos();
  const torsoGeo = getSculptedShirtTorsoGeo(variantIdx);
  const fabricMat = shirtMaterialsCache[variantIdx % shirtMaterialsCache.length];

  const effDepth = Math.max(240, Math.min(430, garmentDepthMm));
  const hangerScaleZ = effDepth / 410;

  // 1. Swan-Neck Metal Hook + Contoured Wooden Hanger
  const hook = new THREE.Mesh(hookGeo, hangerHookMat!);
  hook.castShadow = true;
  grp.add(hook);

  const hanger = new THREE.Mesh(hangerBarGeo, hangerWoodMat!);
  hanger.scale.set(1, 1, hangerScaleZ);
  hanger.castShadow = true;
  grp.add(hanger);

  // 2. Sculpted Draped Shirt Body
  const bodyH = Math.max(420, garmentHeightMm - 45);
  const bodyThickX = 54 + (variantIdx % 3) * 6;
  const torso = new THREE.Mesh(torsoGeo, fabricMat);
  torso.position.set(0, -48, 0);
  torso.scale.set(bodyThickX, bodyH, effDepth * 0.84);
  torso.castShadow = true;
  torso.receiveShadow = true;
  grp.add(torso);

  // 3. Turn-Down Shirt Collar around Hanger Neck
  const collar = new THREE.Mesh(collarGeo, fabricMat);
  collar.position.set(0, -46, 0);
  collar.castShadow = true;
  grp.add(collar);

  // 4. Front & Back Draped Long Sleeves hanging naturally from shoulder tips
  const sleeveLen = bodyH * 0.84;
  [-1, 1].forEach((sideSign) => {
    const sleeve = new THREE.Mesh(sleeveGeo, fabricMat);
    sleeve.position.set(
      sideSign * 2,
      -68,
      sideSign * (effDepth * 0.41)
    );
    sleeve.rotation.x = sideSign * 0.055;
    sleeve.scale.set(1.0, sleeveLen, 1.0);
    sleeve.castShadow = true;
    sleeve.receiveShadow = true;
    grp.add(sleeve);
  });

  // 5. Raised Center Placket Seam along front-facing side (+Z)
  const placket = new THREE.Mesh(placketGeo, fabricMat);
  placket.position.set(0, -56 - bodyH * 0.46, effDepth * 0.41);
  placket.scale.set(1, bodyH * 0.88, 1);
  grp.add(placket);

  // Slight organic per-garment yaw angle on the rail
  grp.rotation.y = ((variantIdx % 4) - 1.5) * 0.04;
  return grp;
}

// ============================================================================
// 2. U-FOLDED ROUNDED KNITWEAR / TOWEL STACK GEOMETRY (GPU-Cached)
// ============================================================================
let sharedFoldedLayerGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;

function getFoldedKnitLayerGeo(): THREE.BufferGeometry {
  if (sharedFoldedLayerGeo) return sharedFoldedLayerGeo;

  // Cross-section in Y-Z plane: smooth 180° rounded front fold loop at +Z and tucked soft layers toward -Z,
  // extruded along X with smooth rounded bevels so every folded sweater looks plump & tactile!
  const shape = new THREE.Shape();
  const lenZ = 0.88;
  const halfH = 0.44;
  const creaseY = 0.04;

  shape.moveTo(-lenZ * 0.5, -halfH);
  shape.lineTo(lenZ * 0.34, -halfH);
  // Smooth rounded front C-fold loop at +Z
  shape.absarc(lenZ * 0.34, 0, halfH, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, false);
  // Gently crowned pillowed top surface back to -Z
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(0, halfH * 1.12, -lenZ * 0.5, halfH * 0.92);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-lenZ * 0.56, halfH * 0.5, -lenZ * 0.5, creaseY);
  // Subtle recessed middle fold crease
  shape.lineTo(lenZ * 0.24, creaseY * 0.5);
  shape.lineTo(-lenZ * 0.5, -creaseY);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-lenZ * 0.56, -halfH * 0.5, -lenZ * 0.5, -halfH);

  const extrude = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
    depth: 0.88,
    bevelEnabled: true,
    bevelSegments: 4,
    steps: 1,
    bevelSize: 0.06,
    bevelThickness: 0.06,
    curveSegments: 14,
  });
  // Rotate so extrusion axis (originally Z) aligns with X (width), Y stays height, X (shape) aligns with Z (depth)
  extrude.center();
  extrude.rotateY(Math.PI / 2);
  extrude.computeVertexNormals();

  sharedFoldedLayerGeo = markSharedGeometry(extrude);
  return sharedFoldedLayerGeo;
}

export function createFoldedKnitwearStackGroup(
  stackW: number,
  stackD: number,
  layersCount = 3,
  seedOffset = 0
): THREE.Group {
  ensurePropMaterials();
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const geo = getFoldedKnitLayerGeo();
  const layerH = 38;

  for (let i = 0; i < layersCount; i++) {
    const mat = knitMaterialsCache[(i + seedOffset) % knitMaterialsCache.length];
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    const shrink = 1 - i * 0.025;
    mesh.scale.set(stackW * shrink, layerH, stackD * shrink);
    mesh.position.set(
      ((i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (i * 1.8)),
      layerH * 0.5 + i * (layerH - 2),
      0
    );
    mesh.rotation.y = ((i + seedOffset) % 3 - 1) * 0.022;
    mesh.castShadow = true;
    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
    grp.add(mesh);
  }
  return grp;
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. TWO-PIECE ARCHITECTURAL LIDDED LINEN STORAGE BOX (Overhanging Fitted Lid!)
// ============================================================================
let sharedUnitRoundedBoxGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;

function getUnitRoundedBoxGeo(): THREE.BufferGeometry {
  if (sharedUnitRoundedBoxGeo) return sharedUnitRoundedBoxGeo;
  const shape = new THREE.Shape();
  const r = 0.04;
  const hw = 0.5 - r;
  const hd = 0.5 - r;
  shape.moveTo(-hw, -hd - r);
  shape.lineTo(hw, -hd - r);
  shape.absarc(hw, -hd, r, -Math.PI / 2, 0, false);
  shape.lineTo(hw + r, hd);
  shape.absarc(hw, hd, r, 0, Math.PI / 2, false);
  shape.lineTo(-hw, hd + r);
  shape.absarc(-hw, hd, r, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, false);
  shape.lineTo(-hw - r, -hd);
  shape.absarc(-hw, -hd, r, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5, false);

  const g = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, {
    depth: 0.94,
    bevelEnabled: true,
    bevelSegments: 2,
    steps: 1,
    bevelSize: 0.02,
    bevelThickness: 0.03,
  });
  g.center();
  g.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  sharedUnitRoundedBoxGeo = markSharedGeometry(g);
  return sharedUnitRoundedBoxGeo;
}

export function createLiddedStorageBoxGroup(
  boxW: number,
  boxH: number,
  boxD: number
): THREE.Group {
  ensurePropMaterials();
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const unitGeo = getUnitRoundedBoxGeo();

  const lidH = Math.min(36, Math.max(26, boxH * 0.23));
  const bodyH = Math.max(60, boxH - lidH * 0.35);

  // 1. Main Linen Box Base
  const baseMesh = new THREE.Mesh(unitGeo, boxBodyLinenMat!);
  baseMesh.scale.set(boxW - 8, bodyH, boxD - 8);
  baseMesh.position.set(0, bodyH * 0.5, 0);
  baseMesh.castShadow = true;
  baseMesh.receiveShadow = true;
  grp.add(baseMesh);

  // 2. Dark Shadow Reveal Line directly beneath Overhanging Lid
  const rimShadow = new THREE.Mesh(unitGeo, boxShadowRimMat!);
  rimShadow.scale.set(boxW - 3, 4, boxD - 3);
  rimShadow.position.set(0, boxH - lidH - 1.5, 0);
  grp.add(rimShadow);

  // 3. Overhanging Fitted Box Lid (+8mm wider & deeper so it casts a real shadow step!)
  const lidMesh = new THREE.Mesh(unitGeo, boxLidLinenMat!);
  lidMesh.scale.set(boxW, lidH, boxD);
  lidMesh.position.set(0, boxH - lidH * 0.5, 0);
  lidMesh.castShadow = true;
  lidMesh.receiveShadow = true;
  grp.add(lidMesh);

  // 4. Subtle Stitched Leather / Warm Brass Label Pull on Front Face
  const pullMesh = new THREE.Mesh(unitGeo, boxPullPlateMat!);
  pullMesh.scale.set(Math.min(48, boxW * 0.2), 14, 5);
  pullMesh.position.set(0, bodyH * 0.52, (boxD - 8) * 0.5 + 2);
  grp.add(pullMesh);

  return grp;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. SCULPTED 3D LASTED LEATHER / SUEDE SHOES WITH WELT SOLES (GPU-Cached)
// ============================================================================
let sharedShoeUpperGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
let sharedShoeSoleGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;
let sharedShoeOpeningGeo: THREE.BufferGeometry | null = null;

function getSculptedShoeGeos() {
  if (!sharedShoeUpperGeo) {
    // 2D footprint outline of a lasted loafer/sneaker extruded & sculpted with arched instep
    const soleShape = new THREE.Shape();
    // Heel at z = -105, Toe at z = +115, Width ~76mm
    soleShape.moveTo(0, -105);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(34, -105, 36, -65, 31, -20);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(28, 20, 41, 55, 36, 88);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(30, 112, 14, 118, 0, 118);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(-14, 118, -30, 112, -36, 88);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(-41, 55, -28, 20, -31, -20);
    soleShape.bezierCurveTo(-36, -65, -34, -105, 0, -105);

    const soleGeo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(soleShape, {
      depth: 13,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 2,
      steps: 1,
      bevelSize: 2,
      bevelThickness: 2,
      curveSegments: 16,
    });
    soleGeo.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    soleGeo.translate(0, 15, 0);
    soleGeo.computeVertexNormals();
    sharedShoeSoleGeo = markSharedGeometry(soleGeo);

    // Sculpted Upper: extrude & deform top vertices to form heel counter, ankle dip, raised instep & rounded toe!
    const upperGeo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(soleShape, {
      depth: 56,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 3,
      steps: 3,
      bevelSize: 2.5,
      bevelThickness: 4,
      curveSegments: 16,
    });
    upperGeo.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    upperGeo.translate(0, 68, 0);

    const pos = upperGeo.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
      let vx = pos.getX(i);
      let vy = pos.getY(i);
      const vz = pos.getZ(i); // -105 (heel) .. +118 (toe)

      const tNorm = (vz + 105) / 223; // 0 = heel, 1 = toe tip
      const hRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (vy - 14) / 58));

      // Anatomical shoe profile height curve: tall heel (0.95), dipped collar (0.72), arched instep (0.82), sleek tapered toe (0.36)
      let profileMaxY = 66;
      if (tNorm < 0.35) {
        profileMaxY = 68 - Math.sin((tNorm / 0.35) * Math.PI) * 8;
      } else {
        const toeT = (tNorm - 0.35) / 0.65;
        profileMaxY = 66 * (1 - Math.pow(toeT, 1.45) * 0.58);
      }

      vy = 13 + hRatio * (profileMaxY - 13);
      // Taper upper inward near top of vamp/collar
      const inward = 1 - hRatio * (0.16 + tNorm * 0.14);
      vx *= inward;

      pos.setXYZ(i, vx, vy, vz);
    }
    upperGeo.computeVertexNormals();
    sharedShoeUpperGeo = markSharedGeometry(upperGeo);

    const openGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(22, 20, 8, 16);
    openGeo.scale(1.0, 1.0, 1.55);
    sharedShoeOpeningGeo = markSharedGeometry(openGeo);
  }
  return {
    upperGeo: sharedShoeUpperGeo!,
    soleGeo: sharedShoeSoleGeo!,
    openingGeo: sharedShoeOpeningGeo!,
  };
}

export function createSculptedShoePairGroup(pairVariantIdx: number): THREE.Group {
  ensurePropMaterials();
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const { upperGeo, soleGeo, openingGeo } = getSculptedShoeGeos();

  const upperMats = [shoeUpperCamelMat!, shoeUpperEspressoMat!, shoeUpperTaupeMat!];
  const upperMat = upperMats[pairVariantIdx % upperMats.length];

  [-46, 46].forEach((offsetX, sideIdx) => {
    const shoe = new THREE.Group();
    shoe.position.set(offsetX, 0, 0);
    shoe.scale.set(sideIdx === 0 ? 1 : -1, 1, 1); // Mirror left & right last!
    shoe.rotation.y = sideIdx === 0 ? 0.035 : -0.035;

    const sole = new THREE.Mesh(soleGeo, shoeSoleCreamMat!);
    sole.castShadow = true;
    sole.receiveShadow = true;
    shoe.add(sole);

    const upper = new THREE.Mesh(upperGeo, upperMat);
    upper.castShadow = true;
    upper.receiveShadow = true;
    shoe.add(upper);

    const footOpening = new THREE.Mesh(openingGeo, shoeInnerDarkMat!);
    footOpening.position.set(0, 61, -42);
    footOpening.rotation.x = 0.18;
    shoe.add(footOpening);

    grp.add(shoe);
  });

  return grp;
}

import * as THREE from "three";

const SHARED_RESOURCE_FLAG = "__birimSharedResource";

export function markSharedGeometry<T extends THREE.BufferGeometry>(geometry: T): T {
  geometry.userData = { ...geometry.userData, [SHARED_RESOURCE_FLAG]: true };
  return geometry;
}

export function markSharedMaterial<T extends THREE.Material>(material: T): T {
  material.userData = { ...material.userData, [SHARED_RESOURCE_FLAG]: true };
  return material;
}

export function markSharedTexture<T extends THREE.Texture>(texture: T): T {
  texture.userData = { ...texture.userData, [SHARED_RESOURCE_FLAG]: true };
  return texture;
}

export function isSharedWebGLResource(
  resource: { userData?: Record<string, unknown> } | null | undefined
): boolean {
  return Boolean(resource?.userData?.[SHARED_RESOURCE_FLAG]);
}

function disposeMaterialSafely(mat: THREE.Material | null | undefined): void {
  if (!mat || isSharedWebGLResource(mat)) return;
  const record = mat as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  const textureKeys = [
    "map",
    "bumpMap",
    "normalMap",
    "roughnessMap",
    "metalnessMap",
    "aoMap",
    "alphaMap",
    "emissiveMap",
  ];
  for (const key of textureKeys) {
    const candidate = record[key];
    if (candidate instanceof THREE.Texture && !isSharedWebGLResource(candidate)) {
      candidate.dispose();
    }
  }
  mat.dispose();
}

/**
 * Traverses an Object3D subtree, disposes all non-shared BufferGeometries, EdgesGeometries,
 * Materials, and owned Textures from GPU VRAM, and clears the container's children.
 */
export function disposeObject3DTree(root: THREE.Object3D | null | undefined): void {
  if (!root) return;
  const geometriesToDispose = new Set<THREE.BufferGeometry>();
  const materialsToDispose = new Set<THREE.Material>();

  root.traverse((obj) => {
    if (
      obj instanceof THREE.Mesh ||
      obj instanceof THREE.Line ||
      obj instanceof THREE.LineSegments ||
      obj instanceof THREE.Points
    ) {
      if (obj.geometry && !isSharedWebGLResource(obj.geometry)) {
        geometriesToDispose.add(obj.geometry);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(obj.material)) {
        obj.material.forEach((m) => {
          if (m && !isSharedWebGLResource(m)) materialsToDispose.add(m);
        });
      } else if (obj.material && !isSharedWebGLResource(obj.material)) {
        materialsToDispose.add(obj.material);
      }
    }
  });

  geometriesToDispose.forEach((geo) => geo.dispose());
  materialsToDispose.forEach((mat) => disposeMaterialSafely(mat));
  root.clear();
}

/**
 * Attaches WebGL context-loss & restoration handlers so GPU driver resets or background tab
 * eviction recover gracefully instead of leaving a dead white canvas.
 */
export function attachWebGLContextRecovery(
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  callbacks: {
    onContextLost?: () => void;
    onContextRestored?: () => void;
  }
): () => void {
  const handleLost = (event: Event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    callbacks.onContextLost?.();
  };
  const handleRestored = () => {
    callbacks.onContextRestored?.();
  };

  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", handleLost, false);
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextrestored", handleRestored, false);

  return () => {
    canvas.removeEventListener("webglcontextlost", handleLost, false);
    canvas.removeEventListener("webglcontextrestored", handleRestored, false);
  };
}
