import {
  CutPiece,
  NestingOptimizationResult,
  SheetDimension,
  optimizeSheetNesting,
  STANDARD_SHEET_2800x2070,
} from "@birim/manufacturing";

export interface AsyncNestingJob {
  jobId: string;
  projectId: string;
  revisionId: string;
  version: number;
  sequenceId: number;
  piecesCount: number;
  status: "pending" | "computing" | "completed" | "cancelled";
  executionMode: "web_worker" | "async_fallback";
  result?: NestingOptimizationResult[];
  durationMs?: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface NestingWorkerRequestOptions {
  projectId?: string;
  revisionId?: string;
}

let activeSequenceId = 0;
let latestSequenceByProject = new Map<string, number>();
let activeProjectId = "default_project";
let currentJob: AsyncNestingJob | null = null;
let activeBrowserWorker: Worker | null = null;
let activeWorkerBlobUrl: string | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<(job: AsyncNestingJob) => void>();

function terminateActiveWorkerAndBlob(): void {
  if (activeBrowserWorker) {
    activeBrowserWorker.terminate();
    activeBrowserWorker = null;
  }
  if (activeWorkerBlobUrl && typeof URL !== "undefined" && typeof URL.revokeObjectURL === "function") {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(activeWorkerBlobUrl);
    activeWorkerBlobUrl = null;
  }
}

const INLINE_NESTING_WORKER_SOURCE = `
self.onmessage = function(e) {
  var data = e.data || {};
  var pieces = data.pieces || [];
  var sheetConfig = data.sheetConfig || {
    name: "Standart Ham/Melamin Levha 2800x2070",
    lengthMm: 2800,
    widthMm: 2070,
    trimCutMm: 15,
    kerfMm: 4.4
  };
  if (!pieces.length) {
    self.postMessage({ ok: true, result: [] });
    return;
  }
  try {
    var materialGroups = new Map();
    for (var i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) {
      var p = pieces[i];
      var key = p.materialId + "::" + p.thicknessMm;
      var list = materialGroups.get(key) || [];
      list.push(p);
      materialGroups.set(key, list);
    }
    var results = [];
    materialGroups.forEach(function(matPieces) {
      var matId = matPieces[0].materialId;
      var matName = matPieces[0].materialName || "Bilinmeyen Malzeme";
      var usableW = sheetConfig.lengthMm - 2 * sheetConfig.trimCutMm;
      var usableH = sheetConfig.widthMm - 2 * sheetConfig.trimCutMm;
      var kerf = sheetConfig.kerfMm;
      var fullSheetAreaM2 = (sheetConfig.lengthMm * sheetConfig.widthMm) / 1000000;
      var itemsToPlace = [];
      for (var j = 0; j < matPieces.length; j++) {
        var piece = matPieces[j];
        var netL = typeof piece.netCutLengthMm === "number" ? piece.netCutLengthMm : piece.lengthMm;
        var netW = typeof piece.netCutWidthMm === "number" ? piece.netCutWidthMm : piece.widthMm;
        var itemW = piece.grain === "crosswise" ? netW : netL;
        var itemH = piece.grain === "crosswise" ? netL : netW;
        for (var q = 0; q < piece.quantity; q++) {
          itemsToPlace.push({
            piece: piece,
            w: itemW,
            h: itemH,
            canRotate: piece.grain === "none"
          });
        }
      }
      itemsToPlace.sort(function(a, b) { return b.w * b.h - a.w * a.h; });
      var sheets = [];
      var unplaced = [];
      var activeSheets = [];
      function createNewSheet(idx) {
        return {
          sheet: {
            sheetIndex: idx + 1,
            materialId: matId,
            materialName: matName,
            sheetDimension: sheetConfig,
            placedPieces: [],
            usableRemnants: [],
            usableRemnantAreaM2: 0,
            netUsedAreaM2: 0,
            totalSheetAreaM2: fullSheetAreaM2,
            wasteAreaM2: fullSheetAreaM2,
            wastePercent: 100
          },
          freeRects: [{ x: sheetConfig.trimCutMm, y: sheetConfig.trimCutMm, w: usableW, h: usableH }]
        };
      }
      for (var k = 0; k < itemsToPlace.length; k++) {
        var item = itemsToPlace[k];
        var placed = false;
        for (var sIdx = 0; sIdx < activeSheets.length; sIdx++) {
          var cur = activeSheets[sIdx];
          var bestRectIdx = -1;
          var bestRotate = false;
          var minRemArea = Infinity;
          for (var rIdx = 0; rIdx < cur.freeRects.length; rIdx++) {
            var rect = cur.freeRects[rIdx];
            if (item.w <= rect.w && item.h <= rect.h) {
              var remA = rect.w * rect.h - item.w * item.h;
              if (remA < minRemArea) { minRemArea = remA; bestRectIdx = rIdx; bestRotate = false; }
            }
            if (item.canRotate && item.h <= rect.w && item.w <= rect.h) {
              var remB = rect.w * rect.h - item.w * item.h;
              if (remB < minRemArea) { minRemArea = remB; bestRectIdx = rIdx; bestRotate = true; }
            }
          }
          if (bestRectIdx >= 0) {
            var chosen = cur.freeRects[bestRectIdx];
            var placeW = bestRotate ? item.h : item.w;
            var placeH = bestRotate ? item.w : item.h;
            cur.sheet.placedPieces.push({
              pieceId: item.piece.id,
              pieceName: item.piece.pieceName,
              materialName: item.piece.materialName,
              x: chosen.x,
              y: chosen.y,
              width: placeW,
              length: placeH,
              isRotated: bestRotate
            });
            cur.sheet.netUsedAreaM2 += (placeW * placeH) / 1000000;
            cur.freeRects.splice(bestRectIdx, 1);
            var rightW = chosen.w - placeW - kerf;
            if (rightW > 50) cur.freeRects.push({ x: chosen.x + placeW + kerf, y: chosen.y, w: rightW, h: placeH });
            var topH = chosen.h - placeH - kerf;
            if (topH > 50) cur.freeRects.push({ x: chosen.x, y: chosen.y + placeH + kerf, w: chosen.w, h: topH });
            placed = true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!placed) {
          if ((item.w > usableW || item.h > usableH) && (!item.canRotate || item.h > usableW || item.w > usableH)) {
            unplaced.push(item.piece);
          } else {
            var newEntry = createNewSheet(activeSheets.length);
            activeSheets.push(newEntry);
            var firstRect = newEntry.freeRects[0];
            var rotNew = (item.w > firstRect.w || item.h > firstRect.h) && item.canRotate && item.h <= firstRect.w && item.w <= firstRect.h;
            var pw = rotNew ? item.h : item.w;
            var ph = rotNew ? item.w : item.h;
            newEntry.sheet.placedPieces.push({
              pieceId: item.piece.id,
              pieceName: item.piece.pieceName,
              materialName: item.piece.materialName,
              x: firstRect.x,
              y: firstRect.y,
              width: pw,
              length: ph,
              isRotated: rotNew
            });
            newEntry.sheet.netUsedAreaM2 += (pw * ph) / 1000000;
            newEntry.freeRects.splice(0, 1);
            var rw = firstRect.w - pw - kerf;
            if (rw > 50) newEntry.freeRects.push({ x: firstRect.x + pw + kerf, y: firstRect.y, w: rw, h: ph });
            var th = firstRect.h - ph - kerf;
            if (th > 50) newEntry.freeRects.push({ x: firstRect.x, y: firstRect.y + ph + kerf, w: firstRect.w, h: th });
          }
        }
      }
      var totalMatNetAreaM2 = 0;
      var totalUsableRemnantAreaM2 = 0;
      for (var m = 0; m < activeSheets.length; m++) {
        var s = activeSheets[m];
        var usableRemnants = [];
        var sheetRemArea = 0;
        for (var frIdx = 0; frIdx < s.freeRects.length; frIdx++) {
          var fr = s.freeRects[frIdx];
          if (fr.w >= 300 && fr.h >= 300) {
            var areaM2 = Number(((fr.w * fr.h) / 1000000).toFixed(3));
            sheetRemArea += areaM2;
            usableRemnants.push({
              id: "rem_" + matId + "_s" + s.sheet.sheetIndex + "_" + (frIdx + 1),
              x: Math.round(fr.x),
              y: Math.round(fr.y),
              width: Math.round(fr.w),
              length: Math.round(fr.h),
              areaM2: areaM2
            });
          }
        }
        s.sheet.usableRemnants = usableRemnants;
        s.sheet.usableRemnantAreaM2 = Number(sheetRemArea.toFixed(3));
        s.sheet.netUsedAreaM2 = Number(s.sheet.netUsedAreaM2.toFixed(3));
        s.sheet.wasteAreaM2 = Number(Math.max(0, s.sheet.totalSheetAreaM2 - s.sheet.netUsedAreaM2).toFixed(3));
        s.sheet.wastePercent = Number(((s.sheet.wasteAreaM2 / s.sheet.totalSheetAreaM2) * 100).toFixed(1));
        totalMatNetAreaM2 += s.sheet.netUsedAreaM2;
        totalUsableRemnantAreaM2 += s.sheet.usableRemnantAreaM2;
        sheets.push(s.sheet);
      }
      var totalGrossAreaM2 = sheets.length * fullSheetAreaM2;
      var overallWastePercent = totalGrossAreaM2 > 0
        ? Number((((totalGrossAreaM2 - totalMatNetAreaM2) / totalGrossAreaM2) * 100).toFixed(1))
        : 0;
      results.push({
        materialId: matId,
        materialName: matName,
        sheets: sheets,
        unplacedPieces: unplaced,
        totalSheetsCount: sheets.length,
        totalNetAreaM2: Number(totalMatNetAreaM2.toFixed(2)),
        totalGrossAreaM2: Number(totalGrossAreaM2.toFixed(2)),
        usableRemnantAreaM2: Number(totalUsableRemnantAreaM2.toFixed(2)),
        overallWastePercent: overallWastePercent
      });
    });
    self.postMessage({ ok: true, result: results });
  } catch (err) {
    self.postMessage({ ok: false, error: err && err.message ? err.message : "Worker nesting error" });
  }
};
`;

export function subscribeNestingJob(listener: (job: AsyncNestingJob) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  if (currentJob) listener(currentJob);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function notify(job: AsyncNestingJob) {
  currentJob = job;
  listeners.forEach((fn) => fn(job));
}

export function resetNestingWorkerState(): void {
  terminateActiveWorkerAndBlob();
  activeSequenceId = 0;
  latestSequenceByProject = new Map();
  activeProjectId = "default_project";
  currentJob = null;
}

/**
 * Dispatches heavy nesting bin-packing asynchronously.
 * WP-12 Contract:
 * - Tracks `projectId + revisionId + jobId + sequenceId`.
 * - Executes inside an isolated browser Web Worker thread when `Worker` + `Blob` are available,
 *   immediately terminating any superseded in-flight worker and revoking its Blob URL, and falls
 *   back to async scheduling in non-Worker environments (such as Node/Vitest).
 */
export async function computeNestingAsync(
  pieces: CutPiece[],
  version: number,
  sheetConfig: SheetDimension = STANDARD_SHEET_2800x2070,
  options: NestingWorkerRequestOptions = {}
): Promise<NestingOptimizationResult[] | null> {
  terminateActiveWorkerAndBlob();

  const sequenceId = ++activeSequenceId;
  const projectId = options.projectId || "default_project";
  const revisionId = options.revisionId || `rev_v${version}`;

  activeProjectId = projectId;
  latestSequenceByProject.set(projectId, sequenceId);

  const jobId = `nest_${projectId}_${revisionId}_seq${sequenceId}`;
  const hasBrowserWorker =
    typeof window !== "undefined" &&
    typeof Worker !== "undefined" &&
    typeof Blob !== "undefined" &&
    typeof URL !== "undefined" &&
    typeof URL.createObjectURL === "function";

  const job: AsyncNestingJob = {
    jobId,
    projectId,
    revisionId,
    version,
    sequenceId,
    piecesCount: pieces.length,
    status: "computing",
    executionMode: hasBrowserWorker ? "web_worker" : "async_fallback",
  };
  notify(job);

  const isStale = () =>
    activeProjectId !== projectId ||
    (latestSequenceByProject.get(projectId) ?? 0) > sequenceId;

  const t0 = performance.now();

  if (hasBrowserWorker) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let localBlobUrl: string | null = null;
      try {
        const blob = new Blob([INLINE_NESTING_WORKER_SOURCE], {
          type: "application/javascript",
        });
        localBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        activeWorkerBlobUrl = localBlobUrl;
        const worker = new Worker(localBlobUrl);
        activeBrowserWorker = worker;

        const cleanup = () => {
          if (localBlobUrl) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(localBlobUrl);
            if (activeWorkerBlobUrl === localBlobUrl) {
              activeWorkerBlobUrl = null;
            }
            localBlobUrl = null;
          }
          if (activeBrowserWorker === worker) {
            activeBrowserWorker = null;
          }
        };

        worker.onmessage = (
          ev: MessageEvent<{ ok: boolean; result?: NestingOptimizationResult[]; error?: string }>
        ) => {
          cleanup();
          const durationMs = Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2));
          if (isStale()) {
            notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled", durationMs });
            resolve(null);
            return;
          }
          if (ev.data?.ok && ev.data.result) {
            const completedJob: AsyncNestingJob = {
              ...job,
              status: "completed",
              result: ev.data.result,
              durationMs,
            };
            notify(completedJob);
            resolve(ev.data.result);
          } else {
            notify({
              ...job,
              status: "cancelled",
              error: ev.data?.error || "Nesting worker hatası",
            });
            resolve(null);
          }
        };

        worker.onerror = () => {
          cleanup();
          const result = optimizeSheetNesting(pieces, sheetConfig);
          const durationMs = Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2));
          if (isStale()) {
            notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled", durationMs });
            resolve(null);
            return;
          }
          notify({
            ...job,
            executionMode: "async_fallback",
            status: "completed",
            result,
            durationMs,
          });
          resolve(result);
        };

        worker.postMessage({ pieces, sheetConfig });
      } catch {
        if (localBlobUrl) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(localBlobUrl);
          if (activeWorkerBlobUrl === localBlobUrl) {
            activeWorkerBlobUrl = null;
          }
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (isStale()) {
            notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled" });
            resolve(null);
            return;
          }
          const result = optimizeSheetNesting(pieces, sheetConfig);
          const durationMs = Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2));
          notify({
            ...job,
            executionMode: "async_fallback",
            status: "completed",
            result,
            durationMs,
          });
          resolve(result);
        }, 0);
      }
    });
  }

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (isStale()) {
        notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled" });
        resolve(null);
        return;
      }

      try {
        const result = optimizeSheetNesting(pieces, sheetConfig);
        const durationMs = Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2));

        if (isStale()) {
          notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled", durationMs });
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }

        const completedJob: AsyncNestingJob = {
          ...job,
          status: "completed",
          result,
          durationMs,
        };
        notify(completedJob);
        resolve(result);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const errorMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Nesting hesaplama hatası";
        notify({ ...job, status: "cancelled", error: errorMsg });
        resolve(null);
      }
    }, 0);
  });
}

import { UnitLength, ModuleInstance } from "@birim/core";
import { WARDROBE_TEMPLATES } from "./templates";

export interface PartitionOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  explanation: string;
  carcassCount: number;
  moduleWidths: UnitLength[];
  pros: string[];
  cons: string[];
}

export interface SmartAdvisorFeedback {
  spanWidthMm: number;
  recommendedPartitions: PartitionOption[];
  hingeAdvice: { doorHeightMm: number; recommendedHingesPerDoor: number; reason: string };
  drawerAdvice: { maxSafeDrawerWidth: number; reason: string };
  manufacturingFeasibilityNotes: string[];
}

/**
 * Deterministic Rule-Based Smart Design Advisor for cabinet layouts and spans.
 */
export function analyzeAndAdviseSpan(spanWidthMm: UnitLength, heightMm: UnitLength = 2200): SmartAdvisorFeedback {
  const partitions: PartitionOption[] = [];
  const feasibilityNotes: string[] = [];

  // Ergonomic and manufacturing limits
  const maxSingleCarcassWidth = 1200; // transport and handling ease
  const minCarcassWidth = 400;

  if (spanWidthMm > 2400) {
    feasibilityNotes.push(
      `${spanWidthMm}mm açıklık tek bir parça plaka veya gövde olarak taşınamaz. En az 2 veya 3 bağımsız gövdeye bölünmesi zorunludur.`
    );
  }

  // 1. Equal 2-Module Partition
  if (spanWidthMm >= 800 && spanWidthMm <= 2400) {
    const half = Math.floor(spanWidthMm / 2);
    partitions.push({
      id: "partition_2_equal",
      name: `2 Eşit Gövde (${half}mm + ${half}mm)`,
      explanation: "Standart simetrik çift gövde yapısı. Yatak odası ve giyinme odaları için en dengeli taşıma ve montaj ergonomisi.",
      carcassCount: 2,
      moduleWidths: [half, half],
      pros: ["Dengeli simetri", "Kolay nakliye ve montaj", "Eşit kapak ölçüleri"],
      cons: ["Genişlik 2000mm üstünde kapaklar genişleyebilir"],
    });
  }

  // 2. 3-Module Partition (for large spans e.g. 2400mm - 3600mm)
  if (spanWidthMm >= 1800) {
    const third = Math.floor(spanWidthMm / 3);
    partitions.push({
      id: "partition_3_equal",
      name: `3 Eşit Gövde (${third}mm + ${third}mm + ${third}mm)`,
      explanation: "Geniş duvarlar için optimum 3 gövdeli master dolap yerleşimi. Bay-bayan veya askı/raf ayrımı için ideal.",
      carcassCount: 3,
      moduleWidths: [third, third, third],
      pros: ["Mükemmel modüler esneklik", "Orta bölüm çekmece, yanlar askı düzeni", "Plaka firesi düşük"],
      cons: ["Birleşimlerde çift yan panel payı (18+18mm) gerekir"],
    });
  }

  // 3. 4-Module Partition (for very large spans e.g. 3000mm - 4000mm)
  if (spanWidthMm >= 2800) {
    const quarter = Math.floor(spanWidthMm / 4);
    partitions.push({
      id: "partition_4_equal",
      name: `4 Eşit Gövde (${quarter}mm x 4)`,
      explanation: "Lüks rezidans giyinme odaları için 4 bağımsız kule modülü. Tavana kadar gömme montaja tam uyumlu.",
      carcassCount: 4,
      moduleWidths: [quarter, quarter, quarter, quarter],
      pros: ["Yüksek yük taşıma kapasitesi", "Her kule bağımsız fonksiyonlandırılabilir"],
      cons: ["Daha fazla gövde paneli ve montaj işçiliği"],
    });
  }

  // Hinge advice based on height
  const recommendedHinges = heightMm > 2000 ? 5 : heightMm > 1600 ? 4 : heightMm > 900 ? 3 : 2;
  const hingeAdvice = {
    doorHeightMm: heightMm,
    recommendedHingesPerDoor: recommendedHinges,
    reason: `${heightMm}mm kapak yüksekliğinde kapak sarkmasını önlemek ve Blumotion frenli kapanış dengesini korumak için kapak başına ${recommendedHinges} adet menteşe zorunludur.`,
  };

  // Drawer advice
  const drawerAdvice = {
    maxSafeDrawerWidth: 1000,
    reason: "Tandembox çekmece raylarında 1000mm üzerindeki genişliklerde sehim ve ray kasılmasını önlemek için yan senkronizasyon mili önerilir.",
  };

  return {
    spanWidthMm,
    recommendedPartitions: partitions,
    hingeAdvice,
    drawerAdvice,
    manufacturingFeasibilityNotes: feasibilityNotes,
  };
}

/**
 * Builds concrete module instances from a chosen partition
 */
export function createModulesFromPartition(
  partition: PartitionOption,
  heightMm = 2200,
  depthMm = 600
): ModuleInstance[] {
  const template = WARDROBE_TEMPLATES[0];
  let curX = 0;

  return partition.moduleWidths.map((w, idx) => {
    const mod = template.createInstance(`mod_partition_${idx + 1}`, `Gövde ${idx + 1} (${w}mm)`);
    mod.position = { x: curX, y: 0, z: 0 };
    mod.dimensions = { width: w, height: heightMm, depth: depthMm };
    curX += w;
    return mod;
  });
}

import {
  DoorOverlayType,
  DoorSystemId,
  HandleCategory,
  ModuleFamilyId,
  OpeningTechnology,
  UnitLength,
} from "@birim/core";

export interface VerificationScopeFlags {
  sourceTechDataVerified: boolean;
  cadGeometryVerified: boolean;
  bomFormulaVerified: boolean;
  drillingPatternVerified: boolean;
  physicalFactorySampleTested: boolean;
}

export interface HardwareDrillingTemplate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  cupDiameterMm: UnitLength;
  cupDepthMm: UnitLength;
  cupEdgeTabMm: UnitLength;
  bossPitchMm: UnitLength; // e.g. 45 (Blum), 52 (Hettich TH52), 48 (Salice)
  bossOffsetMm: UnitLength; // e.g. 9.5 (Blum), 5.5 (Hettich), 9.0 (Salice)
  system32FrontSetbackMm: UnitLength;
  sourceId: string;
}

export interface HardwareProductRecord {
  id: string;
  manufacturerId: "mfr_blum" | "mfr_hettich" | "mfr_hafele" | "mfr_grass" | "mfr_salice" | "mfr_hawa" | "mfr_sugatsune";
  manufacturerName: string;
  familyId:
    | "fam_hinge_concealed"
    | "fam_drawer_box"
    | "fam_runner_concealed"
    | "fam_lift_system"
    | "fam_sliding_system"
    | "fam_pocket_system"
    | "fam_wardrobe_acc"
    | "fam_kitchen_acc"
    | "fam_connector";
  sku: string;
  name: string;
  revision: string;
  lifecycleStatus: "ACTIVE" | "PREFERRED_SUPPLIER" | "DEPRECATED";
  loadCapacityKg: number;
  doorThicknessLimitsMm?: [UnitLength, UnitLength];
  doorWeightLimitsKg?: [number, number];
  powerFactorRangeLf?: [number, number];
  drawerCuttingFormula?: {
    bottomWidthDeductionMm: UnitLength;
    backWidthDeductionMm: UnitLength;
    lengthDeductionMm: UnitLength;
    requiresBottomGroove?: boolean;
  };
  pocketClearanceMm?: {
    pocketWidthMm: UnitLength;
    minCarcassDepthMm: UnitLength;
    minDoorHeightMm: UnitLength;
    maxDoorHeightMm: UnitLength;
  };
  drillingTemplateId?: string;
  compatibleModuleFamilies: ModuleFamilyId[];
  compatibleDoorSystems: DoorSystemId[];
  unitPriceEur: number;
  unit: "adet" | "takım" | "metre";
  sourceId: string;
  verification: VerificationScopeFlags;
}

export interface DoorSystemDefinition {
  id: DoorSystemId;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  leafCount: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
  defaultOverlayType: DoorOverlayType;
  kinematicType:
    | "pivot_vertical"
    | "slide_horizontal_top"
    | "slide_horizontal_bottom"
    | "lift_parallel"
    | "lift_bifold"
    | "lift_up_stay"
    | "fold_side"
    | "pocket_retractable"
    | "tambour_roller"
    | "open";
  maxOpenAngleDeg: number;
  minCarcassDepthMm: UnitLength;
  defaultHardwareProductId?: string;
  verifiedForProduction: boolean;
}

export interface HandleProfileDefinition {
  id: string;
  category: HandleCategory;
  name: string;
  holeSpacingCcMm: UnitLength | null;
  protrusionMm: UnitLength;
  doorHeightDeductionMm: UnitLength;
  minDoorThicknessMm: UnitLength;
  unitPriceEur: number;
  sku: string;
}

export interface OpeningMechanismDefinition {
  id: OpeningTechnology;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  requiresHandle: boolean;
  requiresElectricity: boolean;
  triggerGapMm: UnitLength;
  addonUnitPriceEur: number;
}

export function getHardwareProductById(id?: string): HardwareProductRecord | undefined {
  if (!id) return undefined;
  return V4_HARDWARE_CATALOG.find((p) => p.id === id);
}

export function getDrillingTemplateForHardware(hardwareProductId?: string): HardwareDrillingTemplate {
  const hw = getHardwareProductById(hardwareProductId);
  if (hw?.drillingTemplateId && HARDWARE_DRILLING_TEMPLATES[hw.drillingTemplateId]) {
    return HARDWARE_DRILLING_TEMPLATES[hw.drillingTemplateId];
  }
  return HARDWARE_DRILLING_TEMPLATES.tpl_drill_blum_hinge_45x95;
}

/**
 * Selects optimal nominal runner length (NL) in mm based on usable cabinet inner depth.
 */
export function selectOptimalRunnerLengthMm(usableInnerDepthMm: UnitLength): UnitLength {
  const standardLengths = [600, 550, 500, 450, 400, 350, 270];
  const maxAllowed = usableInnerDepthMm - 10;
  for (const nl of standardLengths) {
    if (nl <= maxAllowed) return nl;
  }
  return 270;
}

import {
  HardwareProductRecord,
  V4_HARDWARE_CATALOG,
  VerificationScopeFlags,
} from "./v4-hardware-catalog";
import { V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES, V4ModuleTemplateDefinition } from "./v4-module-taxonomy";

export type LibraryLifecycleState = "DRAFT" | "REVIEW" | "VERIFIED" | "PUBLISHED" | "DEPRECATED";

export interface LibraryCatalogEntry {
  id: string;
  entityType: "MODULE_TEMPLATE" | "HARDWARE_PRODUCT";
  code: string;
  name: string;
  familyOrManufacturer: string;
  lifecycleState: LibraryLifecycleState;
  sourceId: string;
  sourceRevision?: string;
  defaultDimensions?: { width: number; height: number; depth: number };
  defaultDoorSystemId?: string;
  verification: VerificationScopeFlags;
  semver: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot {
  releaseId: string;
  semver: string;
  publishedAt: string;
  publishedBy: string;
  sha256Digest: string;
  templatesCount: number;
  hardwareProductsCount: number;
  entries?: LibraryCatalogEntry[];
}

export class V4LibraryAdminStore {
  private entries: Map<string, LibraryCatalogEntry> = new Map();
  private customHardware: HardwareProductRecord[] = [];
  private customTemplates: V4ModuleTemplateDefinition[] = [];
  private releases: PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot[] = [];

  constructor() {
    this.seedFromCanonicalLibrary();
  }

  private seedFromCanonicalLibrary() {
    V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES.forEach((tpl) => {
      this.entries.set(tpl.templateId, {
        id: tpl.templateId,
        entityType: "MODULE_TEMPLATE",
        code: tpl.templateId,
        name: tpl.name,
        familyOrManufacturer: tpl.familyId,
        lifecycleState: "REVIEW",
        sourceId: "SRC_BIRIM_FACTORY_V3",
        sourceRevision: "3.1",
        verification: {
          sourceTechDataVerified: false,
          cadGeometryVerified: false,
          bomFormulaVerified: false,
          drillingPatternVerified: false,
          physicalFactorySampleTested: false,
        },
        semver: "4.0.0",
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    });

    V4_HARDWARE_CATALOG.forEach((hw) => {
      this.entries.set(hw.id, {
        id: hw.id,
        entityType: "HARDWARE_PRODUCT",
        code: hw.sku,
        name: hw.name,
        familyOrManufacturer: hw.manufacturerName,
        lifecycleState: "REVIEW",
        sourceId: hw.sourceId,
        sourceRevision: hw.revision,
        verification: {
          sourceTechDataVerified: false,
          cadGeometryVerified: false,
          bomFormulaVerified: false,
          drillingPatternVerified: false,
          physicalFactorySampleTested: false,
        },
        semver: "4.0.0",
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    });
  }

  getAllEntries(filterType?: "MODULE_TEMPLATE" | "HARDWARE_PRODUCT"): LibraryCatalogEntry[] {
    const all = Array.from(this.entries.values());
    if (!filterType) return structuredClone(all);
    return structuredClone(all.filter((e) => e.entityType === filterType));
  }

  getEntry(id: string): LibraryCatalogEntry | undefined {
    const entry = this.entries.get(id);
    return entry ? structuredClone(entry) : undefined;
  }

  createDraftHardwareEntry(params: {
    id: string;
    sku: string;
    name: string;
    manufacturerName: string;
    sourceId: string;
  }): LibraryCatalogEntry {
    if (this.entries.has(params.id)) throw new Error("Kayıt kimliği zaten var.");
    const entry: LibraryCatalogEntry = {
      id: params.id,
      entityType: "HARDWARE_PRODUCT",
      code: params.sku,
      name: params.name,
      familyOrManufacturer: params.manufacturerName,
      lifecycleState: "DRAFT",
      sourceId: params.sourceId,
      verification: {
        sourceTechDataVerified: false,
        cadGeometryVerified: false,
        bomFormulaVerified: false,
        drillingPatternVerified: false,
        physicalFactorySampleTested: false,
      },
      semver: "4.1.0-draft",
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    return structuredClone(entry);
  }

  createDraftTemplateEntry(params: {
    id: string;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    familyId: string;
    sourceId: string;
    defaultDimensions?: { width: number; height: number; depth: number };
    defaultDoorSystemId?: string;
  }): LibraryCatalogEntry {
    if (this.entries.has(params.id)) throw new Error("Şablon kimliği zaten var.");
    const entry: LibraryCatalogEntry = {
      id: params.id,
      entityType: "MODULE_TEMPLATE",
      code: params.code,
      name: params.name,
      familyOrManufacturer: params.familyId,
      lifecycleState: "DRAFT",
      sourceId: params.sourceId,
      defaultDimensions: params.defaultDimensions,
      defaultDoorSystemId: params.defaultDoorSystemId,
      verification: {
        sourceTechDataVerified: false,
        cadGeometryVerified: false,
        bomFormulaVerified: false,
        drillingPatternVerified: false,
        physicalFactorySampleTested: false,
      },
      semver: "4.2.0-draft",
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    return structuredClone(entry);
  }

  updateVerificationFlags(id: string, patch: Partial<VerificationScopeFlags>): LibraryCatalogEntry | null {
    const existing = this.entries.get(id);
    if (!existing) return null;
    const updated: LibraryCatalogEntry = {
      ...existing,
      verification: { ...existing.verification, ...patch },
      lifecycleState: "REVIEW",
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.entries.set(id, updated);
    return updated;
  }

  transitionLifecycleState(
    id: string,
    targetState: LibraryLifecycleState
  ): { success: boolean; error?: string; entry?: LibraryCatalogEntry } {
    const existing = this.entries.get(id);
    if (!existing) {
      return { success: false, error: "Kayıt bulunamadı." };
    }

    const v = existing.verification;
    if (targetState === "VERIFIED" || targetState === "PUBLISHED") {
      if (
        !v.sourceTechDataVerified ||
        !v.cadGeometryVerified ||
        !v.bomFormulaVerified ||
        !v.drillingPatternVerified ||
        !v.physicalFactorySampleTested
      ) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error:
            "VERIFIED veya PUBLISHED durumuna geçiş için Kaynak Teknik Veri, CAD Geometrisi, BOM Formülü ve Delik Şablonu doğrulamaları tamamlanmış olmalıdır.",
        };
      }
      if (!existing.sourceId || existing.sourceId.trim() === "") {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: "Kaynağı (sourceId) olmayan kayıt VERIFIED veya PUBLISHED durumuna geçirilemez.",
        };
      }
    }

    const updated: LibraryCatalogEntry = {
      ...existing,
      lifecycleState: targetState,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.entries.set(id, updated);
    return { success: true, entry: updated };
  }

  async publishNewRelease(semver: string, publishedBy = "BIRIM_ADMIN"): Promise<PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot> {
    if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(semver)) throw new Error("Geçersiz sürüm.");
    if (this.releases.some((r) => r.semver === semver)) throw new Error("Sürüm zaten var.");
    const publishedEntries = Array.from(this.entries.values()).filter(
      (e) => e.lifecycleState === "PUBLISHED"
    );
    if (!publishedEntries.length) throw new Error("Yayınlanmış doğrulanmış kayıt yok.");
    const payload = JSON.stringify(publishedEntries.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)));
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(payload));
    const snapshot: PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot = {
      releaseId: `rel_${semver.replace(/\./g, "_")}_${Date.now()}`,
      semver,
      publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      publishedBy,
      sha256Digest: Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(""),
      entries: JSON.parse(payload),
      templatesCount: publishedEntries.filter((e) => e.entityType === "MODULE_TEMPLATE").length,
      hardwareProductsCount: publishedEntries.filter((e) => e.entityType === "HARDWARE_PRODUCT").length,
    };
    this.releases.unshift(snapshot);
    return structuredClone(snapshot);
  }

  getReleases(): PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot[] {
    return structuredClone(this.releases);
  }

  /**
   * Restores the catalog entries contained in a published release snapshot and resets newer unverified items to REVIEW.
   */
  rollbackToRelease(releaseId: string): { success: boolean; error?: string; restoredCount: number } {
    const release = this.releases.find((r) => r.releaseId === releaseId);
    if (!release || !release.entries) {
      return { success: false, error: "Hedef sürüm snapshot kaydı bulunamadı.", restoredCount: 0 };
    }
    const snapshotIds = new Set(release.entries.map((e) => e.id));
    for (const [id, entry] of this.entries.entries()) {
      if (!snapshotIds.has(id) && entry.lifecycleState === "PUBLISHED") {
        this.entries.set(id, { ...entry, lifecycleState: "REVIEW", updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      }
    }
    for (const snapEntry of release.entries) {
      this.entries.set(snapEntry.id, structuredClone(snapEntry));
    }
    return { success: true, restoredCount: release.entries.length };
  }

  saveToLocalStorage(storageKey = "birim_v4_library_admin_state"): boolean {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return false;
      const payload = {
        entries: Array.from(this.entries.values()),
        releases: this.releases,
      };
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(payload));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  loadFromLocalStorage(storageKey = "birim_v4_library_admin_state"): boolean {
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return false;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (!raw) return false;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
        entries?: LibraryCatalogEntry[];
        releases?: PublishedLibraryReleaseSnapshot[];
      };
      if (!Array.isArray(parsed.entries)) return false;
      this.entries.clear();
      for (const e of parsed.entries) {
        if (e && typeof e.id === "string") {
          this.entries.set(e.id, e);
        }
      }
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.releases)) {
        this.releases = parsed.releases;
      }
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Invalidates any VERIFIED or PUBLISHED entries bound to `sourceId` when the primary source revision changes.
   */
  invalidateEntriesForSourceRevision(sourceId: string, newRevision: string): string[] {
    const invalidatedIds: string[] = [];
    for (const [id, entry] of this.entries.entries()) {
      if (entry.sourceId === sourceId && entry.sourceRevision !== newRevision) {
        this.entries.set(id, {
          ...entry,
          sourceRevision: newRevision,
          lifecycleState: "REVIEW",
          verification: {
            sourceTechDataVerified: false,
            cadGeometryVerified: false,
            bomFormulaVerified: false,
            drillingPatternVerified: false,
            physicalFactorySampleTested: false,
          },
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        invalidatedIds.push(id);
      }
    }
    return invalidatedIds;
  }
}

export const defaultLibraryAdminStore = new V4LibraryAdminStore();

interface TemplateSeed {
  templateId: string;
  familyId: ModuleFamilyId;
  category: ModuleCategory;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  d: number;
  minW: number;
  maxW: number;
  minH?: number;
  maxH?: number;
  minD?: number;
  maxD?: number;
  plinth?: number;
  baysCount?: number;
  bayCustomWidths?: (number | undefined)[];
  bayDoorSystems?: DoorSystemId[];
  bayDoorTypes?: ModuleInstance["bays"][0]["door"]["type"][];
  bayShelvesCount?: number[];
  bayHangingRailsCount?: number[];
  bayDrawersIndices?: number[];
  topDrawerCombo?: boolean;
  doorType?: ModuleInstance["bays"][0]["door"]["type"];
  doorSystemId: DoorSystemId;
  overlayType?: DoorOverlayType;
  hardwareProductId?: string;
  shelvesPerBay?: number;
  drawersHeights?: number[];
  isInternalDrawers?: boolean;
  hangingRailsPerBay?: number;
  specialFitting?: ModuleInstance["bays"][0]["specialFittings"][0]["type"];
  isOpenFront?: boolean;
  isCorner?: boolean;
  isFixedWidth?: boolean;
  requiresFactoryValidation?: boolean;
  complementaryRole?: ModuleInstance["complementaryRole"];
  bodyMaterialId?: string;
  doorMaterialId?: string;
}

function buildTemplateFromSeed(seed: TemplateSeed): V4ModuleTemplateDefinition {
  const compatibleDoorSystems: DoorSystemId[] =
    seed.familyId === "fam_complementary"
      ? ["open"]
      : seed.familyId === "fam_kitchen_wall"
      ? [
          "hinged_single",
          "hinged_double",
          "hinged_inset",
          "lift_up_stay",
          "lift_bi_fold",
          "lift_parallel",
          "open",
        ]
      : [
          "hinged_single",
          "hinged_double",
          "hinged_inset",
          "hinged_overlay_variant",
          "sliding_top_hung",
          "sliding_bottom_rolling",
          "folding_side",
          "pocket_retractable",
          "open",
        ];

  return {
    templateId: seed.templateId,
    familyId: seed.familyId,
    category: seed.category,
    name: seed.name,
    description: seed.description,
    defaultDimensions: { width: seed.w, height: seed.h, depth: seed.d },
    dimensionLimits: {
      minW: seed.minW,
      maxW: seed.maxW,
      minH: seed.minH ?? Math.min(seed.h, 150),
      maxH: seed.maxH ?? 2800,
      minD: seed.minD ?? Math.min(seed.d, 150),
      maxD: seed.maxD ?? 1000,
    },
    defaultDoorSystemId: seed.doorSystemId,
    defaultOverlayType: seed.overlayType || "full_overlay",
    defaultHardwareProductId: seed.hardwareProductId,
    compatibleDoorSystems,
    isFixedWidth: seed.isFixedWidth,
    isCorner: seed.isCorner,
    requiresFactoryValidation: seed.requiresFactoryValidation,
    complementaryRole: seed.complementaryRole,
    createInstance: (id: string, customName?: string): ModuleInstance => {
      const baysCount = seed.baysCount || 1;
      const plinthHeight =
        seed.plinth !== undefined
          ? seed.plinth
          : seed.familyId === "fam_kitchen_wall" || seed.familyId === "fam_complementary"
          ? 0
          : seed.familyId.startsWith("fam_kitchen")
          ? 100
          : 80;
      const innerH = Math.max(100, seed.h - plinthHeight - 36);

      const bays: ModuleInstance["bays"] = Array.from({ length: baysCount }, (_, bayIdx) => {
        const bayDoorSys = seed.bayDoorSystems?.[bayIdx] || seed.doorSystemId;
        const hasDrawersInBay = !seed.bayDrawersIndices || seed.bayDrawersIndices.includes(bayIdx);
        const rawDrawerHeights = hasDrawersInBay ? seed.drawersHeights || [] : [];
        const shelvesCount = seed.bayShelvesCount?.[bayIdx] ?? seed.shelvesPerBay ?? (rawDrawerHeights.length && !seed.isInternalDrawers ? 0 : 1);
        const shelves = Array.from({ length: shelvesCount }, (__, sIdx) => ({
          id: `shelf_${id}_${bayIdx}_${sIdx}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          elevationY: !seed.topDrawerCombo && rawDrawerHeights.length > 0 && rawDrawerHeights.reduce((s, h) => s + h + 5, -5) + 120 < innerH ? (sIdx === 0 ? rawDrawerHeights.reduce((s, h) => s + h + 5, -5) : Math.round(rawDrawerHeights.reduce((s, h) => s + h + 5, -5) + (sIdx * (innerH - rawDrawerHeights.reduce((s, h) => s + h + 5, -5))) / shelvesCount)) : Math.round(((sIdx + 1) * innerH) / (shelvesCount + 1)),
          isAdjustable: true,
        }));

        const drawers = rawDrawerHeights.map((dh, dIdx) => ({
          id: `drw_${id}_${bayIdx}_${dIdx}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          elevationY: seed.topDrawerCombo ? Math.max(0, innerH - dh) : rawDrawerHeights.slice(0, dIdx).reduce((sum, h) => sum + h + 5, 0),
          height: dh,
          slideType: "soft_close" as const,
          isInternal: seed.isInternalDrawers,
          hardwareProductId: dh >= 220 ? "hw_blum_legrabox_c70" : "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
        }));

        const hangingRails = Array.from({ length: seed.bayHangingRailsCount?.[bayIdx] ?? (seed.hangingRailsPerBay || 0) }, (__, rIdx) => ({
          id: `rail_${id}_${bayIdx}_${rIdx}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          elevationY: rIdx === 0 ? Math.max(400, innerH - 120) : Math.round(innerH * 0.48),
          isLiftMechanism: seed.templateId.includes("hanging_heavy") && rIdx === 0,
        }));

        const specialFittings = seed.specialFitting
          ? [
              {
                id: `fit_${id}_${bayIdx}_0`,
                bayIndex: bayIdx,
                elevationY: 320,
                type: seed.specialFitting,
                height: 120,
              },
            ]
          : [];

        const defaultType =
          seed.bayDoorTypes?.[bayIdx] ||
          seed.doorType ||
          (bayDoorSys === "hinged_double"
            ? "double"
            : bayDoorSys === "hinged_inset"
            ? "inset_left"
            : bayDoorSys === "sliding_top_hung"
            ? "sliding"
            : bayDoorSys === "sliding_bottom_rolling"
            ? "sliding_bottom"
            : bayDoorSys === "lift_parallel"
            ? "lift_parallel"
            : bayDoorSys === "lift_bi_fold"
            ? "lift_bi_fold"
            : bayDoorSys === "lift_up_stay"
            ? "lift_up_stay"
            : bayDoorSys === "folding_side"
            ? "folding"
            : bayDoorSys === "pocket_retractable"
            ? "pocket"
            : bayDoorSys === "open"
            ? "open"
            : "single_left");
          void (seed.doorSystemId === "hinged_double"
            ? "double"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "hinged_inset"
            ? "inset_left"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "sliding_top_hung"
            ? "sliding"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "sliding_bottom_rolling"
            ? "sliding_bottom"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_parallel"
            ? "lift_parallel"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_bi_fold"
            ? "lift_bi_fold"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_up_stay"
            ? "lift_up_stay"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "folding_side"
            ? "folding"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "pocket_retractable"
            ? "pocket"
            : seed.doorSystemId === "open"
            ? "open"
            : "single_left");

        return {
          index: bayIdx,
          customWidth: seed.bayCustomWidths?.[bayIdx],
          shelves,
          hangingRails,
          drawers,
          specialFittings,
          door: {
            id: `door_${id}_${bayIdx}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            type: defaultType,
            doorSystemId: bayDoorSys,
            overlayType: seed.overlayType || "full_overlay",
            openingTechnology: seed.doorSystemId === "pocket_retractable" ? "pocket_assisted" : "soft_close",
            handleCategory:
              seed.doorSystemId.startsWith("sliding")
                ? "recessed_grip"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "open" && !(seed.drawersHeights?.length && !seed.isInternalDrawers)
                ? "handleless_plain"
                : "bar_handle",
            hardwareProductId:
              seed.hardwareProductId ||
              (seed.isInternalDrawers
                ? "hw_blum_71b7550"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "hinged_inset"
                ? "hw_blum_71b3750"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_up_stay"
                ? "hw_blum_aventos_hk_27"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_bi_fold"
                ? "hw_blum_aventos_hf_25"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "lift_parallel"
                ? "hw_blum_aventos_hl_25"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "sliding_top_hung"
                ? "hw_hettich_topline_l"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "folding_side"
                ? "hw_hettich_wingline_l"
                : seed.doorSystemId === "pocket_retractable"
                ? "hw_blum_revego_uno"
                : "hw_blum_71b3550"),
            softClose: true,
          },
        };
      });

      return {
        id,
        name: customName || seed.name,
        category: seed.category,
        moduleFamilyId: seed.familyId,
        templateId: seed.templateId,
        position: { x: 0, y: seed.familyId === "fam_kitchen_wall" ? 1450 : 0, z: 0 },
        dimensions: { width: seed.w, height: seed.h, depth: seed.d },
        carcass: {
          panelThickness: 18,
          backPanelThickness: 8,
          backPanelType: "grooved",
          plinthHeight,
          doorPerimeterGap: 2,
          edgeBandThickness: 1,
          bodyMaterialId: seed.bodyMaterialId || "mat_melamine_white",
          doorMaterialId:
            seed.doorMaterialId ||
            (seed.familyId.startsWith("fam_kitchen") ? "mat_lacquer_sage" : "mat_veneer_oak"),
          jointType: "minifix_dowel",
          constructionProfileId: "profile_birim_factory_std",
        },
        isOpenFront: seed.isOpenFront ?? seed.doorSystemId === "open",
        isCorner: seed.isCorner,
        isFixedWidth: seed.isFixedWidth,
        requiresFactoryValidation: seed.requiresFactoryValidation,
        complementaryRole: seed.complementaryRole,
        bays,
      };
    },
  };
}

export const V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES: V4ModuleTemplateDefinition[] = TEMPLATE_SEEDS.map(buildTemplateFromSeed);

export function getTemplatesByFamily(familyId: ModuleFamilyId): V4ModuleTemplateDefinition[] {
  return V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES.filter((t) => t.familyId === familyId);
}

export function getV4TemplateById(templateId: string): V4ModuleTemplateDefinition | undefined {
  const direct = V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.templateId === templateId);
  if (direct) return direct;
  // Aliases for legacy/shorthand template IDs
  const aliasMap: Record<string, string> = {
    tpl_kt_01_single_door_pantry: "tpl_kt_01_pantry_shelved",
    tpl_kt_03_space_tower: "tpl_kt_03_pantry_internal_drawers",
    tpl_kb_04_three_drawer: "tpl_kb_05_three_drawers",
  };
  const alias = aliasMap[templateId];
  return alias ? V4_MODULE_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.templateId === alias) : undefined;
}

export interface SmartWallLayoutProposal {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  carcassCount: number;
  moduleWidthsMm: UnitLength[];
  leftFillerMm: UnitLength;
  rightFillerMm: UnitLength;
  buildModules: () => ModuleInstance[];
}

/**
 * Smart Wall Span Layout Generator
 * Given a target wall length (e.g. 3600mm), proposes engineering-valid 4-carcass, 3-carcass,
 * and mixed-width layouts including automatic left/right wall filler strips.
 */
export function generateSmartWallLayouts(
  wallSpanMm: UnitLength,
  heightMm: UnitLength = 2200,
  depthMm: UnitLength = 600,
  mode: "wardrobe" | "kitchen" = "wardrobe"
): SmartWallLayoutProposal[] {
  const proposals: SmartWallLayoutProposal[] = [];
  const safeSpan = Math.max(800, Math.min(6000, roundIntMm(wallSpanMm)));

  const fillerEach = safeSpan >= 1400 ? 30 : 0;
  const usableSpan = safeSpan - 2 * fillerEach;

  if (mode === "wardrobe") {
    const count4 = safeSpan >= 2400 ? 4 : 2;
    const w4Base = Math.floor(usableSpan / count4);
    const w4Rem = usableSpan - w4Base * count4;
    const widths4 = Array.from({ length: count4 }, (_, i) =>
      i === 0 ? w4Base + w4Rem : w4Base
    );

    proposals.push({
      id: "smart_layout_4_equal",
      title: `${count4} Eşit Gövdeli Dolap (${widths4.join(" + ")} mm)`,
      subtitle:
        fillerEach > 0
          ? `Simetrik çift kapaklı ${count4} gövde + 2×${fillerEach}mm duvar bitiş kör parçası`
          : `Simetrik ${count4} gövde yerleşimi`,
      carcassCount: count4,
      moduleWidthsMm: widths4,
      leftFillerMm: fillerEach,
      rightFillerMm: fillerEach,
      buildModules: () => {
        const tpl = getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_02_two_door")!;
        let curX = fillerEach;
        return widths4.map((w, idx) => {
          const m = tpl.createInstance(`mod_w4_${idx + 1}`, `Gardırop Gövde ${idx + 1}`);
          m.position = { x: curX, y: 0, z: 0 };
          m.dimensions = { width: w, height: heightMm, depth: depthMm };
          curX += w;
          return m;
        });
      },
    });

    if (safeSpan >= 1800) {
      const w3Base = Math.floor(usableSpan / 3);
      const w3Rem = usableSpan - w3Base * 3;
      const widths3 = [w3Base, w3Base + w3Rem, w3Base];

      proposals.push({
        id: "smart_layout_3_equal",
        title: `3 Gövdeli Master Dolap (${widths3.join(" + ")} mm)`,
        subtitle: `Yanlar askı, orta bölüm çekmece/raf kulesi + 2×${fillerEach}mm dolgu`,
        carcassCount: 3,
        moduleWidthsMm: widths3,
        leftFillerMm: fillerEach,
        rightFillerMm: fillerEach,
        buildModules: () => {
          const tplAsk = getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_02_two_door")!;
          const tplMix = getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_12_mixed_organizer")!;
          let curX = fillerEach;
          return widths3.map((w, idx) => {
            const tpl = idx === 1 ? tplMix : tplAsk;
            const m = tpl.createInstance(
              `mod_w3_${idx + 1}`,
              idx === 1 ? "Orta Master Kule" : `Yan Askı Gövde ${idx + 1}`
            );
            m.position = { x: curX, y: 0, z: 0 };
            m.dimensions = { width: w, height: heightMm, depth: depthMm };
            curX += w;
            return m;
          });
        },
      });
    }

    if (safeSpan >= 2400) {
      const wLeft = Math.round(usableSpan * 0.3);
      const wMid = Math.round(usableSpan * 0.28);
      const wRight = Math.round(usableSpan * 0.24);
      const wEnd = usableSpan - wLeft - wMid - wRight;
      const mixedWidths = [wLeft, wMid, wRight, wEnd];

      proposals.push({
        id: "smart_layout_mixed_wardrobe",
        title: `Karma Fonksiyonel Yerleşim (${mixedWidths.join(" + ")} mm)`,
        subtitle: "Uzun Askı + İç Çekmeceli Master + Pantolonluk + Cam Vitrin",
        carcassCount: 4,
        moduleWidthsMm: mixedWidths,
        leftFillerMm: fillerEach,
        rightFillerMm: fillerEach,
        buildModules: () => {
          const templates = [
            getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_09_hanging_heavy")!,
            getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_12_mixed_organizer")!,
            getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_17_trouser_unit")!,
            getV4TemplateById("tpl_wd_19_glass_showcase")!,
          ];
          let curX = fillerEach;
          return mixedWidths.map((w, idx) => {
            const m = templates[idx].createInstance(`mod_mix_${idx + 1}`);
            m.position = { x: curX, y: 0, z: 0 };
            m.dimensions = { width: w, height: heightMm, depth: depthMm };
            curX += w;
            return m;
          });
        },
      });
    }
  } else {
    const fixedOven = 600;
    const fixedDw = 600;
    const remaining = Math.max(800, usableSpan - fixedOven - fixedDw);
    const sinkW = Math.min(900, Math.max(400, Math.round(remaining * 0.5)));
    const drawerW = Math.max(400, remaining - sinkW);
    const kWidths = [sinkW, fixedDw, drawerW, fixedOven];

    proposals.push({
      id: "smart_layout_kitchen_run",
      title: `Akıllı Mutfak Dizilimi (${kWidths.join(" + ")} mm)`,
      subtitle:
        "Evye + Bulaşık Makinesi (600 Sabit) + 3 Çekmeceli Hazırlık + Ankastre Fırın (600 Sabit)",
      carcassCount: 4,
      moduleWidthsMm: kWidths,
      leftFillerMm: fillerEach,
      rightFillerMm: fillerEach,
      buildModules: () => {
        const tpls = [
          getV4TemplateById("tpl_kb_08_sink_base")!,
          getV4TemplateById("tpl_kb_10_dishwasher_front")!,
          getV4TemplateById("tpl_kb_05_three_drawers")!,
          getV4TemplateById("tpl_kb_09_oven_housing")!,
        ];
        let curX = fillerEach;
        return kWidths.map((w, idx) => {
          const m = tpls[idx].createInstance(`mod_k_${idx + 1}`);
          m.position = { x: curX, y: 0, z: 0 };
          m.dimensions = { width: w, height: 720, depth: 580 };
          curX += w;
          return m;
        });
      },
    });
  }

  return proposals;
}

/**
 * Equal & Fixed/Flexible Width Distribution Across Wall Span
 */
export function distributeModulesAlongWall(
  modules: ModuleInstance[],
  wallLengthMm: UnitLength,
  reserveWallFillerMm = 30
): { updatedModules: ModuleInstance[]; leftFillerMm: UnitLength; rightFillerMm: UnitLength } {
  const baseModules = modules.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.category !== "kitchen_wall" &&
      m.category !== "complementary" &&
      (m.rotation?.y || 0) === 0
  );
  if (baseModules.length === 0) {
    return { updatedModules: modules, leftFillerMm: 0, rightFillerMm: 0 };
  }

  const effectiveFiller =
    wallLengthMm >= baseModules.length * 320 + 2 * reserveWallFillerMm
      ? reserveWallFillerMm
      : 0;
  const usableSpan = Math.max(300, wallLengthMm - 2 * effectiveFiller);
  const fixedTotal = baseModules
    .filter((m) => m.isFixedWidth)
    .reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.dimensions.width, 0);
  const flexMods = baseModules.filter((m) => !m.isFixedWidth);
  const remainingForFlex = Math.max(flexMods.length * 250, usableSpan - fixedTotal);
  const flexUnitW = flexMods.length > 0 ? Math.floor(remainingForFlex / flexMods.length) : 0;
  const flexRemainder =
    flexMods.length > 0 ? remainingForFlex - flexUnitW * flexMods.length : 0;

  let curX = effectiveFiller;
  let flexSeen = 0;

  const updatedModules = modules.map((mod) => {
    if (
      mod.category === "kitchen_wall" ||
      mod.category === "complementary" ||
      (mod.rotation?.y || 0) !== 0
    ) {
      return mod;
    }
    const nextW = mod.isFixedWidth
      ? mod.dimensions.width
      : flexSeen++ === 0
      ? flexUnitW + flexRemainder
      : flexUnitW;

    const updated: ModuleInstance = {
      ...mod,
      position: { ...mod.position, x: roundIntMm(curX) },
      dimensions: { ...mod.dimensions, width: roundIntMm(nextW) },
    };
    curX += nextW;
    return updated;
  });

  const rightGap = Math.max(0, roundIntMm(wallLengthMm - curX));
  return {
    updatedModules,
    leftFillerMm: effectiveFiller,
    rightFillerMm: rightGap,
  };
}

/**
 * Multi-Module Batch Property Updater
 */
export function batchUpdateModules(
  modules: ModuleInstance[],
  selectedIndices: number[],
  updates: {
    heightMm?: UnitLength;
    depthMm?: UnitLength;
    bodyMaterialId?: string;
    doorMaterialId?: string;
    doorSystemId?: DoorSystemId;
    handleCategory?: HandleCategory;
    openingTechnology?: OpeningTechnology;
    hardwareProductId?: string;
  }
): ModuleInstance[] {
  const indexSet = new Set(selectedIndices);
  return modules.map((mod, idx) => {
    if (!indexSet.has(idx)) return mod;
    return {
      ...mod,
      dimensions: {
        width: mod.dimensions.width,
        height: updates.heightMm ?? mod.dimensions.height,
        depth: updates.depthMm ?? mod.dimensions.depth,
      },
      carcass: {
        ...mod.carcass,
        bodyMaterialId: updates.bodyMaterialId ?? mod.carcass.bodyMaterialId,
        doorMaterialId: updates.doorMaterialId ?? mod.carcass.doorMaterialId,
      },
      bays: mod.bays.map((b) => ({
        ...b,
        door: {
          ...b.door,
          doorSystemId: updates.doorSystemId ?? b.door.doorSystemId,
          handleCategory: updates.handleCategory ?? b.door.handleCategory,
          openingTechnology: updates.openingTechnology ?? b.door.openingTechnology,
          hardwareProductId: updates.hardwareProductId ?? b.door.hardwareProductId,
        },
      })),
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Wardrobe Interior Layout Wizard
 * Dynamically scales shelves, drawers, rails, and fittings to any module height without overflow.
 */
export function applyWardrobeInteriorWizard(
  module: ModuleInstance,
  wizardId: WardrobeInteriorWizardId,
  targetBayIndex?: number
): ModuleInstance {
  const netH = Math.max(320, calculateNetInnerHeight(module));
  const snap32 = (y: number) =>
    Math.max(64, Math.min(Math.max(96, netH - 64), Math.round(y / 32) * 32));

  const updatedBays = module.bays.map((bay, idx) => {
    if (typeof targetBayIndex === "number" && idx !== targetBayIndex) {
      return bay;
    }

    if (wizardId === "wiz_hanging_heavy") {
      const topShelfY = snap32(netH - 320);
      const midShelfY = snap32(netH * 0.48);
      return {
        ...bay,
        shelves: [
          {
            id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_top`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: topShelfY,
            isAdjustable: false,
          },
          {
            id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_mid`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: midShelfY,
            isAdjustable: false,
          },
        ],
        hangingRails: [
          {
            id: `rl_${module.id}_${idx}_lift`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: Math.max(120, topShelfY - 70),
            isLiftMechanism: true,
          },
          {
            id: `rl_${module.id}_${idx}_bot`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: Math.max(96, midShelfY - 70),
            isLiftMechanism: false,
          },
        ],
        drawers: [],
        specialFittings: [
          {
            id: `fit_${module.id}_${idx}_lift`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: Math.max(96, topShelfY - 120),
            type: "wardrobe_lift" as const,
            height: 120,
          },
        ],
      };
    }

    if (wizardId === "wiz_shelf_heavy") {
      const count = netH >= 1900 ? 5 : netH >= 1100 ? 4 : 2;
      const shelves = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, sIdx) => ({
        id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_${sIdx}`,
        bayIndex: idx,
        elevationY: snap32(((sIdx + 1) * netH) / (count + 1)),
        isAdjustable: true,
      }));
      return {
        ...bay,
        shelves,
        hangingRails: [],
        drawers: [],
        specialFittings: [],
      };
    }

    if (wizardId === "wiz_drawer_heavy") {
      const maxDrawers = netH >= 1100 ? 4 : netH >= 750 ? 3 : 2;
      const drawers = Array.from({ length: maxDrawers }, (_, dIdx) => ({
        id: `drw_${module.id}_${idx}_${dIdx}`,
        bayIndex: idx,
        elevationY: dIdx * 185,
        height: 180,
        slideType: "soft_close" as const,
        isInternal: bay.door.type !== "open",
        hardwareProductId: "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
      }));
      const coverShelfY = snap32(maxDrawers * 185 + 20);
      const upperShelfY = snap32((coverShelfY + netH) / 2);
      return {
        ...bay,
        shelves:
          netH > maxDrawers * 185 + 180
            ? [
                {
                  id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_cov`,
                  bayIndex: idx,
                  elevationY: coverShelfY,
                  isAdjustable: false,
                },
                {
                  id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_up`,
                  bayIndex: idx,
                  elevationY: upperShelfY,
                  isAdjustable: true,
                },
              ]
            : [],
        hangingRails: [],
        drawers,
        specialFittings: [],
        door: {
          ...bay.door,
          hardwareProductId:
            bay.door.type !== "open" ? "hw_blum_71b7550" : bay.door.hardwareProductId,
        },
      };
    }

    if (wizardId === "wiz_shoe_tower") {
      const shoeCount = netH >= 1200 ? 4 : 2;
      const shoeFittings = Array.from({ length: shoeCount }, (_, fIdx) => ({
        id: `fit_${module.id}_${idx}_shoe_${fIdx}`,
        bayIndex: idx,
        elevationY: 120 + fIdx * 180,
        type: "shoe_rack" as const,
        height: 100,
      }));
      const shoeTop = 120 + shoeCount * 180 + 40;
      const remSpan = Math.max(120, netH - shoeTop);
      const bagShelfCount = netH >= 1600 ? 3 : netH >= 1100 ? 2 : 1;
      const bagShelves = Array.from({ length: bagShelfCount }, (_, bIdx) => ({
        id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_bag${bIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: idx,
        elevationY: snap32(shoeTop + ((bIdx + 1) * remSpan) / (bagShelfCount + 1)),
        isAdjustable: true,
      }));
      return {
        ...bay,
        shelves: bagShelves,
        hangingRails: [],
        drawers: [],
        specialFittings: shoeFittings,
      };
    }

    if (wizardId === "wiz_walkin_luxury") {
      const topY = snap32(netH - 340);
      return {
        ...bay,
        shelves: [
          {
            id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_top`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: topY,
            isAdjustable: false,
          },
          {
            id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_mid`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: snap32(Math.min(580, netH * 0.45)),
            isAdjustable: false,
          },
        ],
        hangingRails: [
          {
            id: `rl_${module.id}_${idx}_main`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: Math.max(120, topY - 70),
          },
        ],
        drawers: [
          {
            id: `drw_${module.id}_${idx}_0`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: 0,
            height: 180,
            slideType: "soft_close" as const,
            hardwareProductId: "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
          },
          {
            id: `drw_${module.id}_${idx}_1`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: 185,
            height: 140,
            slideType: "soft_close" as const,
            hardwareProductId: "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
          },
        ],
        specialFittings: [
          {
            id: `fit_${module.id}_${idx}_jwl`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: 200,
            type: "jewelry_tray" as const,
            height: 60,
          },
          {
            id: `fit_${module.id}_${idx}_led`,
            bayIndex: idx,
            elevationY: Math.max(96, topY - 10),
            type: "led_profile" as const,
            height: 20,
          },
        ],
      };
    }

    // Default: wiz_mixed_organizer
    const topShelfY = snap32(netH - 350);
    return {
      ...bay,
      shelves: [
        {
          id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_top`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: topShelfY,
          isAdjustable: false,
        },
        {
          id: `sh_${module.id}_${idx}_low`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: snap32(Math.min(560, netH * 0.45)),
          isAdjustable: false,
        },
      ],
      hangingRails: [
        {
          id: `rl_${module.id}_${idx}_0`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: Math.max(120, topShelfY - 70),
        },
      ],
      drawers: [
        {
          id: `drw_${module.id}_${idx}_0`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: 0,
          height: 180,
          slideType: "soft_close" as const,
          isInternal: bay.door.type !== "open",
          hardwareProductId: "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
        },
        {
          id: `drw_${module.id}_${idx}_1`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: 185,
          height: 180,
          slideType: "soft_close" as const,
          isInternal: bay.door.type !== "open",
          hardwareProductId: "hw_blum_legrabox_m40",
        },
      ],
      specialFittings: [
        {
          id: `fit_${module.id}_${idx}_tr`,
          bayIndex: idx,
          elevationY: Math.min(420, Math.max(380, netH - 220)),
          type: "trouser_rack" as const,
          height: 90,
        },
      ],
      door: {
        ...bay.door,
        hardwareProductId:
          bay.door.type !== "open" ? "hw_blum_71b7550" : bay.door.hardwareProductId,
      },
    };
  });

  return {
    ...module,
    bays: updatedBays,
  };
}

/**
 * Kitchen Automatic Complementary Parts Generator
 */
export function generateKitchenComplementaryModules(
  existingModules: ModuleInstance[],
  wallLengthMm = 3600
): ModuleInstance[] {
  const nonComp = existingModules.filter((m) => m.category !== "complementary");
  const allMainWall = nonComp.filter((m) => (m.rotation?.y || 0) === 0);
  if (allMainWall.length === 0) return existingModules;

  const generated: ModuleInstance[] = [];
  const baseCabinets = allMainWall.filter((m) => m.category === "kitchen_base");
  const minAllX = Math.min(...allMainWall.map((m) => m.position.x));
  const maxAllX = Math.max(...allMainWall.map((m) => m.position.x + m.dimensions.width));
  const maxH = Math.max(...allMainWall.map((m) => m.position.y + m.dimensions.height));

  if (baseCabinets.length > 0) {
    const minX = Math.min(...baseCabinets.map((m) => m.position.x));
    const maxX = Math.max(...baseCabinets.map((m) => m.position.x + m.dimensions.width));
    const spanW = Math.max(600, maxX - minX);
    const topOfBaseY = baseCabinets[0].dimensions.height;

    const tplCountertop = getV4TemplateById("tpl_cm_09_countertop")!;
    const countertop = tplCountertop.createInstance(
      "comp_auto_countertop",
      `Otomatik Çimstone/Belenco Kuvars Tezgâh (${spanW}mm)`
    );
    countertop.position = { x: minX, y: topOfBaseY, z: 0 };
    countertop.dimensions = { width: spanW, height: 40, depth: 600 };
    generated.push(countertop);

    const tplBacksplash = getV4TemplateById("tpl_cm_11_backsplash")!;
    const backsplash = tplBacksplash.createInstance(
      "comp_auto_backsplash",
      `Otomatik Tezgâh Arası Panel (${spanW}mm)`
    );
    backsplash.position = { x: minX, y: topOfBaseY + 40, z: 0 };
    backsplash.dimensions = { width: spanW, height: 600, depth: 18 };
    generated.push(backsplash);
  }

  const tplEndPanel = getV4TemplateById("tpl_cm_05_end_panel")!;
  const endPanel = tplEndPanel.createInstance(
    "comp_auto_end_panel",
    "Otomatik Yan Bitiş Paneli"
  );
  endPanel.position = { x: maxAllX, y: 0, z: 0 };
  endPanel.dimensions = { width: 18, height: maxH, depth: 600 };
  generated.push(endPanel);

  const tplFiller = getV4TemplateById("tpl_cm_04_wall_filler") || tplEndPanel;
  if (minAllX >= 20 && minAllX <= 350) {
    const leftFiller = tplFiller.createInstance(
      "comp_auto_wall_filler_left",
      `Otomatik Sol Duvar Kör Kapama (${minAllX}mm)`
    );
    leftFiller.complementaryRole = "wall_filler";
    leftFiller.position = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 580 };
    leftFiller.dimensions = { width: minAllX, height: maxH, depth: 18 };
    generated.push(leftFiller);
  }
  const rightGap = wallLengthMm - (maxAllX + 18);
  if (rightGap >= 20 && rightGap <= 450) {
    const rightFiller = tplFiller.createInstance(
      "comp_auto_wall_filler_right",
      `Otomatik Sağ Duvar Kör Kapama (${rightGap}mm)`
    );
    rightFiller.complementaryRole = "wall_filler";
    rightFiller.position = { x: maxAllX + 18, y: 0, z: 580 };
    rightFiller.dimensions = { width: rightGap, height: maxH, depth: 18 };
    generated.push(rightFiller);
  }

  return [...nonComp, ...generated];
}

import { FloorPlanPolyline, FloorPlanUnderlay, WallDefinition } from "./types";

/**
 * Parses ASCII DXF or text-based DWG content to extract 2D architectural LINE and LWPOLYLINE segments.
 */
export function parseCadDxfText(
  content: string,
  fileName = "plan.dxf",
  scaleMmPerUnit = 1
): FloorPlanUnderlay {
  const lines = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n").map((l) => l.trim());
  const polylines: FloorPlanPolyline[] = [];

  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const token = lines[i];
    if (token === "LINE") {
      let x1 = 0,
        y1 = 0,
        x2 = 0,
        y2 = 0,
        layer = "0";
      i++;
      while (i + 1 < lines.length && lines[i] !== "0") {
        const code = lines[i];
        const val = lines[i + 1];
        if (code === "8") layer = val;
        else if (code === "10") x1 = parseFloat(val) || 0;
        else if (code === "20") y1 = parseFloat(val) || 0;
        else if (code === "11") x2 = parseFloat(val) || 0;
        else if (code === "21") y2 = parseFloat(val) || 0;
        i += 2;
      }
      polylines.push({
        layer,
        points: [
          { x: Math.round(x1 * scaleMmPerUnit), z: Math.round(y1 * scaleMmPerUnit) },
          { x: Math.round(x2 * scaleMmPerUnit), z: Math.round(y2 * scaleMmPerUnit) },
        ],
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (token === "LWPOLYLINE") {
      const pts: { x: number; z: number }[] = [];
      let curX: number | null = null;
      let closed = false;
      let layer = "0";
      i++;
      while (i + 1 < lines.length && lines[i] !== "0") {
        const code = lines[i];
        const val = lines[i + 1];
        if (code === "8") layer = val;
        else if (code === "70") closed = (parseInt(val, 10) & 1) === 1;
        else if (code === "10") curX = parseFloat(val) || 0;
        else if (code === "20" && curX !== null) {
          const curY = parseFloat(val) || 0;
          pts.push({
            x: Math.round(curX * scaleMmPerUnit),
            z: Math.round(curY * scaleMmPerUnit),
          });
          curX = null;
        }
        i += 2;
      }
      if (closed && pts.length > 2) {
        pts.push({ ...pts[0] });
      }
      if (pts.length >= 2) {
        polylines.push({ layer, points: pts });
      }
      continue;
    }
    i++;
  }

  let minX = Infinity,
    minZ = Infinity,
    maxX = -Infinity,
    maxZ = -Infinity;
  for (const pl of polylines) {
    for (const pt of pl.points) {
      if (pt.x < minX) minX = pt.x;
      if (pt.z < minZ) minZ = pt.z;
      if (pt.x > maxX) maxX = pt.x;
      if (pt.z > maxZ) maxZ = pt.z;
    }
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(minX) || polylines.length === 0) {
    minX = 0;
    minZ = 0;
    maxX = 3600;
    maxZ = 2400;
  } else {
    // Normalize polyline coordinates so minimum corner starts at (0, 0)
    for (const pl of polylines) {
      for (const pt of pl.points) {
        pt.x = Math.round(pt.x - minX);
        pt.z = Math.round(pt.z - minZ);
      }
    }
  }

  const widthMm = Math.max(500, Math.round(maxX - minX));
  const depthMm = Math.max(500, Math.round(maxZ - minZ));
  const ext = fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".dwg") ? "dwg" : "dxf";

  return {
    fileName,
    fileType: ext,
    scaleMmPerUnit,
    widthMm,
    depthMm,
    offsetXMm: 0,
    offsetZMm: 0,
    opacity: 0.75,
    polylines,
  };
}

/**
 * Parses a PDF file's MediaBox (in PDF points, 1 pt = 25.4/72 mm) and returns a calibrated FloorPlanUnderlay.
 */
export function parsePdfFloorPlanMetadata(
  rawTextOrBinary: string,
  fileName = "plan.pdf",
  scaleFactor = 50, // Default 1:50 architectural scale
  dataUrl?: string
): FloorPlanUnderlay {
  const mediaBoxMatch = rawTextOrBinary.match(
    /\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\s*\]/
  );
  let widthMm = 3600;
  let depthMm = 2600;

  if (mediaBoxMatch) {
    const x0 = parseFloat(mediaBoxMatch[1]) || 0;
    const y0 = parseFloat(mediaBoxMatch[2]) || 0;
    const x1 = parseFloat(mediaBoxMatch[3]) || 595;
    const y1 = parseFloat(mediaBoxMatch[4]) || 842;
    const pageWidthMm = Math.abs(x1 - x0) * (25.4 / 72);
    const pageHeightMm = Math.abs(y1 - y0) * (25.4 / 72);
    widthMm = Math.max(600, Math.round(pageWidthMm * scaleFactor));
    depthMm = Math.max(600, Math.round(pageHeightMm * scaleFactor));
  }

  return {
    fileName,
    fileType: "pdf",
    scaleMmPerUnit: scaleFactor,
    widthMm,
    depthMm,
    offsetXMm: 0,
    offsetZMm: 0,
    opacity: 0.65,
    dataUrl,
    polylines: [
      {
        layer: "PDF_PAGE_BOUNDS",
        points: [
          { x: 0, z: 0 },
          { x: widthMm, z: 0 },
          { x: widthMm, z: depthMm },
          { x: 0, z: depthMm },
          { x: 0, z: 0 },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
}

/**
 * Converts eligible CAD underlay polylines (segments >= 400mm) into parametric WallDefinition objects.
 */
export function convertUnderlayPolylinesToWalls(
  underlay: FloorPlanUnderlay,
  ceilingHeightMm = 2600,
  wallThicknessMm = 150
): WallDefinition[] {
  const walls: WallDefinition[] = [];
  const polylines = underlay.polylines || [];
  let idx = 1;

  for (const pl of polylines) {
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < pl.points.length; i++) {
      const p1 = pl.points[i];
      const p2 = pl.points[i + 1];
      const dx = p2.x - p1.x;
      const dz = p2.z - p1.z;
      const len = Math.round(Math.hypot(dx, dz));
      if (len < 400) continue;

      const angleDeg = Math.round((Math.atan2(dz, dx) * 180) / Math.PI);
      const normalizedAngle = ((angleDeg % 360) + 360) % 360;

      walls.push({
        id: `wall_cad_${idx}`,
        name: `CAD Duvar ${idx} (${pl.layer || "0"})`,
        length: len,
        height: ceilingHeightMm,
        thickness: wallThicknessMm,
        position: {
          x: Math.round(p1.x + underlay.offsetXMm),
          y: 0,
          z: Math.round(p1.z + underlay.offsetZMm),
        },
        rotationY: normalizedAngle,
        elements: [],
      });
      idx++;
      if (walls.length >= 16) break;
    }
    if (walls.length >= 16) break;
  }

  return walls;
}

export interface CutoutValidationIssue {
  cutoutId: string;
  severity: "error" | "warning";
  message: string;
}

/**
 * Validates structural edge clearance (min 35mm on closed cutouts) and System 32 drilling row collisions.
 */
export function validatePanelCutouts(
  moduleDims: { width: number; height: number; depth: number },
  panelThicknessMm: number,
  cutouts: PanelCutoutConfig[]
): CutoutValidationIssue[] {
  const issues: CutoutValidationIssue[] = [];
  const minEdgeMarginMm = 35;

  for (const c of cutouts) {
    const panelW =
      c.targetPanel === "back"
        ? Math.max(100, moduleDims.width - 2 * panelThicknessMm + 16)
        : c.targetPanel === "bottom"
        ? Math.max(100, moduleDims.width - 2 * panelThicknessMm)
        : moduleDims.depth;
    const panelH =
      c.targetPanel === "bottom" ? moduleDims.depth : moduleDims.height;

    const halfW = (c.shape === "circle" ? c.diameterMm ?? c.widthMm : c.widthMm) / 2;
    const halfH = (c.shape === "circle" ? c.diameterMm ?? c.heightMm : c.heightMm) / 2;

    if (c.shape === "corner_notch") {
      if (c.widthMm > 60 || c.heightMm > 220) {
        issues.push({
          cutoutId: c.id,
          severity: "warning",
          message: `${c.label}: Süpürgelik çentiği (${c.widthMm}×${c.heightMm} mm) yan panel taşıyıcı kesitini zayıflatabilir (önerilen maks. 60×220 mm).`,
        });
      }
      continue;
    }

    const leftClear = c.centerXMm - halfW;
    const rightClear = panelW - (c.centerXMm + halfW);
    const botClear = c.centerYMm - halfH;
    const topClear = panelH - (c.centerYMm + halfH);

    if (
      leftClear < minEdgeMarginMm ||
      rightClear < minEdgeMarginMm ||
      botClear < minEdgeMarginMm ||
      topClear < minEdgeMarginMm
    ) {
      issues.push({
        cutoutId: c.id,
        severity: "error",
        message: `${c.label}: CNC boşaltma panel kenarına ${minEdgeMarginMm} mm'den fazla yaklaşıyor; taşıyıcı köprü kırılma riski var.`,
      });
    }

    if (
      (c.targetPanel === "left_side" || c.targetPanel === "right_side") &&
      c.centerXMm - halfW <= 45 &&
      c.centerXMm + halfW >= 29
    ) {
      issues.push({
        cutoutId: c.id,
        severity: "warning",
        message: `${c.label}: Yan panel boşaltması 37 mm System 32 raf/menteşe delik aksı ile kesişiyor.`,
      });
    }
  }

  return issues;
}

/**
 * Automatically derives rear panel CNC cutouts when a cabinet sits in front of a wall plumbing/socket element.
 */
export function detectWallUtilityCutoutsForModule(
  mod: {
    id: string;
    position: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
    dimensions: { width: number; height: number; depth: number };
    carcass: { panelThickness: number; plinthHeight: number };
  },
  obstacles: Array<{
    id: string;
    type: string;
    name?: string;
    position: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
    dimensions: { width: number; height: number; depth: number };
  }>
): PanelCutoutConfig[] {
  const T = mod.carcass.panelThickness || 18;
  const generated: PanelCutoutConfig[] = [];

  for (const obs of obstacles) {
    if (obs.type !== "plumbing" && obs.type !== "socket" && obs.type !== "electrical") continue;
    // Must sit near rear wall (z <= 120mm) and overlap module X & Y bounds
    if (Math.abs(obs.position.z - mod.position.z) > 140) continue;

    const overlapX0 = Math.max(mod.position.x + T + 35, obs.position.x);
    const overlapX1 = Math.min(
      mod.position.x + mod.dimensions.width - T - 35,
      obs.position.x + obs.dimensions.width
    );
    const overlapY0 = Math.max(mod.position.y + mod.carcass.plinthHeight + T + 35, obs.position.y);
    const overlapY1 = Math.min(
      mod.position.y + mod.dimensions.height - T - 35,
      obs.position.y + obs.dimensions.height
    );

    if (overlapX1 - overlapX0 >= 30 && overlapY1 - overlapY0 >= 30) {
      const localCenterX = Math.round((overlapX0 + overlapX1) / 2 - (mod.position.x + T - 8));
      const localCenterY = Math.round(
        (overlapY0 + overlapY1) / 2 - (mod.position.y + mod.carcass.plinthHeight + T - 8)
      );
      const isPlumbing = obs.type === "plumbing";
      generated.push({
        id: `auto_cutout_${mod.id}_${obs.id}`,
        targetPanel: "back",
        kind: isPlumbing ? "plumbing_pass" : "socket_double",
        shape: "rect",
        centerXMm: localCenterX,
        centerYMm: localCenterY,
        widthMm: Math.min(260, Math.max(82, Math.round(overlapX1 - overlapX0 + 20))),
        heightMm: Math.min(260, Math.max(82, Math.round(overlapY1 - overlapY0 + 20))),
        cornerRadiusMm: 8,
        label: obs.name || (isPlumbing ? "Otomatik Tesisat Boşaltması" : "Otomatik Priz Boşaltması"),
      });
    }
  }

  return generated;
}
