            dimensions: { width: Math.max(80, fitW - 30), height: 65, depth: Math.max(100, fitD - 30) },
            position: { x: fitX + 15, y: fitY + Math.round(fit.height * 0.58), z: fitZ + 15 },
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          }
        );
      } else if (fit.type === "waste_bin") {
        // Häfele dual waste bins (30L + 15L)
        const halfW = Math.max(40, Math.floor((fitW - 24) / 2));
        components.push(
          {
            id: `${baseId}_sub_bin_30l`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: "Häfele 30L Ana Çöp Kovası",
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: halfW + 16, height: Math.max(120, fit.height - 36), depth: Math.max(100, fitD - 24) },
            position: { x: fitX + 6, y: fitY + 18, z: fitZ + 12 },
            materialId: "mat_anodized_metal",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          },
          {
            id: `${baseId}_sub_bin_15l`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: "Häfele 15L Geri Dönüşüm Kovası",
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: Math.max(36, halfW - 16), height: Math.max(120, fit.height - 36), depth: Math.max(100, fitD - 24) },
            position: { x: fitX + halfW + 26, y: fitY + 18, z: fitZ + 12 },
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          }
        );
      } else if (fit.type === "led_profile") {
        const xOff = bayStartX + Math.round((bayW - ledChanW) / 2);
        bay.shelves.forEach((sh, shIdx) => {
          components.push({
            id: `${baseId}_recessed_led_sh_${shIdx}`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `Häfele Loox5 Raf #${shIdx + 1} Altı Gömme LED 3000K (${ledChanW}×${ledChanD}mm)`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: ledChanW, height: 4, depth: ledChanD },
            position: { x: xOff, y: plinthHeight + T + sh.elevationY - 2.5, z: Math.max(50, depth - 95) },
            materialId: "mat_led_warm_3000k",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          });
        });
      } else if (fit.type === "led_vertical_strip") {
        const vLedH = Math.max(160, netInnerH - 24);
        components.push({
          id: `${baseId}_recessed_led_vert_right`,
          role: "special_fitting",
          label: `Häfele Loox5 Sağ Dikme Gömme Boy LED 3000K (${ledChanW}×${ledChanD}mm)`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: 4, height: vLedH, depth: ledChanW },
          position: { x: bayStartX + bayW - 2.5, y: plinthHeight + T + 12, z: Math.max(24, depth - ledChanD) },
          materialId: "mat_led_warm_3000k",
          isManufacturablePanel: false,
        });
      } else if (fit.type === "led_rod_strip") {
        components.push({
          id: `${baseId}_sub_led_rod`,
          role: "special_fitting",
          label: "Häfele Loox5 Sensörlü LED Askı Borusu 3000K",
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: Math.max(60, bayW - 4), height: 28, depth: 18 },
          position: { x: bayStartX + 2, y: fitY, z: depth / 2 },
          materialId: "mat_led_warm_3000k",
          isManufacturablePanel: false,
        });
      }
    });

    // Sub-dividers
    bay.subDividers?.forEach((sub, sdIdx) => {
      const divT = sub.thickness || T;
      const clampedX = Math.max(40, Math.min(Math.max(60, bayW - divT - 40), sub.offsetX));
      components.push({
        id: sub.id || `${module.id}_bay_${bayIdx}_subdiv_${sdIdx}`,
        role: "carcass_sub_divider",
        label: `Raf Arası Dikme B${bayIdx + 1}-${sdIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: divT, height: sub.height, depth: netInnerD - 10 },
        position: {
          x: bayStartX + clampedX,
          y: plinthHeight + T + sub.elevationY,
          z: 20,
        },
        materialId: bodyMaterialId,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "x",
      });
    });

    // Drawers with manufacturer cutting deduction support
    const bayLeafSpec = fourSpace.doorLeaves[bayIdx];
    const hasNoUpperDoor =
      Boolean(module.isOpenFront) ||
      !bay.door ||
      bay.door.type === "open" ||
      bay.door.doorSystemId === "open";
    bay.drawers.forEach((drawer, dIdx) => {
      const isExtDrawer = !drawer.isInternal;
      const isExtOverlay = isExtDrawer && bayLeafSpec?.overlayType !== "inset";
      const isLowestExtDrawer = isExtOverlay && drawer.elevationY <= 5;
      const isHighestDrawerInBay = !bay.drawers.some(
        (other) => other.id !== drawer.id && other.elevationY > drawer.elevationY
      );
      const isTopComboExtDrawer = isExtOverlay && drawer.elevationY >= netInnerH * 0.55;
      const isTopAtCabinetCeiling =
        isExtOverlay &&
        isHighestDrawerInBay &&
        (isTopComboExtDrawer ||
          (hasNoUpperDoor && drawer.elevationY + drawer.height >= netInnerH * 0.7));
      const extraCoverMm =
        isLowestExtDrawer || isTopComboExtDrawer ? Math.max(0, T - doorPerimeterGap) : 0;
      const drawerY0 = plinthHeight + T + drawer.elevationY;
      const frontX = isExtDrawer ? (bayLeafSpec?.doorX0Mm ?? bayStartX + 2) : bayStartX + 2;
      const frontY = isLowestExtDrawer ? plinthHeight + doorPerimeterGap : drawerY0 + 1.5;
      const cabinetTopAlignY =
        height - doorPerimeterGap - (bay.door.handleCategory === "gola_profile" ? 30 : 0);
      const frontH = isTopAtCabinetCeiling
        ? Math.max(40, cabinetTopAlignY - frontY)
        : Math.max(40, drawer.height + extraCoverMm - 3);
      const frontW = isExtDrawer
        ? Math.max(60, bayLeafSpec?.fullDoorSpanWidthMm || bayW - 4)
        : Math.max(60, bayW - 4);
      const pulledZ = drawerOpenMm;
      const frontZ = isExtDrawer
        ? (bayLeafSpec?.doorZ0Mm ?? depth) + pulledZ + explodeZ
        : depth - T + pulledZ + explodeZ - 24;
      const hwId = drawer.hardwareProductId || "";
      const isAvanTech = hwId === "hw_hettich_avantech_m";
      const isLegrabox = hwId.includes("legrabox");
      const isMovento = hwId.includes("movento");
      const isTandembox = hwId.includes("tandembox");
      const lengthDeductionMm = isTandembox ? 24 : isAvanTech ? 21 : 10;
      const bottomWidthDeductionMm = isTandembox
        ? 75
        : isMovento
        ? 42
        : isLegrabox
        ? 35
        : isAvanTech
        ? 24
        : 68;
      const backWidthDeductionMm = isTandembox
        ? 87
        : isMovento
        ? 42
        : isLegrabox
        ? 38
        : isAvanTech
        ? 24
        : 68;

      const maxBoxD = Math.max(120, frontZ - pulledZ - explodeZ - 24);
      const boxD = Math.min(
        maxBoxD,
        drawer.nominalLengthMm
          ? Math.min(netInnerD - 10, drawer.nominalLengthMm - lengthDeductionMm)
          : Math.min(500, Math.max(260, netInnerD - 50))
      );
      const boxH = Math.max(70, Math.min(220, drawer.height - 38));
      const boxT = isAvanTech || isLegrabox ? 13 : 16;
      const bottomT = isTandembox || isLegrabox || isAvanTech ? 16 : 8;
      // Respect manufacturer width deduction (24mm AvanTech, 35mm LEGRABOX, 42mm MOVENTO, 75mm TANDEMBOX)
      const sideClearance = isTandembox
        ? 21.5
        : isMovento
        ? 21
        : isLegrabox
        ? 17.5
        : isAvanTech
        ? 12
        : 18;
      const boxX0 = bayStartX + sideClearance;
      const boxW = Math.max(100, bayW - 2 * sideClearance);
      const bottomBoardW = hwId
        ? Math.max(80, bayW - bottomWidthDeductionMm)
        : Math.max(68, boxW - 2 * boxT);
      const backBoardW = hwId
        ? Math.max(80, bayW - backWidthDeductionMm)
        : Math.max(68, boxW - 2 * boxT);
      const boxZ0 = frontZ - boxD;

      // 1. Front Panel
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_front`,
        role: "drawer_front",
        label: `Çekmece Önü B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: frontW, height: frontH, depth: T },
        position: {
          x: frontX,
          y: frontY,
          z: frontZ,
        },
        materialId: drawer.frontMaterialId || doorMaterialId,
        isFrontFacing: true,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "z",
      });

      // 3. Left Side Panel of Box
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_side_left`,
        role: "drawer_side_left",
        label: `Çekmece Sol Kasa B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: boxT, height: boxH, depth: boxD },
        position: { x: boxX0, y: drawerY0 + 8, z: boxZ0 },
        materialId: bodyMaterialId,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "x",
      });

      // 4. Right Side Panel of Box
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_side_right`,
        role: "drawer_side_right",
        label: `Çekmece Sağ Kasa B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: boxT, height: boxH, depth: boxD },
        position: { x: boxX0 + boxW - boxT, y: drawerY0 + 8, z: boxZ0 },
        materialId: bodyMaterialId,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "x",
      });

      // 5. Back Panel of Box
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_back`,
        role: "drawer_back",
        label: `Çekmece Arka Kasa B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: backBoardW, height: boxH, depth: boxT },
        position: { x: bayStartX + (bayW - backBoardW) / 2, y: drawerY0 + 8, z: boxZ0 },
        materialId: bodyMaterialId,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "z",
      });

      // 6. Bottom Floor Board of Box
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_bottom`,
        role: "drawer_bottom",
        label: `Çekmece Tabanı B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: bottomBoardW, height: bottomT, depth: hwId ? boxD : boxD - boxT },
        position: { x: bayStartX + (bayW - bottomBoardW) / 2, y: drawerY0 + 8, z: boxZ0 + boxT },
        materialId: bodyMaterialId,
        isManufacturablePanel: true,
        thicknessAxis: "y",
      });

      // 7. Left & Right Undermount Slide Rails
      const slideZ0 = boxZ0 - (pulledZ > 0 ? pulledZ * 0.5 : 0);
      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_slide_left`,
        role: "drawer_slide",
        label: `Çekmece Rayı Sol B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: 12, height: 16, depth: boxD },
        position: {
          x: bayStartX + 4,
          y: drawerY0 + 2,
          z: slideZ0,
        },
        materialId: "mat_anodized_metal",
        isManufacturablePanel: false,
      });

      components.push({
        id: `${drawer.id}_slide_right`,
        role: "drawer_slide",
        label: `Çekmece Rayı Sağ B${bayIdx + 1}-${dIdx + 1}`,
        bayIndex: bayIdx,
        dimensions: { width: 12, height: 16, depth: boxD },
        position: {
          x: bayStartX + bayW - 16,
          y: drawerY0 + 2,
          z: slideZ0,
        },
        materialId: "mat_anodized_metal",
        isManufacturablePanel: false,
      });
    });

    // Doors — Consuming Canonical 4-Space Door Leaf Geometry
    if (!module.isOpenFront && bay.door && bay.door.type !== "open" && bay.door.doorSystemId !== "open") {
      const dType = bay.door.type;
      const dSys = bay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(dType);
      const leafSpec = fourSpace.doorLeaves[bayIdx];
      const isInset = leafSpec.overlayType === "inset";
      const isHalfOverlay = leafSpec.overlayType === "half_overlay";

      const isBlindCornerCab =
        (module.templateId?.includes("blind") || lowerName.includes("kör köşe")) &&
        module.bays.length === 1;
      const blindPanelSpanW = isBlindCornerCab ? Math.max(120, Math.round(innerSpanW * 0.45)) : 0;
      const doorH = leafSpec.baseDoorHeightMm;
      const doorY = leafSpec.doorY0Mm;
      const doorZ = leafSpec.doorZ0Mm + explodeZ;
      const doorX0 = isBlindCornerCab ? T + blindPanelSpanW + 2 : leafSpec.doorX0Mm;
      const fullDoorW = isBlindCornerCab
        ? Math.max(140, width - doorX0 - 2)
        : leafSpec.fullDoorSpanWidthMm;
      const T_door = leafSpec.leafThicknessMm;
      const rad = (doorOpenAngleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
      const openRatio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, doorOpenAngleDeg / 90));
      const doorMatId = bay.door.doorMaterialId || doorMaterialId;

      const isHingedDoubleSplit = !isBlindCornerCab && (
        dSys === "hinged_double" ||
        dType === "double" ||
        dType === "inset_double" ||
        (!dSys.startsWith("sliding") &&
          !dSys.startsWith("lift_") &&
          dSys !== "folding_side" &&
          dType !== "folding" &&
          dSys !== "pocket_retractable" &&
          dType !== "pocket" &&
          dSys !== "tambour_roller" &&
          dType !== "tambour" &&
          leafSpec.leafCount === 2));

      if (isHingedDoubleSplit) {
        const leafW = leafSpec.leafWidthMm;
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_leaf_left`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Çift Kapak Sol B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: leafW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: { x: doorX0, y: doorY, z: doorZ },
          rotation: [0, -rad, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_leaf_right`,
          role: "door_right",
          label: `Çift Kapak Sağ B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: leafW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: { x: doorX0 + leafW + leafSpec.centerRevealGapMm, y: doorY, z: doorZ },
          rotation: [0, rad, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
      } else if (dSys === "sliding_top_hung" || dSys === "sliding_bottom_rolling" || dSys === "sliding_coplanar" || dType === "sliding" || dType === "sliding_bottom") {
        const mountKind =
          bay.door.slidingMountingType ||
          (dSys === "sliding_bottom_rolling" || dType === "sliding_bottom"
            ? "inset_inside"
            : dSys === "sliding_coplanar"
            ? "coplanar_flush"
            : "top_hung_pelmet");

        const totalBays = Math.max(1, module.bays.length);
        const isFrontTrack = bayIdx % 2 === 1 || totalBays === 1;
        const slideDir = bayIdx >= totalBays - 1 ? -1 : 1;

        // Calculate realistic door width, Y-span, and Z-plane per mounting system
        let effDoorW = leafSpec.leafWidthMm;
        let effDoorH = doorH;
        let effDoorY = doorY;
        let baseClosedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - effDoorW, doorX0));
        let leafZ = doorZ;

        if (mountKind === "inset_inside") {
          // 1. INSET DUAL-TRACK (Hettich SlideLine M / Häfele Slido F-Line21):
          // Runs strictly INSIDE carcass side panels & top/bottom horizontal boards with 24mm center overlap!
          const innerClearSpanW = Math.max(240, width - 2 * T);
          const overlapMm = totalBays > 1 ? 22 : 0;
          effDoorW = Math.round((innerClearSpanW + overlapMm * (totalBays - 1)) / totalBays);
          baseClosedX = Math.round(
            T + bayIdx * ((innerClearSpanW - effDoorW) / Math.max(1, totalBays - 1))
          );
          effDoorY = plinth + T + 12; // 12mm bottom recessed track clearance
          effDoorH = Math.max(160, height - plinth - 2 * T - 24); // 12mm top + 12mm bottom track clearance
          leafZ = isFrontTrack ? depth - T_door - 4 : depth - 2 * T_door - 12;
        } else if (mountKind === "coplanar_flush") {
          // 4. COPLANAR FLUSH (Hettich InLine XL / Cinetto PS48):
          // Completely flush in a single Z plane when closed; active front leaf pops out +48mm on pantograph arms then slides!
          const popProgress = Math.min(1, openRatio * 3.5);
          const slideProgress = Math.max(0, (openRatio - 0.22) / 0.78);
          const popZ = isFrontTrack ? popProgress * 48 : 0;
          effDoorY = plinth + 4;
          effDoorH = Math.max(160, height - plinth - 6);
          leafZ = depth + 4 + popZ;
          const coplanarSlideOffset = isFrontTrack ? slideProgress * (bayW * 0.84) * slideDir : 0;
          baseClosedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - effDoorW, doorX0));
          const coplanarX = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - effDoorW, baseClosedX + coplanarSlideOffset));

          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_sliding_${isFrontTrack ? "front" : "rear"}`,
            role: "door_left",
            label: `Hemzemin Koplanar Sürgü Kapak B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: effDoorW, height: effDoorH, depth: T_door },
            position: { x: coplanarX, y: effDoorY, z: leafZ },
            materialId: doorMatId,
            isFrontFacing: true,
            isManufacturablePanel: true,
            thicknessAxis: "z",
            slidingMountingType: mountKind,
          });

          // Top & Bottom Pantograph Carriage Units attached to leaf
          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_sliding_coplanar_mech_top`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `InLine XL Üst Koplanar Pantograf Mekanizması B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: Math.min(260, effDoorW * 0.42), height: 34, depth: 52 + popZ },
            position: {
              x: coplanarX + effDoorW * 0.29,
              y: height - 2,
              z: depth - 42,
            },
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
          });
        } else {
          // 2 & 3. TOP-HUNG EXTERNAL OVERLAY (Exposed TopLine XL vs Concealed Pelmet Fascia):
          const overlapMm = totalBays > 1 ? 26 : 0;
          effDoorW = Math.round((width + overlapMm * (totalBays - 1)) / totalBays);
          baseClosedX = Math.round(
            bayIdx * ((width - effDoorW) / Math.max(1, totalBays - 1))
          );
          effDoorY = plinth + 4;
          effDoorH = Math.max(160, height - plinth - 4);
          leafZ = isFrontTrack ? depth + 34 : depth + 8;
        }

        if (mountKind !== "coplanar_flush") {
          const maxLeft = mountKind === "inset_inside" ? T : 0;
          const maxRight = mountKind === "inset_inside" ? width - T - effDoorW : width - effDoorW;
          const rawSlideOffset = isFrontTrack ? openRatio * (bayW * 0.82) * slideDir : 0;
          const clampedSlideX = Math.max(maxLeft, Math.min(maxRight, baseClosedX + rawSlideOffset));

          const mountTitle =
            mountKind === "inset_inside"
              ? "İçten Raylı Sürgü Kapak"
              : mountKind === "top_hung_pelmet"
              ? "Üstü Kapamalı Sürgü Kapak"
              : "Üstten Askılı Sürgü Kapak";

          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_sliding_${isFrontTrack && totalBays > 1 ? "front" : totalBays > 1 ? "rear" : "front"}`,
            role: "door_left",
            label: `${mountTitle} B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: effDoorW, height: effDoorH, depth: T_door },
            position: {
              x: clampedSlideX,
              y: effDoorY,
              z: leafZ,
            },
            materialId: doorMatId,
            isFrontFacing: true,
            isManufacturablePanel: true,
            thicknessAxis: "z",
            slidingMountingType: mountKind,
          });

          // Emit 2 Roller Carriages + Silent-System Soft-Close Damper per Sliding Door Leaf!
          [0.16, 0.84].forEach((xFrac, cIdx) => {
            const carrX = clampedSlideX + effDoorW * xFrac - 48;
            if (mountKind === "inset_inside") {
              // Bottom recessed ball-bearing wheel carriage + top guide roller
              components.push({
                id: `${bay.door.id}_sliding_carriage_inset_${cIdx}`,
                role: "special_fitting",
                label: `SlideLine M Gömme Tekerlek & Fren Arabası #${cIdx + 1} B${bayIdx + 1}`,
                bayIndex: bayIdx,
                dimensions: { width: 96, height: 28, depth: 18 },
                position: { x: carrX, y: effDoorY - 6, z: leafZ - 8 },
                materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
              });
            } else {
              // Top-hung gooseneck steel bracket + twin roller carriage riding on top track
              components.push({
                id: `${bay.door.id}_sliding_carriage_top_${cIdx}`,
                role: "special_fitting",
                label: `TopLine XL Üstten Askı Tekerlek & Fren Arabası #${cIdx + 1} B${bayIdx + 1}`,
                bayIndex: bayIdx,
                dimensions: { width: 108, height: 42, depth: isFrontTrack ? 48 : 24 },
                position: {
                  x: carrX,
                  y: height - 18,
                  z: depth - 4,
                },
                materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
              });
            }
          });
        }
      } else if (dSys === "lift_up_stay" || dType === "lift_up_stay") {
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_lift_stay`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Yukarı Kalkar Kapak (HK top) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0,
            y: doorY,
            z: doorZ,
          },
          rotation: [-rad * 0.95, 0, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        // Real 3D Blum AVENTOS HK top Power Units & Telescopic Stay Arms (Left & Right Side Panels)
        const mechH = Math.min(130, Math.max(80, doorH * 0.36));
        const mechD = Math.min(210, Math.max(110, netInnerD * 0.62));
        const mechY = doorY + Math.max(30, doorH - mechH - 22);
        const mechZ = Math.max(24, depth - mechD - 16);
        [-1, 1].forEach((sideSign) => {
          const isRightSide = sideSign === 1;
          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_aventos_mech_hk_${isRightSide ? "right" : "left"}`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `Blum AVENTOS HK top Güç Ünitesi & Kaldırma Kolu (${isRightSide ? "Sağ" : "Sol"}) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: 32, height: mechH, depth: mechD },
            position: {
              x: isRightSide ? bayStartX + bayW - 34 : bayStartX + 2,
              y: mechY,
              z: mechZ,
            },
            rotation: [-rad * 0.45, 0, 0],
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          });
        });
      } else if (dSys === "lift_parallel") {
        // WP-04: 4-bar parallelogram linkage arc (AVENTOS HL top)
        const armRadius = Math.min(220, doorH * 0.52);
        const linkAngle = openRatio * (Math.PI * 0.62);
        const liftDy = Math.round(armRadius * (1 - Math.cos(linkAngle)) + openRatio * (doorH * 0.32));
        const liftDz = Math.round(armRadius * Math.sin(linkAngle));
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_lift_parallel`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Paralel Kalkar Kapak (HL top) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0,
            y: doorY + liftDy,
            z: doorZ + liftDz,
          },
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        // Real 3D Blum AVENTOS HL top 4-Bar Parallelogram Power Units & Arms (Left & Right)
        const mechH = Math.min(140, Math.max(85, doorH * 0.38));
        const mechD = Math.min(220, Math.max(120, netInnerD * 0.65));
        const mechY = doorY + Math.max(30, doorH - mechH - 24);
        const mechZ = Math.max(24, depth - mechD - 14);
        [-1, 1].forEach((sideSign) => {
          const isRightSide = sideSign === 1;
          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_aventos_mech_hl_${isRightSide ? "right" : "left"}`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `Blum AVENTOS HL top Paralel Mekanizma (${isRightSide ? "Sağ" : "Sol"}) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: 32, height: mechH, depth: mechD + Math.round(liftDz * 0.7) },
            position: {
              x: isRightSide ? bayStartX + bayW - 34 : bayStartX + 2,
              y: mechY,
              z: mechZ,
            },
            rotation: [-linkAngle * 0.42, 0, 0],
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          });
        });
      } else if (dSys === "lift_bi_fold") {
        // WP-04: Coupled 2-leaf bi-fold linkage (Blum AVENTOS HF top)
        // Upper leaf pivots around its stationary TOP edge (y = doorY + 2*halfH + gap, z = doorZ)
        // Lower leaf top edge is hinged directly to the moving bottom edge of the upper leaf!
        const halfH = leafSpec.leafHeightMm;
        const thetaTop = rad * 0.92;
        const thetaBot = rad * 0.62;
        const topLeafBaseY = doorY + halfH + doorPerimeterGap;
        const topCeilingPivotY = topLeafBaseY + halfH;
        const knuckleJointY = topCeilingPivotY - Math.round(halfH * Math.cos(thetaTop)) - doorPerimeterGap;
        const knuckleJointZ = doorZ + Math.round(halfH * Math.sin(thetaTop));
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_lift_bifold_top`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Katlanır Kalkar Üst Kanat B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: halfH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0,
            y: topLeafBaseY,
            z: doorZ,
          },
          rotation: [-thetaTop, 0, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_lift_bifold_bot`,
          role: "door_right",
          label: `Katlanır Kalkar Alt Kanat B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: halfH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0,
            y: knuckleJointY - halfH,
            z: knuckleJointZ,
          },
          rotation: [thetaBot, 0, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        // Real 3D Blum AVENTOS HF top Bi-Fold Power Units & Telescopic Arms (Left & Right)
        const mechH = Math.min(145, Math.max(90, doorH * 0.34));
        const mechD = Math.min(230, Math.max(120, netInnerD * 0.66));
        const mechY = doorY + Math.max(40, doorH - mechH - 22);
        const mechZ = Math.max(24, depth - mechD - 14);
        [-1, 1].forEach((sideSign) => {
          const isRightSide = sideSign === 1;
          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_aventos_mech_hf_${isRightSide ? "right" : "left"}`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `Blum AVENTOS HF top Katlanır Teleskopik Mekanizma (${isRightSide ? "Sağ" : "Sol"}) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: 32, height: mechH, depth: mechD + Math.round((knuckleJointZ - doorZ) * 0.65) },
            position: {
              x: isRightSide ? bayStartX + bayW - 34 : bayStartX + 2,
              y: mechY,
              z: mechZ,
            },
            rotation: [-thetaTop * 0.45, 0, 0],
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          });
        });
      } else if (dSys === "folding_side" || dType === "folding") {
        // WP-04: True Coupled Accordion Bi-Fold Kinematics (Hettich WingLine L)
        // Wing 1 pivots around left carcass edge (doorX0, doorZ + T_door) by -thetaWing;
        // Wing 2 left knuckle is locked to Wing 1 right tip (jointX, jointZ) and rotates by +thetaWing so its right roller glides along z = doorZ!
        const wingW = Math.max(120, Math.round((fullDoorW - doorPerimeterGap) / 2));
        const thetaWing = rad * 0.88;
        const jointX = doorX0 + Math.round(wingW * Math.cos(thetaWing)) + doorPerimeterGap;
        const jointZ = doorZ + Math.round(wingW * Math.sin(thetaWing));
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_fold_wing_1`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Katlanır Sol Ana Kanat B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: wingW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: { x: doorX0, y: doorY, z: doorZ },
          rotation: [0, -thetaWing, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_fold_wing_2`,
          role: "door_right",
          label: `Katlanır Sağ Eşlenik Kanat B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: wingW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: jointX,
            y: doorY,
            z: jointZ,
          },
          rotation: [0, thetaWing, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        // Top Aluminum Guide Track for Hettich WingLine L Folding System
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_wingline_top_track`,
          role: "special_fitting",
          label: `Hettich WingLine L Üst Katlanır Kılavuz Rayı B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: 14, depth: 22 },
          position: { x: doorX0, y: doorY + doorH - 12, z: doorZ - 8 },
          materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
          isManufacturablePanel: false,
        });
      } else if (dSys === "pocket_retractable" || dType === "pocket") {
        // WP-04: Two-stage pivot (0..35%) then linear pocket retraction (35..100%)
        const pivotPhase = Math.min(1, openRatio / 0.35);
        const retractPhase = openRatio > 0.35 ? (openRatio - 0.35) / 0.65 : 0;
        const pocketYawRad = -pivotPhase * (Math.PI / 2);
        const retractZ = Math.round(retractPhase * Math.min(500, depth * 0.76));
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_pocket_leaf`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Pocket Gizlenen Kapak B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0 + Math.round(pivotPhase * 22),
            y: doorY,
            z: doorZ - retractZ,
          },
          rotation: [0, pocketYawRad, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        if (openRatio > 0.05) {
          components.push({
            id: `${bay.door.id}_revego_pocket_track`,
            role: "special_fitting",
            label: `REVEGO Pocket Taşıyıcı Ray B${bayIdx + 1}`,
            bayIndex: bayIdx,
            dimensions: { width: 16, height: 24, depth: Math.max(200, depth - 60) },
            position: {
              x: bayStartX + 6,
              y: doorY + doorH - 28,
              z: T + 20,
            },
            materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
            isManufacturablePanel: false,
          });
        }
      } else if (dSys === "tambour_roller" || dType === "tambour") {
        const visibleH = Math.max(60, doorH * (1 - openRatio * 0.82));
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_tambour_curtain`,
          role: "door_left",
          label: `Tambur Panjur Kapak (Önizleme) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: visibleH, depth: T_door },
          position: {
            x: doorX0,
            y: doorY + (doorH - visibleH),
            z: doorZ - 8,
          },
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
      } else {
        const isRight = dType === "single_right" || dType === "inset_right" || dType === "half_overlay_right";
        components.push({
          id: `${bay.door.id}_${isRight ? "right" : "left"}`,
          role: isRight ? "door_right" : "door_left",
          label: `Kapak ${isRight ? "Sağ" : "Sol"}${isInset ? " (İçten)" : isHalfOverlay ? " (Yarım Bini)" : ""} B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: fullDoorW, height: doorH, depth: T_door },
          position: { x: doorX0, y: doorY, z: doorZ },
          rotation: [0, isRight ? rad : -rad, 0],
          materialId: doorMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
      }
    }

    currentX += bayW + T;
  });

  // MODULE-WIDE SLIDING DOOR TRACK RAILS, STB-19 BOTTOM GUIDES & CONCEALED TOP PELMET FASCIA VALANCE
  const firstSlidingBay = !module.isOpenFront
    ? module.bays.find((b) => {
        const ds = b.door?.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(b.door?.type || "open");
        return (
          b.door &&
          b.door.type !== "open" &&
          (ds.startsWith("sliding") || b.door.type === "sliding" || b.door.type === "sliding_bottom")
        );
      })
    : undefined;

  if (firstSlidingBay) {
    const dSysSlide =
      firstSlidingBay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(firstSlidingBay.door.type);
    const mountKind =
      firstSlidingBay.door.slidingMountingType ||
      (dSysSlide === "sliding_bottom_rolling" || firstSlidingBay.door.type === "sliding_bottom"
        ? "inset_inside"
        : dSysSlide === "sliding_coplanar"
        ? "coplanar_flush"
        : "top_hung_pelmet");
    const pelmetMatId = firstSlidingBay.door.doorMaterialId || doorMaterialId;

    if (mountKind === "inset_inside") {
      // Recessed Double-Channel Anodized Aluminum Upper Guide Track & Lower Running Track inside Carcass
      const trackSpanW = Math.max(180, width - 2 * T);
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_track_inset_top`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "Üst Çift Kanallı Gömme Alüminyum Sürgü Rayı (SlideLine M / Slido)",
        dimensions: { width: trackSpanW, height: 14, depth: 54 },
        position: { x: T, y: height - T - 14, z: depth - 58 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_track_inset_bottom`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "Alt Çift Kanallı Gömme Alüminyum Taşıyıcı Ray (SlideLine M / Slido)",
        dimensions: { width: trackSpanW, height: 12, depth: 54 },
        position: { x: T, y: plinth + T, z: depth - 58 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });
    } else if (mountKind === "coplanar_flush") {
      // Concealed Roof-Mounted Coplanar Pantograph Track Housing + Under-Floor Guide Rail
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_track_coplanar_top`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "InLine XL Üst Koplanar Senkronize Ray Kasası",
        dimensions: { width: width - 16, height: 26, depth: 78 },
        position: { x: 8, y: height, z: depth - 82 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_guide_bottom`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "InLine XL Alt Gizli Koplanar Kılavuz Rayı",
        dimensions: { width: width - 24, height: 14, depth: 52 },
        position: { x: 12, y: Math.max(0, plinth - 14), z: depth - 46 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });
    } else {
      // Top-Hung Roof-Mounted Heavy-Duty Twin Aluminum Track (TopLine XL) + Concealed Bottom STB-19 Guide
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_track_top_hung`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "Hettich TopLine XL Üstten Askılı Çift Yollu Alüminyum Taşıyıcı Ray",
        dimensions: { width, height: 28, depth: 66 },
        position: { x: 0, y: height, z: depth - 8 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });
      components.push({
        id: `${module.id}_sliding_guide_bottom`,
        role: "special_fitting",
        label: "STB 19 Alt Tabla Altı Gizli Sürgü Kılavuz Profili",
        dimensions: { width: width - 16, height: 12, depth: 48 },
        position: { x: 8, y: Math.max(0, plinth - 12), z: depth + 4 },
        materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
      });

      // Architectural Top Pelmet / Fascia Cover + Left/Right Side End-Caps (Üstü Kapalı / Alın Kapamalı Sistem!)
      if (mountKind === "top_hung_pelmet") {
        const fasciaH = 62;
        const overhangZ = 60;
        components.push({
          id: `${module.id}_sliding_pelmet_fascia`,
          role: "carcass_top",
          label: "Sürgü Üst Alın Kapama Bandı (Gizli Ray Valansı)",
          dimensions: { width, height: fasciaH, depth: T },
          position: { x: 0, y: height - 18, z: depth + overhangZ - T },
          materialId: pelmetMatId,
          isFrontFacing: true,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "z",
        });
        components.push({
          id: `${module.id}_sliding_pelmet_cap_top`,
          role: "carcass_top",
          label: "Sürgü Üst Ray Toz Kapama Kepi",
          dimensions: { width, height: T, depth: overhangZ },
          position: { x: 0, y: height + fasciaH - 18, z: depth },
          materialId: pelmetMatId,
          isManufacturablePanel: true,
          thicknessAxis: "y",
        });
        [0, width - T].forEach((endX, sSide) => {
          components.push({
            id: `${module.id}_sliding_pelmet_end_${sSide}`,
            role: "carcass_side_left",
            label: `Sürgü Üst Valans ${sSide === 0 ? "Sol" : "Sağ"} Yan Kapama`,
            dimensions: { width: T, height: fasciaH, depth: overhangZ - T },
            position: { x: endX, y: height - 18, z: depth },
            materialId: pelmetMatId,
            isManufacturablePanel: true,
            thicknessAxis: "x",
          });
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Explicit motion transforms are consumed identically by both renderers and 2D.
  const fronts = components.filter(c => c.role === "door_left" || c.role === "door_right" || c.role === "drawer_front");
  for (const front of fronts) {
    const bayIdx = front.bayIndex ?? 0;
    const bay = module.bays[bayIdx];
    const leafSpec = fourSpace.doorLeaves[bayIdx];
    if (front.rotation) {
      const topPivot = front.rotation[0] !== 0;
      const isRightEdgeHinge =
        front.role === "door_right" && !topPivot && !front.id.includes("fold_wing_2");
      front.pivot = {
        x: front.position.x + (isRightEdgeHinge ? front.dimensions.width : 0),
        y: front.position.y + (topPivot ? front.dimensions.height : 0),
        z: front.position.z + (topPivot ? 0 : front.dimensions.depth),
      };
    }
    if (front.role === "drawer_front" && bay.drawers.find(d => `${d.id}_front` === front.id)?.isInternal) {
      front.isInternalDrawer = true;
      continue;
    }
    const isRearSlidingLeaf = front.id.includes("_sliding_rear");
    const rawCategory =
      bay.door.handleCategory ??
      (bay.door.handleType === "none" || bay.door.handleType === "push_to_open"
        ? "handleless_plain"
        : "bar_handle");
    const category = isRearSlidingLeaf ? "recessed_grip" : rawCategory;
    components.push(
      ...generateHandleGeometry(front, category, {
        moduleCategory: module.category,
        moduleElevationY: module.position.y,
        moduleHeight: module.dimensions.height,
        handleOrientation: bay.door.handleOrientation,
        handleOffsetY: bay.door.handleOffsetY,
        handleEdgeInsetX: bay.door.handleEdgeInsetX,
        handleLengthMm: bay.door.handleLengthMm,
        handleMaterialId: bay.door.handleMaterialId,
        handleProfileId: bay.door.handleProfileId,
      })
    );

    // Emit visible 3D/2D concealed hinge cups & mounting plates along the hinge edge of hinged doors
    const dSys = bay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(bay.door.type);
    const isHingedLeaf =
      (front.role === "door_left" || front.role === "door_right") &&
      !dSys.startsWith("sliding") &&
      !dSys.startsWith("lift") &&
      dSys !== "tambour_roller" &&
      !front.id.includes("fold_wing_2");
    if (isHingedLeaf && leafSpec && leafSpec.hingePositionsY.length > 0) {
      const isRightHinge = front.role === "door_right";
      const hwBrand = bay.door.hardwareProductId?.includes("hettich")
        ? "Hettich Sensys"
        : bay.door.hardwareProductId?.includes("salice")
        ? "Salice Silentia+"
        : "Blum CLIP top";
      leafSpec.hingePositionsY.forEach((hy, hIdx) => {
        const hingeW = 28;
        const hingeH = 64;
        const hingeD = 38;
        const hx = isRightHinge
          ? front.position.x + front.dimensions.width - hingeW - 2
          : front.position.x + 2;
        const absY = front.position.y + hy - hingeH / 2;
        const hz = front.position.z - hingeD + 4;
        components.push({
          id: `${front.id}_hinge_${hIdx + 1}`,
          role: "door_hinge",
          label: `${hwBrand} Menteşe #${hIdx + 1} (Y:${hy}mm) B${bayIdx + 1}`,
          bayIndex: bayIdx,
          dimensions: { width: hingeW, height: hingeH, depth: hingeD },
          position: { x: hx, y: absY, z: hz },
          rotation: front.rotation,
          pivot: front.pivot,
          parentComponentId: front.id,
          materialId: "mat_metal_chrome",
          isManufacturablePanel: false,
        });
      });
    }
  }

  components.forEach((c) => {
    if (c.role === "plinth") {
      const plMat =
        module.carcass.plinthMaterialId || module.componentMaterialOverrides?.__plinth__;
      if (plMat) c.materialId = plMat;
    }
    if (c.role === "door_left" || c.role === "door_right" || c.role === "drawer_front") {
      const bayObj = typeof c.bayIndex === "number" ? module.bays[c.bayIndex] : module.bays[0];
      const prof =
        bayObj?.door?.crossSectionProfile || module.carcass.crossSectionProfile;
      const poly =
        bayObj?.door?.customCadPolygon || module.carcass.customCadPolygon;
      if (prof) c.crossSectionProfile = prof;
      if (poly && poly.length >= 3) {
        const cleanPoly = poly.filter(
          (pt) => Number.isFinite(pt.x) && Number.isFinite(pt.y)
        );
        let deduped: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
        for (const pt of cleanPoly) {
          const prev = deduped[deduped.length - 1];
          if (!prev || Math.hypot(pt.x - prev.x, pt.y - prev.y) > 1e-4) {
            deduped.push({
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(pt.x.toFixed(4)))),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(pt.y.toFixed(4)))),
            });
          }
        }
        if (deduped.length >= 3) {
          let signedArea2 = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < deduped.length; i++) {
            const a = deduped[i];
            const b = deduped[(i + 1) % deduped.length];
            signedArea2 += a.x * b.y - b.x * a.y;
          }
          if (Math.abs(signedArea2) > 1e-4) {
            c.customCadPolygon = deduped;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const ov = module.componentMaterialOverrides?.[c.id];
    if (ov) c.materialId = ov;
  });
  const result: ModuleGeometryBreakdown = {
    moduleId: module.id,
    overall: module.dimensions,
    components,
    bayWidths,
    netInnerHeight: netInnerH,
    netInnerDepth: netInnerD,
  };
  if (moduleGeometryCache.size >= 400) {
    const oldestKey = moduleGeometryCache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey) moduleGeometryCache.delete(oldestKey);
  }
  moduleGeometryCache.set(cacheKey, result);
  return result;
}

export function generateMultiModuleGeometry(
  modules: ModuleInstance[],
  options: GenerateGeometryOptions = {}
): ModuleGeometryBreakdown[] {
  return modules.map((m) => generateModuleGeometry(m, options));
}

import { componentBounds } from "./component-transform";
import { UnitLength } from "@birim/core";
import { ModuleGeometryBreakdown } from "./types";

export interface Rect2D {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  role: string;
  color?: string;
  isSelected?: boolean;
}

export interface DimensionLine2D {
  id: string;
  x1: number;
  y1: number;
  x2: number;
  y2: number;
  value: UnitLength;
  label: string;
  orientation: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  offset: number;
}

export interface Elevation2DData {
  viewBox: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
  elements: Rect2D[];
  dimensionLines: DimensionLine2D[];
  bayLines: { x: number; y1: number; y2: number; label: string }[];
}

function computeExpandedViewBox(
  baseWidth: number,
  baseHeight: number,
  elements: Rect2D[],
  padding: number
): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number } {
  let minX = 0;
  let minY = 0;
  let maxX = baseWidth;
  let maxY = baseHeight;
  for (const el of elements) {
    if (el.x < minX) minX = el.x;
    if (el.y < minY) minY = el.y;
    if (el.x + el.width > maxX) maxX = el.x + el.width;
    if (el.y + el.height > maxY) maxY = el.y + el.height;
  }
  return {
    x: minX - padding,
    y: minY - padding,
    width: maxX - minX + padding * 2,
    height: maxY - minY + padding * 2,
  };
}

export function generateElevation2D(
  breakdown: ModuleGeometryBreakdown,
  selectedComponentId?: string
): Elevation2DData {
  const { overall, components, bayWidths } = breakdown;
  const padding = 150;

  const hasFrontPlinth = components.some((c) => c.id.includes("_plinth_front"));
  const elements: Rect2D[] = components
    .filter((c) => {
      if (c.role === "carcass_back" || c.role === "hanging_rail" || c.id.includes("_sub_")) {
        return false;
      }
      // Hide rear/internal plinth stretchers, clips, side seals & rear-row legs in 2D Front Elevation so _plinth_front is crisp!
      if (
        c.id.includes("_plinth_rear") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_rib_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_side_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_clip_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_glide_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_left") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_right")
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      // Only show front-row legs as ISO hidden dashed contours (avoid duplicate rear-row overlap at same X!)
      if (c.id.includes("_plastic_leg_") && c.position.z < 70) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    })
    .map((c) => {
      const bounds = componentBounds(c);
      const isHiddenLegBehindPlinth = hasFrontPlinth && c.id.includes("_plastic_leg_");
      const isPlinthSeal = c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_");
      return {
        id: c.id,
        label: c.label,
        x: bounds.min.x,
        y: overall.height - bounds.max.y,
        width: bounds.max.x - bounds.min.x,
        height: bounds.max.y - bounds.min.y,
        role: isHiddenLegBehindPlinth
          ? "plinth_leg_hidden"
          : isPlinthSeal
          ? "plinth_seal"
          : c.role,
        isSelected: c.id === selectedComponentId,
      };
    });

  const dimensionLines: DimensionLine2D[] = [
    {
      id: "dim_total_width",
      x1: 0,
      y1: -40,
      x2: overall.width,
      y2: -40,
      value: overall.width,
      label: `${overall.width} mm`,
      orientation: "horizontal",
      offset: -40,
    },
    {
      id: "dim_total_height",
      x1: -50,
      y1: overall.height,
      x2: -50,
      y2: 0,
      value: overall.height,
      label: `${overall.height} mm`,
      orientation: "vertical",
      offset: -50,
    },
  ];

  const panelThickness = components.find((c) => c.role === "carcass_side_left")?.dimensions.width ?? 0;
  let currentX = panelThickness;
  bayWidths.forEach((bw, i) => {
    dimensionLines.push({
      id: `dim_bay_${i}`,
      x1: currentX,
      y1: overall.height + 40,
      x2: currentX + bw,
      y2: overall.height + 40,
      value: bw,
      label: `B${i + 1}: ${bw} mm`,
      orientation: "horizontal",
      offset: 40,
    });
    currentX += bw + panelThickness;
  });

  return {
    viewBox: computeExpandedViewBox(overall.width, overall.height, elements, padding),
    elements,
    dimensionLines,
    bayLines: [],
  };
}

export function generateTopPlan2D(
  breakdown: ModuleGeometryBreakdown,
  selectedComponentId?: string
): Elevation2DData {
  const { overall, components } = breakdown;
  const padding = 160;

  const elements: Rect2D[] = components
    .filter((c) => c.role.startsWith("carcass") || c.role.startsWith("door") || c.role === "drawer_front" || c.role === "shelf" || c.role === "hanging_rail" || c.role === "special_fitting")
    .map((c) => {
      const bounds = componentBounds(c);
      return {
        id: c.id,
        label: c.label,
        x: bounds.min.x,
        y: bounds.min.z,
        width: bounds.max.x - bounds.min.x,
        height: bounds.max.z - bounds.min.z,
        role: c.role,
        isSelected: c.id === selectedComponentId,
      };
    });

  const dimensionLines: DimensionLine2D[] = [
    {
      id: "dim_plan_width",
      x1: 0,
      y1: -45,
      x2: overall.width,
      y2: -45,
      value: overall.width,
      label: `Genişlik: ${overall.width} mm`,
      orientation: "horizontal",
      offset: -45,
    },
    {
      id: "dim_plan_depth",
      x1: -55,
      y1: 0,
      x2: -55,
      y2: overall.depth,
      value: overall.depth,
      label: `Derinlik: ${overall.depth} mm`,
      orientation: "vertical",
      offset: -55,
    },
  ];

  return {
    viewBox: computeExpandedViewBox(overall.width, overall.depth, elements, padding),
    elements,
    dimensionLines,
    bayLines: [],
  };
}

/**
 * Generates Cross-section 2D view (Düşey Kesit Çizimi) slicing through Depth x Height
 */
export function generateCrossSection2D(
  breakdown: ModuleGeometryBreakdown,
  selectedComponentId?: string,
  options?: { direction?: "Z" | "X"; cutCoordMm?: number }
): Elevation2DData {
  const { overall, components } = breakdown;
  const padding = 120;
  const dir = options?.direction || "Z";

  // Direction "X": B-B Longitudinal Cross-Section (Boyuna Kesit at Depth Z = cutCoordMm, projecting Width X vs Height Y)
  if (dir === "X") {
    const cutZ =
      typeof options?.cutCoordMm === "number"
        ? Math.max(0, Math.min(overall.depth, options.cutCoordMm))
        : Math.round(overall.depth * 0.5);

    const elements: Rect2D[] = components
      .filter((c) => {
        if (
          c.role === "door_left" ||
          c.role === "door_right" ||
          c.role === "door_sliding" ||
          c.role === "door_lift" ||
          c.role === "door_handle"
        ) {
          return cutZ >= overall.depth - 36;
        }
        const b = componentBounds(c);
        return (
          c.role.startsWith("carcass_") ||
          c.role === "plinth" ||
          c.role === "countertop" ||
          c.role === "sub_divider" ||
          (b.min.z <= cutZ + 45 && b.max.z >= cutZ - 45)
        );
      })
      .map((c) => {
        const bounds = componentBounds(c);
        return {
          id: c.id,
          label: c.label,
          x: bounds.min.x,
          y: overall.height - bounds.max.y,
          width: Math.max(4, bounds.max.x - bounds.min.x),
          height: Math.max(4, bounds.max.y - bounds.min.y),
          role: c.role,
          isSelected: c.id === selectedComponentId,
        };
      });

    const dimensionLines: DimensionLine2D[] = [
      {
        id: "dim_sec_width_x",
        x1: 0,
        y1: -30,
        x2: overall.width,
        y2: -30,
        value: overall.width,
        label: `B-B Boyuna Kesit Genişlik: ${overall.width} mm (Derinlik Z: ${cutZ} mm)`,
        orientation: "horizontal",
        offset: -30,
      },
      {
        id: "dim_sec_height_x",
        x1: -40,
        y1: overall.height,
        x2: -40,
        y2: 0,
        value: overall.height,
        label: `Yükseklik: ${overall.height} mm`,
        orientation: "vertical",
        offset: -40,
      },
    ];

    return {
      viewBox: computeExpandedViewBox(overall.width, overall.height, elements, padding),
      elements,
      dimensionLines,
      bayLines: [],
    };
  }

  // Direction "Z": A-A Transverse Side Cross-Section (Enine Yan Kesit at Width X = cutCoordMm, projecting Depth Z vs Height Y)
  const cutX =
    typeof options?.cutCoordMm === "number"
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(overall.width, options.cutCoordMm))
      : undefined;

  // Filter components visible in depth cross-section at cutX
  const elements: Rect2D[] = components
    .filter((c) => {
      const isAllowedRole =
        c.role === "carcass_bottom" ||
        c.role === "carcass_top" ||
        c.role === "plinth" ||
        c.role === "countertop" ||
        c.role === "shelf" ||
        c.role === "sub_divider" ||
        c.role === "carcass_divider" ||
        c.role === "hanging_rail" ||
        c.role === "drawer_box" ||
        c.role === "drawer_side_left" ||
        c.role === "drawer_bottom" ||
        c.role === "drawer_front" ||
        c.role === "door_left" ||
        c.role === "door_right" ||
        c.role === "door_hinge" ||
        c.role === "special_fitting" ||
        c.role === "carcass_back";
      if (!isAllowedRole) return false;
      // In A-A Transverse Side Section, exclude left/right side plinths & ribs spanning full Z so recessed front/rear rails & seal profile show cleanly!
      if (
        c.id.includes("_plinth_side_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_rib_") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_left") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_right")
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      // Always show one representative pair of front/rear plinth legs & clip in Side Section so toe-kick engineering is visible!
      const isRepPlinthHardware =
        c.id.endsWith("_plastic_leg_1") ||
        c.id.endsWith("_plastic_leg_2") ||
        c.id.endsWith("_plinth_clip_2") ||
        c.id.includes("_plinth_seal_front");
      if (
        !isRepPlinthHardware &&
        typeof cutX === "number" &&
        (c.role === "shelf" ||
          c.role === "sub_divider" ||
          c.role === "carcass_divider" ||
          c.role === "hanging_rail" ||
          c.role.startsWith("drawer_") ||
          c.role.startsWith("door_") ||
          c.role === "special_fitting")
      ) {
        const b = componentBounds(c);
        return cutX >= b.min.x - 24 && cutX <= b.max.x + 24;
      }
      return true;
    })
    .map((c) => {
      const bounds = componentBounds(c);
      return {
        id: c.id,
        label: c.label,
        x: bounds.min.z,
        y: overall.height - bounds.max.y,
        width: Math.max(4, bounds.max.z - bounds.min.z),
        height: Math.max(4, bounds.max.y - bounds.min.y),
        role: c.role,
        isSelected: c.id === selectedComponentId,
      };
    });

  const dimensionLines: DimensionLine2D[] = [
    {
      id: "dim_sec_depth",
      x1: 0,
      y1: -30,
      x2: overall.depth,
      y2: -30,
      value: overall.depth,
      label: `Net Derinlik: ${overall.depth} mm`,
      orientation: "horizontal",
      offset: -30,
    },
    {
      id: "dim_sec_height",
      x1: -40,
      y1: overall.height,
      x2: -40,
      y2: 0,
      value: overall.height,
      label: `Net Yükseklik: ${overall.height} mm`,
      orientation: "vertical",
      offset: -40,
    },
  ];

  return {
    viewBox: computeExpandedViewBox(overall.depth, overall.height, elements, padding),
    elements,
    dimensionLines,
    bayLines: [],
  };
}

import { UnitLength, Position3D, Dimensions3D } from "@birim/core";

export type ComponentRole =
  | "carcass_side_left"
  | "carcass_side_right"
  | "carcass_bottom"
  | "carcass_top"
  | "carcass_divider"
  | "carcass_sub_divider"
  | "carcass_back"
  | "plinth"
  | "shelf"
  | "hanging_rail"
  | "special_fitting"
  | "drawer_front"
  | "drawer_box"
  | "drawer_bottom"
  | "drawer_side_left"
  | "drawer_side_right"
  | "drawer_back"
  | "door_handle"
  | "door_hinge"
  | "gola_profile"
  | "drawer_handle"
  | "drawer_slide"
  | "door_left"
  | "door_right"
  | "countertop";

export type PanelThicknessAxis = "x" | "y" | "z";

export interface ComponentGeometry {
  id: string;
  role: ComponentRole;
  label: string;
  bayIndex?: number;
  dimensions: Dimensions3D; // width (dx), height (dy), depth (dz) in mm
  position: Position3D; // local position relative to module origin (bottom-left-rear = 0,0,0) in mm
  rotation?: [number, number, number]; // Euler XYZ in radians
  pivot?: Position3D; // module-space pivot in mm; position remains the closed local box origin
  primitive?: "box" | "sphere" | "cylinder";
  parentComponentId?: string;
  handleCategory?: import("@birim/core").HandleCategory;
  crossSectionProfile?: import("@birim/core").DoorCrossSectionProfile;
  customCadPolygon?: { x: number; y: number }[];
  materialId: string;
  isFrontFacing?: boolean;
  /** True only if this component represents a cuttable sheet/panel piece in BOM (false for UI hardware/handles/profiles) */
  isManufacturablePanel?: boolean;
  /** Explicit axis along which panel thickness lies ("x" for vertical sides/dividers, "y" for horizontal shelves/top/bottom, "z" for fronts/backs) */
  thicknessAxis?: PanelThicknessAxis;
}

export interface ModuleGeometryBreakdown {
  moduleId: string;
  overall: Dimensions3D;
  components: ComponentGeometry[];
  bayWidths: UnitLength[];
  netInnerHeight: UnitLength;
  netInnerDepth: UnitLength;
}

import {
  DEFAULT_MATERIALS,
  DesignProject,
  evaluateProjectCompatibility,
} from "@birim/core";
import {
  ManufacturingBOM,
  buildBirimErpNestingBundle,
  convertCutPieceToErpPartInput,
  type BirimErpNestingBuildOptions,
  type BirimErpNestingExportBundle,
} from "@birim/manufacturing";
import { ERPBlueprintPayload, IERPAdapter, AuditLogEntry } from "./types";

export class MockERPAdapter implements IERPAdapter {
  private inMemoryBlueprints: Map<string, ERPBlueprintPayload> = new Map();
  private idempotencyRegistry: Map<string, string> = new Map();
  private auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[] = [];

  buildNestingPayload(
    project: DesignProject,
    bom: ManufacturingBOM,
    orderId = `SIPARIS_${project.id}`,
    nestingOptions?: BirimErpNestingBuildOptions
  ): BirimErpNestingExportBundle {
    const materialsMap = new Map(DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    return buildBirimErpNestingBundle(project, bom, materialsMap, {
      organizationId: project.branchId || "org_birim_fabrika",
      orderRef: orderId,
      ...nestingOptions,
    });
  }

  async publishProductionBlueprint(
    project: DesignProject,
    bom: ManufacturingBOM,
    orderId = "order_mock_001",
    idempotencyKey?: string,
    nestingOptions?: BirimErpNestingBuildOptions
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    blueprintId: string;
    itemsCount: number;
    nestingJobsCount: number;
    totalSheetsUsed: number;
    nestingBundle: BirimErpNestingExportBundle;
  }> {
    if (
      bom.validationWarnings.length > 0 &&
      bom.validationWarnings.some((w) => w.includes("ERR_"))
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Üretim engeli (ERR_): Tasarım kritik imalat hataları içeriyor, ERP'ye aktarılamaz."
      );
    }

    const compatibility = evaluateProjectCompatibility(project);
    if (compatibility.overallStatus === "INCOMPATIBLE") {
      throw new Error(
        `Üretim engeli (${compatibility.overallStatus}): Tasarım uyumsuz kurallar içeriyor, ERP/CNC'ye aktarılamaz.`
      );
    }

    if (idempotencyKey && this.idempotencyRegistry.has(idempotencyKey)) {
      const existingId = this.idempotencyRegistry.get(idempotencyKey)!;
      const bp = this.inMemoryBlueprints.get(existingId)!;
      return {
        success: true,
        blueprintId: existingId,
        itemsCount: bp.items.length,
        nestingJobsCount: bp.nesting_bundle.jobs.length,
        totalSheetsUsed: bp.nesting_bundle.summary.total_sheets_used,
        nestingBundle: bp.nesting_bundle,
      };
    }

    const blueprintId = `bp_${orderId}_v${project.version}`;
    const nestingBundle = this.buildNestingPayload(
      project,
      bom,
      orderId,
      nestingOptions
    );

    const items = bom.cutList.map((piece) => {
      const workshops: string[] = ["ebatlama"];
      if (piece.edgeBandMeters > 0) {
        workshops.push("kenar_bantlama");
      }
      if ((piece.holes && piece.holes.length > 0) || piece.hasBackGroove) {
        workshops.push("cnc_delik_ve_freze");
      }
      if (piece.materialName.toLowerCase().includes("lake")) {
        workshops.push("boyahane");
      }
      workshops.push("montaj_paketleme");

      const conv = convertCutPieceToErpPartInput(piece, {
        useNetCutDimensions: true,
      });

      return {
        piece_id: piece.id,
        label: piece.pieceName,
        material: piece.materialName,
        dimensions_mm: [
          piece.lengthMm,
          piece.widthMm,
          piece.thicknessMm,
        ] as [number, number, number],
        net_cut_dimensions_mm: [
          piece.netCutLengthMm ?? piece.lengthMm,
          piece.netCutWidthMm ?? piece.widthMm,
          piece.thicknessMm,
        ] as [number, number, number],
        edge_banding: {
          top: piece.edgeBanding.top,
          bottom: piece.edgeBanding.bottom,
          left: piece.edgeBanding.left,
          right: piece.edgeBanding.right,
          thickness_mm: piece.edgeBanding.thickness,
          erp_serialized_edge_banding: conv.partInput.edge_banding,
        },
        grain: piece.grain,
        workshops,
        drilling_count: piece.holes ? piece.holes.length : 0,
      };
    });

    const hardware_items = bom.hardwareList.map((hw) => ({
      sku: hw.sku,
      name: hw.name,
      quantity: hw.quantity,
      unit: hw.unit,
    }));

    const payload: ERPBlueprintPayload = {
      order_id: orderId,
      version: project.version,
      branch_id: project.branchId,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      status: "draft",
      items,
      hardware_items,
      nesting_bundle: nestingBundle,
      metadata: {
        project_id: project.id,
        project_title: project.title,
        branch_id: project.branchId,
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        library_version_id: project.libraryVersionId || "lib_v4_0_0",
        compatibility_status: compatibility.overallStatus,
        cnc_production_approved: compatibility.canApproveProduction,
      },
    };

    this.inMemoryBlueprints.set(blueprintId, payload);
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      this.idempotencyRegistry.set(idempotencyKey, blueprintId);
    }

    this.auditLogs.push({
      id: `AUDIT_${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      userId: "ERP_INTEGRATION_SERVICE",
      branchId: project.branchId,
      action: "PRODUCTION_BLUEPRINT_EXPORTED",
      resourceId: blueprintId,
      details: {
        orderId,
        itemsCount: items.length,
        nestingJobsCount: nestingBundle.jobs.length,
        totalSheetsUsed: nestingBundle.summary.total_sheets_used,
        version: project.version,
      },
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      blueprintId,
      itemsCount: items.length,
      nestingJobsCount: nestingBundle.jobs.length,
      totalSheetsUsed: nestingBundle.summary.total_sheets_used,
      nestingBundle,
    };
  }

  getBlueprint(blueprintId: string): ERPBlueprintPayload | undefined {
    return this.inMemoryBlueprints.get(blueprintId);
  }

  getAuditLogs(): AuditLogEntry[] {
    return this.auditLogs;
  }
}

import { DesignProject, evaluateProjectCompatibility } from "@birim/core";
import { ManufacturingBOM } from "@birim/manufacturing";
import { PricingBreakdown } from "@birim/pricing";
import { IStoreAdapter, StoreQuoteItemPayload, AuditLogEntry } from "./types";

export class MockStoreAdapter implements IStoreAdapter {
  private inMemorySnapshots: Map<string, StoreQuoteItemPayload> = new Map();
  private idempotencyRegistry: Map<string, string> = new Map();
  private auditLogs: AuditLogEntry[] = [];

  async createOrUpdateQuoteItem(
    project: DesignProject,
    bom: ManufacturingBOM,
    pricing: PricingBreakdown,
    quoteId = "quote_mock_default",
    idempotencyKey?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; snapshotId: string; timestamp: string }> {
    if (idempotencyKey && this.idempotencyRegistry.has(idempotencyKey)) {
      const existingSnapshotId = this.idempotencyRegistry.get(idempotencyKey)!;
      return {
        success: true,
        snapshotId: existingSnapshotId,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    const mainMod = project.modules[0];
    const snapshotId = `snp_${project.id}_v${project.version}_${Date.now()}`;
    const compatibility = evaluateProjectCompatibility(project);

    const selectedDoorSystems = Array.from(
      new Set(
        project.modules.flatMap((m) =>
          m.bays
            .map((b) => String(b.door?.doorSystemId || b.door?.type || ""))
            .filter((v) => v.length > 0 && v !== "open")
        )
      )
    );
    const selectedHardwareSkus = bom.hardwareList.map((h) => h.sku);

    const payload: StoreQuoteItemPayload = {
      quoteId,
      cartItemId: `cart_item_${project.id}`,
      branchId: project.branchId,
      idempotencyKey,
      signature: `SIG_HMAC_SHA256_${Date.now()}`,
      configuratorSnapshot: {
        designId: project.id,
        version: project.version,
        libraryVersionId: project.libraryVersionId || "lib_v4_0_0",
        title: project.title,
        category: mainMod ? mainMod.category : "custom",
        dimensionsSummary: mainMod
          ? `${mainMod.dimensions.width} x ${mainMod.dimensions.height} x ${mainMod.dimensions.depth} mm`
          : "Çoklu Modül",
        calculatedPriceEur: pricing.totalWithVatEur,
        calculatedPriceTry: pricing.totalWithVatTry,
        materialsSummary: mainMod
          ? `Gövde: ${mainMod.carcass.bodyMaterialId} | Kapak: ${mainMod.carcass.doorMaterialId}`
          : "Çoklu Malzeme",
        selectedDoorSystems,
        selectedHardwareSkus,
        compatibilityStatus: compatibility.overallStatus,
        bomSummary: {
          totalPieces: bom.summary.totalPiecesCount,
          totalAreaM2: bom.summary.totalPanelAreaM2,
          totalHardwareCount: bom.summary.totalHardwareCount,
          totalDrillingHolesCount: bom.summary.totalDrillingHolesCount || 0,
        },
        rawProjectData: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(project)),
      },
    };

    this.inMemorySnapshots.set(snapshotId, payload);
    if (idempotencyKey) {
      this.idempotencyRegistry.set(idempotencyKey, snapshotId);
    }

    this.auditLogs.push({
      id: `AUDIT_${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      userId: "STORE_SALES_REP_01",
      branchId: project.branchId,
      action: "QUOTE_SNAPSHOT_CREATED",
      resourceId: snapshotId,
      details: {
        quoteId,
        priceEur: pricing.totalWithVatEur,
        piecesCount: bom.summary.totalPiecesCount,
      },
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      snapshotId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  getSnapshot(snapshotId: string): StoreQuoteItemPayload | undefined {
    return this.inMemorySnapshots.get(snapshotId);
  }

  getAuditLogs(): AuditLogEntry[] {
    return this.auditLogs;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// packages/manufacturing/src/erp-nesting/erp-exporters.ts
// Birim ERP lib/gcodeGenerator.ts & lib/selcoExporter.ts birebir makine çıktıları
// ============================================================================

import type {
  ErpPlacementData,
  ErpNestingSheet,
  ErpGCodeConfig,
  ErpNestingSheetResult,
  ErpNestingPart,
  ErpNestingProject,
} from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { DEFAULT_ERP_GCODE_CONFIG } from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { parseErpEdgeBanding } from "./erp-serialization";

// --- 1. CNC Router G-Code (.nc) Exporter ---

export function generateErpSheetGCode(
  sheetResult: ErpNestingSheetResult,
  sheet: ErpNestingSheet,
  config: ErpGCodeConfig = DEFAULT_ERP_GCODE_CONFIG
): string {
  const effectiveConfig: ErpGCodeConfig = {
    ...config,
    cut_depth: sheet.thickness_mm || config.cut_depth,
    pass_depth: Math.min(config.pass_depth, sheet.thickness_mm || config.pass_depth),
  };

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push(`; ==============================`);
  lines.push(`; Panel Nesting G-Code (Birim ERP Compatible)`);
  lines.push(`; Sheet ${sheetResult.sheet_index + 1}: ${sheet.name}`);
  lines.push(`; ${sheet.width_mm}x${sheet.height_mm}x${sheet.thickness_mm}mm`);
  lines.push(`; Parts: ${sheetResult.placements.length}`);
  lines.push(`; Utilization: ${sheetResult.utilization_percent}%`);
  lines.push(`; Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  lines.push(`; ==============================`);
  lines.push(``);

  lines.push(`G90 G21`);
  lines.push(`G17`);
  lines.push(`G28`);
  lines.push(`M3 S${effectiveConfig.spindle_speed}`);
  lines.push(`G4 P2`);
  lines.push(``);

  for (let i = 0; i < sheetResult.placements.length; i++) {
    const p = sheetResult.placements[i];
    lines.push(
      `; --- Part ${i + 1}: ${p.part_label} (${p.width}x${p.height}mm${p.rotated ? " ROTATED" : ""}) ---`
    );
    lines.push(...generatePartCut(p, sheet, effectiveConfig));
    lines.push(``);
  }

  lines.push(`; --- End ---`);
  lines.push(`G0 Z${formatNum(effectiveConfig.safe_z)}`);
  lines.push(`M5`);
  lines.push(`G28`);
  lines.push(`M30`);
  lines.push(``);

  return lines.join("\n");
}

export function generateErpFullGCode(
  sheetResults: ErpNestingSheetResult[],
  sheet: ErpNestingSheet,
  config: ErpGCodeConfig = DEFAULT_ERP_GCODE_CONFIG
): string {
  return sheetResults
    .map((sr) => generateErpSheetGCode(sr, sheet, config))
    .join("\n\n");
}

function generatePartCut(
  placement: ErpPlacementData,
  sheet: ErpNestingSheet,
  config: ErpGCodeConfig
): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const toolRadius = config.tool_diameter / 2;

  // Not: ERP runMaxRects ve GuillotineEngine içinde placement.x ve placement.y
  // zaten margin eklenmiş mutlak plaka koordinatlarıdır (örn. x = 15).
  // ERP gcodeGenerator.ts uyumluluğu için sınır kontrolü ile güvenli kesim yolu üretilir.
  const x1 = placement.x - toolRadius;
  const y1 = placement.y - toolRadius;
  const x2 = placement.x + placement.width + toolRadius;
  const y2 = placement.y + placement.height + toolRadius;

  const passes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(config.cut_depth / config.pass_depth));

  for (let pass = 0; pass < passes; pass++) {
    const depth = Math.min((pass + 1) * config.pass_depth, config.cut_depth);
    if (passes > 1) {
      lines.push(`; Pass ${pass + 1}/${passes} depth: ${formatNum(depth)}mm`);
    }

    lines.push(`G0 Z${formatNum(config.safe_z)}`);
    lines.push(`G0 X${formatNum(x1)} Y${formatNum(y1)}`);
    lines.push(`G1 Z${formatNum(-depth)} F${config.plunge_rate}`);
    lines.push(`G1 X${formatNum(x2)} F${config.feed_rate}`);
    lines.push(`G1 Y${formatNum(y2)}`);
    lines.push(`G1 X${formatNum(x1)}`);
    lines.push(`G1 Y${formatNum(y1)}`);
    lines.push(`G0 Z${formatNum(config.safe_z)}`);
  }

  return lines;
}

function formatNum(n: number): string {
  return n.toFixed(3);
}

export function getErpGCodeFilename(projectNo: string, sheetIndex?: number): string {
  const base = projectNo.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/g, "_");
  if (sheetIndex !== undefined) {
    return `${base}_sheet${sheetIndex + 1}.nc`;
  }
  return `${base}_all.nc`;
}

// --- 2. Selco WNT 600 (Biesse OptiPlanning) CSV Exporter ---
// Format: Label;Qty;Length;Width;Material;Grain;EdgeL1;EdgeL2;EdgeW1;EdgeW2

export function generateErpSelcoCSV(
  project: ErpNestingProject,
  parts: ErpNestingPart[]
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push("Label;Qty;Length;Width;Material;Grain;EdgeL1;EdgeL2;EdgeW1;EdgeW2");

  for (const part of parts) {
    let grainCode = 0;
    if (part.grain_direction === "vertical") grainCode = 1;
    if (part.grain_direction === "horizontal") grainCode = 2;

    const edges = resolveSelcoPartEdges(part);

    const cleanMaterial =
      (part.material_code || project.sheet?.material_type || "MDF")
        .replace(/\[grain:(vertical|horizontal|none)\]/gi, "")
        .replace(/;/g, " ")
        .trim() || "MDF";

    const row = [
      part.part_label.replace(/;/g, " "),
      part.quantity,
      part.height_mm,
      part.width_mm,
      cleanMaterial,
      grainCode,
      edges.l1,
      edges.l2,
      edges.w1,
      edges.w2,
    ];

    lines.push(row.join(";"));
  }

  return lines.join("\r\n");
}

function resolveSelcoPartEdges(part: ErpNestingPart): {
  l1: number;
  l2: number;
  w1: number;
  w2: number;
} {
  // 1. Açık kenar alanları (edgeL1..edgeW2) varsa doğrudan kullan
  if (
    part.edgeL1 !== undefined ||
    part.edgeL2 !== undefined ||
    part.edgeW1 !== undefined ||
    part.edgeW2 !== undefined
  ) {
    return {
      l1: part.edgeL1 && part.edgeL1.trim() ? 1 : 0,
      l2: part.edgeL2 && part.edgeL2.trim() ? 1 : 0,
      w1: part.edgeW1 && part.edgeW1.trim() ? 1 : 0,
      w2: part.edgeW2 && part.edgeW2.trim() ? 1 : 0,
    };
  }

  // 2. JSON serileştirilmiş edge_banding ("{\"edgeL1\":\"1.00mm PVC\",...}") ise ayrıştır
  if (part.edge_banding && part.edge_banding.trim().startsWith("{")) {
    const parsed = parseErpEdgeBanding(part.edge_banding);
    return {
      l1: parsed.edgeL1 ? 1 : 0,
      l2: parsed.edgeL2 ? 1 : 0,
      w1: parsed.edgeW1 ? 1 : 0,
      w2: parsed.edgeW2 ? 1 : 0,
    };
  }

  // 3. Düz metin ("L1,W1") ise ERP selcoExporter.ts ile birebir geriye dönük uyumlu kontrol
  const eb = part.edge_banding || "";
  return {
    l1: eb.includes("L1") ? 1 : 0,
    l2: eb.includes("L2") ? 1 : 0,
    w1: eb.includes("W1") ? 1 : 0,
    w2: eb.includes("W2") ? 1 : 0,
  };
}

export function getErpSelcoFilename(projectNo: string): string {
  const base = projectNo.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/g, "_");
  return `${base}_SELCO_WNT600.csv`;
}
