// ============================================================================
// packages/manufacturing/src/erp-nesting/erp-guillotine-engine.ts
// Birim ERP lib/nestingEngines/GuillotineEngine.ts birebir ebatlama motoru
// Ebatlama makineleri (Selco WNT 600, Holzma, Biesse) için şerit kesim,
// kesim sırası (CutSequence) ve operatör kesim reçetesi üretir.
// ============================================================================

import type {
  ErpNestingPartInput,
  ErpNestingSheetResult,
  ErpPlacementData,
  ErpCutSequence,
  ErpNestingOptimizationSettings,
  ErpGrainDirection,
  ErpRectData,
} from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { getErpPartColor } from "./erp-nesting-types";

export interface ErpSheetConfig {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  kerf: number;
  margin: number;
  grain_direction?: ErpGrainDirection | null;
}

interface PartToPack {
  originalIndex: number;
  instanceIndex: number;
  partId: string;
  label: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  canRotate: boolean;
  grainDirection: string;
  color: string;
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
  hasGroove?: boolean;
  grooveSide?: string;
  grooveOffset?: number;
  grooveWidth?: number;
  grooveDepth?: number;
}

interface GuillotineShelf {
  y: number;
  height: number;
  usedWidth: number;
}

interface GuillotineSheetState {
  index: number;
  placements: ErpPlacementData[];
  sequences: ErpCutSequence[];
  shelves: GuillotineShelf[];
  usedArea: number;
  cuttingInstructions: string[];
}

export class ErpGuillotineEngine {
  public static optimize(
    parts: ErpNestingPartInput[],
    width: number,
    height: number,
    kerf: number,
    margin: number,
    settings?: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings
  ): {
    sheets: ErpNestingSheetResult[];
    totalPartsPlaced: number;
    totalPartsRequested: number;
  } {
    const sheets = ErpGuillotineEngine.run(
      parts,
      { width, height, kerf, margin },
      settings
    );
    const totalPlaced = sheets.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.placements.length, 0);
    const totalRequested = parts.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (p.quantity || 1), 0);
    return {
      sheets,
      totalPartsPlaced: totalPlaced,
      totalPartsRequested: totalRequested,
    };
  }

  public static run(
    parts: ErpNestingPartInput[],
    sheet: ErpSheetConfig,
    settings?: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings
  ): ErpNestingSheetResult[] {
    const margin = Number(settings?.edgeMargin ?? settings?.margin ?? sheet.margin);
    const useCommon = Boolean(settings?.useCommonCut ?? settings?.commonCut);
    const spacing = useCommon ? 0 : Number(settings?.partSpacing ?? settings?.spacing ?? 0);
    const kerf = useCommon ? 0 : Number(settings?.sawKerf ?? settings?.kerf ?? sheet.kerf);

    const sheetL = Number(sheet.width);
    const sheetW = Number(sheet.height);
    const usableL = sheetL - 2 * margin;
    const usableW = sheetW - 2 * margin;

    if (usableL <= 0 || usableW <= 0 || parts.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const baseParts: PartToPack[] = [];
    let colorIdx = 0;
    const sheetGrain: ErpGrainDirection = sheet.grain_direction || "vertical";
    const sheetIsPlain = sheetGrain === "none";

    parts.forEach((p, pIdx) => {
      const qty = Math.max(1, p.quantity || 1);
      const col = getErpPartColor(colorIdx++);

      const effectivePartGrain: ErpGrainDirection = sheetIsPlain
        ? "none"
        : p.grain_direction || sheetGrain;
      const isGrainLocked = !sheetIsPlain && effectivePartGrain !== "none";
      const canRotate =
        !isGrainLocked &&
        Boolean(p.can_rotate) &&
        (settings?.allowRotation ?? settings?.rotationAllowed ?? true);

      for (let i = 0; i < qty; i++) {
        baseParts.push({
          originalIndex: pIdx,
          instanceIndex: i,
          partId: `part_${pIdx}_${i}`,
          label: p.part_label,
          width: p.width_mm,
          height: p.height_mm,
          canRotate,
          grainDirection: effectivePartGrain,
          color: col,
          edgeL1: p.edgeL1,
          edgeL2: p.edgeL2,
          edgeW1: p.edgeW1,
          edgeW2: p.edgeW2,
          hasGroove: p.hasGroove,
          grooveSide: p.grooveSide,
          grooveOffset: p.grooveOffset,
          grooveWidth: p.grooveWidth,
          grooveDepth: p.grooveDepth,
        });
      }
    });

    const heuristics: ((list: PartToPack[]) => PartToPack[])[] = [
      (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => (b.height !== a.height ? b.height - a.height : b.width - a.width)),
      (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => (b.width !== a.width ? b.width - a.width : b.height - a.height)),
      (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => b.width * b.height - a.width * a.height),
      (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => Math.max(b.width, b.height) - Math.max(a.width, a.height)),
      (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => b.width + b.height - (a.width + a.height)),
    ];

    let bestPacking: GuillotineSheetState[] | null = null;
    let minSheets = Infinity;
    let maxDensity = -1;

    for (const heuristic of heuristics) {
      const sorted = heuristic(baseParts);
      const packing = this.runPacking(
        sorted,
        sheetL,
        sheetW,
        usableL,
        usableW,
        spacing,
        margin,
        kerf,
        !sheetIsPlain && (settings?.grainRule ?? settings?.considerGrain ?? true)
      );

      if (packing.length > 0) {
        const totalUsed = packing.reduce((s, sh) => s + sh.usedArea, 0);
        const totalUsable = packing.length * sheetL * sheetW;
        const density = totalUsable > 0 ? totalUsed / totalUsable : 0;

        if (packing.length < minSheets || (packing.length === minSheets && density > maxDensity)) {
          minSheets = packing.length;
          maxDensity = density;
          bestPacking = packing;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!bestPacking) return [];

    const sheetTotalArea = sheetL * sheetW;
    return bestPacking.map((s) => {
      const placedArea = s.placements.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.width * p.height, 0);
      const wasteMm2 = Math.max(0, sheetTotalArea - placedArea);
      const utilization =
        sheetTotalArea > 0 ? Math.round((placedArea / sheetTotalArea) * 10000) / 100 : 0;

      // Şerit sonu ve alt plaka boşluklarını free_rects olarak çıkar (Fire geri kazanımı ile tam uyum)
      const freeRects: ErpRectData[] = [];
      for (const shelf of s.shelves) {
        const tailX = shelf.usedWidth + kerf;
        const tailW = sheetL - margin - tailX;
        if (tailW >= 50 && shelf.height >= 50) {
          freeRects.push({
            x: Math.max(0, tailX - margin),
            y: Math.max(0, shelf.y - margin),
            width: Math.round(tailW),
            height: Math.round(shelf.height),
          });
        }
      }
      if (s.shelves.length > 0) {
        const lastShelf = s.shelves[s.shelves.length - 1];
        const bottomY = lastShelf.y + lastShelf.height + kerf;
        const bottomH = sheetW - margin - bottomY;
        if (usableL >= 50 && bottomH >= 50) {
          freeRects.push({
            x: 0,
            y: Math.max(0, bottomY - margin),
            width: Math.round(usableL),
            height: Math.round(bottomH),
          });
        }
      }

      return {
        sheet_index: s.index,
        placements: s.placements,
        utilization_percent: utilization,
        waste_mm2: wasteMm2,
        free_rects: freeRects,
        sequences: s.sequences,
        cuttingInstructions: s.cuttingInstructions,
        sheet_width: sheetL,
        sheet_height: sheetW,
      };
    });
  }

  private static runPacking(
    parts: PartToPack[],
    sheetL: number,
    sheetW: number,
    usableL: number,
    usableW: number,
    spacing: number,
    margin: number,
    kerf: number,
    grainRule: boolean
  ): GuillotineSheetState[] {
    const sheets: GuillotineSheetState[] = [];

    for (const part of parts) {
      let pLength = part.width;
      let pWidth = part.height;
      let canRotate = part.canRotate;
      let baseRotated = false;

      if (grainRule && part.grainDirection !== "none") {
        canRotate = false;
        if (part.grainDirection === "vertical") {
          pLength = part.width;
          pWidth = part.height;
          baseRotated = false;
        } else if (part.grainDirection === "horizontal") {
          pLength = part.height;
          pWidth = part.width;
          baseRotated = true;
        }
      }

      // Parça hiçbir yönde kullanılabilir plakaya sığmıyorsa atla (sonsuz/taşan plaka önleme)
      const fitsNormal = pLength <= usableL && pWidth <= usableW;
      const fitsRotated = canRotate && pWidth <= usableL && pLength <= usableW;
      if (!fitsNormal && !fitsRotated) {
        continue;
      }

      let placed = false;

      for (const sheet of sheets) {
        if (
          this.tryPlace(
            sheet,
            part,
            pLength,
            pWidth,
            canRotate,
            baseRotated,
            usableL,
            usableW,
            spacing,
            margin,
            kerf
          )
        ) {
          placed = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!placed) {
        const newSheet: GuillotineSheetState = {
          index: sheets.length,
          placements: [],
          sequences: [],
          shelves: [],
          usedArea: 0,
          cuttingInstructions: [],
        };
        sheets.push(newSheet);

        this.tryPlace(
          newSheet,
          part,
          pLength,
          pWidth,
          canRotate,
          baseRotated,
          usableL,
          usableW,
          spacing,
          margin,
          kerf
        );
      }
    }

    const validSheets = sheets.filter((s) => s.placements.length > 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < validSheets.length; i++) {
      validSheets[i].index = i;
      this.generateCutSequences(validSheets[i], sheetL, sheetW, spacing, margin);
      this.generateInstructions(validSheets[i], sheetL, sheetW, margin, kerf);
    }

    return validSheets;
  }

  private static tryPlace(
    sheet: GuillotineSheetState,
    part: PartToPack,
    pLength: number,
    pWidth: number,
    canRotate: boolean,
    baseRotated: boolean,
    usableL: number,
    usableW: number,
    spacing: number,
    margin: number,
    kerf: number
  ): boolean {
    let bestShelf: GuillotineShelf | null = null;
    let bestRotated = false;
    let bestW = pLength;
    let bestH = pWidth;
    let minRemaining = Infinity;

    for (const shelf of sheet.shelves) {
      const reqW1 = shelf.usedWidth === margin ? pLength : spacing + kerf + pLength;
      if (shelf.usedWidth + reqW1 <= usableL + margin && pWidth <= shelf.height) {
        const rem = usableL + margin - (shelf.usedWidth + reqW1);
        if (rem < minRemaining) {
          minRemaining = rem;
          bestShelf = shelf;
          bestRotated = false;
          bestW = pLength;
          bestH = pWidth;
        }
      }

      if (canRotate && pLength !== pWidth) {
        const reqW2 = shelf.usedWidth === margin ? pWidth : spacing + kerf + pWidth;
        if (shelf.usedWidth + reqW2 <= usableL + margin && pLength <= shelf.height) {
          const rem = usableL + margin - (shelf.usedWidth + reqW2);
          if (rem < minRemaining) {
            minRemaining = rem;
            bestShelf = shelf;
            bestRotated = true;
            bestW = pWidth;
            bestH = pLength;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (bestShelf) {
      let placementX = bestShelf.usedWidth;
      if (bestShelf.usedWidth > margin) {
        placementX += spacing + kerf;
      }

      sheet.placements.push({
        part_id: part.partId,
        part_label: part.label,
        x: placementX,
        y: bestShelf.y,
        width: bestW,
        height: bestH,
        rotated: baseRotated || bestRotated,
        rotation: baseRotated || bestRotated ? 90 : 0,
        color: part.color,
        edgeL1: part.edgeL1,
        edgeL2: part.edgeL2,
        edgeW1: part.edgeW1,
        edgeW2: part.edgeW2,
        hasGroove: part.hasGroove,
        grooveSide: part.grooveSide,
        grooveOffset: part.grooveOffset,
        grooveWidth: part.grooveWidth,
        grooveDepth: part.grooveDepth,
        grain_direction: (part.grainDirection as ErpGrainDirection) || null,
        can_rotate: part.canRotate,
      });

      bestShelf.usedWidth = placementX + bestW;
      sheet.usedArea += bestW * bestH;
      return true;
    }

    let newShelfY = margin;
    if (sheet.shelves.length > 0) {
      const lastShelf = sheet.shelves[sheet.shelves.length - 1];
      newShelfY = lastShelf.y + lastShelf.height + spacing + kerf;
    }

    if (newShelfY + pWidth <= usableW + margin && pLength <= usableL) {
      const newShelf: GuillotineShelf = {
        y: newShelfY,
        height: pWidth,
        usedWidth: margin + pLength,
      };
      sheet.shelves.push(newShelf);
      sheet.placements.push({
        part_id: part.partId,
        part_label: part.label,
        x: margin,
        y: newShelfY,
        width: pLength,
        height: pWidth,
        rotated: baseRotated,
        rotation: baseRotated ? 90 : 0,
        color: part.color,
        edgeL1: part.edgeL1,
        edgeL2: part.edgeL2,
        edgeW1: part.edgeW1,
        edgeW2: part.edgeW2,
        hasGroove: part.hasGroove,
        grooveSide: part.grooveSide,
        grooveOffset: part.grooveOffset,
        grooveWidth: part.grooveWidth,
        grooveDepth: part.grooveDepth,
        grain_direction: (part.grainDirection as ErpGrainDirection) || null,
        can_rotate: part.canRotate,
      });
      sheet.usedArea += pLength * pWidth;
      return true;
    }

    if (
      canRotate &&
      pLength !== pWidth &&
      newShelfY + pLength <= usableW + margin &&
      pWidth <= usableL
    ) {
      const newShelf: GuillotineShelf = {
        y: newShelfY,
        height: pLength,
        usedWidth: margin + pWidth,
      };
      sheet.shelves.push(newShelf);
      sheet.placements.push({
        part_id: part.partId,
        part_label: part.label,
        x: margin,
        y: newShelfY,
        width: pWidth,
        height: pLength,
        rotated: true,
        rotation: 90,
        color: part.color,
        edgeL1: part.edgeL1,
        edgeL2: part.edgeL2,
        edgeW1: part.edgeW1,
        edgeW2: part.edgeW2,
        hasGroove: part.hasGroove,
        grooveSide: part.grooveSide,
        grooveOffset: part.grooveOffset,
        grooveWidth: part.grooveWidth,
        grooveDepth: part.grooveDepth,
        grain_direction: (part.grainDirection as ErpGrainDirection) || null,
        can_rotate: part.canRotate,
      });
      sheet.usedArea += pWidth * pLength;
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  private static generateCutSequences(
    sheet: GuillotineSheetState,
    sheetL: number,
    _sheetW: number,
    spacing: number,
    _margin: number
  ): void {
    sheet.sequences = [];
    let step = 1;

    for (const shelf of sheet.shelves) {
      const ripY = shelf.y + shelf.height + spacing / 2;
      sheet.sequences.push({
        stepNumber: step++,
        x1: 0,
        y1: ripY,
        x2: sheetL,
        y2: ripY,
        type: "rip",
        description: `Boy Kesim (Y=${ripY.toFixed(0)}mm)`,
      });

      const shelfPlacements = sheet.placements.filter((p) => p.y === shelf.y);
      for (const pl of shelfPlacements) {
        const crossX = pl.x + pl.width + spacing / 2;
        sheet.sequences.push({
          stepNumber: step++,
          x1: crossX,
          y1: shelf.y,
          x2: crossX,
          y2: shelf.y + shelf.height,
          type: "cross",
          description: `En Kesim (X=${crossX.toFixed(0)}mm - ${pl.part_label})`,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  private static generateInstructions(
    sheet: GuillotineSheetState,
    sheetL: number,
    sheetW: number,
    margin: number,
    kerf: number
  ): void {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    lines.push(`PLAKA #${sheet.index + 1} - EBATLAMA KESİM REÇETESİ (GUILLOTINE)`);
    lines.push(
      `Plaka: ${sheetL} x ${sheetW} mm | Kenar Payı: ${margin} mm | Bıçak (Kerf): ${kerf} mm`
    );
    lines.push("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let step = 1;
    for (const shelf of sheet.shelves) {
      const ripY = shelf.y + shelf.height;
      lines.push(
        `${step++}. ADIM [BOYUNA KESİM]: Panel Y=${ripY.toFixed(0)} mm hizasından boydan boya kesilir.`
      );
      lines.push(`   -> Elde edilen şerit genişliği: ${shelf.height.toFixed(0)} mm`);

      const shelfParts = sheet.placements
        .filter((p) => p.y === shelf.y)
        .sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      for (const p of shelfParts) {
        const crossX = p.x + p.width;
        lines.push(
          `   -> [ENİNE KESİM]: Şerit X=${crossX.toFixed(0)} mm kesilir -> Çıktı: "${p.part_label}" (${p.width}x${p.height} mm)`
        );
      }

      const remW = sheetL - margin - shelf.usedWidth;
      if (remW >= 200) {
        lines.push(
          `   -> [ARTIK ŞERİT]: ${remW.toFixed(0)} x ${shelf.height.toFixed(0)} mm kullanılabilir parça.`
        );
      }
    }

    sheet.cuttingInstructions = lines;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// packages/manufacturing/src/erp-nesting/erp-nesting-algorithm.ts
// Birim ERP lib/nestingAlgorithm.ts birebir MaxRects / Guillotine / Auto motoru
// ve Fire Geri Kazanımı (extractErpReclaimableRemnants)
// ============================================================================

import type {
  ErpNestingPartInput,
  ErpNestingOptimizationResult,
  ErpNestingSheetResult,
  ErpPlacementData,
  ErpReclaimableRemnant,
  ErpNestingOptimizationSettings,
  ErpCutSequence,
  ErpGrainDirection,
} from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { getErpPartColor } from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { ErpGuillotineEngine, type ErpSheetConfig } from "./erp-guillotine-engine";

interface ExpandedPart {
  original_index: number;
  instance_index: number;
  part_id: string;
  label: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  can_rotate: boolean;
  grain_direction: ErpGrainDirection | null;
  area: number;
  color: string;
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
  hasGroove?: boolean;
  grooveSide?: string;
  grooveOffset?: number;
  grooveWidth?: number;
  grooveDepth?: number;
}

interface MaxRect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

interface SheetState {
  index: number;
  free_rects: MaxRect[];
  placements: ErpPlacementData[];
  used_area: number;
  is_remnant?: boolean;
  remnant_id?: string;
  sheet_name?: string;
  usable_width?: number;
  usable_height?: number;
  sheet_width?: number;
  sheet_height?: number;
}

export function runErpNesting(
  parts: ErpNestingPartInput[],
  sheet: ErpSheetConfig,
  settings?: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings
): ErpNestingOptimizationResult {
  const chosenAlgo = settings?.algorithm ?? "Auto";

  if (chosenAlgo === "Guillotine") {
    const guillotineSheets = ErpGuillotineEngine.run(parts, sheet, settings);
    const totalPlaced = guillotineSheets.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.placements.length, 0);
    const totalReq = parts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Math.max(1, p.quantity || 1), 0);
    const totalUsed = guillotineSheets.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + s.placements.reduce((ps, p) => ps + p.width * p.height, 0),
      0
    );
    const totalAvailable =
      guillotineSheets.length * Number(sheet.width) * Number(sheet.height);
    const overallUtil = totalAvailable > 0 ? (totalUsed / totalAvailable) * 100 : 0;
    const totalWaste = Math.max(0, totalAvailable - totalUsed);

    return {
      sheets: guillotineSheets,
      total_parts_placed: totalPlaced,
      total_parts_requested: totalReq,
      overall_utilization: Math.round(overallUtil * 100) / 100,
      total_waste_mm2: totalWaste,
      algorithm: "Guillotine",
      computed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      settings,
    };
  }

  if (chosenAlgo === "Auto") {
    const maxRectsRes = runMaxRects(parts, sheet, settings);
    const guillotineRes = runErpNesting(parts, sheet, {
      ...settings,
      algorithm: "Guillotine",
    });

    if (guillotineRes.sheets.length > 0 && maxRectsRes.sheets.length > 0) {
      if (
        guillotineRes.sheets.length < maxRectsRes.sheets.length ||
        (guillotineRes.sheets.length === maxRectsRes.sheets.length &&
          guillotineRes.overall_utilization >= maxRectsRes.overall_utilization)
      ) {
        return guillotineRes;
      }
    } else if (guillotineRes.sheets.length > 0 && maxRectsRes.sheets.length === 0) {
      return guillotineRes;
    }
    return maxRectsRes;
  }

  return runMaxRects(parts, sheet, settings);
}

function runMaxRects(
  parts: ErpNestingPartInput[],
  sheet: ErpSheetConfig,
  settings?: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings
): ErpNestingOptimizationResult {
  const margin = Number(settings?.edgeMargin ?? settings?.margin ?? sheet.margin);
  const useCommon = Boolean(settings?.useCommonCut ?? settings?.commonCut);
  const kerf = useCommon ? 0 : Number(settings?.sawKerf ?? settings?.kerf ?? sheet.kerf);
  const usableWidth = Number(sheet.width) - 2 * margin;
  const usableHeight = Number(sheet.height) - 2 * margin;

  if (usableWidth <= 0 || usableHeight <= 0) {
    return emptyResult();
  }

  const expanded = expandParts(parts, settings, sheet);
  if (expanded.length === 0) {
    return emptyResult();
  }

  expanded.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area);

  const sheets: SheetState[] = [];
  let totalPlaced = 0;

  if (settings?.priorityRemnantSheets && settings.priorityRemnantSheets.length > 0) {
    for (let ri = 0; ri < settings.priorityRemnantSheets.length; ri++) {
      const rSheet = settings.priorityRemnantSheets[ri];
      const rMargin = Number(
        settings?.edgeMargin ?? settings?.margin ?? rSheet.margin ?? sheet.margin
      );
      const rUsableW = Number(rSheet.width) - 2 * rMargin;
      const rUsableH = Number(rSheet.height) - 2 * rMargin;
      if (rUsableW > 0 && rUsableH > 0) {
        sheets.push(
          createSheet(sheets.length, rUsableW, rUsableH, {
            is_remnant: true,
            remnant_id: rSheet.id,
            sheet_name: rSheet.name || `Artık Plaka ${ri + 1}`,
            sheet_width: Number(rSheet.width),
            sheet_height: Number(rSheet.height),
          })
        );
      }
    }
  }

  for (const part of expanded) {
    const partW = part.width + kerf;
    const partH = part.height + kerf;

    let placed = false;

    for (const sheetState of sheets) {
      const sUsableW = sheetState.usable_width ?? usableWidth;
      const sUsableH = sheetState.usable_height ?? usableHeight;
      if (
        tryPlace(sheetState, partW, partH, part, sheet, sUsableW, sUsableH, margin, kerf)
      ) {
        placed = true;
        totalPlaced++;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!placed) {
      const newSheet = createSheet(sheets.length, usableWidth, usableHeight, {
        is_remnant: false,
        sheet_width: Number(sheet.width),
        sheet_height: Number(sheet.height),
      });
      if (
        tryPlace(newSheet, partW, partH, part, sheet, usableWidth, usableHeight, margin, kerf)
      ) {
        sheets.push(newSheet);
        totalPlaced++;
      }
    }
  }

  const totalRequested = expanded.length;
  const activeSheets = sheets.filter((s) => s.placements.length > 0);

  const sheetResults: ErpNestingSheetResult[] = activeSheets.map((s, idx) => {
    const sUsableW = s.usable_width ?? usableWidth;
    const sUsableH = s.usable_height ?? usableHeight;
    const sArea = sUsableW * sUsableH;
    const utilization = sArea > 0 ? (s.used_area / sArea) * 100 : 0;
    const waste = sArea - s.used_area;

    const sequences: ErpCutSequence[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < s.placements.length - 1; i++) {
      const p1 = s.placements[i];
      const p2 = s.placements[i + 1];
      sequences.push({
        stepNumber: i + 1,
        x1: p1.x + p1.width / 2,
        y1: p1.y + p1.height / 2,
        x2: p2.x + p2.width / 2,
        y2: p2.y + p2.height / 2,
        isTraversal: true,
      });
    }

    if (useCommon) {
      const tolerance = 1.0;
      s.placements.forEach((pl) => {
        const sh = { top: false, bottom: false, left: false, right: false };
        const x1 = pl.x;
        const x2 = pl.x + pl.width;
        const y1 = pl.y;
        const y2 = pl.y + pl.height;
        for (const other of s.placements) {
          if (other.part_id === pl.part_id) continue;
          const ox1 = other.x;
          const ox2 = other.x + other.width;
          const oy1 = other.y;
          const oy2 = other.y + other.height;
          const yOverlap = Math.min(y2, oy2) - Math.max(y1, oy1) > tolerance;
          const xOverlap = Math.min(x2, ox2) - Math.max(x1, ox1) > tolerance;
          if (yOverlap) {
            if (Math.abs(x1 - ox2) < tolerance) sh.left = true;
            if (Math.abs(x2 - ox1) < tolerance) sh.right = true;
          }
          if (xOverlap) {
            if (Math.abs(y1 - oy2) < tolerance) sh.top = true;
            if (Math.abs(y2 - oy1) < tolerance) sh.bottom = true;
          }
        }
        pl.isSharedEdge = sh;
      });
    }

    return {
      sheet_index: idx,
      placements: s.placements,
      utilization_percent: Math.round(utilization * 100) / 100,
      waste_mm2: Math.round(waste * 100) / 100,
      free_rects: s.free_rects.map((r) => ({
        x: r.x,
        y: r.y,
        width: r.width,
        height: r.height,
      })),
      sequences,
      is_remnant: s.is_remnant || false,
      remnant_id: s.remnant_id,
      sheet_name: s.sheet_name,
      sheet_width: s.sheet_width,
      sheet_height: s.sheet_height,
    };
  });

  const totalUsedArea = activeSheets.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.used_area, 0);
  const totalAvailableArea = activeSheets.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + (s.usable_width ?? usableWidth) * (s.usable_height ?? usableHeight),
    0
  );
  const overallUtilization =
    totalAvailableArea > 0 ? (totalUsedArea / totalAvailableArea) * 100 : 0;

  return {
    sheets: sheetResults,
    total_parts_placed: totalPlaced,
    total_parts_requested: totalRequested,
    overall_utilization: Math.round(overallUtilization * 100) / 100,
    total_waste_mm2: Math.round((totalAvailableArea - totalUsedArea) * 100) / 100,
    algorithm: "bottom-left-maxrects",
    computed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    settings,
  };
}

export function extractErpReclaimableRemnants(
  sheetResult: ErpNestingSheetResult,
  opts?: {
    minWidthMm?: number;
    minHeightMm?: number;
    sheetCost?: number | null;
    sheetAreaMm2?: number;
  }
): ErpReclaimableRemnant[] {
  const minW = opts?.minWidthMm ?? 400;
  const minH = opts?.minHeightMm ?? 400;
  const sheetCost = opts?.sheetCost ?? 0;
  const sheetArea = opts?.sheetAreaMm2 ?? 0;

  if (!sheetResult.free_rects || sheetResult.free_rects.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }

  const candidates = sheetResult.free_rects
    .filter(
      (r) =>
        (r.width >= minW && r.height >= minH) ||
        (r.width >= minH && r.height >= minW)
    )
    .map((r) => ({
      ...r,
      area: r.width * r.height,
    }));

  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area);

  const selected: typeof candidates = [];

  for (const cand of candidates) {
    const overlaps = selected.some((s) => {
      const isDisjoint =
        cand.x + cand.width <= s.x ||
        s.x + s.width <= cand.x ||
        cand.y + cand.height <= s.y ||
        s.y + s.height <= cand.y;
      return !isDisjoint;
    });

    if (!overlaps) {
      selected.push(cand);
    }
  }

  return selected.map((r, idx) => {
    const area_mm2 = r.width * r.height;
    const estVal =
      sheetCost && sheetArea > 0
        ? Math.round((area_mm2 / sheetArea) * sheetCost * 100) / 100
        : 0;

    return {
      sheet_index: sheetResult.sheet_index,
      remnant_index: idx + 1,
      x_mm: r.x,
      y_mm: r.y,
      width_mm: r.width,
      height_mm: r.height,
      area_mm2,
      estimated_value: estVal,
    };
  });
}

function emptyResult(): ErpNestingOptimizationResult {
  return {
    sheets: [],
    total_parts_placed: 0,
    total_parts_requested: 0,
    overall_utilization: 0,
    total_waste_mm2: 0,
    algorithm: "bottom-left-maxrects",
    computed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

function expandParts(
  parts: ErpNestingPartInput[],
  settings?: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings,
  sheet?: ErpSheetConfig
): ExpandedPart[] {
  const expanded: ExpandedPart[] = [];
  const globalRotationAllowed =
    settings?.rotationAllowed ?? settings?.allowRotation ?? true;
  const sheetGrain = sheet?.grain_direction || "vertical";
  const sheetIsPlain = sheetGrain === "none";

  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    const part = parts[i];
    const isHorizontalGrain =
      !sheetIsPlain && part.grain_direction === "horizontal";
    const w = isHorizontalGrain ? Number(part.height_mm) : Number(part.width_mm);
    const h = isHorizontalGrain ? Number(part.width_mm) : Number(part.height_mm);

    const partExplicitGrain =
      part.grain_direction === "horizontal" || part.grain_direction === "vertical";
    const effectivePartGrain: ErpGrainDirection | null = partExplicitGrain
      ? part.grain_direction
      : sheetIsPlain
      ? "none"
      : sheetGrain;
    const isGrainLocked =
      partExplicitGrain || (!sheetIsPlain && effectivePartGrain !== "none");
    const canRotate =
      !isGrainLocked && Boolean(part.can_rotate) && globalRotationAllowed;

    for (let q = 0; q < Number(part.quantity); q++) {
      expanded.push({
        original_index: i,
        instance_index: q,
        part_id: `part-${i}-${q}`,
        label: part.part_label,
        width: w,
        height: h,
        can_rotate: canRotate,
        grain_direction: effectivePartGrain,
        area: w * h,
        color: getErpPartColor(i),
        edgeL1: part.edgeL1,
        edgeL2: part.edgeL2,
        edgeW1: part.edgeW1,
        edgeW2: part.edgeW2,
        hasGroove: part.hasGroove,
        grooveSide: part.grooveSide,
        grooveOffset: part.grooveOffset,
        grooveWidth: part.grooveWidth,
        grooveDepth: part.grooveDepth,
      });
    }
  }

  return expanded;
}

function createSheet(
  index: number,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  meta?: {
    is_remnant?: boolean;
    remnant_id?: string;
    sheet_name?: string;
    sheet_width?: number;
    sheet_height?: number;
  }
): SheetState {
  return {
    index,
    free_rects: [{ x: 0, y: 0, width, height }],
    placements: [],
    used_area: 0,
    is_remnant: meta?.is_remnant || false,
    remnant_id: meta?.remnant_id,
    sheet_name: meta?.sheet_name,
    usable_width: width,
    usable_height: height,
    sheet_width: meta?.sheet_width,
    sheet_height: meta?.sheet_height,
  };
}

function tryPlace(
  sheetState: SheetState,
  partW: number,
  partH: number,
  part: ExpandedPart,
  _config: ErpSheetConfig,
  _usableWidth: number,
  _usableHeight: number,
  margin: number,
  kerf: number
): boolean {
  let bestShortSideFit = Infinity;
  let bestLongSideFit = Infinity;
  let bestRotated = false;
  let bestRectIndex = -1;
  const canRotate =
    part.can_rotate && (!part.grain_direction || part.grain_direction === "none");

  for (let i = 0; i < sheetState.free_rects.length; i++) {
    const rect = sheetState.free_rects[i];

    if (partW <= rect.width && partH <= rect.height) {
      const leftoverW = Math.abs(rect.width - partW);
      const leftoverH = Math.abs(rect.height - partH);
      const shortSideFit = Math.min(leftoverW, leftoverH);
      const longSideFit = Math.max(leftoverW, leftoverH);

      if (
        shortSideFit < bestShortSideFit ||
        (shortSideFit === bestShortSideFit && longSideFit < bestLongSideFit)
      ) {
        bestShortSideFit = shortSideFit;
        bestLongSideFit = longSideFit;
        bestRotated = false;
        bestRectIndex = i;
      }
    }

    if (canRotate && partH <= rect.width && partW <= rect.height) {
      const leftoverW = Math.abs(rect.width - partH);
      const leftoverH = Math.abs(rect.height - partW);
      const shortSideFit = Math.min(leftoverW, leftoverH);
      const longSideFit = Math.max(leftoverW, leftoverH);

      if (
        shortSideFit < bestShortSideFit ||
        (shortSideFit === bestShortSideFit && longSideFit < bestLongSideFit)
      ) {
        bestShortSideFit = shortSideFit;
        bestLongSideFit = longSideFit;
        bestRotated = true;
        bestRectIndex = i;
      }
    }
  }

  if (bestRectIndex === -1) {
    return false;
  }

  const bestRect = sheetState.free_rects[bestRectIndex];
  const placedW = bestRotated ? partH : partW;
  const placedH = bestRotated ? partW : partH;
  const actualW = placedW - kerf;
  const actualH = placedH - kerf;

  const placement: ErpPlacementData = {
    part_id: part.part_id,
    part_label: part.label,
    x: margin + bestRect.x,
    y: margin + bestRect.y,
    width: actualW,
    height: actualH,
    rotated: bestRotated,
    rotation: bestRotated ? 90 : 0,
    color: part.color,
    edgeL1: part.edgeL1,
    edgeL2: part.edgeL2,
    edgeW1: part.edgeW1,
    edgeW2: part.edgeW2,
    hasGroove: part.hasGroove,
    grooveSide: part.grooveSide,
    grooveOffset: part.grooveOffset,
    grooveWidth: part.grooveWidth,
    grooveDepth: part.grooveDepth,
    grain_direction: part.grain_direction,
    can_rotate: part.can_rotate,
  };

  sheetState.placements.push(placement);
  sheetState.used_area += actualW * actualH;

  splitFreeRects(sheetState, bestRect, bestRectIndex, placedW, placedH);
  return true;
}

function splitFreeRects(
  sheetState: SheetState,
  rect: MaxRect,
  rectIdx: number,
  placedW: number,
  placedH: number
): void {
  sheetState.free_rects.splice(rectIdx, 1);

  const rightW = rect.width - placedW;
  if (rightW > 1) {
    sheetState.free_rects.push({
      x: rect.x + placedW,
      y: rect.y,
      width: rightW,
      height: rect.height,
    });
  }

  const topH = rect.height - placedH;
  if (topH > 1) {
    sheetState.free_rects.push({
      x: rect.x,
      y: rect.y + placedH,
      width: placedW,
      height: topH,
    });
  }

  sheetState.free_rects = sheetState.free_rects.filter(
    (r) => r.width >= 5 && r.height >= 5
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// packages/manufacturing/src/erp-nesting/erp-nesting-bridge.ts
// Birim Configurator (ManufacturingBOM / CutPiece) -> Birim Portal ERP Nesting
// %100 Birebir Veri, Ölçü, Kenar Bandı (U1/U2/K1/K2), Arkalık Kanalı,
// Suyolu/Lif Yönü ve Çoklu Levha İş Emri Köprüsü
// ============================================================================

import {
  DEFAULT_MATERIALS,
  roundMm,
  type DesignProject,
  type MaterialDefinition,
} from "@birim/core";
import type { CutPiece, ManufacturingBOM } from "../types";
import type {
  BirimErpNestingBoardJob,
  BirimErpNestingBuildOptions,
  BirimErpNestingExportBundle,
  BirimErpPartTraceMeta,
  ErpGrainDirection,
  ErpNestingOptimizationSettings,
  ErpNestingPart,
  ErpNestingPartInput,
  ErpNestingPlacement,
  ErpNestingProject,
  ErpNestingSheet,
  ErpNestingSheetInput,
} from "./erp-nesting-types";
import { getErpPartColor } from "./erp-nesting-types";
import {
  buildErpEdgeSummaryCode,
  formatErpMaterialTypeWithGrain,
  formatErpTapeByThickness,
  mapErpPartFromDb,
  parseErpSheetGrain,
  serializeErpEdgeBanding,
} from "./erp-serialization";
import {
  extractErpReclaimableRemnants,
  runErpNesting,
} from "./erp-nesting-algorithm";
import {
  generateErpFullGCode,
  generateErpSelcoCSV,
} from "./erp-exporters";

export interface ConvertedErpPieceRecord {
  partInput: ErpNestingPartInput;
  sourcePiece: CutPiece;
  crosswiseCanonicalized: boolean;
}

/**
 * Tek bir Configurator `CutPiece` nesnesini Birim ERP `NestingPartInput`
 * sözleşmesine dönüştürür.
 *
 * Koordinat & Kenar Sözleşmesi (ERP NestingCanvas2D & GuillotineEngine ile %100 uyumlu):
 * - Normal / Dikey Suyolu ("lengthwise" veya "none"):
 *   - `width_mm` = Parça Boyu (`netCutLengthMm ?? lengthMm`, plaka X=2800 eksenine paralel)
 *   - `height_mm` = Parça Eni (`netCutWidthMm ?? widthMm`, plaka Y=2100/2070 eksenine paralel)
 *   - `edgeL1` (U1 / Üst uzun kenar) = `edgeBanding.left`
 *   - `edgeL2` (U2 / Alt uzun kenar) = `edgeBanding.right`
 *   - `edgeW1` (K1 / Sol kısa kenar) = `edgeBanding.bottom`
 *   - `edgeW2` (K2 / Sağ kısa kenar) = `edgeBanding.top`
 *   - `grooveSide` = Normal parçada arka uzun kenar U2 ("Alt"), X-aynalanmış sağ yan dikmede U1 ("Üst")
 * - Yatay Suyolu ("crosswise"):
 *   - Ahşap damarının parçanın En (`widthMm`) kenarı boyunca akması istendiğinde,
 *     plaka damarı X=2800 ekseni boyunca olduğu için parça plaka koordinatlarında
 *     90° kanonikleştirilir (`width_mm = En`, `height_mm = Boy`, `grain_direction = "vertical"`,
 *     `can_rotate = false`). Böylece hem `GuillotineEngine` hem `MaxRects` hem de `NestingCanvas2D`
 *     sıfır lif uyarısıyla (`hasCrossGrainMismatch = false`) ve doğru U1/U2/K1/K2 kenarlarla keser.
 */
export function convertCutPieceToErpPartInput(
  piece: CutPiece,
  options?: {
    useNetCutDimensions?: boolean;
    materialCode?: string | null;
    sheetHasGrain?: boolean;
  }
): ConvertedErpPieceRecord {
  const useNet = options?.useNetCutDimensions !== false;
  const rawLength = roundMm(
    useNet ? piece.netCutLengthMm ?? piece.lengthMm : piece.lengthMm,
    2
  );
  const rawWidth = roundMm(
    useNet ? piece.netCutWidthMm ?? piece.widthMm : piece.widthMm,
    2
  );

  const eb = piece.edgeBanding;
  const tapeL_left = formatErpTapeByThickness(eb.left, eb.thickness);
  const tapeL_right = formatErpTapeByThickness(eb.right, eb.thickness);
  const tapeW_bottom = formatErpTapeByThickness(eb.bottom, eb.thickness);
  const tapeW_top = formatErpTapeByThickness(eb.top, eb.thickness);

  const baseHasGroove = Boolean(piece.hasBackGroove);
  const baseGrooveSide = piece.mirrorInnerFaceX ? "Üst" : "Alt";
  const grooveOffset = roundMm(piece.backGrooveOffsetMm ?? 20, 1);
  const grooveWidth = 8.5;
  const grooveDepth = 8;

  const isCrosswise = piece.grain === "crosswise";
  let width_mm = rawLength;
  let height_mm = rawWidth;
  let edgeL1 = tapeL_left;
  let edgeL2 = tapeL_right;
  let edgeW1 = tapeW_bottom;
  let edgeW2 = tapeW_top;
  let grooveSide = baseGrooveSide;
  let grain_direction: ErpGrainDirection = "none";
  let can_rotate = true;

  if (piece.grain === "lengthwise") {
    grain_direction = "vertical";
    can_rotate = false;
  } else if (isCrosswise) {
    // 90° Kanonikleştirme: En kenarı (damar yönü) -> plaka X=2800 (width_mm) eksenine yerleşir
    width_mm = rawWidth;
    height_mm = rawLength;
    edgeL1 = tapeW_bottom;
    edgeL2 = tapeW_top;
    edgeW1 = tapeL_right;
    edgeW2 = tapeL_left;
    grooveSide = piece.mirrorInnerFaceX ? "Sağ" : "Sol";
    grain_direction = "vertical";
    can_rotate = false;
  } else {
    // Düz/Desensiz parça ("none")
    grain_direction = "none";
    can_rotate = true;
  }

  // Modül adı + Parça adı birleşimi (ERP operatör etiketinde modül izlenebilirliği için)
  const cleanMod = (piece.moduleName || "").trim();
  const cleanName = (piece.pieceName || piece.id).trim();
  const part_label =
    cleanMod && !cleanName.toLowerCase().includes(cleanMod.toLowerCase())
      ? `${cleanMod} - ${cleanName}`
      : cleanName;

  const summary = buildErpEdgeSummaryCode({ edgeL1, edgeL2, edgeW1, edgeW2 });

  const partInput: ErpNestingPartInput = {
    part_label,
    width_mm,
    height_mm,
    quantity: Math.max(1, piece.quantity || 1),
    can_rotate,
    grain_direction,
    edge_banding: serializeErpEdgeBanding({
      edge_banding: summary || null,
      edgeL1,
      edgeL2,
      edgeW1,
      edgeW2,
      hasGroove: baseHasGroove,
      grooveSide: baseHasGroove ? grooveSide : undefined,
      grooveOffset: baseHasGroove ? grooveOffset : undefined,
      grooveWidth: baseHasGroove ? grooveWidth : undefined,
      grooveDepth: baseHasGroove ? grooveDepth : undefined,
    }),
    edgeL1,
    edgeL2,
    edgeW1,
    edgeW2,
    hasGroove: baseHasGroove,
    grooveSide: baseHasGroove ? grooveSide : undefined,
    grooveOffset: baseHasGroove ? grooveOffset : undefined,
    grooveWidth: baseHasGroove ? grooveWidth : undefined,
    grooveDepth: baseHasGroove ? grooveDepth : undefined,
    material_code: options?.materialCode ?? piece.materialId ?? null,
  };

  return {
    partInput,
    sourcePiece: piece,
    crosswiseCanonicalized: isCrosswise,
  };
}

/**
 * Tüm projeyi (ManufacturingBOM) malzeme + kalınlık gruplarına ayırarak
 * Birim ERP Nesting altyapısına (%100 DB ve API uyumlu) hazır iş emirleri paketine dönüştürür.
 */
export function buildBirimErpNestingBundle(
  project: Pick<DesignProject, "id" | "title" | "version" | "branchId">,
  bom: ManufacturingBOM,
  materialsMap: Map<string, MaterialDefinition> = new Map(
    DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((m) => [m.id, m])
  ),
  options?: BirimErpNestingBuildOptions
): BirimErpNestingExportBundle {
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const orgId = options?.organizationId || project.branchId || "org_birim_fabrika";
  const createdBy = options?.createdBy || "birim-configurator";
  const orderRef = options?.orderRef || `${project.id}_v${project.version}`;

  const sheetWidthMm = options?.sheetWidthMm ?? 2800;
  const sheetHeightMm = options?.sheetHeightMm ?? 2100;
  const kerfMm = options?.kerfMm ?? 4;
  const edgeMarginMm = options?.edgeMarginMm ?? 15;
  const partSpacingMm = options?.partSpacingMm ?? 0;
  const algorithm = options?.algorithm ?? "Auto";
  const useCommonCut = Boolean(options?.useCommonCut);
  const useNetCutDimensions = options?.useNetCutDimensions !== false;
  const aggregateIdenticalParts = options?.aggregateIdenticalParts !== false;
  const minRemnantWidthMm = options?.minRemnantWidthMm ?? 400;
  const minRemnantHeightMm = options?.minRemnantHeightMm ?? 400;

  const optimizationSettings: ErpNestingOptimizationSettings = {
    algorithm,
    sawKerf: kerfMm,
    kerf: kerfMm,
    edgeMargin: edgeMarginMm,
    margin: edgeMarginMm,
    partSpacing: partSpacingMm,
    spacing: partSpacingMm,
    useCommonCut,
    commonCut: useCommonCut,
    rotationAllowed: true,
    allowRotation: true,
    grainRule: true,
    considerGrain: true,
    minRemnantWidth: minRemnantWidthMm,
  };

  // Malzeme + Kalınlık bazında grupla (ERP'de her NestingProject tek bir NestingSheet tipine bağlanır)
  const boardGroups = new Map<string, CutPiece[]>();
  for (const piece of bom.cutList || []) {
    const key = `${piece.materialId}::${piece.thicknessMm}`;
    const arr = boardGroups.get(key) || [];
    arr.push(piece);
    boardGroups.set(key, arr);
  }

  const jobs: BirimErpNestingBoardJob[] = [];
  let groupIdx = 0;

  boardGroups.forEach((groupPieces, groupKey) => {
    groupIdx++;
    const sample = groupPieces[0];
    const matDef = materialsMap.get(sample.materialId);
    const thicknessMm = sample.thicknessMm || matDef?.thickness || 18;

    const inferredGrain: ErpGrainDirection = matDef
      ? matDef.hasGrain
        ? "vertical"
        : "none"
      : groupPieces.some((p) => p.grain !== "none")
      ? "vertical"
      : parseErpSheetGrain(sample.materialName).grainDirection;

    const materialCode = matDef?.decorCode
      ? `${matDef.brand ? `${matDef.brand}-` : ""}${matDef.decorCode}-${thicknessMm}MM`
      : `${sample.materialId.toUpperCase()}-${thicknessMm}MM`;

    const sheetAreaM2 = (sheetWidthMm * sheetHeightMm) / 1_000_000;
    const sheetCost =
      matDef?.costPerM2 && matDef.costPerM2 > 0
        ? roundMm(matDef.costPerM2 * sheetAreaM2, 2)
        : null;

    const sheetName = `${sample.materialName} (${sheetWidthMm}x${sheetHeightMm}x${thicknessMm}mm)`;
    const formattedMaterialType = formatErpMaterialTypeWithGrain(
      `${sample.materialName} ${thicknessMm}mm`,
      inferredGrain
    );

    const sheetId = `erp_sheet_${sample.materialId}_${thicknessMm}mm`;
    const projectId = `erp_nst_${project.id}_g${groupIdx}`;
    const projectNo = `NST-${year}-${String(groupIdx).padStart(4, "0")}`;

    const sheetInput: ErpNestingSheetInput = {
      name: sheetName,
      material_type: formattedMaterialType,
      width_mm: sheetWidthMm,
      height_mm: sheetHeightMm,
      thickness_mm: thicknessMm,
      kerf_mm: kerfMm,
      edge_margin_mm: edgeMarginMm,
      cost_per_sheet: sheetCost,
      grain_direction: inferredGrain,
    };

    const sheetRecord: ErpNestingSheet = {
      id: sheetId,
      organization_id: orgId,
      name: sheetName,
      material_type: sample.materialName,
      width_mm: sheetWidthMm,
      height_mm: sheetHeightMm,
      thickness_mm: thicknessMm,
      kerf_mm: kerfMm,
      edge_margin_mm: edgeMarginMm,
      cost_per_sheet: sheetCost,
      grain_direction: inferredGrain,
      is_active: true,
      created_at: nowIso,
      updated_at: nowIso,
    };

    // Parçaları dönüştür ve isteğe bağlı olarak birebir aynı ölçü/bant/kanal parçaları quantity altında birleştir
    const convertedList = groupPieces.map((cp) =>
      convertCutPieceToErpPartInput(cp, {
        useNetCutDimensions,
        materialCode,
        sheetHasGrain: inferredGrain !== "none",
      })
    );

    const partInputs: ErpNestingPartInput[] = [];
    const partTraceability: BirimErpPartTraceMeta[] = [];

    if (aggregateIdenticalParts) {
      const aggMap = new Map<
        string,
        {
          input: ErpNestingPartInput;
          trace: BirimErpPartTraceMeta;
        }
      >();

      for (const conv of convertedList) {
        const p = conv.partInput;
        const sig = [
          p.part_label,
          p.width_mm,
          p.height_mm,
          p.can_rotate ? "1" : "0",
          p.grain_direction || "none",
          p.edge_banding || "",
          p.material_code || "",
        ].join("|");

        const existing = aggMap.get(sig);
        if (existing) {
          existing.input.quantity += p.quantity;
          existing.trace.source_piece_ids.push(conv.sourcePiece.id);
          if (!existing.trace.module_ids.includes(conv.sourcePiece.moduleId)) {
            existing.trace.module_ids.push(conv.sourcePiece.moduleId);
          }
          if (!existing.trace.module_names.includes(conv.sourcePiece.moduleName)) {
            existing.trace.module_names.push(conv.sourcePiece.moduleName);
          }
          existing.trace.drilling_holes_count += conv.sourcePiece.holes?.length || 0;
        } else {
          const erpPartId = `${projectId}_part_${aggMap.size + 1}`;
          aggMap.set(sig, {
            input: { ...p },
            trace: {
              erp_part_id: erpPartId,
              part_label: p.part_label,
              source_piece_ids: [conv.sourcePiece.id],
              module_ids: [conv.sourcePiece.moduleId],
              module_names: [conv.sourcePiece.moduleName],
              component_role: conv.sourcePiece.componentRole,
              nominal_length_mm: conv.sourcePiece.lengthMm,
              nominal_width_mm: conv.sourcePiece.widthMm,
              net_cut_length_mm:
                conv.sourcePiece.netCutLengthMm ?? conv.sourcePiece.lengthMm,
              net_cut_width_mm:
                conv.sourcePiece.netCutWidthMm ?? conv.sourcePiece.widthMm,
              crosswise_canonicalized: conv.crosswiseCanonicalized,
              drilling_holes_count: conv.sourcePiece.holes?.length || 0,
            },
          });
        }
      }

      aggMap.forEach(({ input, trace }) => {
        partInputs.push(input);
        partTraceability.push(trace);
      });
    } else {
      convertedList.forEach((conv, idx) => {
        const erpPartId = `${projectId}_part_${idx + 1}`;
        partInputs.push(conv.partInput);
        partTraceability.push({
          erp_part_id: erpPartId,
          part_label: conv.partInput.part_label,
          source_piece_ids: [conv.sourcePiece.id],
          module_ids: [conv.sourcePiece.moduleId],
          module_names: [conv.sourcePiece.moduleName],
          component_role: conv.sourcePiece.componentRole,
          nominal_length_mm: conv.sourcePiece.lengthMm,
          nominal_width_mm: conv.sourcePiece.widthMm,
          net_cut_length_mm:
            conv.sourcePiece.netCutLengthMm ?? conv.sourcePiece.lengthMm,
          net_cut_width_mm:
            conv.sourcePiece.netCutWidthMm ?? conv.sourcePiece.widthMm,
          crosswise_canonicalized: conv.crosswiseCanonicalized,
          drilling_holes_count: conv.sourcePiece.holes?.length || 0,
        });
      });
    }

    // DB satır formatında `nesting_parts` kayıtları
    const partRecords: ErpNestingPart[] = partInputs.map((p, idx) =>
      mapErpPartFromDb({
        id: partTraceability[idx]?.erp_part_id || `${projectId}_part_${idx + 1}`,
        project_id: projectId,
        part_label: p.part_label,
        width_mm: p.width_mm,
        height_mm: p.height_mm,
        quantity: p.quantity,
        can_rotate: p.can_rotate,
        grain_direction: p.grain_direction,
        edge_banding: p.edge_banding,
        edgeL1: p.edgeL1,
        edgeL2: p.edgeL2,
        edgeW1: p.edgeW1,
        edgeW2: p.edgeW2,
        hasGroove: p.hasGroove,
        grooveSide: p.grooveSide,
        grooveOffset: p.grooveOffset,
        grooveWidth: p.grooveWidth,
        grooveDepth: p.grooveDepth,
        material_code: p.material_code,
        color: getErpPartColor(idx),
        priority: 0,
        created_at: nowIso,
      })
    );

    // Birebir ERP Nesting Algoritmasını Çalıştır
    const optimizationResult = runErpNesting(
      partInputs,
      {
        width: sheetWidthMm,
        height: sheetHeightMm,
        kerf: kerfMm,
        margin: edgeMarginMm,
        grain_direction: inferredGrain,
      },
      optimizationSettings
    );

    // DB satır formatında `nesting_placements` kayıtları (`part_i_q` veya `part-i-q` -> `partRecords[i].id`)
    const placementRecords: ErpNestingPlacement[] = [];
    optimizationResult.sheets.forEach((sh) => {
      sh.placements.forEach((pl, plIdx) => {
        const idxMatch = pl.part_id.match(/^part[_-](\d+)[_-](\d+)$/);
        const origIdx = idxMatch ? Number(idxMatch[1]) : 0;
        const matchedPart = partRecords[origIdx] || partRecords[0];
        placementRecords.push({
          id: `${projectId}_pl_${sh.sheet_index}_${plIdx}`,
          project_id: projectId,
          part_id: matchedPart ? matchedPart.id : pl.part_id,
          sheet_index: sh.sheet_index,
          x_mm: pl.x,
          y_mm: pl.y,
          placed_width_mm: pl.width,
          placed_height_mm: pl.height,
          is_rotated: Boolean(pl.rotated),
          rotation: pl.rotation ?? (pl.rotated ? 90 : 0),
          hasCollision: Boolean(pl.hasCollision),
          created_at: nowIso,
          part: matchedPart,
        });
      });
    });

    // Fire Geri Kazanımı (Reclaimable Remnants >= 400x400 mm)
    const sheetAreaMm2 = sheetWidthMm * sheetHeightMm;
    const reclaimableRemnants = optimizationResult.sheets.flatMap((sh) =>
      extractErpReclaimableRemnants(sh, {
        minWidthMm: minRemnantWidthMm,
        minHeightMm: minRemnantHeightMm,
        sheetCost,
        sheetAreaMm2,
      })
    );

    const projectName = `${project.title} — ${sample.materialName} (${thicknessMm}mm)`;
    const notes = `Birim Configurator v${project.version} otomatik üretim emri (${
      useNetCutDimensions ? "Bant düşülmüş net kesim ölçüleri" : "Bitmiş anma ölçüleri"
    })`;

    const projectRecord: ErpNestingProject = {
      id: projectId,
      organization_id: orgId,
      project_no: projectNo,
      name: projectName,
      status: optimizationResult.sheets.length > 0 ? "optimized" : "draft",
      sheet_id: sheetId,
      source_type: "production_order",
      source_ref: orderRef,
      created_by: createdBy,
      optimization_data: optimizationResult,
      total_sheets_used: optimizationResult.sheets.length,
      utilization_percent: optimizationResult.overall_utilization,
      waste_area_mm2: optimizationResult.total_waste_mm2,
      notes,
      created_at: nowIso,
      updated_at: nowIso,
      sheet: sheetRecord,
      parts: partRecords,
      placements: placementRecords,
    };

    const selcoCsv = generateErpSelcoCSV(projectRecord, partRecords);
    const cncGcode =
      optimizationResult.sheets.length > 0
        ? generateErpFullGCode(optimizationResult.sheets, sheetRecord)
        : "";

    jobs.push({
      job_index: groupIdx,
      group_key: groupKey,
      material_id: sample.materialId,
      material_name: sample.materialName,
      material_code: materialCode,
      thickness_mm: thicknessMm,
      sheet_input: sheetInput,
      sheet_record: sheetRecord,
      project_record: projectRecord,
      part_inputs: partInputs,
      part_records: partRecords,
      placement_records: placementRecords,
      optimization_result: optimizationResult,
      reclaimable_remnants: reclaimableRemnants,
      part_traceability: partTraceability,
      selco_csv: selcoCsv,
      cnc_gcode: cncGcode,
      api_requests: {
        post_sheet: {
          endpoint: "/api/nesting/sheets",
          method: "POST",
          body: sheetInput,
        },
        post_project: {
          endpoint: "/api/nesting",
          method: "POST",
          body: {
            name: projectName,
            sheet_id: sheetId,
            source_type: "production_order",
            source_ref: orderRef,
            notes,
          },
        },
        post_parts: {
          endpoint: `/api/nesting/${projectId}/parts`,
          method: "POST",
          body: { parts: partInputs },
        },
        post_optimize: {
          endpoint: `/api/nesting/${projectId}/optimize`,
          method: "POST",
          body: { settings: optimizationSettings },
        },
      },
    });
  });

  // Genel Özet Metrikleri
  const totalSheetsUsed = jobs.reduce(
    (s, j) => s + j.optimization_result.sheets.length,
    0
  );
  const totalPartsRequested = jobs.reduce(
    (s, j) => s + j.optimization_result.total_parts_requested,
    0
  );
  const totalPartsPlaced = jobs.reduce(
    (s, j) => s + j.optimization_result.total_parts_placed,
    0
  );
  const totalWasteMm2 = jobs.reduce(
    (s, j) => s + j.optimization_result.total_waste_mm2,
    0
  );
  const totalUsedMm2 = jobs.reduce(
    (s, j) =>
      s +
      j.optimization_result.sheets.reduce(
        (shSum, sh) =>
          shSum + sh.placements.reduce((pSum, pl) => pSum + pl.width * pl.height, 0),
        0
      ),
    0
  );
  const totalGrossMm2 = totalSheetsUsed * sheetWidthMm * sheetHeightMm;
  const overallUtilPercent =
    totalGrossMm2 > 0
      ? Math.round((totalUsedMm2 / totalGrossMm2) * 10000) / 100
      : 0;

  const allRemnants = jobs.flatMap((j) => j.reclaimable_remnants);
  const reclaimAreaM2 =
    Math.round(
      (allRemnants.reduce((s, r) => s + r.area_mm2, 0) / 1_000_000) * 1000
    ) / 1000;

  // Birleştirilmiş Selco WNT 600 CSV (Tek başlık altında tüm malzeme grupları)
  const combinedSelcoLines: string[] = [
    "Label;Qty;Length;Width;Material;Grain;EdgeL1;EdgeL2;EdgeW1;EdgeW2",
  ];
  for (const j of jobs) {
    const rows = j.selco_csv.split(/\r?\n/).slice(1).filter(Boolean);
    combinedSelcoLines.push(...rows);
  }

  const combinedCncGcode = jobs
    .filter((j) => j.cnc_gcode.length > 0)
    .map(
      (j) =>
        `; ############################################################\n` +
        `; GRUP ${j.job_index}: ${j.material_name} (${j.thickness_mm}mm) - ${j.project_record.project_no}\n` +
        `; ############################################################\n` +
        j.cnc_gcode
    )
    .join("\n\n");

  return {
    schema_version: "birim-erp-nesting/v1.0",
    generated_at: nowIso,
    source_system: "birim-configurator",
    source_project_id: project.id,
    source_project_title: project.title,
    source_project_version: project.version,
    organization_id: orgId,
    order_ref: orderRef,
    dimension_basis: useNetCutDimensions ? "net_cut_mm" : "nominal_finished_mm",
    settings: {
      ...optimizationSettings,
      sheet_width_mm: sheetWidthMm,
      sheet_height_mm: sheetHeightMm,
    },
    summary: {
      board_groups_count: jobs.length,
      total_sheets_used: totalSheetsUsed,
      total_parts_requested: totalPartsRequested,
      total_parts_placed: totalPartsPlaced,
      unplaced_parts_count: Math.max(0, totalPartsRequested - totalPartsPlaced),
      overall_utilization_percent: overallUtilPercent,
      total_waste_m2: Math.round((totalWasteMm2 / 1_000_000) * 1000) / 1000,
      reclaimable_remnants_count: allRemnants.length,
      reclaimable_remnants_area_m2: reclaimAreaM2,
    },
    jobs,
    combined_selco_csv: combinedSelcoLines.join("\r\n"),
    combined_cnc_gcode: combinedCncGcode,
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// packages/manufacturing/src/erp-nesting/erp-serialization.ts
// Birim ERP lib/nestingService.ts & PartListPanel.tsx birebir serileştirme katmanı
// ============================================================================

import type {
  ErpGrainDirection,
  ErpNestingPart,
  ErpNestingSheet,
} from "./erp-nesting-types";

export function normalizeErpEdgeValue(val?: string | null): string {
  if (!val) return "";
  const clean = val.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (
    clean === "" ||
    clean === "none" ||
    clean === "yok" ||
    clean.includes("bantsız") ||
    clean.includes("bantsiz")
  ) {
    return "";
  }
  if (clean.includes("2") || clean.includes("2.0") || clean.includes("2mm")) {
    return "2.00mm PVC";
  }
  if (clean.includes("1") || clean.includes("1.0") || clean.includes("1mm")) {
    return "1.00mm PVC";
  }
  if (clean.includes("0.4") || clean.includes("0.40")) {
    return "0.40mm PVC";
  }
  return val.trim();
}

export function formatErpTapeByThickness(
  hasBand: boolean,
  thicknessMm: number
): string {
  if (!hasBand || thicknessMm <= 0) return "";
  if (thicknessMm >= 1.8) return "2.00mm PVC";
  if (thicknessMm >= 0.7) return "1.00mm PVC";
  return "0.40mm PVC";
}

export function buildErpEdgeSummaryCode(p: {
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
}): string {
  const tags: string[] = [];
  if (p.edgeL1) tags.push("L1");
  if (p.edgeL2) tags.push("L2");
  if (p.edgeW1) tags.push("W1");
  if (p.edgeW2) tags.push("W2");
  return tags.join(",");
}

export function serializeErpEdgeBanding(p: {
  edge_banding?: string | null;
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
  hasGroove?: boolean;
  grooveSide?: string;
  grooveOffset?: number;
  grooveWidth?: number;
  grooveDepth?: number;
}): string | null {
  if (p.edgeL1 || p.edgeL2 || p.edgeW1 || p.edgeW2 || p.hasGroove) {
    const autoSummary = buildErpEdgeSummaryCode(p);
    return JSON.stringify({
      edgeL1: p.edgeL1 || "",
      edgeL2: p.edgeL2 || "",
      edgeW1: p.edgeW1 || "",
      edgeW2: p.edgeW2 || "",
      hasGroove: Boolean(p.hasGroove),
      grooveSide: p.grooveSide || "Alt",
      grooveOffset: p.grooveOffset ?? 20,
      grooveWidth: p.grooveWidth ?? 4,
      grooveDepth: p.grooveDepth ?? 8,
      summary: p.edge_banding || autoSummary,
    });
  }
  return p.edge_banding || null;
}

export function parseErpEdgeBanding(edgeBandingStr: string | null | undefined): {
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
  hasGroove?: boolean;
  grooveSide?: string;
  grooveOffset?: number;
  grooveWidth?: number;
  grooveDepth?: number;
  summary?: string;
} {
  if (!edgeBandingStr) return {};
  try {
    if (edgeBandingStr.startsWith("{")) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(edgeBandingStr) as {
        edgeL1?: string;
        edgeL2?: string;
        edgeW1?: string;
        edgeW2?: string;
        hasGroove?: boolean;
        grooveSide?: string;
        grooveOffset?: number;
        grooveWidth?: number;
        grooveDepth?: number;
        summary?: string;
      };
      return {
        edgeL1: parsed.edgeL1 || undefined,
        edgeL2: parsed.edgeL2 || undefined,
        edgeW1: parsed.edgeW1 || undefined,
        edgeW2: parsed.edgeW2 || undefined,
        hasGroove: parsed.hasGroove ?? undefined,
        grooveSide: parsed.grooveSide || undefined,
        grooveOffset:
          parsed.grooveOffset !== undefined ? Number(parsed.grooveOffset) : undefined,
        grooveWidth:
          parsed.grooveWidth !== undefined ? Number(parsed.grooveWidth) : undefined,
        grooveDepth:
          parsed.grooveDepth !== undefined ? Number(parsed.grooveDepth) : undefined,
        summary: parsed.summary || undefined,
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Plain text fallback
  }
  return { summary: edgeBandingStr };
}

export function parseErpSheetGrain(rawMaterialType: string | null | undefined): {
  cleanMaterialType: string;
  grainDirection: ErpGrainDirection;
} {
  if (!rawMaterialType) {
    return { cleanMaterialType: "MDF", grainDirection: "vertical" };
  }
  const match = rawMaterialType.match(/\[grain:(vertical|horizontal|none)\]/i);
  if (match) {
    const grainDirection = match[1].toLowerCase() as ErpGrainDirection;
    const cleanMaterialType = rawMaterialType
      .replace(/\[grain:(vertical|horizontal|none)\]/i, "")
      .trim();
    return { cleanMaterialType: cleanMaterialType || "MDF", grainDirection };
  }

  const lower = rawMaterialType.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower.includes("düz") ||
    lower.includes("lake") ||
    lower.includes("beyaz") ||
    lower.includes("sac") ||
    lower.includes("metal") ||
    lower.includes("alüminyum") ||
    lower.includes("kompakt") ||
    lower.includes("pleksi") ||
    lower.includes("akrilik") ||
    lower.includes("ham") ||
    lower.includes("antrasit") ||
    lower.includes("kaşmir") ||
    lower.includes("kasmir") ||
    lower.includes("arkalık") ||
    lower.includes("arkalik")
  ) {
    return { cleanMaterialType: rawMaterialType, grainDirection: "none" };
  }

  return { cleanMaterialType: rawMaterialType, grainDirection: "vertical" };
}

export function formatErpMaterialTypeWithGrain(
  materialType: string,
  grain?: ErpGrainDirection | null
): string {
  const clean = materialType
    .replace(/\[grain:(vertical|horizontal|none)\]/i, "")
    .trim();
  if (!grain) return clean;
  return `${clean} [grain:${grain}]`;
}

export function adjustErpGrooveSideForRotation(
  originalSide: string | undefined,
  rotationDeg: number
): string {
  if (!originalSide) return "";
  let cleanSide = originalSide.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (cleanSide === "top" || cleanSide === "üst") cleanSide = "üst";
  if (cleanSide === "bottom" || cleanSide === "alt") cleanSide = "alt";
  if (cleanSide === "left" || cleanSide === "sol") cleanSide = "sol";
  if (cleanSide === "right" || cleanSide === "sağ") cleanSide = "sağ";

  const sides = ["alt", "sağ", "üst", "sol"];
  const sidesTr = ["Alt", "Sağ", "Üst", "Sol"];
  const index = sides.indexOf(cleanSide);
  if (index < 0) return originalSide;
  const shift = Math.floor(((rotationDeg % 360) + 360) % 360 / 90) % 4;
  return sidesTr[(index + shift) % 4];
}

export function mapErpPartFromDb(raw: ErpNestingPart): ErpNestingPart {
  const parsed = parseErpEdgeBanding(raw.edge_banding);
  return {
    ...raw,
    edgeL1: raw.edgeL1 ?? parsed.edgeL1,
    edgeL2: raw.edgeL2 ?? parsed.edgeL2,
    edgeW1: raw.edgeW1 ?? parsed.edgeW1,
    edgeW2: raw.edgeW2 ?? parsed.edgeW2,
    hasGroove: raw.hasGroove ?? parsed.hasGroove ?? false,
    grooveSide: raw.grooveSide ?? parsed.grooveSide ?? "Alt",
    grooveOffset: raw.grooveOffset ?? parsed.grooveOffset ?? 20,
    grooveWidth: raw.grooveWidth ?? parsed.grooveWidth ?? 4,
    grooveDepth: raw.grooveDepth ?? parsed.grooveDepth ?? 8,
    grain_direction: (raw.grain_direction as ErpGrainDirection) || null,
  };
}

export function mapErpSheetFromDb(raw: ErpNestingSheet): ErpNestingSheet {
  const parsed = parseErpSheetGrain(raw.material_type);
  return {
    ...raw,
    material_type: parsed.cleanMaterialType,
    grain_direction: raw.grain_direction || parsed.grainDirection,
  };
}

const bomProjectCache = new Map<string, ManufacturingBOM>();

function computeProjectBOMKey(
  project: DesignProject,
  materialsMap: Map<string, MaterialDefinition>
): string {
  return JSON.stringify([project, Array.from(materialsMap.entries())]);
}

function formatEdgeBandCode(eb: EdgeBandingConfig): string {
  const bCount = (eb.left ? 1 : 0) + (eb.right ? 1 : 0);
  const eCount = (eb.top ? 1 : 0) + (eb.bottom ? 1 : 0);
  if (bCount === 0 && eCount === 0) return "Bantsız";
  if (bCount === 2 && eCount === 2) return `4K (2B+2E) ${eb.thickness}mm`;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (bCount > 0) parts.push(`${bCount}B`);
  if (eCount > 0) parts.push(`${eCount}E`);
  return `${parts.join("+")} ${eb.thickness}mm`;
}

function doesBayDoorHingeOnLeft(bay: ModuleInstance["bays"][number] | undefined): boolean {
  if (!bay || !bay.door) return false;
  const dType = bay.door.type;
  const dSys = bay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(dType);
  if (
    dType === "open" ||
    dSys === "open" ||
    dSys.startsWith("sliding") ||
    dSys.startsWith("lift") ||
    dSys === "pocket_retractable" ||
    dSys === "tambour_roller"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  return (
    dType === "single_left" ||
    dType === "left" ||
    dType === "double" ||
    dType === "inset_left" ||
    dType === "inset_double" ||
    dType === "half_overlay_left" ||
    dType === "folding" ||
    dSys === "hinged_double" ||
    dSys === "folding_side"
  );
}

function doesBayDoorHingeOnRight(bay: ModuleInstance["bays"][number] | undefined): boolean {
  if (!bay || !bay.door) return false;
  const dType = bay.door.type;
  const dSys = bay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(dType);
  if (
    dType === "open" ||
    dSys === "open" ||
    dSys.startsWith("sliding") ||
    dSys.startsWith("lift") ||
    dSys === "pocket_retractable" ||
    dSys === "tambour_roller"
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  return (
    dType === "single_right" ||
    dType === "right" ||
    dType === "double" ||
    dType === "inset_right" ||
    dType === "inset_double" ||
    dType === "half_overlay_right" ||
    dSys === "hinged_double"
  );
}

function hasSinkOrCooktopAppliance(module: ModuleInstance): boolean {
  const sig = `${module.id} ${module.name} ${module.templateId || ""}`.toLowerCase();
  return (
    sig.includes("sink") ||
    sig.includes("evye") ||
    sig.includes("eviye") ||
    sig.includes("cooktop") ||
    sig.includes("ocak") ||
    sig.includes("oven_base")
  );
}

export function generateBOMForProject(
  project: DesignProject,
  materialsMap: Map<string, MaterialDefinition> = new Map(DEFAULT_MATERIALS.map((m) => [m.id, m])),
  options?: GenerateBOMOptions

  if (!project || !project.modules || project.modules.length === 0) {
    return {
      projectId: project?.id || "empty",
      version: project?.version || 1,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      approvalStatus: "draft",
      summary: {
        totalPiecesCount: 0,
        totalPanelAreaM2: 0,
        totalEdgeBandMeters: 0,
        totalHardwareCount: 0,
        totalDrillingHolesCount: 0,
      },
      cutList: [],
      hardwareList: [],
      materialUsage: [],
      nestingResults: [],
      validationWarnings: [],
      shelfDeflectionAnalyses: [],
      productionGate: {
        isReadyForErp: false,

      },
    };
  }

  const skipSyncNesting = Boolean(options?.skipSyncNesting);
  const cacheKey = `${computeProjectBOMKey(project, materialsMap)}_sn:${skipSyncNesting ? 1 : 0}`;
  const cached = bomProjectCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const cutList: CutPiece[] = [];
  const hardwareMap: Map<string, HardwareBOMItem> = new Map();
  const shelfDeflectionAnalyses: ShelfDeflectionBOMEntry[] = [];

  function addHardware(

    if (quantity <= 0) return;

    if (existing) {
      existing.quantity = roundMm(existing.quantity + quantity, 2);
      existing.totalPrice = roundMm(existing.quantity * existing.unitPrice, 2);

      hardwareMap.set(sku, {

  }

  const projectHasSinkOrHob = project.modules.some(
    (m) => m.category !== "complementary" && hasSinkOrCooktopAppliance(m)

  project.modules.forEach((module: ModuleInstance) => {
    const geo = generateModuleGeometry(module);

    const hasGroovedBack =

    if (module.category !== "complementary") {

      }

      module.bays.forEach((bay) => {
        const prof =
          bay.door?.crossSectionProfile || module.carcass.crossSectionProfile || "flat_slab";
        if (
          prof !== "flat_slab" &&
          bay.door?.type !== "open" &&
          bay.door?.doorSystemId !== "open"
        ) {
          const doorAreaM2 = roundMm(
            (module.dimensions.width * module.dimensions.height) /

          );
          const rateMap: Record<
            string,

              name: "CNC Dikey Mikro-Derz (Fitilli / Fluted) Yüzey İşleme",

            bevel_45: {

              name: "CNC 45° Pahlı Kapak Kenar Kesit İşleme",
              price: 14.0,

            custom_cad_profile: {

          const spec = rateMap[prof];
          if (spec && doorAreaM2 > 0) {

      module.bays.forEach((bay, bIdx) => {
        if (bay.shelves.length > 0) {

          const depthMm = Math.max(120, fourSpace.usableInternal.netInnerDepthMm - 10);
          const shelfT = bay.shelves[0]?.thickness || module.carcass.panelThickness || 18;
          const matCat =
            bodyMat.category === "wood"

              : bodyMat.category === "glass" || bodyMat.category === "mirror"

          const defl = calculateShelfDeflection(spanMm, depthMm, shelfT, matCat, 45);
          shelfDeflectionAnalyses.push({

        );

    }

    const bayMechanismAdded = new Set<number>();

    geo.components.forEach((comp) => {
      if (comp.role === "hanging_rail") {
        addHardware(
          "HW_HANGING_RAIL",

      if (

      let mat = materialsMap.get(comp.materialId) || bodyMat;
      const customGrain =
        module.componentGrainOverrides?.[comp.id] || module.componentGrainOverrides?.__all__;
      let grain: CutPiece["grain"] = mat.hasGrain
        ? customGrain === "crosswise"
          ? "crosswise"

        : "none";
      const defaultEbThickness = module.carcass.edgeBandThickness || 1;
      let edgeBanding: EdgeBandingConfig = {
        top: false,
        bottom: false,
        left: false,

        thickness: defaultEbThickness,
      };

      // Local Panel Coordinate System:
      // length (`lengthMm`, Y-axis 0..h) = primary/long span;
      // width (`widthMm`, X-axis 0..w) = secondary/depth span.
      // Edge Banding Convention:
      // left (x=0) & right (x=w) run along lengthMm (Boy/B);
      // bottom (y=0) & top (y=h) run along widthMm (En/E).
      let length = comp.dimensions.height;
      let width = comp.dimensions.depth;
      const bayIdx = comp.bayIndex ?? 0;
      const bay = module.bays[bayIdx] || module.bays[0];
      const dSys = bay
        ? bay.door.doorSystemId || inferDoorSystemIdFromType(bay.door.type)
        : "open";
      const isInsetDoor = Boolean(
        bay?.door.overlayType === "inset" ||

      );

      let mirrorInnerFaceX = false;
      let partHingePositionsY: number[] | undefined;
      let partHingePositionsBackY: number[] | undefined;

      let cutoutWidthMm: number | undefined;
      let cutoutDepthMm: number | undefined;

      if (comp.role.includes("side") && !comp.role.includes("drawer")) {
        length = comp.dimensions.height;
        width = comp.dimensions.depth;

        };

            ? doesBayDoorHingeOnRight(hostBay)
            : doesBayDoorHingeOnLeft(hostBay);

          if (shouldDrillHingeMounts && hostLeaf && hostLeaf.hingePositionsY.length > 0) {
