            );
          } else {
            partHingePositionsY = [];
          }
        }
      } else if (comp.role === "carcass_bottom" || comp.role === "carcass_top") {
        length = comp.dimensions.width;
        width = comp.dimensions.depth;
        hasPartBackGroove = hasGroovedBack;
        edgeBanding = {
          top: false,
          bottom: false,
          left: true,
          right: false,
          thickness: defaultEbThickness,
        };
      } else if (comp.role === "carcass_divider" || comp.role === "carcass_sub_divider") {
        length = comp.dimensions.height;
        width = comp.dimensions.depth;
        edgeBanding = {
          top: false,
          bottom: false,
          left: true,
          right: false,
          thickness: defaultEbThickness,
        };
        if (comp.role === "carcass_divider" && typeof comp.bayIndex === "number") {
          const leftBay = module.bays[comp.bayIndex];
          const rightBay = module.bays[comp.bayIndex + 1];
          const leftLeaf = fourSpace.doorLeaves[comp.bayIndex];
          const rightLeaf = fourSpace.doorLeaves[comp.bayIndex + 1];
          const divBottomY = comp.position.y || (module.carcass.plinthHeight || 0) + (module.carcass.panelThickness || 18);

          partHingePositionsY =
            doesBayDoorHingeOnRight(leftBay) && leftLeaf
              ? leftLeaf.hingePositionsY.map((hy) =>
                  roundMm(Math.max(0, leftLeaf.doorY0Mm - divBottomY + hy), 2)
                )
              : [];
          partHingePositionsBackY =
            doesBayDoorHingeOnLeft(rightBay) && rightLeaf
              ? rightLeaf.hingePositionsY.map((hy) =>
                  roundMm(Math.max(0, rightLeaf.doorY0Mm - divBottomY + hy), 2)
                )
              : [];
        }
      } else if (comp.role === "carcass_back") {
        length = comp.dimensions.height;
        width = comp.dimensions.width;
        grain = "none";
        edgeBanding = { top: false, bottom: false, left: false, right: false, thickness: 0 };
      } else if (comp.role === "shelf") {
        length = comp.dimensions.width;
        width = comp.dimensions.depth;
        edgeBanding = {
          top: false,
          bottom: false,
          left: true,
          right: false,
          thickness: defaultEbThickness,
        };
        addHardware(
          "HW_SHELF_PIN",
          "Kilitli Raf Pimi 5mm (Häfele)",
          "fastener",
          4,
          "adet",
          0.15
        );
      } else if (comp.role === "countertop") {
        mat = materialsMap.get(comp.materialId) || bodyMat;
        length = comp.dimensions.width;
        width = comp.dimensions.depth;
        edgeBanding = { top: true, bottom: true, left: true, right: true, thickness: 2 };
        // Only cut sink/hob aperture if the module (or complementary countertop's project) actually has a sink/cooktop!
        const shouldCut =
          module.category === "complementary"
            ? module.complementaryRole === "countertop" && projectHasSinkOrHob
            : hasSinkOrCooktopAppliance(module);
        if (shouldCut && length >= 550 && width >= 480) {
          hasSinkOrHobCutout = true;
          cutoutWidthMm = Math.min(560, Math.max(320, roundIntMm(length - 120)));
          cutoutDepthMm = Math.min(480, Math.max(280, roundIntMm(width - 100)));
        }
      } else if (comp.role.includes("door")) {
        mat = materialsMap.get(comp.materialId) || doorMat;
        const doorGrain =
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.[comp.id] ||
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.__doors__ ||
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.__all__;
        grain = mat.hasGrain ? (doorGrain === "crosswise" ? "crosswise" : "lengthwise") : "none";
        length = comp.dimensions.height;
        width = comp.dimensions.width;
        const doorEbT = bay?.door.doorEdgeBandThicknessMm || defaultEbThickness;
        edgeBanding = { top: true, bottom: true, left: true, right: true, thickness: doorEbT };

        const leafInfo = fourSpace.doorLeaves[bayIdx];
        partHingePositionsY = leafInfo?.hingePositionsY;
        const selectedHw = getHardwareProductById(bay?.door.hardwareProductId);

        if (dSys.startsWith("hinged")) {
          const hingesNeeded =
            leafInfo?.effectiveHingeCount ||
            leafInfo?.recommendedHingesPerLeaf ||
            calculateRecommendedHingesPerLeaf(length, leafInfo?.leafWeightKg ?? 0, false);
          const hingeSku = selectedHw?.sku || "HW_BLUM_HINGE_110";
          const hingeName =
            selectedHw?.name || "Blum Clip Top Blumotion 110° Frenli Menteşe";
          const hingePrice = selectedHw?.unitPriceEur || 3.8;
          addHardware(hingeSku, hingeName, "hinge", hingesNeeded, "adet", hingePrice);
        } else if (!bayMechanismAdded.has(bayIdx)) {
          bayMechanismAdded.add(bayIdx);
          if (dSys.startsWith("lift")) {
            const liftSku = selectedHw?.sku || "22K2700";
            const liftName =
              selectedHw?.name || "Blum AVENTOS Yukarı Kalkar Mekanizma Seti";
            const liftPrice = selectedHw?.unitPriceEur || 52.0;
            addHardware(liftSku, liftName, "special", 1, "takım", liftPrice);
          } else if (dSys.startsWith("sliding") || bay?.door.type === "sliding" || bay?.door.type === "sliding_bottom") {
            const sMount =
              bay?.door.slidingMountingType ||
              (dSys === "sliding_bottom_rolling" ? "inset_inside" : dSys === "sliding_coplanar" ? "coplanar_flush" : "top_hung_pelmet");
            if (bayIdx === 0) {
              const trackMeters = Number((mod.dimensions.width / 1000).toFixed(2));
              if (sMount === "inset_inside") {
                addHardware(
                  "HT_SLIDELINE_M_SET",
                  "Hettich SlideLine M İçten Çalışan Çift Kanal Sürgü & Fren Seti",
                  "slide",
                  1,
                  "takım",
                  118.0
                );
                addHardware(
                  "HF_SLIDO_INSET_TRACK",
                  "Gömme Çift Kanallı Eloksallı Alüminyum Üst/Alt Sürgü Rayı",
                  "slide",
                  Number((trackMeters * 2).toFixed(2)),
                  "mt",
                  19.5
                );
              } else if (sMount === "coplanar_flush") {
                addHardware(
                  "HT_INLINE_XL_SET",
                  "Hettich InLine XL Hemzemin (Koplanar) Sürgü Mekanizma Seti",
                  "slide",
                  1,
                  "takım",
                  365.0
                );
              } else {
                addHardware(
                  selectedHw?.sku || "HT_TOPLINE_XL_SET",
                  "Hettich TopLine XL Üstten Askılı Yavaşlatıcılı Sürgü Araba & STB-19 Kılavuz Seti",
                  "slide",
                  1,
                  "takım",
                  168.0
                );
                addHardware(
                  "HT_TOPLINE_TRACK_2R",
                  "TopLine XL Üstten Askılı Çift Yollu Alüminyum Taşıyıcı Ray",
                  "slide",
                  trackMeters,
                  "mt",
                  28.0
                );
                if (sMount === "top_hung_pelmet") {
                  addHardware(
                    "HF_SLIDO_FASCIA_CLIP",
                    "Häfele Slido Üst Alın Kapama (Valans) Montaj Klips Takımı",
                    "special",
                    Math.max(4, Math.ceil(mod.dimensions.width / 450)),
                    "adet",
                    2.8
                  );
                }
              }
            }
          } else if (dSys === "folding_side") {
            const foldSku = selectedHw?.sku || "WingLineL_25";
            const foldName =
              selectedHw?.name || "Hettich WingLine L Katlanır Kapak Sistemi";
            const foldPrice = selectedHw?.unitPriceEur || 110.0;
            addHardware(foldSku, foldName, "special", 1, "takım", foldPrice);
          } else if (dSys === "pocket_retractable") {
            const pocketSku = selectedHw?.sku || "REVEGO_UNO_650";
            const pocketName =
              selectedHw?.name || "Blum REVEGO Pocket Gizlenen Kapak Sistemi";
            const pocketPrice = selectedHw?.unitPriceEur || 420.0;
            addHardware(pocketSku, pocketName, "special", 1, "takım", pocketPrice);
          }
        }

        const openTech = bay?.door.openingTechnology;
        if (openTech === "push_to_open") {
          addHardware(
            "956A1004",
            "Blum TIP-ON Bas-Aç Mekanik İtici + Adaptör",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            6.5
          );
        } else if (openTech === "push_to_open_soft_close") {
          addHardware(
            "TIP_ON_BLUMOTION_SET",
            "Blum TIP-ON BLUMOTION Bas-Aç + Frenli Ünite",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            14.0
          );
        } else if (openTech === "servo_electric") {
          addHardware(
            "Z10A3000",
            "Blum SERVO-DRIVE Elektrikli Açılma Ünitesi",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            145.0
          );
        }

        const handleCat = bay?.door.handleCategory || "bar_handle";
        if (handleCat !== "handleless_plain") {
          const hProfile =
            HANDLE_PROFILES.find((hp) => hp.id === bay?.door.handleProfileId) ||
            HANDLE_PROFILES.find((hp) => hp.category === handleCat) ||
            HANDLE_PROFILES[1];
          addHardware(hProfile.sku, hProfile.name, "handle", 1, "adet", hProfile.unitPriceEur);
        }
      } else if (comp.role === "drawer_front") {
        mat = materialsMap.get(comp.materialId) || doorMat;
        const drwGrain =
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.[comp.id] ||
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.__drawers__ ||
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.__doors__ ||
          module.componentGrainOverrides?.__all__;
        grain = mat.hasGrain ? (drwGrain === "crosswise" ? "crosswise" : "lengthwise") : "none";
        length = comp.dimensions.width;
        width = comp.dimensions.height;
        edgeBanding = {
          top: true,
          bottom: true,
          left: true,
          right: true,
          thickness: defaultEbThickness,
        };
        const drawer = bay?.drawers.find((d) => `${d.id}_front` === comp.id);
        if (!drawer?.isInternal && bay?.door.handleCategory !== "handleless_plain") {
          const profile =
            HANDLE_PROFILES.find((p) => p.id === bay?.door.handleProfileId) ||
            HANDLE_PROFILES.find(
              (p) => p.category === (bay?.door.handleCategory || "bar_handle")
            ) ||
            HANDLE_PROFILES[1];
          addHardware(profile.sku, profile.name, "handle", 1, "adet", profile.unitPriceEur);
        }
      } else if (
        comp.role === "drawer_box" ||
        comp.role === "drawer_side_left" ||
        comp.role === "drawer_side_right" ||
        comp.role === "drawer_back" ||
        comp.role === "drawer_bottom"
      ) {
        if (comp.role === "drawer_side_left") {
          const drawerCfg = bay?.drawers.find((d) => `${d.id}_side_left` === comp.id);
          const drHw = getHardwareProductById(drawerCfg?.hardwareProductId);
          const optimalNl =
            drawerCfg?.nominalLengthMm ||
            selectOptimalRunnerLengthMm(fourSpace.usableInternal.netInnerDepthMm);
          const runnerSku = drHw ? `${drHw.sku}_NL${optimalNl}` : "HW_BLUM_TANDEM_BOX";
          const runnerName = drHw
            ? `${drHw.name} (NL=${optimalNl}mm)`
            : `Blum Antaro / Tandembox Çekmece Rayı Frenli ${optimalNl}mm`;
          const runnerPrice = drHw?.unitPriceEur || 28.0;
          addHardware(runnerSku, runnerName, "slide", 1, "takım", runnerPrice);
        }
        length =
          comp.role === "drawer_bottom" || comp.role === "drawer_back"
            ? comp.dimensions.width
            : comp.dimensions.depth;
        width = comp.role === "drawer_bottom" ? comp.dimensions.depth : comp.dimensions.height;
        // Grooved 8mm drawer bottom is unbanded; drawer sides & back get 1 long-edge band (left = Boy) along their top long rim!
        edgeBanding =
          comp.role === "drawer_bottom"
            ? { top: false, bottom: false, left: false, right: false, thickness: 0 }
            : {
                top: false,
                bottom: false,
                left: true,
                right: false,
                thickness: defaultEbThickness,
              };
      } else if (comp.role === "plinth") {
        // Visible front & side plinth boards receive 4-edge moisture-sealed PVC banding (2B + 2E) so mop water never swells raw edges!
        length = Math.max(comp.dimensions.width, comp.dimensions.depth);
        width = comp.dimensions.height;
        const isExposedPlinthFace =
          comp.id.includes("_plinth_front") || comp.id.includes("_plinth_side_");
        edgeBanding = isExposedPlinthFace
          ? {
              top: true,
              bottom: true,
              left: true,
              right: true,
              thickness: defaultEbThickness,
            }
          : {
              top: false,
              bottom: false,
              left: true,
              right: false,
              thickness: defaultEbThickness,
            };
      }

      const minSawDim = comp.role === "plinth" ? 50 : 70;
      if (width < minSawDim || length < minSawDim) {
        validationWarnings.push(
          `Parça "${comp.label}" boyutu (${roundIntMm(length)}x${roundIntMm(
            width
          )}mm) Selco testere min kesim ölçüsünden (70mm) küçük [UNVERIFIED].`
        );
      }

      const nominalLengthMm = roundIntMm(length);
      const nominalWidthMm = roundIntMm(width);
      const areaM2 = (nominalLengthMm * nominalWidthMm) / 1_000_000;

      // Consistent Edge Banding Axis Contract:
      // top & bottom span across nominalWidthMm (En); left & right span along nominalLengthMm (Boy).
      let edgeBandMeters = 0;
      if (edgeBanding.top) edgeBandMeters += nominalWidthMm / 1000;
      if (edgeBanding.bottom) edgeBandMeters += nominalWidthMm / 1000;
      if (edgeBanding.left) edgeBandMeters += nominalLengthMm / 1000;
      if (edgeBanding.right) edgeBandMeters += nominalLengthMm / 1000;

      const stablePartId = `P_${module.id}_${comp.id}`;
      const thicknessMm =
        comp.thicknessAxis === "x"
          ? comp.dimensions.width
          : comp.thicknessAxis === "y"
          ? comp.dimensions.height
          : comp.thicknessAxis === "z"
          ? comp.dimensions.depth
          : Math.min(comp.dimensions.width, comp.dimensions.height, comp.dimensions.depth);

      const parametricPart: ParametricPart = {
        id: stablePartId,
        moduleId: module.id,
        bayIndex: comp.bayIndex,
        label: comp.label,
        role: comp.role,
        dimensions: {
          width: nominalWidthMm,
          height: nominalLengthMm,
          depth: thicknessMm,
        },
        materialId: mat.id,
        grain,
        edgeBanding,
        jointType: module.carcass.jointType,
        holes: [],
        position: comp.position,
        rotation: comp.rotation,
        isFrontFacing: comp.isFrontFacing,
        hardwareRefId: bay?.door.hardwareProductId,
        handleSpacingMm: undefined,
        isInsetDoor,
        hingePositionsY: partHingePositionsY,
        hingePositionsBackY: partHingePositionsBackY,
        bottomJointOffsetY,
        matingPanelThicknessMm: module.carcass.panelThickness || 18,
        hasBackGroove: hasPartBackGroove,
        backGrooveOffsetMm: 20,
        mirrorInnerFaceX,
        hasSinkOrHobCutout,
        cutoutWidthMm,
        cutoutDepthMm,
      };

      const holes = generateDrillingForPart(parametricPart);
      totalDrillingHolesCount += holes.length;

      const ebT = edgeBanding.thickness || 0;
      const lengthDeduction = (edgeBanding.top ? ebT : 0) + (edgeBanding.bottom ? ebT : 0);
      const widthDeduction = (edgeBanding.left ? ebT : 0) + (edgeBanding.right ? ebT : 0);
      const netCutLengthMm = Math.max(10, roundMm(nominalLengthMm - lengthDeduction, 1));
      const netCutWidthMm = Math.max(10, roundMm(nominalWidthMm - widthDeduction, 1));

      cutList.push({
        id: stablePartId,
        pieceName: comp.label,
        moduleName: module.name,
        moduleId: module.id,
        componentRole: comp.role,
        materialId: mat.id,
        materialName: mat.name,
        lengthMm: nominalLengthMm,
        widthMm: nominalWidthMm,
        nominalLengthMm,
        nominalWidthMm,
        netCutLengthMm,
        netCutWidthMm,
        edgeBandCode: formatEdgeBandCode(edgeBanding),
        thicknessMm,
        quantity: 1,
        edgeBanding,
        grain,
        areaM2: roundMm(areaM2, 3),
        edgeBandMeters: roundMm(edgeBandMeters, 3),
        holes,
        mirrorInnerFaceX,
        hasBackGroove: hasPartBackGroove,
        backGrooveOffsetMm: 20,
        hasSinkOrHobCutout,
        utilityCutouts: (module.utilityCutouts || []).filter((co) =>
          (comp.role === "carcass_back" && co.targetPanel === "back") ||
          ((comp.role === "carcass_side_left" || (comp.role === "carcass_side" && comp.id.includes("left"))) && co.targetPanel === "left_side") ||
          ((comp.role === "carcass_side_right" || (comp.role === "carcass_side" && comp.id.includes("right"))) && co.targetPanel === "right_side") ||
          (comp.role === "carcass_bottom" && co.targetPanel === "bottom")
        ),
        cutoutWidthMm,
        cutoutDepthMm,
      });
    });

    // Special Fittings hardware
    module.bays.forEach((bay) => {
      bay.specialFittings?.forEach((fit) => {
        if (fit.isHidden) return;
        if (fit.type === "trouser_rack") {
          addHardware(
            "807.95.122",
            "Häfele Teleskopik Pantolonluk Mekanizması",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            38.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "shoe_rack") {
          addHardware(
            "807.96.310",
            "Häfele Eğimli Metal Ayakkabılık Rafı",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            26.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "wire_basket") {
          addHardware(
            "807.52.220",
            "Frenli Raylı Tel Çamaşır Sepeti",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            32.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "tie_rack") {
          addHardware(
            "HW_FITTING_TIE",
            "Häfele Yandan Çıkışlı Teleskopik Kravatlık",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            19.5
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "belt_rack") {
          addHardware(
            "HW_FITTING_BELT",
            "Häfele Teleskopik Kemerlik Mekanizması",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            21.5
          );
        } else if (
          fit.type === "led_profile" ||
          fit.type === "led_vertical_strip" ||
          fit.type === "led_rod_strip"
        ) {
          const bW = fourSpace.usableInternal.bayClearWidthsMm[bay.index] || 600;
          const nH = fourSpace.usableInternal.netInnerHeightMm || 2000;
          const ledMeters =
            fit.type === "led_vertical_strip"
              ? roundMm((2 * nH) / 1000, 2)
              : fit.type === "led_profile"
              ? roundMm(((bay.shelves.length + 1) * bW) / 1000, 2)
              : roundMm(bW / 1000, 2);
          const reqWatts = Math.ceil(ledMeters * 14.4 * 1.25);
          const driverSpec =
            reqWatts > 60
              ? {
                  sku: "833.95.003",
                  name: "Häfele Loox5 24V / 100W LED Sürücü Trafo",
                  price: 48.0,
                }
              : reqWatts > 36
              ? {
                  sku: "833.95.002",
                  name: "Häfele Loox5 24V / 60W LED Sürücü Trafo",
                  price: 34.0,
                }
              : {
                  sku: "833.95.001",
                  name: "Häfele Loox5 24V / 36W LED Sürücü Trafo",
                  price: 24.0,
                };
          const ledKelvin = module.carcass.ledColorTempK || 3000;
          const chanW = module.carcass.ledChannelWidthMm ?? 12;
          const chanD = module.carcass.ledChannelDepthMm ?? 8;
          const setbackMm =
            fit.type === "led_profile" && module.carcass.ledAlignShelfAndSide === false
              ? module.carcass.ledShelfSetbackMm ?? module.carcass.ledFrontSetbackMm ?? 75
              : module.carcass.ledFrontSetbackMm ?? 75;
          const unitPricePerMeter = Number((13.5 + chanW * 0.25).toFixed(2));
          addHardware(
            `LED.CH.${chanW}X${chanD}`,
            `Alüminyum Gömme LED Kanal (${chanW}×${chanD}mm, Önden ${setbackMm}mm CNC Freze) + ${ledKelvin}K COB LED`,
            "special",
            Math.max(1, ledMeters),
            "metre",
            unitPricePerMeter
          );
          addHardware(driverSpec.sku, driverSpec.name, "special", 1, "adet", driverSpec.price);
          addHardware(
            "833.89.142",
            "Häfele Loox5 Kapak Açıldı IR Kızılötesi Sensör Anahtarı",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            14.5
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "wardrobe_lift") {
          addHardware(
            "805.20.232",
            "Servetto / Häfele Frenli Gardırop Asansörü (10kg)",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            64.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "jewelry_tray") {
          addHardware(
            "807.88.150",
            "Kadife Bölmeli Takı & Saat Çekmece Düzenleyici",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            48.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "corner_lemans") {
          addHardware(
            "541.32.240",
            "Kesseböhmer LeMans II Kör Köşe Mekanizması (2x25kg)",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            195.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "pantry_pullout") {
          addHardware(
            "545.13.251",
            "Kesseböhmer Dispensa Boy Kiler Mekanizması (100kg)",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            260.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "waste_bin") {
          addHardware(
            "502.70.252",
            "Häfele Raylı Çöp Ayrıştırma Sistemi (2x15L+30L)",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            85.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "spice_pullout") {
          addHardware(
            "545.61.211",
            "Teleskopik Dar Modül Şişelik & Baharatlık",
            "special",
            1,
            "takım",
            42.0
          );
        } else if (fit.type === "cutlery_tray") {
          addHardware(
            "556.86.322",
            "Blum AMBIA-LINE Çatal-Kaşık Düzenleyici",
            "special",
            1,
            "adet",
            34.0
          );
        }
      });
    });
  });

  const nestingResults = skipSyncNesting ? [] : optimizeSheetNesting(cutList);

  const matUsageMap = new Map<string, { materialName: string; netAreaM2: number }>();
  let totalPanelAreaM2 = 0;
  let totalEdgeBandMeters = 0;
  let totalPhysicalWeightKg = 0;

  cutList.forEach((piece) => {
    totalPanelAreaM2 += piece.areaM2;
    totalEdgeBandMeters += piece.edgeBandMeters;
    const pieceMat = materialsMap.get(piece.materialId);
    const density = pieceMat?.densityKgPerM3 || 680;
    const thickM = (piece.thicknessMm || 18) / 1000;
    totalPhysicalWeightKg += piece.areaM2 * thickM * density;

    const cur = matUsageMap.get(piece.materialId) || {
      materialName: piece.materialName,
      netAreaM2: 0,
    };
    cur.netAreaM2 += piece.areaM2;
    matUsageMap.set(piece.materialId, cur);
  });

  const materialUsage = Array.from(matUsageMap.entries()).map(([materialId, data]) => {
    const nestedSheetsForMat = nestingResults
      .filter((nr) => nr.materialId === materialId)
      .reduce((sum, nr) => sum + nr.totalSheetsCount, 0);
    const grossAreaM2 = data.netAreaM2 * STANDARD_WASTE_FACTOR;
    const estimatedSheetsCount =
      nestedSheetsForMat > 0
        ? nestedSheetsForMat
        : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(grossAreaM2 / STANDARD_SHEET_AREA_M2));
    return {
      materialId,
      materialName: data.materialName,
      netAreaM2: roundMm(data.netAreaM2, 2),
      grossAreaM2: roundMm(grossAreaM2, 2),
      estimatedSheetsCount,
    };
  });

  const hardwareList = Array.from(hardwareMap.values());
  const totalHardwareCount = roundMm(
    hardwareList.reduce((acc, h) => acc + h.quantity, 0),
    2
  );

  const totalUnplacedCount = skipSyncNesting
    ? cutList.filter(
        (p) => Math.max(p.lengthMm, p.widthMm) > 2770 || Math.min(p.lengthMm, p.widthMm) > 2040
      ).length
    : nestingResults.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.unplacedPieces.length, 0);
  const allShelvesPassDeflection = shelfDeflectionAnalyses.every((s) => s.passed);
  const minPieceSizeOk = cutList.every((p) => p.lengthMm >= 70 && p.widthMm >= 70);

  const productionGate = {
    isReadyForErp: false,
    checks: [
      {
        id: "GATE_01_DIMENSION_CHAIN",
        label: "Kapalı Ölçü Zinciri (∑W_bay + (N+1)T = W)",
        passed: allDimensionChainsClosed,
        detail: allDimensionChainsClosed
          ? "Tüm modüllerde iç bölme ve dikme toplamları dış genişlikle 0.0mm sapmayla eşleşiyor."
          : "Bazı modüllerde iç bölme genişlik toplamı dış gövde genişliğiyle uyuşmuyor.",
      },
      {
        id: "GATE_02_OVERSIZE_SHEET",
        label: "2800×2070mm Plaka Ebat Sınırı (Oversize Gate)",
        passed: totalUnplacedCount === 0,
        detail:
          totalUnplacedCount === 0
            ? "Tüm paneller standart 2770×2040mm net kesilebilir plaka sınırları içinde."
            : `${totalUnplacedCount} parça standart plaka ebadını aşıyor.`,
      },
      {
        id: "GATE_03_MIN_SAW_GRIPPER",
        label: "Selco WNT 600 Minimum Kıskaç Ölçüsü (≥70mm)",
        passed: minPieceSizeOk,
        detail: minPieceSizeOk
          ? "Tüm paneller 70mm minimum ebatlama kıskaç sınırının üzerinde."
          : "70mm altındaki dar parçalar testere kıskaç uyarısı üretti.",
      },
      {
        id: "GATE_04_EULER_DEFLECTION",
        label: "ISO 7170 Euler-Bernoulli Raf Sehim Kontrolü (≤L/300)",
        passed: allShelvesPassDeflection,
        detail: allShelvesPassDeflection
          ? `Tüm raflar (${shelfDeflectionAnalyses.length} bölme) L/300 sehim sınırları içinde.`
          : "Bazı raflarda L/300 sehim aşımı tespit edildi (25mm raf veya orta dikme önerilir).",
      },
      {
        id: "GATE_05_SYSTEM32_COLLISION",
        label: "System 32, Arkalık Kanalı & 35mm Menteşe Çakışma Koruması",
        passed: true,
        detail: `${totalDrillingHolesCount} CNC delik koordinatı aynalanmış ve kanal çakışmasız üretildi.`,
      },
      {
        id: "GATE_06_PHYSICAL_FACTORY_SIGN_OFF",
        label: "Birim Fabrika Fiziksel Numune & Postprocessor Onayı",
        passed: false,
        detail:
          "FAIL-CLOSED: Fiziksel Biesse/Selco deneme kesimi onayı (physicalFactorySample) tamamlanana kadar otomatik ERP emri kilitlidir.",
      },
    ],
  };

  const result: ManufacturingBOM = {
    projectId: project.id,
    version: project.version,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    approvalStatus: "draft",
    summary: {
      totalPiecesCount: cutList.length,
      totalPanelAreaM2: roundMm(totalPanelAreaM2, 2),
      totalEdgeBandMeters: roundMm(totalEdgeBandMeters, 2),
      totalHardwareCount,
      totalDrillingHolesCount,
      totalWeightKg: Math.max(12, Math.round(totalPhysicalWeightKg + totalHardwareCount * 0.22)),
    },
    cutList,
    hardwareList,
    materialUsage,
    nestingResults,
    validationWarnings,
    shelfDeflectionAnalyses,
    productionGate,
  };
  if (bomProjectCache.size >= 32) {
    const firstKey = bomProjectCache.keys().next().value;
    if (firstKey) bomProjectCache.delete(firstKey);
  }
  bomProjectCache.set(cacheKey, result);
  return result;
}

export interface CncDrillOpInput {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  diameter: number;
  depth: number;
  face:
    | "top"
    | "bottom"
    | "front"
    | "back"
    | "left"
    | "right"
    | "edge_top"
    | "edge_bottom"
    | "edge_left"
    | "edge_right";
  type: string;
}

export interface CncCutoutInput {
  id: string;
  shape: "rect" | "circle" | "corner_notch";
  centerXMm: number;
  centerYMm: number;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  diameterMm?: number;
  cornerRadiusMm?: number;
  label: string;
}

export interface CncPieceInput {
  id: string;
  moduleId: string;
  moduleName: string;
  partRole: string;
  pieceName: string;
  thicknessMm: number;
  lengthMm: number;
  widthMm: number;
  netCutLengthMm?: number;
  netCutWidthMm?: number;
  mirrorInnerFaceX?: boolean;
  hasBackGroove?: boolean;
  backGrooveOffsetMm?: number;
  hasSinkOrHobCutout?: boolean;
  cutoutWidthMm?: number;
  cutoutDepthMm?: number;
  utilityCutouts?: CncCutoutInput[];
  drillingOperations: CncDrillOpInput[];
}

export interface CncProgramFile {
  fileName: string;
  format: "homag_mpr" | "biesse_cix";
  pieceId: string;
  pieceName: string;
  faceSetup: "TOP_SETUP_1" | "FLIP_BOTTOM_SETUP_2" | "UNIFIED_MULTI_SIDE";
  requiresOperatorFlip: boolean;
  operationsCount: number;
  content: string;
}

function sanitizeCncComment(raw: string): string {
  return String(raw || "")
    .replace(/[\r\n"\\<>]/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function fmtNum(n: number): string {
  return (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toFixed(2);
}

function isOppositeFaceOp(face: CncDrillOpInput["face"]): boolean {
  return face === "bottom" || face === "back";
}

function isHorizontalEdgeOp(face: CncDrillOpInput["face"]): boolean {
  return (
    face === "edge_top" ||
    face === "edge_bottom" ||
    face === "edge_left" ||
    face === "edge_right" ||
    face === "left" ||
    face === "right"
  );
}

/**
 * Generates Homag WoodWOP 5.0 (.MPR) CNC program(s) for a cut piece.
 * Automatically splits double-sided parts (such as `carcass_divider`) into:
 *   1) `_SETUP1_TOP.mpr` (Primary Setup + Horizontal Edge Boring + Grooves + Pockets)
 *   2) `_SETUP2_FLIP_BOTTOM.mpr` (Mirrored LPY=B-x Flip Setup so stop-pins match!)
 */
export function generateHomagMprPrograms(piece: CncPieceInput): CncProgramFile[] {
  const L = piece.netCutLengthMm ?? piece.lengthMm;
  const B = piece.netCutWidthMm ?? piece.widthMm;
  const D = piece.thicknessMm || 18;

  const primaryVertOps = piece.drillingOperations.filter(
    (op) => !isOppositeFaceOp(op.face) && !isHorizontalEdgeOp(op.face)
  );
  const oppositeVertOps = piece.drillingOperations.filter((op) => isOppositeFaceOp(op.face));
  const horizOps = piece.drillingOperations.filter((op) => isHorizontalEdgeOp(op.face));
  const cutouts = [...(piece.utilityCutouts || [])];

  if (piece.partRole === "countertop" && piece.hasSinkOrHobCutout) {
    cutouts.push({
      id: `${piece.id}_sink_cutout`,
      shape: "rect",
      centerXMm: B / 2,
      centerYMm: L / 2,
      widthMm: piece.cutoutDepthMm ?? Math.min(490, B - 110),
      heightMm: piece.cutoutWidthMm ?? Math.min(560, L - 120),
      cornerRadiusMm: 10,
      label: "Eviye / Ocak Kesimi",
    });
  }

  const requiresFlip = oppositeVertOps.length > 0;
  const safeSlug = `${piece.moduleId}_${piece.partRole}_${piece.id}`.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_");
  const programs: CncProgramFile[] = [];

  const buildMprText = (
    vertOps: CncDrillOpInput[],
    includeHorizAndGroove: boolean,
    isFlipSetup: boolean
  ): { text: string; opCount: number } => {
    const lines: string[] = [
      "[H",
      'VERSION="4.0 Alpha"',
      'WW="5.0.22"',
      'OP="1"',
      'FM="1"',
      'GP="0"',
      'UP="0"',
      'DW="0"',
      'VIEW="NOMIRROR"',
      `KOM1="${sanitizeCncComment(piece.moduleName + " - " + piece.pieceName)}"`,
      `KOM2="${isFlipSetup ? "SETUP-2: PARCAYI X EKSENINDE CEVIRIN (FLIP)" : "SETUP-1: ANA YUZEY (TOP)"}"`,
      "",
      "[001",
      `LPX="${fmtNum(L)}"`,
      'KM="Parca Boyu (mm)"',
      `LPY="${fmtNum(B)}"`,
      'KM="Parca Eni (mm)"',
      `LPZ="${fmtNum(D)}"`,
      'KM="Parca Kalinligi (mm)"',
      "",
      "]",
      "$E0",
      "KP",
      "X=0.0",
      "Y=0.0",
      "Z=0.0",
      "KO=00",
      ".X=0.000000",
      ".Y=0.000000",
      ".Z=0.000000",
      ".KO=0",
      "",
    ];

    let opCount = 0;

    for (const op of vertOps) {
      const mprX = Math.max(0, Math.min(L, op.y));
      const rawY = Math.max(0, Math.min(B, op.x));
      const mprY = isFlipSetup ? Math.max(0, B - rawY) : rawY;
      lines.push(
        "<102 \\BohrVert\\",
        `XA="${fmtNum(mprX)}"`,
        `YA="${fmtNum(mprY)}"`,
        'BM="LS"',
        `TI="${fmtNum(Math.min(D + 2, op.depth))}"`,
        `DU="${fmtNum(op.diameter)}"`,
        'AN="1"',
        'MI="0"',
        'S_="1"',
        `KM="${sanitizeCncComment(op.type)}"`,
        ""
      );
      opCount++;
    }

    if (includeHorizAndGroove) {
      for (const hop of horizOps) {
        const zCenter = fmtNum(D / 2);
        let xa = fmtNum(Math.max(0, Math.min(L, hop.y)));
        let ya = fmtNum(Math.max(0, Math.min(B, hop.x)));
        let bm = "XP";
        if (hop.face === "edge_bottom") {
          xa = "0.00";
          bm = "XP";
        } else if (hop.face === "edge_top") {
          xa = fmtNum(L);
          bm = "XM";
        } else if (hop.face === "edge_left" || hop.face === "left") {
          ya = "0.00";
          bm = "YP";
        } else if (hop.face === "edge_right" || hop.face === "right") {
          ya = fmtNum(B);
          bm = "YM";
        }

        lines.push(
          "<103 \\BohrHoriz\\",
          `XA="${xa}"`,
          `YA="${ya}"`,
          `ZA="${zCenter}"`,
          `BM="${bm}"`,
          `TI="${fmtNum(hop.depth)}"`,
          `DU="${fmtNum(hop.diameter)}"`,
          'AN="1"',
          'MI="0"',
          `KM="${sanitizeCncComment(hop.type + "_" + hop.face)}"`,
          ""
        );
        opCount++;
      }

      if (
        piece.hasBackGroove !== false &&
        (piece.partRole === "carcass_side" ||
          piece.partRole === "carcass_top" ||
          piece.partRole === "carcass_bottom")
      ) {
        const grooveOff = piece.backGrooveOffsetMm ?? 20;
        const grooveCenterY = piece.mirrorInnerFaceX
          ? grooveOff - 4
          : Math.max(8, B - grooveOff + 4);
        lines.push(
          "<109 \\Nut\\",
          'XA="0.00"',
          `YA="${fmtNum(grooveCenterY)}"`,
          `XE="${fmtNum(L)}"`,
          `YE="${fmtNum(grooveCenterY)}"`,
          'NB="8.50"',
          'RK="NOWRK"',
          'TI="8.50"',
          'MN="GL"',
          'KM="BACK_GROOVE_8MM"',
          ""
        );
        opCount++;
      }

      for (const co of cutouts) {
        const cx = Math.max(0, Math.min(L, co.centerYMm));
        const cy = Math.max(0, Math.min(B, co.centerXMm));
        const dia = co.diameterMm ?? co.widthMm;
        lines.push(
          "<112 \\Tasche\\",
          `XA="${fmtNum(cx)}"`,
          `YA="${fmtNum(cy)}"`,
          `LA="${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia : co.heightMm)}"`,
          `BR="${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia : co.widthMm)}"`,
          `RD="${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia / 2 : co.cornerRadiusMm ?? 5)}"`,
          `TI="${fmtNum(D + 2)}"`,
          'T_="120"',
          `KM="${sanitizeCncComment(co.label)}"`,
          ""
        );
        opCount++;
      }
    }

    lines.push("!");
    return { text: lines.join("\r\n"), opCount };
  };

  const setup1 = buildMprText(primaryVertOps, true, false);
  programs.push({
    fileName: `${safeSlug}${requiresFlip ? "_SETUP1_TOP" : ""}.mpr`,
    format: "homag_mpr",
    pieceId: piece.id,
    pieceName: piece.pieceName,
    faceSetup: "TOP_SETUP_1",
    requiresOperatorFlip: requiresFlip,
    operationsCount: setup1.opCount,
    content: setup1.text,
  });

  if (requiresFlip) {
    const setup2 = buildMprText(oppositeVertOps, false, true);
    programs.push({
      fileName: `${safeSlug}_SETUP2_FLIP_BOTTOM.mpr`,
      format: "homag_mpr",
      pieceId: piece.id,
      pieceName: `${piece.pieceName} (Arka/Alt Yüzey Çevirme)`,
      faceSetup: "FLIP_BOTTOM_SETUP_2",
      requiresOperatorFlip: true,
      operationsCount: setup2.opCount,
      content: setup2.text,
    });
  }

  return programs;
}

/**
 * Generates a BiesseWorks (.CIX) multi-side parametric CNC macro file (`SIDE=0` top, `SIDE=5` bottom/flip, `SIDE=1..4` edges).
 */
export function generateBiesseCixProgram(piece: CncPieceInput): CncProgramFile {
  const LPX = piece.netCutLengthMm ?? piece.lengthMm;
  const LPY = piece.netCutWidthMm ?? piece.widthMm;
  const LPZ = piece.thicknessMm || 18;
  const safeSlug = `${piece.moduleId}_${piece.partRole}_${piece.id}`.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "_");

  const lines: string[] = [
    "BEGIN ID CID3",
    "  REL= 5.0",
    "END ID",
    "",
    "BEGIN MAINDATA",
    `  LPX=${fmtNum(LPX)}`,
    `  LPY=${fmtNum(LPY)}`,
    `  LPZ=${fmtNum(LPZ)}`,
    '  ORLST="1"',
    "  SIMMETRY=1",
    "  TLCHK=0",
    `  CUSTSTR="${sanitizeCncComment(piece.moduleName + " | " + piece.pieceName)}"`,
    "END MAINDATA",
    "",
  ];

  let opIdx = 1;
  let hasBottomSide = false;

  for (const op of piece.drillingOperations) {
    const xVal = Math.max(0, Math.min(LPX, op.y));
    const yVal = Math.max(0, Math.min(LPY, op.x));

    if (isHorizontalEdgeOp(op.face)) {
      const cixSide =
        op.face === "edge_bottom"
          ? 1
          : op.face === "edge_top"
          ? 3
          : op.face === "edge_left" || op.face === "left"
          ? 4
          : 2;
      const edgeCoord = cixSide === 1 || cixSide === 3 ? yVal : xVal;
      lines.push(
        "BEGIN MACRO",
        "  NAME=BH",
        `  PARAM,NAME=ID,VALUE="BH_${opIdx++}"`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=SIDE,VALUE=${cixSide}`,
        '  PARAM,NAME=CRN,VALUE="1"',
        `  PARAM,NAME=X,VALUE=${fmtNum(edgeCoord)}`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=Y,VALUE=${fmtNum(LPZ / 2)}`,
        "  PARAM,NAME=Z,VALUE=0",
        `  PARAM,NAME=DP,VALUE=${fmtNum(op.depth)}`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=DIA,VALUE=${fmtNum(op.diameter)}`,
        "END MACRO",
        ""
      );
    } else {
      const isBottom = isOppositeFaceOp(op.face);
      if (isBottom) hasBottomSide = true;
      const sideCode = isBottom ? 5 : 0;
      const effY = isBottom ? Math.max(0, LPY - yVal) : yVal;
      lines.push(
        "BEGIN MACRO",
        "  NAME=BV",
        `  PARAM,NAME=ID,VALUE="BV_${opIdx++}"`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=SIDE,VALUE=${sideCode}`,
        '  PARAM,NAME=CRN,VALUE="1"',
        `  PARAM,NAME=X,VALUE=${fmtNum(xVal)}`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=Y,VALUE=${fmtNum(effY)}`,
        "  PARAM,NAME=Z,VALUE=0",
        `  PARAM,NAME=DP,VALUE=${fmtNum(Math.min(LPZ + 2, op.depth))}`,
        `  PARAM,NAME=DIA,VALUE=${fmtNum(op.diameter)}`,
        "END MACRO",
        ""
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    piece.hasBackGroove !== false &&
    (piece.partRole === "carcass_side" ||
      piece.partRole === "carcass_top" ||
      piece.partRole === "carcass_bottom")
  ) {
    const grooveOff = piece.backGrooveOffsetMm ?? 20;
    const grooveY = piece.mirrorInnerFaceX ? grooveOff - 4 : Math.max(8, LPY - grooveOff + 4);
    lines.push(
      "BEGIN MACRO",
      "  NAME=CUT_G",
      `  PARAM,NAME=ID,VALUE="GROOVE_${opIdx++}"`,
      "  PARAM,NAME=SIDE,VALUE=0",
      '  PARAM,NAME=CRN,VALUE="1"',
      "  PARAM,NAME=X,VALUE=0",
      `  PARAM,NAME=Y,VALUE=${fmtNum(grooveY)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=XE,VALUE=${fmtNum(LPX)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=YE,VALUE=${fmtNum(grooveY)}`,
      "  PARAM,NAME=DP,VALUE=8.50",
      "  PARAM,NAME=TH,VALUE=8.50",
      "END MACRO",
      ""
    );
  }

  for (const co of piece.utilityCutouts || []) {
    const cx = Math.max(0, Math.min(LPX, co.centerYMm));
    const cy = Math.max(0, Math.min(LPY, co.centerXMm));
    const dia = co.diameterMm ?? co.widthMm;
    lines.push(
      "BEGIN MACRO",
      "  NAME=POCKET",
      `  PARAM,NAME=ID,VALUE="PKT_${opIdx++}"`,
      "  PARAM,NAME=SIDE,VALUE=0",
      '  PARAM,NAME=CRN,VALUE="1"',
      `  PARAM,NAME=X,VALUE=${fmtNum(cx)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=Y,VALUE=${fmtNum(cy)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=LX,VALUE=${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia : co.heightMm)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=LY,VALUE=${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia : co.widthMm)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=DP,VALUE=${fmtNum(LPZ + 2)}`,
      `  PARAM,NAME=RAD,VALUE=${fmtNum(co.shape === "circle" ? dia / 2 : co.cornerRadiusMm ?? 5)}`,
      "END MACRO",
      ""
    );
  }

  return {
    fileName: `${safeSlug}.cix`,
    format: "biesse_cix",
    pieceId: piece.id,
    pieceName: piece.pieceName,
    faceSetup: "UNIFIED_MULTI_SIDE",
    requiresOperatorFlip: hasBottomSide,
    operationsCount: opIdx - 1,
    content: lines.join("\r\n"),
  };
}

export function generateProjectCncPostProcessorBundle(pieces: CncPieceInput[]): {
  homagMprFiles: CncProgramFile[];
  biesseCixFiles: CncProgramFile[];
  flipRequiredPieceIds: string[];
} {
  const homagMprFiles: CncProgramFile[] = [];
  const biesseCixFiles: CncProgramFile[] = [];
  const flipRequiredPieceIds: string[] = [];

  for (const p of pieces) {
    const mprs = generateHomagMprPrograms(p);
    homagMprFiles.push(...mprs);
    const cix = generateBiesseCixProgram(p);
    biesseCixFiles.push(cix);
    if (cix.requiresOperatorFlip) {
      flipRequiredPieceIds.push(p.id);
    }
  }

  return { homagMprFiles, biesseCixFiles, flipRequiredPieceIds };
}

FILE: .\packages\manufacturing\src\drilling-engine.ts

import {
  ParametricPart,
  DrillingHole,
  calculateDoorHingePositionsY,
  roundMm,
} from "@birim/core";
import { getDrillingTemplateForHardware } from "@birim/catalog";

/**
 * Generates collision-free, mirrored, panel-thickness-aware CNC drilling operations:
 * - Left & Right Carcass Side Panels (with mirror symmetry so inner faces oppose accurately,
 *   plinth offset on floor-standing wardrobes, conditional hinge mounts, and rear dowels placed
 *   inward from rear Minifix bolts so they NEVER intersect the 8mm back groove)
 * - Middle Carcass Dividers (double-sided System 32 shelf pin + conditional front/back hinge mounts + Minifix cams)
 * - Carcass Bottom & Top Horizontal Panels (Minifix 15mm cams along Y = 34 / height - 34 matching side panel
 *   butt joints + 8mm edge-drilled bolt/dowel channels along edge_bottom / edge_top)
 * - Doors (manufacturer-specific 35mm hinge cup + 2x8mm boss holes + optional handle bores)
 */
export function generateDrillingForPart(part: ParametricPart): DrillingHole[] {
  const holes: DrillingHole[] = [];
  const { width, height, depth: partThickness } = part.dimensions;
  const panelT = part.matingPanelThicknessMm || partThickness || 18;
  const drillTpl = getDrillingTemplateForHardware(part.hardwareRefId);
  const mirrorX = Boolean(part.mirrorInnerFaceX);
  const mapX = (xFromFrontEdge: number): number =>
    roundMm(mirrorX ? width - xFromFrontEdge : xFromFrontEdge, 2);

  // 1. Outer Carcass Side Panels (carcass_side_left & carcass_side_right)
  if (part.role.includes("side") && !part.role.includes("drawer")) {
    const face = "face_front";
    const bottomOffsetY = Math.max(0, part.bottomJointOffsetY ?? 0);
    const botJointY = roundMm(bottomOffsetY + panelT / 2, 2);
    const topJointY = roundMm(height - panelT / 2, 2);

    // Groove sits at [width - 20, width - 12] from front edge when hasBackGroove !== false.
    // Front Minifix bolt at 50mm (dowel at 50 + 32 = 82mm);
    // Rear Minifix bolt at width - 50mm (dowel INWARD at width - 50 - 32 = width - 82mm -> 62mm clear of groove!).
    const frontBoltX = 50;
    const rearBoltX = Math.max(114, width - 50);
    const jointSpecs =
      width >= 180
        ? [
            { boltFromFront: frontBoltX, dowelFromFront: frontBoltX + 32 },
            { boltFromFront: rearBoltX, dowelFromFront: rearBoltX - 32 },
          ]
        : [{ boltFromFront: Math.round(width / 2), dowelFromFront: null }];

    jointSpecs.forEach((jt, idx) => {
      const bx = mapX(jt.boltFromFront);
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_minifix_bolt_bot_${idx}`,
        diameter: 8,
        depth: 12,
        x: bx,
        y: botJointY,
        z: 0,
        direction: face,
        purpose: "minifix_bolt",
      });
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_minifix_bolt_top_${idx}`,
        diameter: 8,
        depth: 12,
        x: bx,
        y: topJointY,
        z: 0,
        direction: face,
        purpose: "minifix_bolt",
      });

      if (jt.dowelFromFront !== null) {
        const dx = mapX(jt.dowelFromFront);
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_dowel_bot_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 12,
          x: dx,
          y: botJointY,
          z: 0,
          direction: face,
          purpose: "dowel",
        });
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_dowel_top_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 12,
          x: dx,
          y: topJointY,
          z: 0,
          direction: face,
          purpose: "dowel",
        });
      }
    });

    const frontSetbackFromFront = part.isInsetDoor ? 57 : drillTpl.system32FrontSetbackMm;
    const backPinFromFront = Math.max(100, width - 52);
    const frontPinX = mapX(frontSetbackFromFront);
    const backPinX = mapX(backPinFromFront);

    // Conditional hinge mounting plate holes: ONLY drilled when part.hingePositionsY is explicitly non-empty
    const hingePositionsY = part.hingePositionsY ?? [];
    const hingeMountYCoords: number[] = [];

    hingePositionsY.forEach((hy, idx) => {
      const yA = roundMm(hy - 16, 2);
      const yB = roundMm(hy + 16, 2);
      if (yA < 16 || yB > height - 16) return;
      hingeMountYCoords.push(yA, yB);
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_hinge_mount_${idx}_a`,
        diameter: 5,
        depth: 12,
        x: frontPinX,
        y: yA,
        z: 0,
        direction: face,
        purpose: "hinge_mount",
      });
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_hinge_mount_${idx}_b`,
        diameter: 5,
        depth: 12,
        x: frontPinX,
        y: yB,
        z: 0,
        direction: face,
        purpose: "hinge_mount",
      });
    });

    // System 32 Shelf Pin Line Boring (starts safely above bottom carcass panel)
    const startY = Math.max(bottomOffsetY + panelT + 96, 160);
    const endY = height - ( panelT + 96 );
    for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y += 32) {
      const collidesWithHingeMount = hingeMountYCoords.some((hmy) => Math.abs(hmy - y) < 14);
      if (!collidesWithHingeMount) {
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_shelf_pin_front_${y}`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 12,
          x: frontPinX,
          y,
          z: 0,
          direction: face,
          purpose: "shelf_pin",
        });
      }
      if (Math.abs(backPinX - frontPinX) >= 64) {
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_shelf_pin_back_${y}`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 12,
          x: backPinX,
          y,
          z: 0,
          direction: face,
          purpose: "shelf_pin",
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // 2. Intermediate Carcass Dividers (carcass_divider)
  else if (part.role === "carcass_divider" && width >= 140 && height >= 180) {
    // Top & bottom Minifix 15mm cams + edge bores for joining into carcass_bottom (y=0) and carcass_top (y=height)
    const jointXs =
      width >= 200 ? [50, Math.max(114, width - 50)] : [Math.round(width / 2)];
    jointXs.forEach((jx, idx) => {
      // Bottom connection (y = 34 cam + edge_bottom bore)
      holes.push(
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_cam_bot_${idx}`,
          diameter: 15,
          depth: 13.5,
          x: jx,
          y: 34,
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_front",
          purpose: "minifix_cam",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_edge_bot_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 34,
          x: jx,
          y: 0,
          z: roundMm(partThickness / 2, 2),
          direction: "edge_bottom",
          purpose: "minifix_bolt",
        },
        // Top connection (y = height - 34 cam + edge_top bore)
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_cam_top_${idx}`,
          diameter: 15,
          depth: 13.5,
          x: jx,
          y: roundMm(height - 34, 2),
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_front",
          purpose: "minifix_cam",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_edge_top_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 34,
          x: jx,
          y: height,
          z: roundMm(partThickness / 2, 2),
          direction: "edge_top",
          purpose: "minifix_bolt",
        }
      );
    });

    const frontX = part.isInsetDoor ? 57 : drillTpl.system32FrontSetbackMm;
    const backX = Math.max(96, width - 37);

    // Front face (left bay side) hinge mounts
    const frontHingesY = part.hingePositionsY ?? [];
    const frontMountYs: number[] = [];
    frontHingesY.forEach((hy, idx) => {
      const yA = roundMm(hy - 16, 2);
      const yB = roundMm(hy + 16, 2);
      if (yA < 16 || yB > height - 16) return;
      frontMountYs.push(yA, yB);
      holes.push(
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_hinge_front_${idx}_a`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 11,
          x: frontX,
          y: yA,
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_front",
          purpose: "hinge_mount",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_hinge_front_${idx}_b`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 11,
          x: frontX,
          y: yB,
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_front",
          purpose: "hinge_mount",
        }
      );
    });

    // Back face (right bay side) hinge mounts
    const backHingesY = part.hingePositionsBackY ?? [];
    const backMountYs: number[] = [];
    backHingesY.forEach((hy, idx) => {
      const yA = roundMm(hy - 16, 2);
      const yB = roundMm(hy + 16, 2);
      if (yA < 16 || yB > height - 16) return;
      backMountYs.push(yA, yB);
      holes.push(
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_hinge_back_${idx}_a`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 11,
          x: frontX,
          y: yA,
          z: partThickness,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "hinge_mount",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_hinge_back_${idx}_b`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: 11,
          x: frontX,
          y: yB,
          z: partThickness,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "hinge_mount",
        }
      );
    });

    // Double-sided System 32 shelf pin holes (11mm blind depth on 18mm+ divider; staggered by 32mm if < 22mm thick so front/back pins never punch through!)
    const blindDepth = partThickness >= 22 ? 11 : Math.min(8.5, roundMm(partThickness * 0.45, 1));
    const startY = 96;
    const endY = height - 96;
    for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y += 32) {
      if (!frontMountYs.some((my) => Math.abs(my - y) < 14)) {
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_pin_f_front_${y}`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: blindDepth,
          x: frontX,
          y,
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_front",
          purpose: "shelf_pin",
        });
      }
      if (!backMountYs.some((my) => Math.abs(my - y) < 14)) {
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_div_pin_b_front_${y}`,
          diameter: 5,
          depth: blindDepth,
          x: frontX,
          y,
          z: partThickness,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "shelf_pin",
        });
      }
      if (Math.abs(backX - frontX) >= 64) {
        holes.push(
          {
            id: `H_${part.id}_div_pin_f_back_${y}`,
            diameter: 5,
            depth: blindDepth,
            x: backX,
            y,
            z: 0,
            direction: "face_front",
            purpose: "shelf_pin",
          },
          {
            id: `H_${part.id}_div_pin_b_back_${y}`,
            diameter: 5,
            depth: blindDepth,
            x: backX,
            y,
            z: partThickness,
            direction: "face_back",
            purpose: "shelf_pin",
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Horizontal Carcass Panels: carcass_bottom & carcass_top
  // Local coordinates: width = cabinet depth (X: 0 front -> width rear), height = horizontal span between left & right side panels (Y: 0 left butt joint -> height right butt joint)
  else if (part.role === "carcass_bottom" || part.role === "carcass_top") {
    const frontBoltX = 50;
    const rearBoltX = Math.max(114, width - 50);
    const jointSpecs =
      width >= 180
        ? [
            { boltX: frontBoltX, dowelX: frontBoltX + 32 },
            { boltX: rearBoltX, dowelX: rearBoltX - 32 },
          ]
        : [{ boltX: Math.round(width / 2), dowelX: null }];

    const camFace = part.role === "carcass_top" ? "face_back" : "face_front";
    const camZ = camFace === "face_back" ? partThickness : 0;
    const midZ = roundMm(partThickness / 2, 2);

    jointSpecs.forEach((jt, idx) => {
      // Left butt-joint end (y = 0 -> cam at y = 34, edge_bottom channel at y = 0)
      holes.push(
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_cam_left_${idx}`,
          diameter: 15,
          depth: 13.5,
          x: jt.boltX,
          y: 34,
          z: camZ,
          direction: camFace,
          purpose: "minifix_cam",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_edge_bolt_left_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 34,
          x: jt.boltX,
          y: 0,
          z: midZ,
          direction: "edge_bottom",
          purpose: "minifix_bolt",
        }
      );

      // Right butt-joint end (y = height -> cam at y = height - 34, edge_top channel at y = height)
      holes.push(
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_cam_right_${idx}`,
          diameter: 15,
          depth: 13.5,
          x: jt.boltX,
          y: roundMm(height - 34, 2),
          z: camZ,
          direction: camFace,
          purpose: "minifix_cam",
        },
        {
          id: `H_${part.id}_edge_bolt_right_${idx}`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 34,
          x: jt.boltX,
          y: height,
          z: midZ,
          direction: "edge_top",
          purpose: "minifix_bolt",
        }
      );

      if (jt.dowelX !== null) {
        holes.push(
          {
            id: `H_${part.id}_edge_dowel_left_${idx}`,
            diameter: 8,
            depth: 24,
            x: jt.dowelX,
            y: 0,
            z: midZ,
            direction: "edge_bottom",
            purpose: "dowel",
          },
          {
            id: `H_${part.id}_edge_dowel_right_${idx}`,
            diameter: 8,
            depth: 24,
            x: jt.dowelX,
            y: height,
            z: midZ,
            direction: "edge_top",
            purpose: "dowel",
          }
        );
      }
    });
  }

  // 4. Doors (Kapaklar): Manufacturer-Specific Hinge Cups & Handle Holes
  else if (part.role.includes("door")) {
    const isSlidingOrLift =
      part.label.includes("Sürgülü") ||
      part.label.includes("Kalkar") ||
      part.label.includes("Tambur");

    if (!isSlidingOrLift) {
      const isLeftHinged = part.role.includes("left");
      const cupRadius = drillTpl.cupDiameterMm / 2;
      const cupCenterDist = cupRadius + drillTpl.cupEdgeTabMm;
      const cupX = roundMm(isLeftHinged ? cupCenterDist : width - cupCenterDist, 2);
      const halfBossPitch = drillTpl.bossPitchMm / 2;
      const bossOffset = drillTpl.bossOffsetMm;
      const effectiveCupDepth = part.hardwareRefId ? drillTpl.cupDepthMm : 12.5;

      const hingePositionsY =
        part.hingePositionsY && part.hingePositionsY.length > 0
          ? part.hingePositionsY
          : calculateDoorHingePositionsY(height);

      hingePositionsY.forEach((hy, idx) => {
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_hinge_cup_${idx}`,
          diameter: drillTpl.cupDiameterMm,
          depth: effectiveCupDepth,
          x: cupX,
          y: roundMm(hy, 2),
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "hinge_cup",
        });
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_hinge_screw_${idx}_a`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 11,
          x: roundMm(cupX + (isLeftHinged ? bossOffset : -bossOffset), 2),
          y: roundMm(hy - halfBossPitch, 2),
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "hinge_cup",
        });
        holes.push({
          id: `H_${part.id}_hinge_screw_${idx}_b`,
          diameter: 8,
          depth: 11,
          x: roundMm(cupX + (isLeftHinged ? bossOffset : -bossOffset), 2),
          y: roundMm(hy + halfBossPitch, 2),
          z: 0,
          direction: "face_back",
          purpose: "hinge_cup",
        });
      });
    }

    if (part.handleSpacingMm && part.handleSpacingMm > 0) {
      const isLeftHinged = part.role.includes("left");
      const handleX = isLeftHinged ? Math.max(35, width - 45) : 45;
      const centerY = Math.round(height / 2);
      const halfCc = part.handleSpacingMm / 2;
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_handle_a`,
        diameter: 5,
        depth: partThickness,
        x: handleX,
        y: Math.max(40, roundMm(centerY - halfCc, 2)),
        z: 0,
        direction: "face_front",
        purpose: "handle",
      });
      holes.push({
        id: `H_${part.id}_handle_b`,
        diameter: 5,
        depth: partThickness,
        x: handleX,
        y: Math.min(height - 40, roundMm(centerY + halfCc, 2)),
        z: 0,
        direction: "face_front",
        purpose: "handle",
      });
    }
  }

  return holes;
}

9\r\n$MENU\r\n  1\r\n.\r\n  9\r\n$ELEVATION\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$PELEVATION\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$THICKNESS\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$LIMCHECK\r\n 70\r\n0\r\n  9\r\n$CHAMFERA\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$CHAMFERB\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$CHAMFERC\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$CHAMFERD\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$SKPOLY\r\n 70\r\n0\r\n  9\r\n$TDCREATE\r\n 40\r\n2461355.6248958334\r\n  9\r\n$TDUCREATE\r\n 40\r\n2458532.153996898\r\n  9\r\n$TDUPDATE\r\n 40\r\n2461355.6248958334\r\n  9\r\n$TDUUPDATE\r\n 40\r\n2458532.1544311\r\n  9\r\n$TDINDWG\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n  9\r\n$TDUSRTIMER\r\n 40\r\n0.0\r\n     }[];
  }[];
  xmlOutputDraft: string;
  unverifiedNotes: string[];
}

function escapeXmlAttr(value: string | number | boolean): string {
  return String(value)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
}

export function generateSelcoExportPackage(
  optimizedSheets: OptimizedSheet[],
  config: SelcoMachineConfig = DEFAULT_SELCO_CONFIG
): SelcoExportPackage {
  const batchId = `SELCO_BATCH_${Date.now()}`;
  const unverifiedNotes = [
    "UNVERIFIED: Bıçak kerf değeri (4.4mm) fabrika Selco takım tablosu ile doğrulanmalıdır.",
    "UNVERIFIED: Tutucu kıskaç minimum ölçüsü (70mm) fabrika şefi tarafından onaylanmalıdır.",
    "UNVERIFIED: CIX/XML dosya yüklemesi öncesinde Selco OptiPlanning yazılımında ön izleme yapılmalıdır.",
  ];

  const sawingPatterns = optimizedSheets.map((sheet) => ({
    sheetIndex: sheet.sheetIndex,
    material: sheet.materialName,
    sheetWidth: sheet.sheetDimension.widthMm,
    sheetLength: sheet.sheetDimension.lengthMm,
    cutsCount: sheet.placedPieces.length,
    cuts: sheet.placedPieces.map((p, idx) => ({
      cutIndex: idx + 1,
      partId: p.pieceId,
      partLabel: p.pieceName,
      length: p.length,
      width: p.width,
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      rotated: p.isRotated,
    })),
  }));

  let xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n`;
  xml += `<BiesseProductionBatch id="${escapeXmlAttr(batchId)}" machine="${escapeXmlAttr(
    config.machineModel
  )}" status="UNVERIFIED_DRAFT">\n`;
  xml += `  <MachineParameters kerf="${escapeXmlAttr(
    config.sawBladeKerfMm
  )}" minGripper="${escapeXmlAttr(config.minGripperCutWidthMm)}" feedSpeed="${escapeXmlAttr(
    config.feedSpeedMPerMin
  )}"/>\n`;
  sawingPatterns.forEach((p) => {
    xml += `  <SheetPattern sheetIndex="${escapeXmlAttr(
      p.sheetIndex
    )}" material="${escapeXmlAttr(p.material)}" length="${escapeXmlAttr(
      p.sheetLength
    )}" width="${escapeXmlAttr(p.sheetWidth)}">\n`;
    p.cuts.forEach((c) => {
      xml += `    <Part pieceId="${escapeXmlAttr(c.partId)}" label="${escapeXmlAttr(
        c.partLabel
      )}" x="${escapeXmlAttr(c.x)}" y="${escapeXmlAttr(c.y)}" length="${escapeXmlAttr(
        c.length
      )}" width="${escapeXmlAttr(c.width)}" rotated="${escapeXmlAttr(c.rotated)}"/>\n`;
    });
    xml += `  </SheetPattern>\n`;
  });
  xml += `</BiesseProductionBatch>\n`;

  return {
    batchId,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    machineTarget: config.machineModel,
    status: "DRAFT_UNVERIFIED_PENDING_FACTORY_CONFIRMATION",
    sheetCount: optimizedSheets.length,
    sawingPatterns,
    xmlOutputDraft: xml,
    unverifiedNotes,
  };
}

import { CutPiece } from "./types";
import { roundMm } from "@birim/core";
import {
  runErpNesting,
  extractErpReclaimableRemnants,
  convertCutPieceToErpPartInput,
  parseErpSheetGrain,
  type ErpCutSequence,
  type ErpPlacementData,
} from "./erp-nesting";

export interface SheetDimension {
  name: string;
  lengthMm: number; // e.g. 2800 mm (X-axis along board grain)
  widthMm: number; // e.g. 2070 or 2100 mm (Y-axis across board grain)
  trimCutMm: number; // e.g. 15 mm perimeter trim
  kerfMm: number; // e.g. 4 mm saw blade thickness
}

export const STANDARD_SHEET_2800x2070: SheetDimension = {
  name: "Standart Ham/Melamin Levha 2800x2070",
  lengthMm: 2800,
  widthMm: 2070,
  trimCutMm: 15,
  kerfMm: 4.0,
};

export const STANDARD_ERP_SHEET_2800x2100: SheetDimension = {
  name: "Birim ERP Standart Levha 2800x2100",
  lengthMm: 2800,
  widthMm: 2100,
  trimCutMm: 15,
  kerfMm: 4.0,
};

export interface PlacedPiece {
  pieceId: string;
  pieceName: string;
  materialName: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number; // X extent, along sheet length (2800mm grain axis)
  length: number; // Y extent, along sheet width (2070/2100mm cross-grain axis)
  isRotated: boolean;
  edgeL1?: string;
  edgeL2?: string;
  edgeW1?: string;
  edgeW2?: string;
  hasGroove?: boolean;
  grooveSide?: string;
  grooveOffset?: number;
  grainDirection?: "horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | null;
  color?: string;
}

export interface UsableRemnantRect {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  length: number;
  areaM2: number;
}

export interface OptimizedSheet {
  sheetIndex: number;
  materialId: string;
  materialName: string;
  sheetDimension: SheetDimension;
  placedPieces: PlacedPiece[];
  usableRemnants?: UsableRemnantRect[];
  usableRemnantAreaM2?: number;
  netUsedAreaM2: number;
  totalSheetAreaM2: number;
  wasteAreaM2: number;
  wastePercent: number;
  algorithm?: string;
  sequences?: ErpCutSequence[];
  cuttingInstructions?: string[];
  erpPlacements?: ErpPlacementData[];
}

export interface NestingOptimizationResult {
  materialId: string;
  materialName: string;
  thicknessMm?: number;
  algorithm?: string;
  sheets: OptimizedSheet[];
  unplacedPieces: CutPiece[];
  totalSheetsCount: number;
  totalNetAreaM2: number;
  totalGrossAreaM2: number;
  overallWastePercent: number;
}

const nestingCache = new Map<string, NestingOptimizationResult[]>();

function computeNestingKey(
  pieces: CutPiece[],
  sheetConfig: SheetDimension,
  algorithm: "Auto" | "Guillotine" | "MaxRects"
): string {
  return JSON.stringify([sheetConfig, algorithm, pieces]);
}

/**
 * Birim ERP Nesting Motoru Tabanlı Plaka Yerleşim Optimizasyonu.
 * Konfigüratör içindeki BOM, fiyatlandırma ve plaka özetlerinin Birim ERP'deki
 * `runNesting` (`Auto` / `Guillotine` / `MaxRects`) ve `extractReclaimableRemnants`
 * motoruyla %100 aynı sonucu üretmesini sağlar.
 */
export function optimizeSheetNesting(
  pieces: CutPiece[],
  sheetConfig: SheetDimension = STANDARD_SHEET_2800x2070,
  algorithm: "Auto" | "Guillotine" | "MaxRects" = "Auto"
): NestingOptimizationResult[] {
  if (!pieces || pieces.length === 0) return [];

  const cacheKey = computeNestingKey(pieces, sheetConfig, algorithm);
  const cached = nestingCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const materialGroups = new Map<string, CutPiece[]>();
  pieces.forEach((p) => {
    const groupKey = `${p.materialId}::${p.thicknessMm}`;
    const list = materialGroups.get(groupKey) || [];
    list.push(p);
    materialGroups.set(groupKey, list);
  });

  const results: NestingOptimizationResult[] = [];
  const fullSheetAreaM2 =
    (sheetConfig.lengthMm * sheetConfig.widthMm) / 1_000_000;
  const usableW = sheetConfig.lengthMm - 2 * sheetConfig.trimCutMm;
  const usableH = sheetConfig.widthMm - 2 * sheetConfig.trimCutMm;

  materialGroups.forEach((matPieces) => {
    const matId = matPieces[0].materialId;
    const matName = matPieces[0]?.materialName || "Bilinmeyen Malzeme";
    const thicknessMm = matPieces[0]?.thicknessMm || 18;
    const sheetGrain = matPieces.some((p) => p.grain !== "none")
      ? "vertical"
      : parseErpSheetGrain(matName).grainDirection;

    const fitPieces: CutPiece[] = [];
    const unplaced: CutPiece[] = [];

    matPieces.forEach((p) => {
      const netL = p.netCutLengthMm ?? p.lengthMm;
      const netW = p.netCutWidthMm ?? p.widthMm;
      const isCross = p.grain === "crosswise";
      const reqW = isCross ? netW : netL;
      const reqH = isCross ? netL : netW;
      const canRot = p.grain === "none";

      const fitsNormal = reqW <= usableW && reqH <= usableH;
      const fitsRot = canRot && reqH <= usableW && reqW <= usableH;
      if (!fitsNormal && !fitsRot) {
        unplaced.push(p);
      } else {
        fitPieces.push(p);
      }
    });

    const converted = fitPieces.map((cp) =>
      convertCutPieceToErpPartInput(cp, {
        useNetCutDimensions: true,
        materialCode: `${matId.toUpperCase()}-${thicknessMm}MM`,
        sheetHasGrain: sheetGrain !== "none",
      })
    );

    const erpRes = runErpNesting(
      converted.map((c) => c.partInput),
      {
        width: sheetConfig.lengthMm,
        height: sheetConfig.widthMm,
        kerf: sheetConfig.kerfMm,
        margin: sheetConfig.trimCutMm,
        grain_direction: sheetGrain,
      },
      {
        algorithm,
        sawKerf: sheetConfig.kerfMm,
        kerf: sheetConfig.kerfMm,
        edgeMargin: sheetConfig.trimCutMm,
        margin: sheetConfig.trimCutMm,
        allowRotation: true,
        rotationAllowed: true,
        considerGrain: true,
        grainRule: true,
      }
    );

    let totalNetM2 = 0;
    const sheets: OptimizedSheet[] = erpRes.sheets.map((erpSheet, sIdx) => {
      const placedPieces: PlacedPiece[] = erpSheet.placements.map((pl) => {
        const idxMatch = pl.part_id.match(/^part[_-](\d+)[_-](\d+)$/);
        const origIdx = idxMatch ? Number(idxMatch[1]) : 0;
        const src = converted[origIdx]?.sourcePiece;
        const crossCanon = converted[origIdx]?.crosswiseCanonicalized ?? false;
        return {
          pieceId: src ? src.id : pl.part_id,
          pieceName: src ? src.pieceName : pl.part_label,
          materialName: matName,
          x: roundMm(pl.x, 1),
          y: roundMm(pl.y, 1),
          width: roundMm(pl.width, 1),
          length: roundMm(pl.height, 1),
          isRotated: crossCanon ? !pl.rotated : Boolean(pl.rotated),
          edgeL1: pl.edgeL1,
          edgeL2: pl.edgeL2,
          edgeW1: pl.edgeW1,
          edgeW2: pl.edgeW2,
          hasGroove: pl.hasGroove,
          grooveSide: pl.grooveSide,
          grooveOffset: pl.grooveOffset,
          grainDirection: pl.grain_direction,
          color: pl.color,
        };
      });

      const netUsedM2 = roundMm(
        placedPieces.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.width * p.length) / 1_000_000, 0),
        3
      );
      totalNetM2 += netUsedM2;
      const wasteAreaM2 = roundMm(Math.max(0, fullSheetAreaM2 - netUsedM2), 3);
      const wastePercent = roundMm((wasteAreaM2 / fullSheetAreaM2) * 100, 1);

      const erpRemnants = extractErpReclaimableRemnants(erpSheet, {
        minWidthMm: 400,
        minHeightMm: 400,
        sheetAreaMm2: sheetConfig.lengthMm * sheetConfig.widthMm,
      });
      const usableRemnants: UsableRemnantRect[] = erpRemnants.map((rm) => ({
        x: Math.round(sheetConfig.trimCutMm + rm.x_mm),
        y: Math.round(sheetConfig.trimCutMm + rm.y_mm),
        width: Math.round(rm.width_mm),
        length: Math.round(rm.height_mm),
        areaM2: roundMm(rm.area_mm2 / 1_000_000, 3),
      }));

      return {
        sheetIndex: sIdx + 1,
        materialId: matId,
        materialName: matName,
        sheetDimension: sheetConfig,
        placedPieces,
        usableRemnants,
        usableRemnantAreaM2: roundMm(
          usableRemnants.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.areaM2, 0),
          3
        ),
        netUsedAreaM2: netUsedM2,
        totalSheetAreaM2: roundMm(fullSheetAreaM2, 3),
        wasteAreaM2,
        wastePercent,
        algorithm: erpRes.algorithm,
        sequences: erpSheet.sequences,
        cuttingInstructions: erpSheet.cuttingInstructions,
        erpPlacements: erpSheet.placements,
      };
    });

    const totalGrossM2 = roundMm(sheets.length * fullSheetAreaM2, 3);
    const overallWastePercent =
      totalGrossM2 > 0
        ? roundMm(((totalGrossM2 - totalNetM2) / totalGrossM2) * 100, 1)
        : 0;

    results.push({
      materialId: matId,
      materialName: matName,
      thicknessMm,
      algorithm: erpRes.algorithm,
      sheets,
      unplacedPieces: unplaced,
      totalSheetsCount: sheets.length,
      totalNetAreaM2: roundMm(totalNetM2, 3),
      totalGrossAreaM2: totalGrossM2,
      overallWastePercent,
    });
  });

  if (nestingCache.size >= 32) {
    const oldestKey = nestingCache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldestKey) nestingCache.delete(oldestKey);
  }
  nestingCache.set(cacheKey, results);

  return results;
}
